tt44568661.name: Bigg Boss Malayalam: Agnipareeksha
tt44568661.description: Bigg Boss Agnipariksha is a Malayalam reality television spin-off that airs on JioHotstar as a prequel to Bigg Boss Malayalam. The series follows a group of 40 ordinary contestants who face physical, mental and social challenges to earn a coveted spot inside the Bigg Boss Malayalam house. Throughout the competition, the contestants are tested on their resilience, teamwork, leadership, adaptability and decision-making under pressure. Each challenge forces them to prove their personality, determination and ability to handle the intense environment associated with the Bigg Boss format. As the competition progresses, only the strongest and most deserving participants will get the chance to become official contestants in the upcoming season of Bigg Boss Malayalam.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Grand Launch
videos.overview: The commoners enter Agnipareeksha, ready to face bold challenges and impress the judges. Who will survive the test and move closer to the Bigg Boss house?

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: A Face-Off Over the Selection
videos.overview: 20 contestants confront the judges over the first 20 selections, raising tough questions and triggering a heated debate over the verdicts.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: The First Test Begins
videos.overview: Mohanlal welcomes all 40 contestants with a powerful Bigg Boss message as four teams enter their first Agnipareeksha, where unexpected turns await them.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Stage Battle Ends in Strict Action
videos.overview: Relay task quickly turns into an ugly fight on stage. After inappropriate behaviour, the contestants face tough consequences.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Bitter Moments and a Shocking
videos.overview: The yum & yuck task pushes contestants to their absolute limits. Intense reactions and tense moments, lead to an unexpected and shocking elimination.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Infinity Pendant Turns Tables
videos.overview: Four teams face off in high stake tasks while infinity pendant holders claim big perks. Who all will survive this chaos and secure their spot?

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Tears, Truths, and High Thrills
videos.overview: A perfect mix of high stakes action and pure excitement today. Personal stories bring contestants to tears before the explosive glasses task kicks off.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Two Special Guests Onstage
videos.overview: Fan favorites Rajith Kumar and Veena Nair judge an explosive showdown! Tension rises and energy peaks as contestants push their limits to survive the ultimate Agnipareeksha.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Nadira and Cereena Join the Drama
videos.overview: Guest judges Nadira and Cereena bring star power to an unforgettable night! A contestant's painful story leaves everyone in tears before the intense competition resumes.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Eviction Nominations
videos.overview: A wild emoji mind game puts contestants to test. The Puke and Kiss emoji task creates rift between the them, while the eviction nomination raises tension.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: A Day of Surprises
videos.overview: An intense rope game pushes contestants into a chaotic battle. Unexpected twists raise the stakes, while the judges unveil a game-changing reward.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Onam Celebrations and Fun Games
videos.overview: The contestants celebrate Onam with grand laughter, and high-spirited games. As everyone come together for the festive cheer, they create some unforgettable moments.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: The Judges Walkout
videos.overview: Trust shatters and chaos takes over during a fiery color game. Alliances break down, leading to a dramatic walkout which leaves everyone speechless.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Friendships Put to Test
videos.overview: The contestants are pushed to their limits when competition takes precedence over friendship. Unexpected reactions and explosive moments builds on the drama

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: The Circle of Trust
videos.overview: Guest judges Kutty Akhil and Suchithra bring high-energy entertainment. However the contestants face a check on their strategies, loyalties and game spirit.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Guests Arrive with Mystery Boxes
videos.overview: Kidilam Firoz and Poli Firoz enter with mysterious surprise boxes and exciting twists unfold. Intense drama and hilarious moments bring thrilling suspense in the house.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Wild Talent Meet Extreme Tasks
videos.overview: Contestants are pushed to their breaking point in a brutal task. Before resetting the mood with thrilling talent acts, the stage is filled with non-stop drama and high-energy excit

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Contestants Gets Roasted
videos.overview: A suspenseful nomination task uncovers hidden faces and motives. As the contestants go through a brutal roasting session, they turn on their self-defense mode.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: A Doll Game Packed With Twists
videos.overview: A simple doll game spirals into anxiety and unexpected twists. Subsequently, the stage comes alive with stunning talent performances and unlimited entertainment.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Two Task, One Intense Battle
videos.overview: A quirky medicine task brings sarcasm and laughter. Later, a tricky satin cloth challenge pushes strategy and competition to the limit.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: The Great Character Swap
videos.overview: Laughter takes over as contestants mimic each other with sarcasm and hilarious impersonations. The thrilling roll-on game packed with fun raises the bar.

videos.title: Agnipareeksha: Finale Fight To Join BB House
videos.overview: High tension at the Grand Finale! With eviction looming, finalists battle through laughter and drama for a life changing spot inside the Bigg Boss house.

tt44145365.name: Aakali Rajyam
tt44145365.description: Three friends, one fresh start, and a life full of unexpected challenges. As job struggles, money problems, and personal battles push them to the edge, can their friendship and a bold new dream change their lives?

videos.title: Episode 01
videos.overview: Meet Ramesh, Akshay, and Aruna as they navigate friendship, work, family, and the struggles of everyday life. What happens when their comfort zone is suddenly put to the test?

videos.title: Episode 02
videos.overview: With pressure building and new opportunities on the horizon, the trio finds themselves making choices that could change everything. But can they keep it all together?

videos.title: Episode 03
videos.overview: Friendship faces its first real test as things don't go quite as planned. Will the trio find a way through the chaos and discover a new path forward?

videos.title: Episode 04
videos.overview: A fresh beginning comes with its own set of challenges as the friends step into unfamiliar territory. Can their big idea survive the realities standing in its way?

videos.title: Episode 05
videos.overview: As personal struggles pull the friends in different directions, their dream faces another setback. Can they stay together when life starts pulling them in different directions?

videos.title: Episode 06
videos.overview: When their dreams seem out of reach, an unexpected opportunity brings fresh hope. Can the trio finally turn their idea into a future of their own?

tt43715856.name: Objection, My Lord!
tt43715856.description: A father burns himself alive outside the Hyderabad High Court, demanding justice for his missing daughter, Sameera. When the system moves on and forgets, one question remains.Did Sameera ever exist? A forgotten lawyer, Parshuram, is forced out of self imposed exile to fight for the answer.

videos.title: Flames of justice
videos.overview: Impacted by Narayana's suicide, a former lawyer faces his past and returns to the court for justice.

videos.title: Sparks of Change
videos.overview: ​Uncovering flaws in the system, Parashuram and Vedha race against time to gather evidence.

videos.title: The Breaking Point
videos.overview: ​Parashuram fights in court while Vedha faces personal pressure and finds a key witness, Lakshmi.

videos.title: Surmount the Challenge
videos.overview: ​Parashuram exposes procedural flaws and a fake identity in court, shifting the course of the case.

videos.title: The Hunt for Truth
videos.overview: Vedha is attacked while pursuing a lead to trace Sameera, prompting Parashuram to step up his game.

videos.title: The Concealed Reality
videos.overview: ​Parashuram's past comes to light. Vedha saves him from a trap, enabling him to locate Sameera.

videos.title: The Truth Unveiled ​
videos.overview: Parashuram exposes the conspiracy in a tense courtroom battle while a decoy gets Sameera to safety.

tt21908550.name: Vadhandhi
tt21908550.description: Vivek, a diligent cop, takes charge of the investigation of the murder of a beautiful young girl, Velonie. The rumours about her that spring up post her death threatens to irrevocably damage Velonie's image, Vivek must wade through a web of half-truths and confusing leads to solve the case.

tt39182415.name: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket
tt39182415.description: A washed-up PT teacher, a legendary coach and a generation of misfit students come together to save a legacy.

videos.title: First Innings
videos.overview: Rangan, once a celebrated cricket hero, is now working as a PT instructor. Rukmani, the head of MNCA, hopes that new batch of players will help restore the academy’s legacy.

videos.title: Campus Oath
videos.overview: The juniors take a tour of the academy. Coach Natraj warns to adhere to discipline when the boys’ team returns from a disqualified match. Hostel nights reveal ragging antics.

videos.title: Morning Runs
videos.overview: Coaches Natraj and Selvam test the players' diving skills and patience after they face Rukmani’s fury for being late. Rukmani battles threats that could shut the academy forever.

videos.title: Ghost Practice
videos.overview: Falling for the seniors’ ghost tale, the juniors dare each other to pre-dawn practice. Rishi impresses at the nets, making Velu jealous. Mani, Thangam and Theo’s bond gets strong.

videos.title: Dream Wakeup
videos.overview: Rukmani faces the MNCA’s sponsors who warn about Matheyan’s uncontrolled anger. A fight in the canteen creates cracks between the juniors and seniors. Mani dreams about Thangam.

videos.title: Footwork and Footwear
videos.overview: Matheyan and Jackie help Mani make a video to impress his dad and get money to buy shoes for Thangam. An astrologer predicts that someone from Rangan’s past will reenter his life.

videos.title: Hidden Torture
videos.overview: Seniors turn training into bullying, masked as combined drills, leaving Veera terrified. Thangam’s breakthrough in bowling is hidden by strong family pressure to get married.

videos.title: Revenge Storm
videos.overview: Veera’s gangster father storms MNCA over ragging, forcing Rukmani into a public apology. Rajasekar’s inspection ends with a brutal shutdown threat, and he now vows revenge.

videos.title: Mani’s Mission
videos.overview: Mani confronts Rukmani about the academy shutting down. Rukmani exposes Rajasekar’s drug expulsion past. Thangam and Rishi worry about their parents’ decision about the academy.

videos.title: Pair Up Pressure
videos.overview: Theo and Matheyan form senior-junior training pairs. Rangan takes Mani to spy on Anchor Cricket Academy’s high-tech facilities. A kitchen disaster brings Rishi and Thangam closer.

videos.title: Hidden Feelings
videos.overview: Rukmani is shaken by Rajasekar’s threats. Preparations for the 50th-year alumni gala begin. Mani hides his feelings for Thangam while Rukmani sets to train young Valli in cricket.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Rangan is shocked to see Thangam’s photo among his marriage proposals. Thangam’s growing discomfort around Rangan leads to accusations and outrage and everyone turns against him.

videos.title: Mistakes and Misfires
videos.overview: Shattered by Rukmani's mistrust, Rangan nearly quits cricket, but his aunt persuades him to return only to face cold stares. Rukmani later apologises for overreacting.

videos.title: Golden Jubilee Begins
videos.overview: As the event unfolds, excitement masks rising tensions. Mani lifts Thangam's spirits. Velu's bid to rejoin the team backfires, leading to a clash that Theo halts.

videos.title: Shadows of the Past
videos.overview: Thulasi's speech revives a painful past tied to Rangan. Shaken by the memories, Rangan retreats. Rukmani finds him and together they step forward to face Thulasi and the truth.

videos.title: Rangan’s Return
videos.overview: Rukmani firmly shuts Rajasekar down. A tense match sees Velu steady the students until Rangan joins and turns it around. The alumni win, but the academy begins to heal.

videos.title: Unspoken Wounds
videos.overview: As alumni celebrate Rangan's return, Thangam seethes in silence. Amid cricket talks with the management, Rangan mentions players now battle inner struggles more than the game.

videos.title: The Weight of the Past
videos.overview: Flashbacks reveal Rangan's fall, a former Ranji captain silenced for opposing injustice. Thulasi introduces a new MNCA scheme. Rangan and Thulasi silently acknowledge their past.

videos.title: Lines of Trust
videos.overview: When allegations arise against Rangan, Thulasi ensures fairness. Thangam bravely reveals her fear came from family pressure, while Rangan maintains a calm demeanour in response.

videos.title: Open Challenge
videos.overview: Thangam defends Rangan, while others oppose him. Thulasi and Rukmani plan to save the academy. A cricket match brings peace until Girish and Matheyan ignite a rivalry.

videos.title: Cracks in Between
videos.overview: Unresolved tension leads to emotional fallout as Mani's jealousy erupts publicly. Meanwhile, Thulasi and Rangan find unexpected comfort in cricket, uncovering past truths.

videos.title: Inner Battle
videos.overview: Thangam tries to reconcile the differences between Rishi and the boys’ team, but they refuse to heed her words. Meanwhile, Rishi contemplates transferring to another school.

videos.title: Unstable Ground
videos.overview: Selvam's dismissal plunges the academy into chaos, with Natraj managing both teams. Meanwhile, Rukmani and Rangan uncover sexism and ego during the replacement search.

videos.title: Crossing the Boundary
videos.overview: What starts as a bold underground match quickly descends into open conflict, leading to chaos and violence. Rangan arrives just in time to prevent history from repeating itself.

videos.title: Anger Beneath Bruises
videos.overview: Girish fails to threaten Rangan. Rishi doubts himself as Girish provokes him. Rangan hides the injured boys from Ms. Rukmani. Jackie blames Rishi, but the juniors defend him.

videos.title: Damage Control
videos.overview: The girls hide the boy's wounds, but tension grows when Rukmani sees Rishi bruised. Rangan protects the team despite suspicion. Away from the academy, Rangan confides in Thulasi.

videos.title: Dreams, Doubts and a Blowback
videos.overview: A counselling session uncovers the dreams of the students as well as Rishi’s feelings. Motivated by Thulasi, Rangan offers support to the students and gains Rukmani’s trust.

videos.title: They Are My Team
videos.overview: Rangan defends his students against misleading police evidence. Theo’s video unveils the truth, yet the damage persists. Natraj storms out in anger, and Rukmini distrusts Rangan.

videos.title: Fault Lines
videos.overview: Rangan officially steps in as the coach, but Padma openly rejects him. Natraj’s harsh words humiliate Mani targeting his friendship with Theo. Mani discovers scars on Rishi’s hand.

videos.title: Pressure Points
videos.overview: Girish faces Rajasekar’s anger over fake evidence. Thulasi encourages Rangan. While Thangam thinks Mani is in love with Theo, Vinay confronts Rukmani over Rishi’s safety.

videos.title: Hidden Battles
videos.overview: Mani fakes illness to escape the academy ground. He learns about Rishi's hidden struggles and his reluctance toward an acting career imposed by his dad. A bond forms between them.

videos.title: Midnight Panic and Confessions
videos.overview: Thangam, Matheyan and others search desperately for Mani as he lies drunk on Rishi’s terrace. Next day, on the ground, Mani explodes, confessing his love for a stunned Thangam.

videos.title: Shifts and Challenges
videos.overview: Mani feels anxious remembering his argument with Thangam. Rishi faces his dad’s pressure to leave cricket. Rangam changes the batting order, facing the wrath of Padma.

videos.title: Voices Under Noise
videos.overview: Theo turns to Matheyan for advice with the girls’ team. At the nets, Rangan’s intense drills test focus and adaptability. Theo calmly guides Padma. Rishi confesses his fear.

videos.title: Silent Drift
videos.overview: Thangam worries about her growing feelings for Mani. Rangan seeks Rukmani’s approval for new players. Rishi confides in her about his dad’s plan. Theo and Matheyan share a moment.

videos.title: One Last Chance
videos.overview: Seeing Valli secretly practicing, Rangan recognises her natural reflexes and determination. Mani pleads with Vinay to give Rishi one chance. Thangam decides to stay away from Mani.

videos.title: Closed Gates
videos.overview: When Rukmani and the principal can't help Rangan to have Valli join the girls’ team, he contacts Thulasi. While Rishi pushes Mani to focus on cricket, the girls doubt Theo’s moves.

videos.title: Unsaid Feelings
videos.overview: Thulasi proposes a scheme to Rangan to legitimise Valli’s entry into the team. Rishi trains Mani. Theo and Matheyan sneak out to celebrate his birthday and confess their feelings.

videos.title: Surface Fractures
videos.overview: During a midnight ride, Theo and Matheyan nearly hit a drunken woman. Later, Rangan introduces Valli to the girls' team, which provokes resistance from most of the team members.

videos.title: Shifting Bonds
videos.overview: Padma suspects Valli manipulated her way onto the team, but Rangan supports her. Later, Rishi guides Mani through each ball in a practice match.

videos.title: Gossip and Revelations
videos.overview: Valli endures harsh mockery regarding her background, which also impacts her father. Although she contemplates quitting, Rangan refuses to allow her to give up.

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: Natraj reveals the final lineup and surprises the boys with a celebratory meal. As unity grows, Matheyan confides in Theo about Natraj’s emotionally charged coaching style.

videos.title: Unsteady Minds
videos.overview: Thangam tells Rangan about Valli's poor practice. Theo and Mani have a disagreement from misunderstandings about their friendship, while Thangam remains unfocused during the match.

videos.title: Choices Left Unspoken
videos.overview: Thangam, confused by her emotions, explores love online and eventually opens up to Theo. Meanwhile, Mani decides the best way to cope with his intense feelings is to bury them.

videos.title: Terrace Party
videos.overview: Mani tells everyone he moved on from love to friendship with Thangam. He tricks everyone, including Varsha, into attending a party by falsely stating that it is Rishi's birthday.

videos.title: Viral Turn
videos.overview: The boys struggle in practice after the party and Nataraj punishes them. To showcase Valli's talent, Rangan records her and posts a social media clip that quickly gains attention.

videos.title: Rising Tensions
videos.overview: News of an NRI-funded fellowship by Dhoorai sparks rivalry in the academy. The girls tease Rangan about Thulasi, while Rukmani hints she knows about them, making Thulasi shy away.

videos.title: Night Unravels
videos.overview: Shaken after the practice match, Rishi battles anxiety triggered by Nataraj. Rangan's first visit to Thulasi's house turns tense during an unexpected talk with her grandfather.

videos.title: Unseen War
videos.overview: Rangan and Thulasi spend time together and she talks about her life with Rajeev. Natraj vows payback after a drunk Rishi attacks his house and hurts him.

videos.title: Silent Pressure
videos.overview: Rajasekar realises the flaw in his academy. While Natraj targets Rishi, Padma’s selfish gameplay creates cracks in the team. Mani meets Thangam’s parents and wins their trust.

videos.title: Sudden Arrival
videos.overview: Rishi is shaken by the harsh realities of class divide between students. Rangan’s bold call on field leaves Padma shaken. Matheyan panics when his mother arrives at the academy.

videos.title: Facing Nightmare
videos.overview: Seeing his drunk mother, Matheyan fears his nightmare may come true. While Theo becomes his anchor, Rangan confronts Natraj and declares that he will stand as Matheyan’s guardian

videos.title: Tournament Heat
videos.overview: At an event, Rangan's return is celebrated, but Natraj becomes increasingly insecure. Later, Matheyan feels shattered when Natraj publicly removes him as team captain.

videos.title: Beginning of the Battle
videos.overview: On the field, MNCA starts strong, but Natraj’s provocation hurts Matheyan. MNCA faces a crushing defeat. Rangan helps Matheyan confront his pain. Rukmani faces Rajasekar’s taunts

videos.title: Fear to Fire
videos.overview: Padma discourages the girls, but Theo shuts her down. MNCA's nerves show early. Despite doubts, Rangan shifts focus to strategy, backing his bowlers and trusting their instincts.

videos.title: Falling Apart
videos.overview: Velu ignores Matheyan’s suggestion. Rishi chooses to fight his battle. Rukmani confronts Natraj for benching Rishi, his poor decisions and rigid leadership that cost MNCA heavily.

videos.title: Narrow Loss
videos.overview: As pressure builds before a crucial game, the MNCA boys struggle while the girls deliver a win. Rukmani intervenes in Natraj's decisions, restoring team balance but angering him.

videos.title: Momentum Shift
videos.overview: Just when the boys think their journey is over, Rangan shows Matheyan a slim chance to qualify. Matheyan then reshapes the batting order, despite Natraj's resistance.

videos.title: Silent Sabotage
videos.overview: As the MNCA boys' hopes rest on Anchor's results, Girish plays a calculated game, benching his main players. Meanwhile, in the girls' camp, Padma returns with a change of heart.

videos.title: Against the Odds
videos.overview: Natraj loses his authority and vents his frustrations on the team. He humiliates Matheyan, leading Rukmani to dismiss him. Rangan steps in to assist them.

videos.title: Interrupted Moments
videos.overview: During a group photo, Theo spots Rangan and Thulasi holding hands. Rishi’s father is happy with his success. Rangan and Thulasi share a moment, but Rukmani’s call interrupts them.

videos.title: Rukmani's Treat
videos.overview: Rukmani takes the teams for a celebratory dinner. While Rishi flirts with Varsha, Theo exposes Rangan’s secret. As Thangam tries to confess to Mani, a message from Anu stuns all.

videos.title: Rumours and Rivalries
videos.overview: With no coach for the boys' team, debates over Natraj and Rangan spark clashes. Meanwhile, Thangam grows jealous of Mani's date, with Rishi and Theo secretly stirring trouble.

videos.title: Shift in Bonds
videos.overview: Rumours swirl about Rangan and Thulasi, leaving them unsettled. Mani's approaching date fuels Thangam's restlessness, pushing her to finally confess her love.

videos.title: Awkward Beginnings
videos.overview: The boys learn of Thangam's confession to Mani and spread it across the academy. Mani struggles to cope with the news. Meanwhile, Rangan and Thulasi hesitate to text each other.

videos.title: Date Plan
videos.overview: Matheyan devises a plan to ease Mani's and Thangam's awkwardness. Meanwhile, on the field, Padma's growing isolation leads to emotional outbursts.

videos.title: Unsteady Hearts
videos.overview: Padma’s sudden move to Anchor shocks the MNCA team, and they feel betrayed. Rangan’s reunion with Dharani helps him release past guilt. Thulasi worries about Rajeev’s threats.

videos.title: Triple Date
videos.overview: The triple date begins with excitement for Rishi, Varsha, Mani, Thangam, Theo, and Matheyan. Each relationship finds its rhythm, turning unspoken emotions into something real.

videos.title: Love and Leverage
videos.overview: Rangan helps Matheyan to strengthen their bond. While Padma faces isolation and backlash in her new environment, a viral post turns Thulasi and Rangan’s lives into controversy.

videos.title: Silent Battles
videos.overview: Rishi asks Matheyan support Rangan through the ongoing controversy. Thulasi faces pressure from the media and her party. Padma begins to feel the emotional cost of her decision.

videos.title: Cracks Beneath the Calm
videos.overview: Rishi accepts calmly when Varsha decides to leave the academy. Rangan and Rukmani realise Rajasekar is behind the rumours. While Thulasi faces pressure, Girish targets Matheyan.

videos.title: Lines Crossed
videos.overview: Rajiv’s video as Thulasi’s supportive husband gains sympathy. Matheyan confronts Girish for targeting his mother, while Rangan faces Rajasekhar and declares his stand for Thulasi.

videos.title: New Year Break
videos.overview: Matheyan struggles with his feelings about his mother. Rukmani calmly manages tensions, advising Rangan. She announces a New Year break to help everyone regain clarity and reset.

videos.title: Holiday Begins
videos.overview: Love finds room to grow for Mani and Thangam during the break. Theo brings a nervous Matheyan to her home and introduces him to her parents.

videos.title: Love Under Pressure
videos.overview: Thangam lies to her mother and leaves for Mani's house. At Theo's house, Matheyan faces parental inquisition about his parents, making him uncomfortable and Theo furious.

videos.title: Between Holding and Losing
videos.overview: Matheyan's deep fear of rejection surfaces during a tense exchange with Theo, making her confront her parents. Thangam's mother realises she is hiding something and warns her.

videos.title: Strength and Silence
videos.overview: Despite Mani's concern and meddling, Matheyan and Theo struggle with their circumstances. Rangan introduces new training methods to the boys' team.

videos.title: The Counter Move
videos.overview: Baskar comes prepared with his complaints, but Thulasi is way ahead when she presents video proof. However, Rajasekar has another plan up his sleeve, thanks to Girish.

videos.title: Where Hearts Drift
videos.overview: Rangan anticipates Rajasekhar's move and has a plan prepared. Triggered by the Anchor boys, a casual game at the local ground turns unpleasant as pride curdles into insecurity.

videos.title: The Distance Between Us
videos.overview: A light-hearted moment spirals when Jackie takes offence to a casual remark. Rangan attempts to restore unity, but miscommunication and bruised egos continue to widen the rift.

videos.title: When Control Slips
videos.overview: Tensions explode as Matheyan hits Jackie in front of everyone, leaving both teams shaken. Matheyan later feels guilty, while Jackie is torn between anger and humiliation.

videos.title: Cracks Deepen
videos.overview: Burdened by team issues, Rangan finds clarity from Thulasi. He helps Matheyan face his family struggles and problems with Jackie, urging resolution over avoidance.

videos.title: What Still Matters
videos.overview: Thulasi and Rangan enjoy playful moments together in Chennai. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the boys at the academy despite the girls' efforts to help.

videos.title: Rangan's Challenge
videos.overview: Matheyan visits his mother at a bar, and she promises to quit drinking. At the academy, the seniors accuse Rangan of favouritism, and his challenge leaves him in shock.

videos.title: Healing and Breaking
videos.overview: Rangan reveals that the girls versus boys match is a strategy to push unity among boys. While Mani isolates himself, ignoring Thangam, Matheyan prepares his mother for rehab.

videos.title: Emotion vs Ego
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam try to outperform each other during practice. Hurt turns into determination when the girls realise the boys are looking down on them.

videos.title: Mind Over Momentum
videos.overview: The girls begin intense training to secure a victory over the boys. Meanwhile, the boys' team faces challenges due to changes and instability within the team.

videos.title: Deal with Divide
videos.overview: Amid the challenges faced by the boys' team and their ongoing conflict with the girls' team, Mani receives an offer from Velu. Will this proposal disrupt or resolve the conflict?

videos.title: The Cost of Pride
videos.overview: As the girls thrive on unity and leadership, the boys struggle to find common ground. Will teamwork triumph, or will the boys rise above their differences?

videos.title: Last Ball, Last Chance
videos.overview: The girls win against the odds, while the boys face the consequences of their mistakes. Mani and Thangam reconcile, but Thangam's possessiveness sparks tension with Anu.

videos.title: When Everything Falls Apart
videos.overview: Matheyan and Jackie put their differences aside and reunite, surprising everyone. Meanwhile, Anu's world is turned upside down by a sudden expulsion from Anchor Academy.

videos.title: Dreams or Duty?
videos.overview: Anu starts a new chapter at MNCA as Theo feels jealous about her arrival. Rishi makes the difficult decision to quit cricket to support his father through a financial crisis.

videos.title: Between Missing and Moving On
videos.overview: The academy struggles to move on after Rishi's departure. When exam dates are announced, cricket takes a backseat. Meanwhile, Thulasi heads into a crucial divorce hearing.

videos.title: When Silence Hurts
videos.overview: Exam pressure replaces cricket. The juniors desperately search for study notes and help. Thulasi's divorce hearing takes a major setback when Rajeev refuses a mutual separation.

videos.title: Preparation and Crisis
videos.overview: Velu orders the seniors to not help the juniors, but two of them ignore him. Rangan receives a golden opportunity, but the situation gets worse for his beloved MNCA and Rukmani.

videos.title: MNCA Under Threat
videos.overview: As Rangan hunts for sponsors, the MNCA crisis snowballs, leading to a meeting with the trustees. Anu and Jackie bond over physics, creating tension between Mani and Thangam.

videos.title: Renewed Hope
videos.overview: The exams finally arrive. Thangam receives good news, which becomes a welcome respite for the academy. Rukmani begins accepting MNCA's possible end, but Rangan stays hopeful.

videos.title: Costly Clash
videos.overview: Theo's parents visit her at the academy, but she misunderstands their intentions. While Rangan gives a tour to a potential investor, an unwelcome sight greets them.

videos.title: Love in Fragments
videos.overview: Matheyan rejoices as his mother slowly returns to her old self. At the advertisement shoot, Thangam and Girish grow closer, stirring jealousy in Mani.

videos.title: Weight of Staying
videos.overview: Anu steals the spotlight in a practice match, leaving Thangam jealous, especially as Mani cheers for her. Elsewhere, Rangan is shaken upon learning about the attack on Thulasi.

videos.title: Under Evaluation
videos.overview: Rangan spends a restless night, troubled by the unachievable condition he imposed on the Chennai club. Later, Matheyan is deeply unsettled by his mother's unexpected health scare.

videos.title: Before Impact
videos.overview: Rukmani shocks Rangan by deciding to sell MNCA's assets. Meanwhile, competition drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu, while Anu and Thangam clash openly on the field.

videos.title: Hearts Start to Align
videos.overview: As tensions build across the academy, personal bonds start affecting the game. Rangan reveals the funding deal with Chennai Club to Rukmani and later shares it with Thulasi.

videos.title: Shifting Equations
videos.overview: Thangam confronts Mani over his lies, straining their relationship. Kalyani collapses during practice and shocks Rangan by revealing that she is pregnant.

videos.title: Choice Within
videos.overview: As Kalyani faces an unexpected pregnancy and a life-changing choice, Rangan helps her find her answer. Meanwhile, growing selection pressure drives a wedge between Mani and Pandu.

videos.title: Shift in Play
videos.overview: Kalyani's absence leaves the girls' team struggling. Mani's growing insecurity over Girish drives a wedge between him and Thangam, hurting both their relationship and their game.

videos.title: Words That Hurt
videos.overview: As Kalyani's departure weighs heavily on Rangan, he lashes out at Thulasi. Her emotional distress quickly becomes the subject of discussion at her workplace.

videos.title: Practice, Pressure, Promises
videos.overview: Worried the academy is nearing its end, Matheyan plans a surprise proposal for Theo with Mani and Thangam's help. But Matheyan's bike crashes, leaving her with a knee injury.

videos.title: Parallel Hearts
videos.overview: After Matheyan's proposal, he and Theo revel in their new relationship, while Mani and Thangam fight. The academy travels to Chennai for its most significant challenge yet.

videos.title: One Team, Many Battles
videos.overview: Rangan mocks the team's low spirits, but Theo stands by them and tries to light up the mood. A stop at a Dhaba turns chaotic as a clash with Anchor Academy erupts into a fight.

videos.title: Her Birthday, His Forever
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam decide not to speak until the tournament ends. Rangan's birthday proposal plans for Thulasi take an unexpected turn after Rajeev humiliates them.

videos.title: Beyond the Game
videos.overview: Jackie uncovers MNCA's financial crisis and Rangan's secret sacrifice for the academy. Meanwhile, disaster strikes as Theo suffers a serious knee injury, ruling her out for weeks.

videos.title: Out of Sync
videos.overview: Anu's surprise captaincy takes a tense turn when a crucial call involving Thangam sparks misunderstandings between the two. Later, Rajasekhar's taunts rile up Rangan and Rukmani.

videos.title: Double Pressure
videos.overview: A sudden schedule shake-up catches the MNCA girl's off guard. Clashing egos and crumbling teamwork push the boys to the edge against Madurai Hawks.

videos.title: What Makes a Team
videos.overview: MNCA's internal conflict costs them another match, revealing Rangan's fierce side. Matheyan's and Rangan's guidance encourages the team to confront their egos and insecurities.

videos.title: Us vs Them
videos.overview: Rangan motivates the teams. With the chase collapsing, Matheyan delivers a breathtaking win and takes MNCA into the quarterfinals. Amid celebrations, Jackie gets devastating news.

videos.title: The Quarter-Final Storm
videos.overview: Mani and Thangam's relationship reaches a painful breaking point. The girls fight through a tense quarterfinal. On the boys' side, Mani's early exit intensifies the pressure.

videos.title: When Life Demands More
videos.overview: Theo receives clearance to rejoin the girls' team as captain. Disaster strikes when Jackie learns Matheyan's mother is in critical condition, forcing Matheyan to rush home.

videos.title: Unsaid Goodbyes
videos.overview: Just before the finals, Matheyan faces the darkest moment of his life. Although Rangan stands by him through this tough time, panic spreads when Matheyan suddenly goes missing.

videos.title: A Legacy Reborn
videos.overview: Despite Matheyan's disappearance, Rangan pushes the team forward, reminding them what's at stake. Meanwhile, Matheyan fulfils his late mother's last wish on her birthday.

tt14635500.name: Brothers-in-Law
tt14635500.description: Aliyans (Brothers-in-Law) is a hit Malayalam sitcom on Kaumudy TV, directed by Rajesh Thalachira. It premiered on February 24, 2020, as a sequel to Aliyan vs Aliyan (Brother-in-Law vs Brother-in-Law). Set in Thiruvananthapuram, the show follows Ratnamma and her family, centering on the love-hate dynamic between brothers-in-law Kanakan and Cleatus. Most episodes revolve around Cleatus landing in trouble thanks to his quirky ideas, with Kanakan often stepping in to save the day.

videos.title: The Story Goes Like This
videos.overview: Aliyans is a family comedy sitcom of Kaumudy TV. Its about the love - hate relationship between two brother-in-laws and their families. Aneesh Ravi, Soumya Bhagyananthan, Riyas Narmakala, Manju Pathrose, Sethulekshmi, Binoj Kulathoor, Mani Shornur and Akshayamol. Aliyans is directed by Rajesh Thalachira.

videos.title: Search for Cleatus
videos.overview: When a Sheikh from Dubai comes in search of Cleatus, everyone starts believing that Cleatus has messed up something in Dubai and the Sheikh is after his life. How will Cleatus save himself from the Sheikh? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Kanakan Gets the Chit Funds
videos.overview: Kanakan tells Lilly and Thankam that based on the lucky draw, he has won the Chit Funds. But as soon as they come to know about it, they ask for their share to fulfill their wishes. Helpless Kanakan couldn't refuse but shared with them. Later a man visits Kanakan to ask for some money, but will Lilly and Thankam give up on their share to help the man? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Jasmine Flowers
videos.overview: After much pondering, Thambi finally finds a new job, but he hides it from her wife, Sulu, saying that he has got a job but didn't reveal where he has got the job. Sulu suspects that her husband, Thambi is having an extra-marital affair which makes her heavily disappointed as she gets a scent of Jasmine flowers from Thambi's shirt. Is Thambi really having an extra-marital affair? Find out to know more.

videos.title: The Speech
videos.overview: Takkuddu tells his mother that he has got a chance to give a speech in his school. On hearing this, his mom gets annoyed and stops talking to him till the time he backs off from giving the speech. Later Thankam's brother and his wife consoles her and pacifies her. Takkudu tells his mom that he removed his name from the list. What happens next? Find out to know more.

videos.title: Service Co-operation Bank Lilly
videos.overview: Thambi visits Lilly and gives her some money to keep it safe with her as she thinks that her wife, Sulu will spend all his earned money which he had earned from his acting classes, till Thambi asks for it. Later, Lilly gives that money to Kanakan to help his friend, Suresh, for his child's medical expenses. Later Thambi visits Lilly and asks for his money back as he has to give it to repay the loan which he took from a moneylender. Now what will Lilly do? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Kanakan's Ooty Trip
videos.overview: Ronald receives a message from Kanakan saying that he and his friends have been arrested by the Tamil Nadu Police for partying with a few girls in a hotel room in Ooty. He shares this news from Girirajan but hides it from the other family members. Later Thankam learns the truth from Ronald after getting at his back and consoles Lilly after informing her. After a while, Kanakan returns from the trip, but all are angry on him. What's the truth? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Fight for the Set Saree
videos.overview: Thankam and Girija, both of them selected the same few set sarees which were gifted to Ratnamma, because of which, they had an argument. Now the men of the house have decided to convince both of them to wear the set sarees or else Ratnamma had decide to donate it to Orphanage. Will the men succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Girija's Chain Goes Missing
videos.overview: Ronald asks for some money from Thankam which she refuses to give. Later Ronald visits Ratnamma thinking that she might agree to give money but is a bit doubtful. Later when he comes to know that Amma is getting ready to collect pension from the bank, that's when he agrees to join her. Meanwhile Girija keeps the chain on the table of her room and goes to take bath. After returning, she notices that her chain goes missing and later calls Lilly and Thankam to search for it. Thankam raises doubt that Ronald might have stolen it to get some hard cash in exchange of that. Does her suspicion come out to be true? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Fear of Girija's Anger
videos.overview: Ronald informs Thankam that Girirajan felt unconscious and has been sent to the hospital. On return, they informed the family members that it was due to weakness and so they suggested him to do a few physical exercises. Girirajan refuses but Girija warns him that if he doesn't follow, she will impose stricter restrictions on him. Later Girija finds a stick in Girirajan's shirt's pocket which later Lilly identifies it as a smoke weed. What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Men of Kerala Association
videos.overview: Ronald has plans to start an association having all the men of Kerala who are tired of their wife's tantrum and his association aims to solve the problems of the men. Will he succeed in this movement? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Who Gets to Have the Dosa Pan?
videos.overview: Lilly, on Thankam's behest, purchases a Dosa Pan for her from a salesgirl who's very young. Later, Girirajan reveals that Lilly has been cheated by that girl as Girirajan purchased a similar dosa pan for even lesser price. On hearing this, Thankam refuses to take the pan from Lilly and also decides not to repay her for the pan she purchased. Who gets to have the pan? Will Thankam accept it? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Scooter Needs a Repair
videos.overview: Kanakan, who takes pride and good care of his scooter, find out that his scooter isn't working properly. Voluntarily, Ronald promises to Kanakan that he'll fix his scooter as soon as possible. Will Ronald succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Movie Review
videos.overview: Ronald, in order to earn some money, decides to open his YouTube channel for reviewing the movies. Everything was going well, later his greediness takes over him. Now what will happen? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ratnamma's Fear
videos.overview: Ratnamma's friend visits her for the last time before leaving this city as her children does not treat her properly. On hearing this, Ratnamma starts to worry, whether her children and her family would treat her in the same manner as her friend was treated. Later, Kanakan (who left early without meeting Ratnamma), Lilly, Thankam, Takkuddu and Ronald couldn't pay attention to her as they were busy with their work. How will the family members console Ratnamma? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ronald Takes up the Job of Loading and Unloading Goods
videos.overview: Ronald receives a phone call from Rosemary, who requests financial assistance to settle an overdue electricity bill, which has led to a power outage at his residence. In response, Ronald seeks monetary help from his relatives, but only Lilly offers support. Upon noticing the money in Ronald's possession, Kanakan chastises him for frequently relying on family for financial aid. This prompts Ronald to accept a job involving the loading and unloading of goods at a vegetable shop, which pleases Kanakan as he observes Ronald's newfound work ethic. However, as news of Ronald's situation spreads, his family members begin to feel sympathy for him. Tune in to discover more!

videos.title: Where is Ratnamma's Phone?
videos.overview: Lilly and Kanakan leaves from their home to attend a wedding. Lilly informs Amma that she has prepared the rice but couldn't find the time to make the curry, so she suggests Amma to go to Thankam's place to have the food from there. Later Thankam gets a call from Cleatus asking her to get his important document, leaving Amma, Takkuddu and Ronald behind. Amma reprimands Takkuddu for taking her mobile phone and snatches it away. Later she kept it away from his reach, near the windowsill in the kitchen but later it goes missing from there. Everyone suspects Takkuddu. Has he lost or damaged Amma's phone? Watch the episode to know more!

videos.title: Ronald's Plan Goes in Vain
videos.overview: Thankam becomes upset with Lilly after she instructs her to remain silent so that the Ladies Meeting can proceed. Subsequently, a sister named Mini visits Lilly to provide a loan for her husband's medical treatment. Ronald discovers the truth about Mini's deception from Sister Omana who had spoken ill of her. Ronald's intention is to expose Mini's dishonesty in front of Lilly and Kanakan the following day when she comes to collect the loan, aiming to impress them. Meanwhile, Thankam secretly learns the full story from Ronald, who was overheard discussing the incident and his plan to reveal it over the phone. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: The Ladies' Conversational Gathering
videos.overview: When Thankam, Lilly and Takkuddu were returning from the temple, they met Sister Omana, who's heading to meet one of their acquaintances, who are dealing with their family problems. On hearing this, Thankam and Lilly requests Omana to come to their place to give them updates after meeting them. Once Omana reaches, she tells the story to Lilly, Thankam and Ratnamma! What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ratnamma Gets Into an Argument With Lilly
videos.overview: Ratnamma admonishes Lilly for her negligence in leaving the gas stove on while the rice cooker is preparing the rice. Subsequently, in an effort to support Amma, Thankam engages in a dispute with Lilly, which disturbs Kanakan's tranquility. Eventually, news of Kanakan's unexpected transfer spreads among everyone. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: Ronald Demands for a Scooter
videos.overview: Thankam and Lilly ask Ronald to purchase some grocery items, but he returns home late, causing frustration among everyone. He proposes that if they buy him a scooter, he will be able to complete his errands quickly, thus saving both time and money. Will they agree to his request? Watch now to discover more!

videos.title: Just One Look at Me
videos.overview: Akshaya calls Thankam requesting her to ask someone to pick her up from the hostel as all of her friends have gone to their parent's place for a few days. Thankam, at first relucted, later Lilly convinced her to allow her to come back from the hostel. Later, Sulu's cousin brother, Lallu, learns the news of Akshaya's return and is wanting her to see once! Will his dream be fulfilled? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam and Cleatus Argue With Each Other
videos.overview: Thankam chastises Cleatus for spending the funds that were specifically set aside for Akshaya's hostel and tuition fees on his party expenses. As a result, they have chosen to live apart and refrain from communicating. What will be the resolution of their conflict? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Akshaya Centre
videos.overview: Kanakan expresses his intention to establish an Akshaya Centre, not in the name of his wife, Lilly, but rather in the name of her sister, Thankam. This revelation leaves Lilly feeling disheartened and troubled, however, Kanakan eventually persuades her to see his perspective. Subsequently, both Lilly and Kanakan come to the realization that Thankam does not meet the necessary criteria to qualify as a candidate for opening the Akshaya Centre, which makes her feel upset. Will Kanakan succeed in launching the Akshaya Centre? If so, under whose name will it be registered? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Rising Heatwave
videos.overview: Thankam requests a new table fan from Cleatus, as the existing fan in their room is inoperative and the rising heatwave is making it difficult for them to sleep. She hands Cleatus 2000 Rupees to purchase a new fan, but he instead brings back a fan that has been unused at Girirajan's residence. When Thankam asks for a refund, Cleatus refuses, claiming he used the money to fulfill his party obligations. However, it later comes to light that he had actually given the money to settle a debt. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Breaking the Fast
videos.overview: A distressed woman seeks assistance from Cleatus, hoping he will confront the moneylender who has threatened to evict her and her two children. Regrettably, Cleatus declines to help because of avenging his revenge against her former husband for deceiving Cleatus. Observing her sorrow and disappointment, Thankam and Lilly devise a strategy to provide financial support to the woman. Will their plan be successful? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Ethakka Appam With Beef Fry
videos.overview: When Kanakan, Lilly and Ratnamma were trying to pacify Thankam and Cleatus as they were arguing with each other, on the other hand, Girirajan and Girija Ammayi were arguing with each together while coming to their place, as Girija refused to have Beef Fry and Pazham Poori, a combination which only a few Keralites like. That's when the men of the house decided to give the ladies of the house, a taste of this combination. Will they succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Half Price Scam
videos.overview: In the initial scene, Girirajan and Thankam engage in a dispute over a minor issue. Subsequently, news of the Half Price Scheme spreads, voluntarily prompting Girirajan to give Lilly 1000 Rupees to purchase a coupon worth 3000 Rupees. Witnessing this, Thankam feels envious and urges Cleatus to ask Girirajan for an additional 1000 Rupees to obtain her own coupon. Will Girirajan extend his generosity to Thankam as well? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Addiction Free Kerala Campaign
videos.overview: Members of the DDT Party, in collaboration with opposition party members, have initiated a campaign aimed at educating the youth about the dangers of illegal drug use for their own well-being. Meanwhile, Lilly, Thankam, and other Kudumbashree members are visiting the nearby neighborhood to promote this initiative. During their outreach, they encounter a woman who appears to be in distress but conceals her situation from them. Will she seek their assistance? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Lilly's Secretary Position at Stake
videos.overview: Thankam informs everyone that Lilly failed to perform her duties as the Secretary of the Kudambashree Group and might be expelled from the position of Secretary and Thankam has a higher chance of regaining her position. That's when Ronald comes up with a plan to save Lilly. Will his plan work? Find out to know more!

videos.title: A Trip to Munnar
videos.overview: Ronald receives information from a friend who claims to have seen Cleatus and Kanakan in Munnar. Thankam and Lilly find it hard to believe that they might be betraying them instead of fulfilling their work obligations. Is Ronald's account accurate? Are Kanakan and Cleatus being dishonest with their families? Uncover the truth!

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 1
videos.overview: While playing, Nallu and Saiyyu noticed that Ratnamma appeared sad and disheartened, and they suspected that she might have been crying. They inquired about her feelings, but Ratnamma chose not to share the truth with them. Later, Thankam also noticed her distress and posed the same question, yet Ratna Amma again withheld her feelings. Eventually, during lunch, Ratnamma opened up to everyone about her disappointment. Shortly after, two unexpected guests arrived at Kanakan's residence, seeking information about Cleatus. Upon their arrival, Cleatus appeared visibly distressed. Who are these visitors, and what has caused Cleatus's unease? Uncover the details to find out more!

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 2
videos.overview: Tom and Jessy, an eloped couple, seek refuge, triggering comedic attempts to hide them. The episode focuses on the humorous situations and the family's efforts to maintain secrecy from others.

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 3
videos.overview: The eloped couple's presence creates legal and political worries, given their influential families. A politician's statement adds tension. The episode follows the family's attempts to manage the situation, ending with the couple's departure.

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 4
videos.overview: The family focuses on convincing the eloped couple to leave their refuge. The episode is filled with comedic situations and dialogues as the family attempts to solve the problem and get the couple to leave.

videos.title: The Vishu Celebrations
videos.overview: On the fortunate occasion of Vishu, a young girl arrives at Kanakan's home inquiring about his whereabouts from his family. Regrettably, Kanakan is not at home and will be returning late from work. Upon learning this, the girl chooses to remain there until she can meet him. Subsequently, Ronald discloses a startling revelation about the girl to his family. What prompts this mysterious girl's visit? What is her motive for wanting to see Kanakan? Discover the answers to these questions!

videos.title: The Armchair
videos.overview: Ronald, inebriated, occupies the armchair at Kanakan's residence. Upon noticing this, Girirajan admonishes him, stating that only he and Kanakan, following Kanakan's father, are permitted to use the armchair. Ronald, feeling offended by this trivial matter, engages in a dispute with Girirajan and declares his intention to never return. What unfolds next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: The Missing Blue Churidar
videos.overview: Two representatives from a charitable organization visited the homes to collect unused clothing and solicit donations from both households. As Lilly and Thankam were occupied with their domestic tasks, they asked the men to return at a later time. Upon their return, Lilly donated her old clothes and proceeded to Thankam's residence to retrieve the garments that Thankam had placed on the table. After the men departed, Thankam inquired about a missing blue churidar that she had set aside for alterations, which had been given to her by a friend. Eventually, Thankam realizes that Lilly inadvertently included that churidar with her old clothes when she donated them. Will they be able to retrieve it from the charity, or will Thankam need to compensate her friend? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: The Buttermilk
videos.overview: Ronald asked Thankam for some food to satisfy his hunger; however, she declined his request due to a dispute with Cleatus, which resulted in the spices she was sautéing being burned. Subsequently, Thankam's creditor, Sister Savitri, visited her to collect the money owed, but Thankam was unable to repay the debt as Cleatus had taken the funds. She then asked Ronald to provide an excuse, but in his pursuit of making some money, Ronald deceived Thankam. Shortly thereafter, seeking to quench his thirst, Ronald went out in search of buttermilk but was unable to find any. He eventually made some at home, but soon experienced loose motions. What could be the cause of this? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam's Birthday Celebration
videos.overview: Thankam shares her wish with Cleatus to visit a temple and enjoy breakfast from outside in celebration of her upcoming birthday. Cleatus promptly agrees to fulfill his wife's request. Upon their return, when questioned about their outing, Cleatus discloses that it was Thankam's birthday. This revelation surprises everyone, particularly Kanakan, who had forgotten the occasion, further upsetting Thankam, especially since she was already feeling the absence of Akshaya. Meanwhile, Takkuddu finds himself in trouble after creating a mess. How will they resolve this situation? How will Kanakan make amends with Thankam? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Teaching Thambi a Lesson
videos.overview: Thambi, eager to evict his new tenants, a police officer and his wife, employs various strategies to achieve his goal, yet all his attempts prove futile. It is at this point that the police team devises a scheme to intimidate Thambi and teach him a lesson. Will they be successful? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Swapping Identities
videos.overview: Thankam notifies Lilly that a young woman from the Microfinance bank is scheduled to arrive today to collect the chit funds. Thankam is anxious upon learning that Sister Sulu failed to repay Thankam with the necessary funds, as she doesn't have money, leaving her unable to pay the full amount to the young woman. Subsequently, the young woman arrives at Thankam's residence to collect the chit funds. In response, Thankam decides to assume Lilly's identity, informing the young woman that Thankam (who's actually Lily), has stepped out for an errand and will return late in the evening. However, the young woman insists on receiving the complete payment before leaving. How will Thankam manage to settle the total amount with the young woman? Stay tuned for further developments!

videos.title: A Big Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Ronald has noticed that in recent days, whenever Thambi, Sulu's husband, and Sufi, Mammootty's wife, leave the house, they engage in secret conversations. He communicates this observation to the other residents and subsequently informs Thambi and Sufi. How will they respond? What is the reality behind this? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Ronald Causes a Trouble Again
videos.overview: Thankam urged Ronald to promptly withdraw cash from the nearby ATM; however, Ronald was reluctant to undertake this task due to his aching legs. After considerable persuasion, he consented to go, opting to either take a rickshaw or use Kanakan's scooter. Initially, Lilly was hesitant to lend the scooter to Ronald, but she eventually relented after he assured her that he would not cause any damage. However, upon exiting the ATM, Ronald discovered the scooter lying on the roadside, resulting in minor damage. He reassured Lilly and Thankam that he would repair the scooter. Will he manage to finish this task before Kanakan returns? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus Gets Into Trouble
videos.overview: Cleatus is presented with an opportunity to appear on a news channel for a contentious debate against the opposition party, which had colluded with a road contractor responsible for a road accident due to negligence. However, he soon finds himself in a predicament upon discovering that the allegations he made against both the party and the contractor were unfounded. What will unfold next? Stay tuned for more details!

videos.title: The Story of the Marriage Ring
videos.overview: The ex-fiancé of Thankam, who was set to marry her, came to her home to reclaim the ring that her mother had given to her. Unfortunately, Thankam cannot remember where she had kept the ring. After extensive questioning from all the household members, Lilly proposes that Kanakan should inquire with Girirajan as well, believing he may have information regarding its whereabouts. What happens next? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: An Imposter in Disguise
videos.overview: One morning, Sufi's youngest sister, Surmi, arrives at Sufi's place to surprise her but instead got a surprise when she learnt that they aren't at home. Thankam calls her to her place to rest and wait till they come. Susbsequently, Lilly arrives and insisted her to stay at her place. Later, Thankam and Lilly leave for the Kudumbashree meeting (Ladies Meeting), leaving Takkuddu behind. When they came back, they found her to be missing. What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Job as an Aanganwadi Helper
videos.overview: Both Girija and Thankam convey their eagerness to engage in work rather than idly spending their time after finishing household tasks. The following day, Thankam visits the Aanganwadi Centre for some work and is presented with an opportunity to serve as an Aanganwadi helper. She shares this news with Kanakan, anticipating that Cleatus would decline. Girija asserts that if Thankam is unable to accept the position, she is willing to take it, however, both of their husbands oppose this. Who will ultimately seize this opportunity? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Missing Induction Cooker
videos.overview: One morning, Sister Sulu approached Lilly to request a gas cylinder for cooking purposes. However, Lilly was unable to assist as her own gas cylinder was nearly empty. Instead, she lent Sister Sulu, Sufi's Induction Cooker to help her until a new gas cylinder could be obtained. Later, Sulu and Thambi returned to inform Lilly that the Induction Cooker had been stolen. Who could be responsible for the theft? How will Lilly explain this situation to Sufi? Tune in to discover the full story!

videos.title: The Friendly Avengers
videos.overview: Cleatus and Ronald informs the household members that two people were after them, and in order to save themselves from getting bashed up, they run for their lives, leaving the ladies and Takkuddu behind. After a while, the two men arrive in search of Cleatus. With Kanakan's absence, the ladies try to pacify the men to come back later as Cleatus was not there, but they resisted to stay back unless they teach Cleatus a lesson! How will the ladies manage to pacify the two men? Watch now to know the story!

videos.title: A Sip of Redemption for Thankam
videos.overview: The narrative commences with distressing news conveyed by Appu Kuttan Sir to Cleatus, informing him of Natarajan's sudden heart attack, which has left him on a ventilator in the hospital. Subsequently, Natarajan clarifies the situation. During this time, Lilly ridicules Thankam for never having offered even a cup of tea to Ansar and Natarajan during their visits to Cleatus. In an effort to counter Lilly's claim, Thankam extends an invitation for them to enjoy a cup of tea. Will Thankam resolve the dispute by disproving Lilly's assertion? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Surmi Gets Blackmailed
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Surmi, the younger sister of Sufi, who is in a state of distress after being blackmailed by an individual. This person had spiked her drink, taken unauthorized photographs, and recorded videos of her, subsequently demanding money to prevent the release of this content on social media. Surmi was not in a suitable mental state to confide in Lilly and Thankam, prompting Sufi to inform them of the situation so that Kanakan could step in and provide assistance. How will Kanakan apprehend the perpetrator, ensure he faces consequences for his actions, and safeguard Surmi's dignity from being compromised? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Girija's Love for Poetry
videos.overview: The entire household appears taken aback by Girija's transformation, as she begins sharing poetry on social media. The following morning, Girirajan arrives, visibly concerned about Girija's abrupt change in behavior. What unfolds next? Discover the details!

videos.title: Why is Thankam Upset?
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Cleatus, Thankam, Takkuddu, and Lilly as they prepare to attend a wedding. Upon their return, Thankam appears to be distressed and is uncommunicative. What might be the cause of this demeanor? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Summer Camp
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Thankam expressing her frustration over the children constantly watching television. Upon abruptly turning it off, Takkuddu retaliates with a vulgar remark, inciting anger in her and others. The family resolves to send the children to a summer camp, but the kids refuse. What unfolds next? Discover the details!

videos.title: Ansar Gets a Second-Hand Car
videos.overview: The narrative commences as Ansar acquires a pre-owned vehicle and reaches Cleatus's home. Upon noticing the car, Kanakan ridicules Cleatus for lacking a vehicle. This provokes Cleatus, who, accompanied by Ronald, visits a second-hand car dealership to purchase a car. Will he succeed in buying a car and disproving Kanakan? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan Saves the Day
videos.overview: The story commences with Thankam waking up Takkuddu and sending him to the Summer Camp. Upon his return, Thankam notices that there are red marks on his hands. On questioning, Takkuddu makes excuses and walks away. Later, Thankam learns the truth and informs Lilly about it. Meanwhile Sulu informs Girirajan about this incident and decides to handle the situation. Will he succeed in fulfilling the task? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam's Grand Pretence
videos.overview: Thankam and Cleatus gets involved in a fight where Thankam accuses Cleatus of abusing her physically. Everyone gets highly upset on knowing this and express their anger towards him. How will Cleatus save himself from everyone's wrath? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Frock Nighty
videos.overview: One morning, Girija Ammayi returns to Kanakan's place after attending the opening ceremony of her friend's store. On her way back, she had purchased three Frock Nighties for the ladies of the house, except for Ratnamma, which makes her feel sad and disappointed. Earlier, unaware of the reason behind her sadness, when Girija asked, Ratnamma opened up and expressed her desire for a Frock Nighty. Will the household members agree to buy one for her? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Cleatus Experiences Severe Itching
videos.overview: While traveling by bus to a party event in Kozhikode, Cleatus experiences severe itching. He decides to broadcast a live video to express his discomfort. However, he soon faces difficulties when his assertions are proven to be untrue. How will Cleatus extricate himself from this predicament? What might be the cause of his intense itching? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Lilly is the Star
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly receives a phone call from Cleatus, who informs her of an opportunity to perform with her students at a nearby upcoming shoot. Seizing this chance, Lilly starts rehearsing the dance performance with her students. Will she achieve the recognition and fame she desires? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: A Dispute Between the Mother-In-Law and Daughter-In-Law
videos.overview: One morning, Sister Omana pays a visit to Ratnamma to inquire about her health. Following an extensive discussion, she encounters Lilly and incites her against Ratnamma by spreading negative remarks about her. Upon hearing this, Lilly becomes very distressed and confronts Ratnamma, leading to a conflict between them. How will their misunderstanding be uncovered? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Kids' Vishu Money
videos.overview: As is customary, Cleatus and Ronald find themselves in urgent need of funds. Subsequently, they discover that the children have not yet utilized the money they received during the Vishu Celebrations. The two devise a strategy to determine who will acquire the money. Who will emerge victorious? Read on to find out more!

videos.title: Girirajan's New Farm Helper - Part 1
videos.overview: This episode opens with Girirajan alerting Cleatus to the absence of his farm helper, who has also taken some money. The team heads to the Red Spinach farm in search of him, but to their disappointment, he is not found. After returning to Kanakan's home, Lilly and Thankam have a confrontation. Later, Girirajan gets a call from his missing farm helper. What unfolds in the next part? Keep watching to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan's New Farm Helper - Part 2
videos.overview: In the latter segment of this episode, Cleatus admonishes Kishanchand, the newly appointed Bengali farm assistant employed by Girirajan, for failing to inform everyone about his location. Subsequently, a small group of Bengali workers organizes a protest at the farm, prompting Girirajan and Cleatus to leave in order to address the situation, but they end up being captured. Where has Kishanchand disappeared to? What consequences will Girirajan and Cleatus face if he cannot be located? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: A Meeting of Love and Friendship
videos.overview: Cleatus, together with his DDT Party Members, has chosen to initiate a campaign with the assistance of the opposition party. Conversely, Shashi, the leader of the RDP Party and Cleatus's rival, is strategizing his own plans. Subsequently, at home, the children engage in a dispute among themselves, which is then joined by Thankam and Lilly. After addressing these issues, Girirajan receives a call informing him of Cleatus's arrest. What will transpire next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: Spilled Mustard: Sowing Seeds of Strife
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma was preparing a dish in the kitchen when she asked Lilly to hand her the mustard seeds. By mistake, Lilly dropped some mustard seeds on the floor. Ratnamma remarked that the spilled mustard seeds would lead to disputes within the household. She indicated that Lilly was bound to have an argument, but Lilly, determined to disprove Ratnamma's assertions, promised not to engage in any fights that day. Will she succeed in her challenge and refute both Ratnamma and the age-old superstition? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Red Spinach - The Root Cause of the Problem
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma requests the farm helper to provide her with several bundles of Red Spinach. Upon observing this, Girirajan reprimands Ratnamma for her request. Disheartened and furious, she departs from the scene. Later, upon returning home, she resolves to cut off her relationship with Girirajan due to his disrespectful behavior in front of the farm helpers. Girirajan arrives at her home and attempts various methods to soothe her, yet she remains resolute in her decision. How will Girirajan manage to appease Ratnamma and restore their relationship? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Mischievous Little Thief
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam was preparing Takkuddu's bag to send him to the Summer Tuition Classes, however Takkuddu pleaded with his mother not to send him. After considerable persuasion, just as they were about to depart, they realized that one pair of their footwear was missing. Meanwhile, while Kanakan and Lilly were on their way back home, they encountered Takkuddu's teacher, who expressed his concerns regarding his behavior to them. The following day, even Kanakan's one pair of footwear went missing! Who could be responsible for this theft? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus Lands Ronald In Trouble
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus found himself in urgent need of 500 Rupees and asked Thankam for assistance. However, Thankam declined his request, explaining that she did not possess sufficient funds to help him. While on his way to a party function in Kollam, Cleatus encountered Ronald and inquired if he could lend him money, but Ronald also lacked the necessary funds. Subsequently, Cleatus formulated a scheme that placed Ronald in a difficult position. How will he extricate himself from this predicament? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The God in Disguise
videos.overview: One morning, when Girirajan and Thankam reaches home after returning from the temple, Lilly notices that Thankam's chain is missing!
