If you've ever stood in long queues, adjusted with limited resources, dreamed big despite small means, or believed that tomorrow will be better, this episode is for you.

videos.title: Laalo Team on Their Cannes Journey & Success Story
videos.overview: Every great film begins with a dream. Some dreams make it all the way to Cannes. In this special episode of Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman welcomes the talented creators behind the acclaimed film Laalo—Ankit Sakhiya, Jay Vyas, and Shruhad Goswami. From the challenges of independent filmmaking to earning international recognition and taking Laalo to the Cannes Film Festival, this conversation is filled with inspiring stories, creative struggles, memorable moments, and valuable insights for every cinema lover. If you're passionate about filmmaking, storytelling, or chasing impossible dreams, this is an episode you won't want to miss.

videos.title: Nitin Gadkari
videos.overview: The very first episode of Shekhar Tonite kicks off with none other than Nitin Gadkari joining Shekhar Suman for a conversation that’s equal parts insightful, unfiltered, and outrageously entertaining.

videos.title: Bobby Deol
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Bobby Deol joins Shekhar Suman for a conversation filled with honesty, nostalgia, laughter, stardom, struggles, reinvention, and moments you’ve never seen before.

videos.title: Ali Fazal
videos.overview: An honest, witty, and unfiltered conversation with Ali Fazal and Shekhar Suman, as they dive into stories, perspectives, and moments you don’t usually get to hear.

videos.title: Amruta Fadnavis
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Amruta Fadnavis joins Shekhar Suman for a candid conversation filled with personal stories, music, public life, perspectives on leadership, and moments of honesty, humour, and insight. From balancing multiple roles to navigating life in the public eye, this episode offers a side of Amruta Fadnavis rarely seen before.

videos.title: Manoj Bajpayee
videos.overview: In this episode of Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman and Manoj Bajpayee come together for a candid exchange on life, cinema, ambition, struggles, reinvention, and the stories that shape an artist. From his early days of uncertainty to becoming one of India's most respected actors, Manoj reflects on the journey with honesty, humour, and perspective. A conversation that's insightful, entertaining, and deeply human.

videos.title: Gippy Grewal
videos.overview: Punjabi music sensation and beloved actor Gippy Grewal joins Shekhar Suman on Shekhar Tonite for a conversation that goes far beyond the glitz and glamour. In this episode, Gippy opens up about his incredible journey — from his early struggles to becoming one of the biggest names in Punjabi music and cinema.  He talks candidly about the highs and lows of his career, the emotional moments that shaped him as an artist, and the personal sacrifices behind his success story. Expect raw honesty, heartfelt nostalgia, and a few laughs along the way as Shekhar Suman digs deep into the man behind the music. This is one of the most emotional and real conversations on Shekhar Tonite yet — a must-watch for fans of Gippy Grewal, Punjabi music, and inspiring life stories.

videos.title: Farah Khan
videos.overview: Farah Khan Opens Up on Tees Maar Khan, Marriage, Motherhood, Bollywood & Her Incredible Journey. One of Bollywood's most loved filmmakers, choreographers, and entertainers, Farah Khan joins Shekhar Suman. In this candid episode, Farah Khan shares stories from her extraordinary career, opens up about the highs and lows of Bollywood, reflects on the criticism surrounding Tees Maar Khan, talks about marriage, motherhood, success, failure, and how she reinvented herself in the digital age. Known for her wit and infectious sense of humor, Farah also shares hilarious behind-the-scenes moments, personal anecdotes, and life lessons that make this conversation both inspiring and entertaining. From laughter to heartfelt reflections, this episode has something for every Bollywood fan.

videos.title: Prajakta Koli
videos.overview: Prajakta Koli (MostlySane) joins Shekhar Suman on Shekhar Tonite for one of the most honest and heartfelt conversations yet. From getting rejected at her very first radio internship to becoming the only Indian on the TIME100 Creator list — Prajakta's journey is nothing short of extraordinary. In this full episode, Prajakta Koli talks candidly about building MostlySane from the ground up, the pressure of being a full-time content creator, her popular role as Dimple in Mismatched (Netflix), her debut novel Too Good To Be True, life after marriage, and what she will never trade for fame. She also shares a deeply personal and moving tribute in the confession room that you won't forget.

videos.title: Sunidhi Chauhan
videos.overview: This week on Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman welcomes one of India's most iconic and celebrated voices—Sunidhi Chauhan. From her extraordinary musical journey to behind-the-scenes stories, unforgettable performances, career milestones, and candid conversations, this episode is a heartfelt celebration of a voice that has defined generations. Known for her versatility, passion, and unmatched stage presence, Sunidhi opens up like never before in an engaging conversation with Shekhar Suman. Expect laughter, nostalgia, inspiration, music, and plenty of memorable moments.

videos.title: Badhshah
videos.overview: In this episode, Shekhar Suman sits down with one of India's biggest music icons, #Badshah  for an honest and engaging conversation. From his journey in the music industry and the stories behind his biggest hits to fame, success, challenges, creativity, and life beyond the spotlight, Badshah opens up like never before.

videos.title: Pankaj Tripathi
videos.overview: In this episode, Shekhar Suman engages the acclaimed performer in an engaging and hilarious discussion about his journey from theatre to becoming a Bollywood icon. From his breakthrough roles in Gangs of Wasseypur to his stellar performances across films and web series, Pankaj Tripathi opens up about the craft of acting, career challenges, and the moments that shaped his incredible trajectory. Expect witty banter, surprising revelations, and Shekhar's signature satirical humor as two brilliant minds discuss cinema and storytelling.

videos.title: Shashwat Sachdev
videos.overview: The genius behind the music of Uri: The Surgical Strike and blockbuster franchise Dhurandhar, composer Shashwat Sachdev, joins Shekhar Suman for a deeply moving and inspiring conversation. He talks about training under his guru Ustad Ramzan Khan, the incredible sacrifices made by his parents, his sister (who gave up her own singing career for him), and his wife after their move to Mumbai in 2017 — and opens up about the journey behind some of Bollywood's biggest soundtracks. Before the interview, Shekhar Suman opens the show with his sharpest satire yet — taking aim at the Delhi student protests, Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation, and the government's viral reel culture. A perfect blend of biting political comedy and heartfelt musical conversation, only on Shekhar Tonite!

videos.title: Vikas Khanna
videos.overview: World-renowned chef, restaurateur, and MasterChef India judge Vikas Khanna joins Shekhar Suman for one of the most emotional conversations of the season. From being told as a child he'd never walk, to his mother's unwavering belief that he was "born to fly," Vikas opens up about the journey that shaped his life. He shares the heartbreaking story behind his acclaimed New York restaurant Bungalow — built as a promise to his late sister, and the first restaurant in a century to receive 3 Michelin  stars from The New York Times. He also talks about cooking for global icons like Barack Obama, PM Modi, the Dalai Lama, and the Pope, and reflects on resilience, identity, and what it truly means to build a home, not just a restaurant.

videos.title: Vikrant Massey
videos.overview: National Award-winning actor Vikrant Massey joins Shekhar Suman for a deeply candid and emotional conversation. He shares the touching story behind his name - inspired by INS Vikrant - his humble middle-class upbringing, and the humiliation he faced after being fired on his very first television shoot. Vikrant opens up about his hard-fought journey from TV to films, his National Award-winning performance in 12th Fail, and the real reason behind his much-talked-about "break" from the industry - choosing to spend time with his newborn son and ailing father over the demands of newfound fame.

videos.title: Vir Das
videos.overview: International Emmy Award-winning comedian, actor, and writer ‪@virdas‬  joins Shekhar Suman for a raw, honest, and thought-provoking conversation. He breaks his silence on the backlash following his viral "Two Indias" speech, opens up about the FIRs and legal battles that comedy has brought him, and shares his unfiltered philosophy that "controversy should not become your content." Vir also reflects on his journey from getting bullied in boarding school to becoming the first Indian to win an International Emmy, his humble beginnings on The Great Indian Comedy Show, his love for dogs, and why he believes comedy - not acting - gives him complete creative freedom.

videos.title: Amish Tripathi
videos.overview: What happens when India's ancient stories meet a modern storyteller? This week on Shekhar Tonite, Shekhar Suman sits down with bestselling author and storyteller Amish Tripathi for a fascinating conversation about Lord Shiva, Indian mythology, faith, writing, philosophy, and the stories that have shaped India. Amish opens up about his journey from being an atheist to finding faith, the inspiration behind The Shiva Trilogy, and how writing The Immortals of Meluha changed his life. A candid, thought-provoking conversation between Shekhar Suman and Amish Tripathi that explores faith, philosophy, literature and the timeless power of Indian stories.

videos.title: Nawazuddin Siddiqui
videos.overview: One of Indian cinema's most acclaimed and versatile actors, Nawazuddin Siddiqui, joins UNI Cards Presents Shekhar Suman for a raw, inspiring, and deeply honest conversation on Shekhar Tonite. He recalls the sheer self-belief that carried him through a mere 40-second role in Sarfarosh, opens up about years of struggle and self-doubt after being told he "wasn't good looking," and shares the pivotal moment director Anurag Kashyap told him, "I want Nawaz, not Al Pacino" — reshaping his approach to acting forever. From iconic roles like Faisal Khan and Dashrath Manjhi to performing alongside his daughter, Nawazuddin reflects on craft, failure, and what real success means.

tt42446103.name: Warrant
tt42446103.description: A bullied and vulnerable small‑town constable transforms into a brutal force while solving forgotten warrant cases, until a custodial death forces the law to judge the man he has become.

videos.title: An Attack That Changed Karuppu's Life
videos.overview: On his first station duty, Karuppu lets an accused escape, but when he recaptures him, a brutal attack changes his life forever.

videos.title: Karuppu Faces Humiliation
videos.overview: Mocked by colleagues and burdened by a humiliating nickname, Karuppu struggles in the force until a major warrant case comes his way.

videos.title: A Determined Karuppu's Warrant Mission
videos.overview: Determined to prove himself, Karuppu leads a warrant mission but ends up realising that nabbing criminals is tougher than donning the uniform.

videos.title: A Brutal Murder Case
videos.overview: The entire police station is stunned when Karuppu cracks a brutal murder case and controls a violent 15-member clash in a single day.

videos.title: The Honey Trap
videos.overview: As the hunt for Kodaikanal Saravanan intensifies, Karuppu sets a honey trap to nab the notorious criminal.

videos.title: Karuppu's Poweful Attack on Saravanan
videos.overview: Power and rage engulf Karuppu as he brutally breaks Saravanan’s leg in what appears to be an encounter.

videos.title: Feared Yet Trusted
videos.overview: Karuppu rises as the station’s most feared and trusted constable, but in the quest of solving others’ problems, he slowly begins to lose his own humanity.

videos.title: Karuppu’s Troubled Past
videos.overview: A mysterious custodial death unsettles the department as Karuppu’s troubled past resurfaces, drawing his name into the enquiry.

tt40431801.name: Kasargod Embassy
tt40431801.description: Azi and Chemmu, cousins trapped in poverty in late 2000s Kasaragod, work for their cunning uncle Razak Mama, whose stationery shop hides a forgery racket.

tt31924802.name: The Revolutionaries
tt31924802.description: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.

videos.title: Behroopiya
videos.overview: An assassination attempt on the Viceroy shakes the foundations of the British Raj. As the Empire unleashes the ruthless Lt. Col. Dyer to hunt down those responsible, Rash Behari Bose races to finish the mission he set in motion. Sachindranath Sanyal struggles against his family's legacy of operating in the shadows, throwing his engagement to Pratibha Lahiri into question.

videos.title: Shaagird
videos.overview: After a narrow escape, Rash contemplates his next move. Sachin is torn between the promise of love and his dream of fighting on the frontlines of the freedom struggle, facing a choice that could alter the course of his life. Meanwhile, Dyer's relentless investigation for British India's Most Wanted Man leads him to Benaras.

videos.title: Ekla Cholo Re
videos.overview: Rash and Sachin reunite with Pishima, caretaker of the Revolutionaries' Calcutta safe house. After years underground, the legendary Bagha Jatin returns with an audacious plan: to execute the greatest heist the British Empire has ever seen. DCP Tegart closes in on the elusive revolutionary and, determined not to let Jatin slip away a second time, unwittingly walks into a carefully laid trap.

videos.title: Paigaam
videos.overview: The Revolutionaries go underground. As Dyer tightens the noose around Rash, an unforeseen obstacle throws his hunt into disarray. In Benaras, 18-year-old rebel Kartar Singh Sarabha joins forces with Pratibha, who takes a bold risk to deliver a message that could alter the rebellion's fate. And when a message from Ghadar leader Lala Hardayal reaches Rash, a dying revolution surges back to life.

videos.title: Shabaash!
videos.overview: A devastating incident leaves Rash and Jatin confronting the cost of their cause, as Sachin fights for his life. Just as Dyer narrows in on the hiding Revolutionaries, the tide begins to turn, as thousands answer the call of revolution.

videos.title: Komagata Maru
videos.overview: After a long and perilous voyage, the Komagata Maru finally docks in Calcutta. Disguised among the crowds, Rash, Kartar, and Pishima arrive to receive the revolutionaries returning home to fight for freedom. But the British are ready for them. As Dyer and Tegart race to unravel the insurgent plot, Rash finds himself trapped at the heart of a conspiracy on the verge of exposure.

videos.title: Aur Bhi Aayenge
videos.overview: An ally and a mole are both revealed. Pratibha challenges Jatin's perspective on the role of women in the revolution as Pishima holds on against torturous circumstances. The Revolutionaries scatter to execute their plans, leaving themselves dangerously exposed. Meanwhile, Tegart pieces together a single, devastating clue that could bring the entire revolution crashing down.

videos.title: Ghadar!
videos.overview: Heartbreaking news months before Ghadar day leaves the Revolutionaries reeling and forces Rash to confront the terrible cost of freedom. When all hope seems lost, Pratibha arrives at the training camp with a bold plan that could save the rebellion. But as the dream of revolution is reborn, the mole finally plays his cards, threatening to bring the entire movement crashing down.

tt29540636.name: Pharma
tt29540636.description: A young medical representative struggles against the pharma game, masters it and eventually fights against it.

tt38792244.name: Inspection Bungalow
tt38792244.description: In the village of Aravangad, Sub-Inspector Vishnu is forced to shift his police station to a haunted Forest Inspection Bungalow with a dark past.

tt37534689.name: Kammattam
tt37534689.description: Inspector Antonio George smells foul play in the mysterious death of Samuel Umman. As his investigation leads him to Samuel's employee, Francis, Antonio realises that a much larger game is in play.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: Detective Antonio George investigates the staged road accident that killed planter Samuel Umman, uncovering a murder mystery.

videos.title: Pursuit
videos.overview: Realising that Shaji was not alone on the day of the incident, Antonio decides to first find the person who was with Shaji.

videos.title: Forgery
videos.overview: Antonio discovers that a loan has been taken out in Samuel's name. He meets with the bank employee, Sharath, to find out who took out the loan.

videos.title: Exposure
videos.overview: Antonio realises that both Shaji and Samuel's deaths were linked to the bank. While interrogating the bank employees, Antonio uncovers many irregularities in the files.

videos.title: Vengeance
videos.overview: Samuel's son, Ebin, identifies the person responsible for his father's death and decides to take revenge.

videos.title: Unraveled
videos.overview: The mystery behind the murders unravels before Antonio. He goes in search of Ebin and Francis, who used to work at Samuel's plantation. Can he arrest the culprit before more lives are lost?

tt30218223.name: The Chronicles Of The 4.5 Gang
tt30218223.description: A group of five slum boys dream of making it big amidst the chaotic world of crime, comedy, and survival.

videos.title: Attack on the Cop
videos.overview: In 2004, a gold-smuggling heist leaves young Arikuttan scarred and entangled in violence. Fourteen years later, he arrives in Auran seeking a ghostwriter to reshape his crime-ridden past, as memories of his youth in Thiruvanjipuram - friendships, betrayals, and clashes with local goons - come flooding back.

videos.title: Gangster take over Ponakavu
videos.overview: As SI Suresh recovers, Arikuttan and his friends are drawn deeper into revenge, leading them to Bonakkad, a criminal hideout with ties to their past. When a violent act changes everything, the boys commit their first crime and go into hiding, setting in motion consequences that will haunt them all.

videos.title: Ponkashi Milk Mafia at large
videos.overview: After surviving a near-fatal shooting, Arikuttan finds himself cared for by his friends and SI Suresh. As Maniyan pursues music and love, Kanji enters PSC training, and Moonga lures the gang into a lucrative milk smuggling scam with Suresh at its core. Their newfound prosperity fuels ambition and reckless choices - from kidnapping a music director to brutal revenge on Senthil for misbehaving with women. But as the gang enjoys cars, cable TV, and influence, Inspector Stalin's pursuit puts a dent into their plan.

videos.title: Goons take over the state capital
videos.overview: While serving time in jail, Arikuttan reconnects with his estranged father, forging an uneasy bond. Meanwhile, Senthil's wealthy plantation family retaliates for his public humiliation by sending an army of workers led by Muthuvel to Thiruvanjipuram, unleashing a wave of violence against local gangs. As Maniyan's dreams are shattered in the clashes and the city descends into chaos, unlikely alliances form, but peace only returns once the Tamil gang withdraws - leaving behind broken clubs, ruined friendships, and broken Thadippalam on the brink of demolition.

videos.title: Cold-blooded Christmas
videos.overview: As SI Suresh plots to seize control of the city's flower trade from the powerful Pookada Vava, Arikuttan and his gang are drawn into a dangerous scheme of arson and revenge. Meanwhile, Maniyan's dreams of becoming a singer unravel in jealousy and violence, leaving Pranita devastated. In the present day, Arikuttan urges his ghostwriter to paint him as a victim, but the truth of Vava's death casts a darker shadow over his story.

videos.title: Gunfires at the Festival
videos.overview: After the murder of Pookada Vava, suspicion falls on Kanji, who is arrested and sentenced, while Arikuttan rises in power, winning tenders and fulfilling his childhood dream of leading a temple festival. Maniyan finds fame as a singer, but tragedy strikes when Ramani, seeking vengeance for her husband's death, unleashes a violent chain of retribution. As betrayal, love, and ambition collide, Arikuttan's world spirals into bloodshed and loss, leaving behind only fragments of memory - and a half-finished book that may be his last attempt at redemption.

tt39151086.name: Muthu Alias Kaattaan
tt39151086.description: A story of an man who becomes a legend, a Monster, and a Miracle, depending on the Storyteller.

videos.title: The Immortal Smile
videos.overview: A quiet rural police station on the verge of shutting down is suddenly thrown into action when a shocking discovery emerges.

videos.title: The Enigma
videos.overview: The frustrating search for the head's identity starts yielding unconnected stories from unexpected sources. The policemen finally get a clue, and it is an elephant.

videos.title: Queen of the Arabian Sea
videos.overview: In Kerala, Sidharthan and Thangamudi find the elephant and reach the place where Muthu worked years ago. A bomb blast at an orphanage becomes a new puzzle to solve.

videos.title: The Fragrance of Henna
videos.overview: In Tamil Nadu, Kaalai Pandian listens to Sittu's story of Muthu and Meena's blooming love. In Kerala, Benny remembers how Muthu calmed an elephant's fury.

videos.title: Sleepless City Blues
videos.overview: The relationship between Muthu and Meena in Madurai comes to light. A chance encounter in the forest reveals how Muthu's courage set Benny's political journey in motion.

videos.title: Things Fall Apart
videos.overview: Sidharthan finds Jessy, who narrates Muthu's stint at the orphanage a decade back, ending in a bomb blast. Benny agrees to meet the investigators.

videos.title: Friends, Foes and Fortunes
videos.overview: Benny reveals more about Sivendra's secretive life and a long-standing rivalry. But Sidharthan suspects there's more to the story than what he's being told.

videos.title: Separation
videos.overview: Meena confides in Jessy about the final days she spent with Muthu. With this lead, Sidharthan finds Bastin, who completes the story of Sivendra and Johny.

videos.title: Nemesis
videos.overview: At a vibrant temple festival, a new side of Muthu comes to light as rising tensions among local youths spiral into chaos. The night takes a dark and unexpected turn.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: Pattalam Babu reveals to Sidharthan how Johny targeted Muthu once he was released from prison and its horrific consequences. The inspector finally pieces everything together.

tt38534276.name: Mazha Thorum Munpe
tt38534276.description: Abandoned as a child, Aleena grows up longing for love. Will life ever lead her back to her lost parents and the happiness she dreams of?

videos.title: Aleena's World Falls Apart
videos.overview: Tensions rise during the 25th anniversary celebrations of Snehanikethan as caretaker Brijithamma suddenly collapses. Aleena is devastated upon hearing the doctor's grave diagnosis.

tt27128638.name: Kerala Crime Files
tt27128638.description: A sex worker's mysterious and gruesome murder in a suburban lodge called "Grand Tourist Home" baffles the police as the only lead they have is a fake address.

tt39090300.name: Seher hone ko hai
tt39090300.description: Strong-willed Kausar defies societal barriers for her daughter Seher's big dreams, but will destiny stand by their side?

videos.title: Secrets Surface at a Family Picnic
Seher Flies a Kite With Mahid
Can Seher Truly Hide Her Pain?
Husna Forces Kausar to Reveal Truth
Mahid Ends His Marriage with Seher
Mahid Urges Seher to Move On
Fatima and Wasim's Web of Deceit
Mahid Gets Seher and Kausar Home
Seher and Mahid Spy on the Family
Husna's Big Move to Win Mahid's Trust
Seher, Kausar Run for Their Lives
Mahid and Seher Search for Kausar
Seher Walks Out of Mahid's Life
Mahid Plans a Surprise for Seher
Husna sparks a clash with Seher

tt37443874.name: Constable Kanakam
tt37443874.description: Kanakam, a brave young woman, becomes the first lady constable from her village. When she's posted to a new village where women are mysteriously disappearing, including her friend Chandrika, she begins an investigation. Despite facing resistance and shocking truths, Kanakam fights for justice and truth with courage and determination.

videos.title: Jaathara
videos.overview: 1990s, Repalle — a quiet village in Srikakulam — is haunted by the mysterious disappearances of young girls near the eerie Adavigutta forest.To ease rising panic, village president Prakash Rao organizes a vibrant four-day jathara (festival), hoping music, dance, and crowds will drown out the fear. Among the attendees are Constable Kanakam, a soft-spoken but brave officer, and Chandrika, a passionate folk dancer.But as festivities unfold, strange incidents resurface. A curfew quietly spreads: no girls out after 8 PM, especially near Adavigutta. Then, without warning, Kanakam and Chandrika vanish from the festival grounds.

videos.title: Thappetagullu
videos.overview: As the jathara celebrations continue, a shocking truth surfaces — Chandrika is missing. Whispers of suspicion turn toward Kanakam when a witness claims the two left the festival together. A buried feud, a missing man, and a chilling discovery in the woods unravel a deadly twist.

videos.title: Adivigutta
videos.overview: As Chandrika’s father arrives in Repalle demanding answers, tensions rise. Meanwhile, Kanakam’s search for the truth angers her fellow officers, and she’s punished with night duty near the haunted woods.But the forest is watching… and something dark awaits.

videos.title: Thrisulam
videos.overview: In the depths of Adavi Gutta, Kanakam stumbles upon eerie crow nests and a chilling clue a lost gold watch point to a new suspect:  Interrogation reveals a boy with a strange mark, seen in the deeper forest. As Kanakam digs deeper, the forest’s secrets grow darker—and deadlier.

videos.title: Mandasa kova
videos.overview: A wedding in Paderu turns deadly when an insulted cook, takes revenge on the guest. Meanwhile, Kanakam’s search leads her all the way to Delhi, where an ex-military officer confirms her worst fear: the man with the strange mark! . Back in Repalle, drawn by eerie whispers in the night, Kanakam ventures into Adavi Gutta—where she finally comes face-to-face with the man she’s been hunting.

videos.title: Nakshatram
videos.overview: With the man in custody, Kanakam is closer than ever to the truth—but the real questions remain. Who is he really? What dark secrets lie within the mysterious dish? As time runs out and the village’s shadowy past begins to surface, Kanakam must uncover the truth buried in the forest before evil strikes again.

videos.title: Konda Thelu
videos.overview: Haunted by omens, a deadly sting, and a cryptic warning, Kanakam begins to realize the truth may be hiding closer than she ever suspected. With only three days to act, her search leads her to a familiar doorstep — where fear gives way to a far more dangerous discovery.

videos.title: Addam
videos.overview: Kanakam’s investigation deepens when a misplaced clue and a hidden financial trail lead her to Pitapuram, where shocking truths about identity and family begin to surface. As secrets unravel and reflections deceive, she realizes the person she’s searching for may not be who she believed — and the real truth has already vanished into the shadows.

videos.title: Selavu
videos.overview: Kanakam returns home to face an irreversible loss as buried guilt and unanswered questions resurface. As contradictions unravel and hidden truths emerge, her investigation takes a dangerous turn — leaving one chilling question behind: if the past has already claimed a life, who is next?

videos.title: Siksha
videos.overview: An arrest brings no relief as Kanakam uncovers a truth more devastating than the crime itself, forcing her to question justice, identity, and the weight of buried grief. When the past finally reveals its cruelty, Kanakam makes a haunting choice — choosing silence as the final punishment, knowing some truths are meant not to heal, but to haunt.

tt37844587.name: The Confession of Paul Jobson
tt37844587.description: A film crew unknowingly welcomes a true psychopath onto their set. But when they push his buttons one too many times, their shoot turns into a deadly game of survival.

videos.title: Reel Vs Real
videos.overview: A film crew unknowingly welcomes a true psychopath onto their set. But when they push his buttons one too many times, their shoot turns into a deadly game of survival.

tt37803840.name: Police Police
tt37803840.description: A cop hires a criminal to become a cop illegally. How long will they manage to get away with it?

videos.title: The Clash of Paths
videos.overview: Sub-Inspector Raja lives a disciplined life while Murali spends his time gambling. What happens when the two encounter each other for the first time in a moment of conflict?

videos.title: A Chance at Redemption
videos.overview: Murali redeems himself by helping SI Raja identify the culprit in a chain-snatching case. How will Raja react when he narrates his life's dream to him?

videos.title: Vaavar's Rise
videos.overview: Because of SI Raja's aggressive actions, he is restrained from handling cases at the station. This leaves Vaavar to dominate every investigation.

videos.title: Raja's Offer
videos.overview: In a bid to reestablish himself at the station, Raja extends an offer to Murali. But will Murali accept it?

videos.title: The Uniform of Dreams
videos.overview: A fading wish, a fragile bond - the only world Murali knows is on the verge of disappearing.

videos.title: The Paths We Dare
videos.overview: When loyalties and risks collide, a single decision can change the course of two lives... or trap them both.

videos.title: Hidden Training
videos.overview: As secrets come to light, can Murali step onto a new path? Or will the memories of the past continue to follow him?

videos.title: First Day
videos.overview: Murali steps into his new role. Now, he and Raja must keep the secrets that brought them together.

videos.title: Shifting Moves
videos.overview: Murali and Lalithambika’s game takes a new turn. Now, can mysteries hold? Or will Raja and Vaavar’s secret dealings change everything?

videos.title: Echoes of the Hunt
videos.overview: A trap is laid in the park. Though the kidnappers were in sight, constable Murali’s error alters everything.

videos.title: Roasted by the Minister
videos.overview: Raja gets trapped under the weight of power and authority. Meanwhile, Murali stands confused and helpless.

videos.title: Unexpected Allies
videos.overview: Lalithambika and Murali, once enemies by necessity, are forced to become allies. What will happen next?

videos.title: Past Imperfect
videos.overview: Raja's painful past is revealed to Murali. Thanks to their friends, Lalithambika and Murali are forced to sit through a movie together.

videos.title: Operation Love Letter
videos.overview: Skeletal remains are found in a cemented drum, and Vaavar is tasked to solve it. Meanwhile, Jeeva and team chase a thief who left behind a love letter.

videos.title: Centre of Attention
videos.overview: Muniyandi asks his son about a kidnapped college boy. Arthana questions Vaavar about the status of the cemented skeleton case, but Murali already has answers.

videos.title: Kidnapping a Case
videos.overview: Murali volunteers to solve the case of the kidnapped college boy, but Vaavar has its file under lock and key. Meanwhile, Lalithambika comes across Raja's daughter on the road.

videos.title: An Unexpected Meeting
videos.overview: After years, Raja and Neelasundaravalli come face to face. As forgotten emotions from the past resurface, where will this unexpected encounter take their love journey?

videos.title: The Unfinished Chapter
videos.overview: As Vaavar’s hunt for truth begins, will the outcome be as he expects? Raja and Neelasundaravalli’s untold love story unfolds. In a tale of love, who made the mistakes?

videos.title: The Missed Details
videos.overview: After providing solid evidence, Vaavar closes the murder case. Murali, however, feels something is not right and secretly begins his own investigation. Will his efforts bear fruit?

videos.title: Trust Your Instincts!
videos.overview: Murali’s instinct insists that something is amiss, and he finds himself re-investigating a case already thought as solved. Will his gut be right this time?

videos.title: The Hidden Badge
videos.overview: Murali’s secret life as a cop begins to unravel when his past comes chasing. As chaos erupts, SI Raja steps in, and Lalithambika’s quiet presence weaves into the unfolding storm.

videos.title: First Pay
videos.overview: Murali begins to understand the pulse of police life through Raja’s guidance. His first salary becomes a moment of pride and warmth, bridging the distance between duty and home.

videos.title: The Power Play
videos.overview: Raja fumes when illegal money linked to a minister slip from the law’s grip. With Murali’s sharp idea, the chase shifts from the streets to strategy, where power and justice clash.

videos.title: The Fall of Power
videos.overview: Murali’s master plan unfolds with surgical precision, pulling a powerful minister into a web of his own making. As truth surfaces, a father’s silence burns louder than his power.

videos.title: A Quiet Shift
videos.overview: A regular day at the station brings small tensions and quiet victories. Unspoken changes linger in the air, setting up a new phase for everyone.

videos.title: Operation Ganga Cow
videos.overview: A routine complaint turns into a quirky field mission that puts the station’s teamwork and patience to the test. What starts as a light assignment leads to an unexpected trail.

videos.title: Echoes from Two Decades
videos.overview: A promising lead takes the team back 20 years into a forgotten killing. What starts as a routine enquiry ends with a chilling recollection of the past.

videos.title: Buried Truths
videos.overview: Clues from the past take Raja and Murali deeper into an unsolved murder. Each answer raises new questions about what really happened 20 years ago.

videos.title: Algorithm of Memories
videos.overview: As Raja follows an AI trace, a reunion with his childhood friend Shwetha reawakens the past. Neela’s impulsive choice adds a new twist to the team’s rhythm.

videos.title: Collision Point
videos.overview: An official lead and a personal choice collide on the same day. An attack at Lalithambika’s office pulls Raja into a rescue that blurs every line between case and care.

videos.title: Sugar and Surveillance
videos.overview: In Visakhapatnam, a modest sweet stall hides more than sugar. Murali and Lalithambika’s undercover move draw the suspect out, but every smile at the counter could be a test.

videos.title: Closing Circuit
videos.overview: Every clue points to one moment and it finally arrives. Raja connects the missing links and cracks both cases in a move that rewrites the investigation’s course.

videos.title: Party and the Paper
videos.overview: Raja, Murali and the rest of the team celebrate the completion of a difficult case. But the calm fractures when Swetha is attacked at the hospital and a vital file is stolen.

videos.title: Ashes of the Truth
videos.overview: A son’s breakdown changes everything for Muniyandi. Lalitha and Murali spend quality time together. But what happens when a stolen post-mortem report goes up in flames?

videos.title: Neon Clue
videos.overview: Murali’s search for a strange glow-mask opens a path no one expected. As the dots start to align, Muniyandi makes a silent decision that pushes the case into deeper waters.

videos.title: Warmth and Whispers
videos.overview: A tender meeting arranged by Murali brings an unexpected softness to Raja’s day. However, a young girl’s absence hints that the moment of joy might have come with a shadow.

videos.title: The White Clue
videos.overview: A sudden incident pushes Raja and Murali towards an unexpected trail. As a forgotten detail unfolds, tensions erupt when Neela storms in. A white clue changes course of the case.

videos.title: The Mask Trail
videos.overview: The team chases the origins of a mysterious mask, only to find the trail growing thinner. In the station, uneasy silences and hidden fears begin to surface.

videos.title: Written in Clues
videos.overview: The team examines one letter that could unlock everything. Each stroke, each mark, draws the net tighter. Soon, the case feels uncomfortably near.

videos.title: Breaking Point
videos.overview: Just as the investigation tightens, a brutal incident rattles everyone. Fear and anger rise on both sides of the law. The station enters an unfamiliar territory.

videos.title: Trouble Visits More Than Once
videos.overview: Aachi and Lalithambika get hospitalised. While Vaavar's temper and Muniyandi's suspension unsettle the team, one truth becomes clear: nothing stays buried for long.

videos.title: The Weight of the Truth
videos.overview: Troubled by Vaavar's warning, Murali goes into a state of panic. A simple missing bike complaint opens a trail that refuses to stay simple.

videos.title: A Trail and a Shadow
videos.overview: Raja follows a quiet danger, one that began with Lalitha. Somewhere outside the station, a pair of old eyes starts watching the officers more closely.

videos.title: Warmth and Clashing Realities
videos.overview: Lalitha settles into a new space, unaware of the emotions it awakens. Raja starts investigating all the bike gangs. Meanwhile, Vinoth visits Murali's station.

videos.title: Emotional Turmoil
videos.overview: The case stirs up old memories as Murali and Raja battle their inner conflicts. Neela, in pain, tries to call Raja, but cannot reach him.

videos.title: The Missing Rudraksha!
videos.overview: Vinoth’s missing Rudraksha has Murali worried as his past returns to haunt him. Raja wonders about Murali’s strange behaviour. Meanwhile, a desperate Neela takes a drastic step.

videos.title: Inner Struggle
videos.overview: Murali worries about his secret being revealed. Meanwhile, Raja is angry with Murali's strange behaviour. Will Vishwa’s word of advice guide him through his stress?

videos.title: The Drug Route
videos.overview: Lalitha tries to comfort a dejected Murali. When Raja senses his conflict, Murali confesses to him. With the air cleared between them, Raja takes a firm decision.

videos.title: Confession and Confusion
videos.overview: Murali gets clarity on Vinoth's role in his past through his confession. Meanwhile, confusion arises at the station as the cops struggle to crack an existing case.

videos.title: Award Gone Wrong
videos.overview: It was supposed to be a happy family moment, a milestone in Neela's professional career, but again Mission MAD fails. Meanwhile, Murali springs many surprises on Lalitha.

videos.title: Wheel of Life
videos.overview: Finally, Murali brings his magic moving house to Lalitha. A major incident from Murali's past is unravelled because of Bheemji.

videos.title: The End or the New Beginning!
videos.overview: Murali's struggle with the past and Raja's search for Lalitha's attacker ends. But the answer isn't something they're going to like as a much bigger challenge begins.

videos.title: A Bond Breaks! A Bond Forms!
videos.overview: After the unexpected turn of events, Murali ends his friendship with Vinoth. For Lalitha, a new chapter is set to begin as she gets closer to Murali and bonds with his grandmother.

videos.title: Matchmaking!
videos.overview: The case of a missing bride takes Raja to his better half. Lalitha's father registers her name at the matrimony office, but Swetha is a step ahead as she plays the matchmaker.

videos.title: Mission MAD Ends in Vain
videos.overview: Neela finds out who is behind Mission MAD and changes her divorce lawyer. Vaavar sets out to bring justice to Mohammad Ali while Raja continues his search for the missing bride.

videos.title: Two Different Paths
videos.overview: Murali and Lalitha enjoy the first essence of their love. Raja is shocked to get a divorce notice from Neela. Meanwhile, the case believed to be solved takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: The Root of All Evil
videos.overview: Lalitha and Murali confess to Raja about the reason behind Neela's recent outburst. A dejected Raja informs them what conspired on that day to lead to his and Neela's split.

videos.title: Raja Finds the Bride
videos.overview: Raja works his way to find the missing bride who was earlier considered as a fraudster. Meanwhile, Aira learns about the past he shares with Raja.

videos.title: No Giving Up!
videos.overview: Lalitha encourages Raja not to give up and to fight his case against Neela. While Swency is firm that Jeeva learns to ride a bicycle, the Mohammad Ali case takes a positive turn.

videos.title: Parents and Problems
videos.overview: During the divorce hearing, Raja and Neela dispute over Sathya’s custody. Lalitha’s father, on the other hand, comes between his daughter and her love unintentionally.

videos.title: The Price Of Truth
videos.overview: Murali is shocked to learn about Lalitha’s father. Worried that Murali's truth may land them in trouble, Raja gives him an ultimatum. Ayiravathan warns Raja of an upcoming rivalry.

videos.title: Duty Or Desire?
videos.overview: Shattered, Murali avoids Lalitha, who worries about his behaviour. Ayiravathan prepares kids and youth to fight for their caste while his men wage an indirect war against the cops.

videos.title: In The Dark
videos.overview: Unable to bear his silence, an anxious Lalitha confronts Murali. Meanwhile, despite several issues, Raja and Murali see some light in their quest to solve Mohammad Ali's case.

videos.title: Round 1 Goes to Ayiravathan
videos.overview: Raja and Murali track down Mohammad Ali's killer and arrest him. However, things turn against Raja in the courtroom, leading to his suspension, much to Ayiravathan’s relief.

videos.title: Clueless Days
videos.overview: The cops struggle with electricity and landowner issues. Lalitha is unable to assess Murali’s strange behaviour. Suspended Raja is spotted at a place no one expected him to be in.

videos.title: The Cops Strike Back!
videos.overview: Under Raja's direction, the cops strike back at the landowner and the EB guys. Later, Raja gets closer to one of Ayiravathan's accomplices.

videos.title: Powered Again
videos.overview: With swift action of the police, the landowner issue is resolved, and power is restored at the station. While Lalitha confronts Murali, Raja sets out to gather new evidence.

videos.title: Payback Time
videos.overview: The Mohammed Ali case is back for hearing. Raja gives it back to Ayiravathan as Palani Veerappan is convicted for causing the accident. Someone is moving closer to Murali's truth.

videos.title: Yet Another Challenge
videos.overview: The detective demands a bribe from Raja and Murali to hide Murali’s secret. While Raja encourages a dejected Murali to fight back, he is unaware of Ayiravathan’s next strike.

videos.title: As Different as Night and Day
videos.overview: Murali and Lalitha hide their newfound romance from Raja. Meanwhile, Raja's personal secrets come to light after a video is released by Ayiravathan’s team.

videos.title: In the Shadows!
videos.overview: Lalitha and Murali’s romantic lunch is disturbed by Raja. Later, to nullify the detective’s threat, Murali follows him and figures there is something fishy about his activities.

videos.title: Caught ‘Gold’ Handed!
videos.overview: The detective’s illegal gold smuggling deed is discovered by Raja and Murali and both parties agree mutually to forgo their findings. Neela’s shocking news startles everyone.

videos.title: Misery of a Child and God
videos.overview: A distressed Sathya enters a judge's chamber in court and her question shocks everyone. Raja’s probe affects Neela. Later, Raja and Murali go after a missing God's crown.

videos.title: Not on the Same Page
videos.overview: Raja and Murali's opinions vary in the lost crown case as they doubt two different people. Lalitha has a spat with Gautham for refusing a lucrative offer from one of his friends.

videos.title: Is Blood Thicker than Water?
videos.overview: Feeling guilty, Neela decides to unite with Raja for Sathya’s sake. Raja and Murali catch the thief of the missing crown in Kanagavel's house. However, the crown is still missing.

videos.title: Chasing the Crown and Throne
videos.overview: After retrieving the crown, the cops find out who the mastermind is. Ayiravathan, who is chasing the MLA throne, learns that Lalitha is his only hurdle and he confronts her.

videos.title: Home is Sweet and Sour
videos.overview: Raja shifts to Neela's house after agreeing to conditions and signing an agreement. At the station, Jeeva gets a weird case when a family is attacked by someone that's not a human.

videos.title: Fight Against Discrimination
videos.overview: The alien fiasco is solved by Raja. He moves a step forward against discrimination by taking up Karthik's honour killing case. However, his life in Neela's house has a rocky start.

videos.title: On Cloud Nine!
videos.overview: Murali and Raja are over the moon. While Raja is happy at Neela's house, Murali and Lalitha have their share of fun. The cops fail to get proof in the Karthik murder case.

videos.title: New Crimes, New Clues
videos.overview: Raja's crime rate increases as Neela finds him breaking home rules. Murali goes awry during a romantic video call with Lalitha. Later, the cop duo gets a step closer to the truth.

videos.title: Getting Closer
videos.overview: Raja and Murali are getting closer to identifying Karthik's killer. Later, Murali discreetly acquires evidence from Eli by swapping his phone with a decoy.

videos.title: Standing Up
videos.overview: The commissioner scolds the cops for investigating the Karthik murder case. Vaavar defends his team, and the commissioner warns Lalitha. She resists, sparking tension with Murali.

videos.title: The Sacrifice
videos.overview: Raja seeks help to turn the case around. Meanwhile, Ayira retraces the cops' moves and realises they're too close, forcing him to sacrifice someone to protect himself.

videos.title: Hurdles Everywhere
videos.overview: Raja plans to stay with his father, but Neela insists he comes home. As troubles arise, the Karthik murder hearing starts hopeful, but linking Ayira fails since the A1 is dead.

videos.title: Anything Can Happen in Love
videos.overview: After the Karthik case setback, Lalitha got upset at Murali, while Raja and Neela grew closer. Swency told Jeeva that love had created the imaginary alien.

videos.title: Love Takes You Through Time
videos.overview: To win Lalitha over, Murali gives her everything she loved as a child, including a school crush. During the Mohammad Ali murder case, Raja and Murali discover a new character.

videos.title: Romance With and Without a Car
videos.overview: Murali and Lalitha share a loving car ride, while Raja creates a moment with Neela on his bike. Raja and Murali find a way to contact Ramesh, key to the Mohammad Ali case.

videos.title: Love Can Hurt
videos.overview: The cops retrieve Mohammad Ali’s data, which cost him his life. Lalitha is overjoyed when her grandfather recalls her and asks about her marriage.

videos.title: Bedridden!
videos.overview: Raja suspects his accident was deliberate. The station is alarmed when the lorry driver surrenders. When Raja settles in Neela's house, an unexpected visitor arrives to meet him.

videos.title: The Confrontation
videos.overview: Ayira welcomes a foreigner business partner. Shwetha discovers that many school students are affected by a disease. Raja confronts Murali about his secret romance with Lalitha.

videos.title: Something Deep Inside
videos.overview: Neela invites Murali and Lalitha for lunch and apologises for her behaviour. Raja and Murali steal sand samples from Ayira's yard and send them for testing. The result shocks them.

videos.title: Cat is Out of the Bag
videos.overview: The cops try to get details about Ayira's Korean partner. Raja plans action, but Murali and Jeeva fail to catch Kim. Lalitha feels shattered to learn of Murali's past from Stella.

videos.title: Protest No More!
videos.overview: Kim gets angry with the situation. Ayira handles the protesters and media, while his wife convinces the mothers to leave the protest site. Raja is upset to see his plan go in vain.

videos.title: Another Case, Another Disappointment
videos.overview: Lalitha tries to pin the silicosis issue on Ayira. The quarry's fate is decided, but Palani Veerappan comes up with a plan

videos.title: Too Much Exposure
videos.overview: Gautham secretly records Lalitha and Raja’s conversation as Raja tries to convince her about Murali’s truth. The Commissioner gets furious when he learns Lalitha loves Murali.

videos.title: The Axis Power
videos.overview: Ayira is cornered by Kim and the syndicate. Palani Veerappan gets caught by cops. Ayira shows Gautham’s recording to the Commissioner and together, they form a dangerous alliance.

videos.title: The Blues
videos.overview: Murali and Jeeva spot Ayira get a blue wig from a salon. Vaavar informs the team that police trainer Radhakrishnan is arriving for the Police Day event, shocking Murali and Jeeva.

videos.title: A New Alliance
videos.overview: Ayira and the commissioner clash over the Murali-Raja case. Later, Muniyandi calls out Raja for fraudulently appointing Murali as a police officer.

videos.title: All is Well
videos.overview: Love is back in Raja and Neela's life. Murali gets Vinoth to spy on Ayira. The commissioner joins Raja and Murali as they round up Ayira, but something unexpected happens.

videos.title: All is Not Well
videos.overview: During Police Day celebrations, Murali urges Lalitha to stay, but she ignores him. He evades Radhakrishnan's threat but is caught by the commissioner, beginning a new mission.

tt31925699.name: Arabia Kadali
tt31925699.description: A fictional suspense drama series that revolves around a group of fishermen from rival villages who inadvertently trespass into international waters and find themselves imprisoned in a foreign jail.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In the rival villages of Chepalawada and Matsyawada, fishermen journey to Sangrol for the fishing season. On their way to the fishing port in Gujarat, a violent scuffle breaks out among the men, causing some to be thrown off the train. Will they make it to the port on time and join this year’s fishing expedition?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Badiri and the fishermen begin their expedition with a bad omen, and they are given two rundown boats unfit for the deep sea. Ganga, a passionate teacher in the coastal village, is torn between her love for Badiri and her fears for her brother Chinna, entangled in illegal activities.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Badiri sails into a deadly storm, chasing his father’s lost legacy. Lightning cracks as waves crash, nearly swallowing his crew. Then, a Pakistani Navy speedboat emerges from the dark, silent, fast, and closing in. Heart pounding with grief and fear, Badiri must outrun the sea’s fury and this shadowy threat to save his men.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Captured at sea, Indian fishermen face an uncertain fate in Karachi. While being transported, their situation turns catastrophe as a shattering bomb blast erupts mid-transport. In court, Badiri fiercely defends his peers, embodying loyalty and hope. In India, back in the village, they find out about their loved ones trapped in jail and are shattered.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In Matsyawada, villagers panic over the arrest of the fishermen. Ganga gets a loan from Sekhar and heads to Vishakhapatnam to start the quest for the fishermen's release. Government officials, Susheel and Swaroop, push hard to bring the men back home. Will the fishermen ever return, or is a darker truth lurking just out of reach?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In the shadows of a Pakistani prison, Indian fisherman Badiri fights for survival against ruthless terrorists plotting against him, and a tormented guard harbours a deadly secret that could save or doom him. While back in Matsyawada, heartbroken Ganga clings to cryptic letters amid government silence and a sinister smuggling web threatening to unravel their world in an instant.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In a sweltering prison yard, a warden's rare mercy sparks a chain of buried secrets when a guard uncovers a withheld letter that could upend fragile bonds among inmates. The news of partial releases after two gruelling years stirs hope, regret, and unspoken fears among the confined.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: In the village gripped by despair, innocent Chinna falls into a treacherous money scheme to free his jailed father, while Ganga ignites a viral protest, amassing a growing coalition of supporters. Will their collective courage liberate the captives, or will malevolent forces prevail?

tt28755900.name: Love Under Construction
tt28755900.description: Vinod is ready to build his dream house. But is he ready to face the hurdles in his path?

videos.title: Foundation of Love
videos.overview: Pappan oversees the work of Vinod's new home in Kerala. In Dubai, Vinod, who is building this home for his eager parents, meets Gouri. But a job loss throws his future into turmoil.

videos.title: Building Bridges
videos.overview: Gouri pushes for marriage and a move to Canada. With no job, a half-built house, a mounting debt, and disapproving families, what will Vinod do?

videos.title: Reinforced Romance
videos.overview: Vinod and Pappan try to fast-track the marriage registration, but a vindictive officer refuses to help them. As Vinod struggles with money, he gets shocking news.

videos.title: Bricks and Hearts
videos.overview: Vinod is hit with fraud, the secret about the wall collapse and more money struggles. As Gouri's father tightens control, her mother accuses their maid of theft.

videos.title: Sealing the Cracks
videos.overview: Vinod returns the pawned jewellery but gets into a fight with Gouri's dad. When rumours start flying linking Pappan and Gouri, Vinod and Gouri realise they have no time to lose.

videos.title: The Final Coat
videos.overview: While Gouri faces her angry father, Vinod challenges the overseer. At the registration office, Gouri finally loses her patience and temper when Vinod arrives really late.

tt36600023.name: Mayasabha
tt36600023.description: Mayasabha is a period political drama set in Mid 70s Andhra Pradesh. Krishnama Naidu, an idealistic student leader and a charismatic MS Rami Reddy wade into the world of Andhra politics. As they turn thick friends, they strive to use politics as a means to achieve public good. But caste fault lines erupt, loyalties are tested and their bond is pushed to the brink. Will their friendship sustain the brutal ascent of power where there is place for only one at the summit?

videos.title: The Story Of India Is The Story Of Caste
videos.overview: A determined KKN defies his family to pursue higher education, showcasing sharp leadership in a surprising turn. Meanwhile, MSR, a medical student from a powerful family, makes a bold move for love that challenges tradition. Witness their pivotal first steps toward uncertain futures.

videos.title: Natural Born Leaders
videos.overview: MSR's loyalty to his matinee idol sparks a confrontation, resulting in a possible rustication from college. Elsewhere, KKN bravely challenges a dominant political force in college elections. Will his passion overcome cunning sabotage and betrayal?

videos.title: A 'Hi' Amidst Chaos
videos.overview: MSR navigates family feuds and deadly attacks, seeking peace with his new bride. Meanwhile, KKN rescues the girl he loves from a life of misery, but fate has something else in store for him. Their separate struggles culminate in a pivotal bus journey where they meet for the first time.

videos.title: Rebels With A Cause
videos.overview: KKN becomes an enforcer for a controversial government policy, while MSR fiercely resists it. This leads to a fiery confrontation, but as they clash over ideals, a surprising connection forms. Witness the dramatic birth of an unlikely and powerful friendship.

videos.title: Ticket To Mayasabha
videos.overview: KKN orchestrates a grand political event, hoping for a big break. But ego and jealousy threaten KKN's dreams, testing his perseverance. Meanwhile, MSR is drawn into politics by a stinging insult, setting both friends on separate electoral paths.

videos.title: Train To Mayasabha
videos.overview: MSR has to navigate the complexities of caste politics in pursuit of victory. KKN faces a daunting election with no funds to run his campaign. Can idealism triumph over money? Witness the nail-biting vote count as two friends embark on their political destinies.

videos.title: Awakening The Sabha
videos.overview: With lofty ambitions, KKN and MSR enter the assembly, only to find themselves powerless amidst apathy and corruption. They devise a cunning plan to create chaos and rise through the ranks. As political musical chairs intensify, their strategic ascent to power sets the stage for a dramatic clash with a legendary figure.

videos.title: The Caste Fault Lines
videos.overview: MSR pushes for action against the armed rebels, sparking a heated ideological clash with KKN. Meanwhile, internal power struggles in the party culminate in a brutal humiliation for the chief minister, setting the stage for a new regional party and an iconic campaign.

videos.title: Surviving The Tsunami
videos.overview: KKN faces a shocking political challenge from his own father-in-law, which puts him in a tough spot with Iravati. When KKN and MSR experience different fortunes in the elections, their bond is tested as they face a heartbreaking choice that forever changes their friendship.

tt36643714.name: Operation Safed Sagar: The Untold Story of the Kargil War
tt36643714.description: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

tt33131120.name: 1000 Babies
tt33131120.description: Enter a cradle of mysteries where a man with a dark past manipulates multiple lives through a series of cryptic letters and deadly games.

tt37356230.name: AIR
tt37356230.description: Three boys. One elite college. A system that demands perfection. Arjun, Imran, and Raju come from different worlds but share one secret: they don’t want to be here. As rebellion sparks friendship, their bond deepens amid pressure, heartbreak, and identity struggles. Guided by a radical teacher with a troubled past, they must decide who they truly are—beyond marks and expectations.

videos.title: Integration
videos.overview: A journey that will test friendship, ambition, and identity. Arjun follows love, Raju battles pressure, and Imran chases dreams against all odds—at All India Rankers Junior College, where the real test is life itself

videos.title: Resistance
videos.overview: At All India Rankers Junior College, Arjun, Imran, and Raju find themselves trapped in a system they never chose. Arjun is disheartened when his school crush doesn’t show up. Imran, hopeful at first, struggles with homesickness and isolation. Raju feels caged in hostel life under a strict teacher’s watch. Each boy is alone—until a shared act of rebellion sparks a bond that could change everything.

videos.title: Radioactive
videos.overview: Determined to escape, Arjun, Imran, and Raju try everything to get expelled—from wild stunts to pranking staff. When nothing works, they take one final shot: storming the principal’s office with cricket bats. What happens next could change everything.

videos.title: Fusion
videos.overview: Arjun backs out mid-rebellion, shocking Imran and Raju. As tensions rise, the truth comes out—and so does a deeper bond. With Jayshree and Lucky, a new gang forms. But just as things click, a new threat emerges.

videos.title: Irreversible
videos.overview: A shuffling exam threatens to split Arjun, Imran, and Raju, each desperate to hold on to what matters. Meanwhile, new teacher Surya’s unorthodox methods stir trouble and change. Choices made now could have lasting consequences.

videos.title: The Catalyst
videos.overview: Caught cheating on the shuffling exam, Arjun, Imran, and Raju face harsh punishment from Parthasarathy, the ruthless college owner. Surya’s unorthodox teaching clashes with management as his painful past unfolds—but even he can’t protect the boys from the fallout.

videos.title: Equilibrium
videos.overview: After their public fall, Arjun, Imran, and Raju are sent home but return with new resolve. Placed in the lowest section, they rebuild under Surya’s guidance and prepare to challenge the top students—on a journey of friendship, failure, and resilience.

tt27540960.name: Jai Mahendran
tt27540960.description: When Mahendran, a corrupt and manipulative deputy Thasildar, believes in getting things done through powerplay and influence within the system, becomes the victim of his own plans to sabotage an entire system in an attempt to safeguard his job and restore his reputation.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Mahendran, the deputy tehsildar, agrees to help Joseph, a man facing legal issues due a name mismatch in his mother's documents, upon learning that he is a close friend of a Member of Parliament. Meanwhile, the impending monsoon leads to concerns with the public over a dam that may breach due to heavy rainfall.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Mahendran asks Biju to create a certificate that would help the old lady but not be used as a political weapon against him. Meanwhile, the office employees bid farewell to Tehsildar Shibu, who is replaced by Tehsildar Shobha, who has a different way of running things.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Mahendran is displeased with Shobha's posting, as Prajas approaches him pledging to forget his political affiliation and join Mahendran's union if he is relieved from control room duty. Meanwhile, Shobha notices that Mahendran is not in office and marks a half-day against his attendance, infuriating him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The news of Mahendran and Shobha's suspension creates headlines in the media. While Shobha is devastated, Mahendran looks for support from his political party. However, the leaders wash their hands off the scandal and tell him there's nothing they can do for him.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Biju agrees to help Mahendran when he realises that the only way to trap those responsible for the scandal is to investigate the land document records. When news of the corruption in the land distributed to the 48 families breaks, Aravindan is pressured to find out how the files were leaked. Meanwhile, Unni tells Shobha that it would be easier to pay the bribe than expect a fair investigation.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After joining hands with Shobha to clear both their names, Mahendran meets with the leader of the opposite faction of the ruling party. Later, at a protest, Harichandran is attacked by goons who disguised themselves as the minister's supporters.

tt27494250.name: Nadu Center
tt27494250.description: They fight, they fall, they rise... together!

videos.title: Watch and Learn
videos.overview: PK joins a new school, but trouble follows him. Parvathi, the vice principal, plans to fix the school's prestige by forming a basketball team, but PK has sworn off the game.

videos.title: You Should Play Again
videos.overview: Disappointed with PK's behaviour, VP demands to see him, but he skips school to avoid facing her. Worried, Abel tries desperately to reach him.

videos.title: School Full of Cuckoos
videos.overview: PK goes back to school in search of the person who put the joint in his bag. He is sent to the VP's room and gets rebuked for ruining the school's reputation.

videos.title: You Dunnit
videos.overview: Chandru suffers as his family is stuck in a complicated situation, and his sister is his only moral support. He vents his frustrations on PK, and PK does not back down.

videos.title: Final Warning!
videos.overview: PK and Chandru face VP's wrath, but things take an unexpected turn for them. PK recollects events and incidents from his previous school, and gains perspective towards this school.

videos.title: Coffee..?
videos.overview: Cultural fever begins at KB School. PK gets a bitter-sweet surprise on his birthday. While Guru and Kalidas decide to partake in fashion show, PK is in a dilemma about his past.

videos.title: Break-up and Basketball
videos.overview: PK meets Sanjana, and they share an unexpected evening together. Influenced by the experience, PK realises he needs closure, leading him to play once more for that elusive victory.

videos.title: If Only Words Meant Something
videos.overview: PK convinces the VP to let him assemble a team, but she refuses his request. Meanwhile, Guru and Kaali are in the process of recruiting girls for the fashion show.

videos.title: Wanna Play?
videos.overview: PK tries to introduce basketball, hoping to form a team to compete in a tournament, but encounters a lack of interest. Meanwhile, Guru and Kaali's friendship is put to the test.

videos.title: The Cultural Fest
videos.overview: During the cultural fest, PK sets out on a mission to find players for his basketball team. Elsewhere, Fara befriends a guy online and invites him to meet her at the event.

videos.title: Knock Out
videos.overview: As PK and Jade bond, he throws down a challenge to his rival basketball team. Later, the cultural fest spirals into chaos, dragging Abel into a nightmare.

videos.title: Written and Directed by Guru
videos.overview: Except for PK and Jayanth, the rest of the suspended students return to school. Meanwhile, inspired by the chaos that happened at culturals, Guru writes his own film.

videos.title: Never Quit Basketball
videos.overview: PK unites with his former coach and finds motivation. Friends gather for Jayanth as PK trains the team, while VP pushes the management to approve the basketball team.

videos.title: Not in Sync
videos.overview: Fara and Kaali go through a rough patch with their families, while Guru and Kaali get into a fight. Amid all this chaos, PK finds it challenging to manage without a coach.

videos.title: A Day's Time
videos.overview: Vettri steps in as the KB team's unofficial coach but continues losing as PK waits for his first win. PK must decide whether to compete in a tournament hosted by his former school.

videos.title: Let's Face It
videos.overview: A frustrated PK considers withdrawing from the tournament. Chandru worsens matters by fixing a match without the team's consent.

videos.title: One Win!
videos.overview: PK decides to join the SPI school tournament with his team, but just as things fall into place, everything begins to fall apart. Can PK still claim victory?

tt27494250.language: Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi

tt36912840.name: Devika & Danny
tt36912840.description: Devika, a compassionate and grounded music teacher living a seemingly ordinary life, is engaged to an insecured and possessive Jaggu. Meanwhile, she bumps into a stranger Danny and his arrival begins to shift Devika's world, leading her down an unforeseen path of self-discovery and unexpected connections.

videos.title: The Priest's Prediction
videos.overview: Docile and obedient Devika gets engaged to domineering Jaggi. Her world changes when a mysterious stranger, Danny, enters her life. Meanwhile, Durga and his gang look for Dannny

videos.title: The Family Secret
videos.overview: Devika and Danny grow close to eath other, and she opens up to him. Feeling guilty, Danny reveals an impossible truth about himself.

videos.title: Danny's Pursuit
videos.overview: Upset wih Danny, Devika refuses to help him. Sensing something strange in the house, Devika's grandfathwe conducts a ritual to drive away

videos.title: Devika Defies the Sacred Order
videos.overview: Danny recalls and how he was saved by Durga, a gang leader. Folllowing Durga's orders, Danny tries to forcefully empty  a building , only to learn it's an orphange

videos.title: Journey that Redefined Her Destiny
videos.overview: To hellp Danny, Devika concocts an excuse and seceretly leaves for Hyderabad with Danny, Pinky and Subbu. While Jaggi confronts confronts her family, a priest

videos.title: The Road to Danny's Redemption
videos.overview: Devika and Danny go to Durga's house to get Gayathri Amma's documents. Devika finally confronts Jaggi and her spiritual journey begins.

videos.title: The Frog Jumps Out of the Bowl
videos.overview: Devika and Danny go to Durga's house to get Gayathri Amma's documents. Devika finally confronts Jaggi and her spiritual journey begins.

tt40914930.name: Alliance
tt40914930.description: A competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points-the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

tt15478036.name: Manorathangal
tt15478036.description: Eight legendary filmmakers collaborate with 9 superstars, breathing life into the timeless stories of author M.T. Vasudevan Nair. Based in Kerala, these stories explore the nuances of human nature.

videos.title: Olavum Theeravum
videos.overview: Vappootty, a timber trader, finds himself in love with Nabeesa, the sister of his late friend. Their romance faces obstacles as Nabeesa's mother, who works as a prostitute, attempts to marry her off to Kunjali, a wealthy trader.

videos.title: Kadugannava
videos.overview: Venugopal, a journalist, travels to Sri Lanka for a seminar but ends up on a journey to find Leela, a woman he believes is his step-sister.

videos.title: Kazhcha
videos.overview: Sudha returns to her hometown only to break the news of her failing marriage to her mother. While the women try to dissuade her from getting a divorce, she finds support in the most unexpected place.

videos.title: Shilalikhitham
videos.overview: History Professor Gopalankutty and his daughter visit his village to investigate stone inscriptions found in an old temple. However, a girl’s death in the village pits the two against each other.

videos.title: Vilpana
videos.overview: Sunil and Mrs. Parekh meet when he goes to buy a particular piece of furniture from her. The two form an unlikely friendship when she introduces him as her husband to other prospective buyers.

videos.title: Sherlock
videos.overview: An alcoholic in recovery, Balu travels to the USA to spend time with his sister and find a job. His life in America takes a turn when the pet cat, Sherlock Holmes Shinde, starts following him around.

videos.title: Kadalkkaattu
videos.overview: Keshav moves away from his family and his pregnant wife, Bharathi, to earn a better living. Soon, he refuses to return to the village as he finds himself attracted to another woman, Margaret.

videos.title: Abhayam Thedi, Veendum
videos.overview: A man returns to his village in Kerala, which seems to have changed over the years. Unable to find his old home, he seeks shelter in an abandoned house. What happens when the owner returns?

videos.title: Swargam Thurakkunna Samayam
videos.overview: The benefactor of a village, Kuttinarayanan predicts that Master Madhavan will die the next day and calls for his family to visit. However, the family feels cheated when Master wakes up from sleep.

tt39100726.name: Heartiley Battery
tt39100726.description: Sofia, a brilliant but emotionally guarded scientist, believes love is nothing more than biology. After witnessing her parents' relationship fall apart, she invents a device called the Love Meter to prove that true love can be measured.

videos.title: Love vs Logic
videos.overview: Sofia is a brilliant scientist who doesn’t believe in the concept of love. She creates a device called the Love Meter to measure true love. Her path crosses with Sid, a charming comic writer.

videos.title: The Challenge Begins
videos.overview: When Sofia’s device causes his close ones to break up, Sid vows revenge. He decides to prove the invention wrong by making Sofia fall in love with him.

videos.title: The 12-Hour Rule
videos.overview: Sofia and Sid end up on a forced date, but the night takes an unexpected turn. When an emotional Sofia returns home, her device shocks her further by revealing that she is falling for Sid.

videos.title: Signals and Silence
videos.overview: Sid manages to win Sofia’s heart with persistence and small gestures. Sofia finds herself missing him on the day that Sid fails to show up.

videos.title: Zero Love
videos.overview: When Sofia accepts her feelings for Sid, the device shocks her with a reading of zero. A heartbroken Sid leaves, and Sofia questions her beliefs about science and love.

videos.title: Love Beyond Logic
videos.overview: Sofia learns a life lesson about true love that needs no proof or measurement. All she has to do now is choose Sid over her beliefs. Will she choose love or logic?

tt35465105.name: Kobali
tt35465105.description: Two families become entangled in revenge, greed, and payback. Rising tensions unearth buried secrets that impact multiple lives.

videos.title: The Shadows of the Past.
videos.overview: During a village festival, Ramu is drawn into a violent conflict. The past reveals his fraught relationship with his family, especially his brother Srinu.

videos.title: The Drug Lead
videos.overview: Ramu gets into the narcotic drug trade to help his family financially. However, a clash with the local gangsters compels Srinu to intervene.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: A vengeful Ramana assigns ruthless Murthy to eliminate Sambaiah's family. Meanwhile, Ramu, embroiled in the illegal drug trade, gets caught in a dangerous web of deceit and betrayal.

videos.title: The First Strike
videos.overview: While seeking refuge after an attack, Sambaiah's family meets a girl whose father is killed. The police question Ramu after his brother Gopi gets implicated in a series of crimes.

videos.title: The Desperation
videos.overview: Srinu and Ramu flee after a deadly encounter with Peeri's gang. They learn of Gopi's betrayal and his fate. An elderly lady shelters Meena and her family, but are they really safe?

videos.title: The Hunt Begins
videos.overview: Shocked by Gopi's fate, Srinu and Ramu decide to seek revenge. While Ramu receives a crucial tip about Paidiraju's whereabouts, Srinu prepares for the inevitable confrontation.

videos.title: The Reckoning
videos.overview: Amidst the revelry of a village festival, SI Raghu confronts Paidiraju. While Srinu and his family face a new threat, Ramana spirals into grief and a thirst for revenge.

videos.title: The Confrontation
videos.overview: Srinu confronts Ramana, seeking revenge for his family's death. But a mysterious figure appears for retribution for past wrongs. What will happen to Srinu and his family?

tt27950365.name: Nagendran’s Honeymoons
tt27950365.description: A lazy man named Nagendran, who, with his friend Soman, hatches a plan to marry multiple women to earn money from dowry to escape his village and find a better life abroad.

videos.title: Jaanaki
videos.overview: When an opportunity to go to the Gulf arises, Nagendran finds himself short of funds. Soman proposes an unconventional solution: marriage.

videos.title: Lillykutty
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman arrive in Pathanamthitta to see Lillykutty. While Lillykutty weaves her influence over Nagendran, can he secure Varkey’s elusive approval?

videos.title: Laila
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman encounter Laila in Kasaragod. Her mysterious past ensnares Nagendran with fear. Can he break free from her grasp?

videos.title: Saavithri
videos.overview: Nagendran and Soman reach Palakkad to acquire the necessary funds and meet Saavithri. Can Nagendran save her, or will he get trapped in the palls of a dilapidated Brahmin household?

videos.title: Thangam
videos.overview: Why are the locals rushing to marry off Thangam? Nagendran meets Thangam in Kuttanad and struggles to outwit the locals. He and Soman try to escape from Varkey’s grasp.

videos.title: Mozhi
videos.overview: Bewitched by Mozhi at first sight, Nagendran is not able to deceive her. Tensions rise as he and Soman clash for the first time. Can Nagendran forge a new life with Mozhi?

tt32241474.name: Top Cooku Dupe Cooku
tt32241474.description: Top Cooku Dupe Cooku is an Indian Tamil-language comedy-based cooking competition show, Produced by Media Masons. The show based on Star Vijay's Cooku with Comali. It premieres on Sun TV on May 19, 2024, and airs every Sunday at 12:30 (IST). It is also available for streaming on Sun NXT. The show judged by Chef Venkatesh Bhat, Binny Krishnakumar and hosted by VJ Rakesh.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Get ready for laughter and culinary chaos! 'Top Cooku Dupe Cooku' is a comedy cookery show where a celebrity top cook teams up with a chef and a dupe cook to execute a culinary challenge. Tune in for a hilarious dose of comedy, food, and fun!

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Get ready for the laugh riot! 'Vaigaipuyal' Vadivelu brings his signature humor to 'Top Cooku Dupe Cooku'. This episode promises double the entertainment with hilarious challenges and Vadivelu's witty commentary. Don't miss out on the side-splitting fun!

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Witness Vadivelu again in the third episode of Top Cooku Dupe Cooku. It is a brand new cookery show on Sun TV, which was judged by Chef Venkatesh Bhat.
