tt31924772.name: The Rana Daggubati Show
tt31924772.description: Featuring genuine conversations, fun moments and a healthy dose of quirk- this is The Rana Daggubati Show. It’s not just another show, it’s an experience—one that dares to break norms and redefine entertainment by featuring fun and exciting conversations with stars from telugu industry and beyond.

videos.title: Normal Is Boring
videos.overview: Teja is hosting an Award Show for the first time, his entire dilemma is whether his two 'seniors' Rana & Nani, will give him the advice he needs or is he in for some whacky surprises?

videos.title: And Just Like That
videos.overview: Siddhu comes to Rana with a problem about his late-night hunger and Sreeleela joins them to find a solution.

videos.title: Cousins, Cars and Cinema
videos.overview: Rana meets Chay and they chalk a plan to soup up an old car. As they relive childhood memories they are joined by their cousins who discuss cinema, legacy and much more.

videos.title: Master Influencers
videos.overview: Rana reaches out to the Masters who have influenced him, discovering new perspectives to experience the Cinema we all love.

videos.title: Myth Buster!
videos.overview: Get ready for a whirlwind adventure as Rana Daggubati kicks off his journey to Kundapura to meet the one and only Rishab Shetty along with Neha Shetty.

videos.title: When THE GOOD BOY meets BAD BOY
videos.overview: Dulquer and Meenakshi dive into a fun conversation about their latest film and share hilarious childhood memories. The fun continues as they head to the set of Kantha, where Rana juggles producer duties and Dulquer shines as the star.

videos.title: Getting Real with the Real Star
videos.overview: After a wild New Year’s party with his friends Navdeep & Faria, Rana has a wild guest, the Cult Kannada Superstar Upendra along with Actor-Producer Sharmiela Mandre.

videos.title: V for Victory
videos.overview: Come celebrate Sankranthi in the Daggubati home, with a whole selection of Sankranthi sweets curated by Rana’s sister Ashritha, specially for Venky Sir and his squad - Aishwarya, Meenakshi & Anil. Along with a surprise visitor, the musical icon, Ramana Gogula.

tt24364990.name: Poacher
tt24364990.description: A group of Indian Forest Service officers, NGO workers, police constables and good samaritans risk their lives trying to track down the biggest elephant ivory poachers in the history of India and bring them to justice.

tt38568136.name: Kuttram Purindhavan
tt38568136.description: In a small-town, when a girl goes missing, Retiree Baskaran takes extreme measures to protect his grandson, Esther is consumed by guilt, and powerless constable Gautham races to find the truth. Secrets surface, leading to an uneasy alliance between Baskaran and Gautham, to a final showdown, justice is served, but guilt leaves some with closure and others haunted.

videos.title: In Search Of The Lost
videos.overview: On the night of village temple celebration, a man is found dead outside his home and his daughter, Mercy, vanishes without a trace. Her grieving mother, Esther, is desperate to find her child. Baskaran, a government pharmacist, is desperately waiting for his retirement money - the only hope to save his grandson Rahul, who needs urgent surgery. A reason draws Gautham, the powerless cop, close to the case.

videos.title: What Happened Last Night?
videos.overview: Mercy faces an unthinkable ordeal and is brought to Baskaran for urgent help. He tried his best, but his efforts fail. Trapped by his desperate situation, Baskaran hides the truth. When he reveals it to his wife, she is shaken and unwilling, but with no other choice, she follows his decision. Together, they bury the truth for their own gain - Cops are tracking the suspect behind Mercy's disappearance.

videos.title: Living With The Lie
videos.overview: Baskaran and his wife struggle to keep their secret buried, forced into lie after lie as every step risks exposure. Esther's search grows frantic, her dread of the worst pressing harder each day. Meanwhile, Gautham closes in, his suspicion fixed on Baskaran, and he is on the edge of finding the truth.

videos.title: Through The Darkness
videos.overview: Baskaran's desperation reaches its peak as his grandson's surgery becomes a matter of life and death. Driven by fear and love, he goes to unimaginable lengths, sinking deeper into darkness. Meanwhile, Gautham collects damning evidence, steadily piecing together Baskaran's hidden crimes.

videos.title: The Guilty Ones
videos.overview: Baskaran is consumed by guilt, haunted by the sins he committed against Esther and Mercy. Tormented, he even contemplates turning himself in. Esther struggles with her own guilt, blaming herself for her daughter's disappearance. When Baskaran meets Gautham, he finds a kindred spirit - Gautham's past guilt mirrors his own. Together, they reluctantly unite in a tense pursuit to uncover the real criminal.

videos.title: Breaking The Silence
videos.overview: The most unexpected secrets come to light, revealing hidden details of the night of the crime that no one knew. The true story of Mercy is finally uncovered, exposing shocking truths. Everything builds toward an imminent face-off between the real killer, Baskaran and Gautham.

videos.title: The Closure
videos.overview: The hunt for the killer begins amid the chaos of the temple festival. The final battle is set. Baskaran confronts the killer alone in a tense face-off, while Gautham races against time to catch him. The killer is caught, and both the killer and Baskaran are arrested. Esther is heartbroken when she learns the truth about Baskaran. In the end, the three are left to face the weight of their guilt in their own ways. The full truth comes to light.

tt32047599.name: Vikkatakavi
tt32047599.description: In the 1970s, the people of Amaragiri are devastated by a plague that causes memory loss. A detective, Rama Krishna, arrives to investigate the case. Will he find the cause or fall prey to the curse?

tt27349179.name: Perilloor Premier League
tt27349179.description: Malavika, who comes to the village of Perilloor to find love with her boyfriend Sreekuttan, unexpectedly ends up becoming the village Panchayat President against her will. Later, her life goes upside down along with the problems stirred by the wayward people of Perilloor Panchayath.
tt27349179.language: Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Hindi, Marathi, Bengali

tt38126232.name: The Game: You Never Play Alone
tt38126232.description: A career-driven game developer fights back against misogynistic expectations after she becomes the target of brutal attacks online and in real life.

tt33091601.name: The Mystery of Moksha Island
tt33091601.description: A lavish inheritance and a pharma empire lure a dead scientist's relatives to a remote island. The excitement turns into horror when they realise it's a trap.

tt14140444.name: Naagini
tt14140444.description: Nagini, a shape-shifting snake who resides in Naagalokam, vows to take revenge on the greedy human beings responsible for killing her parents for the Naagamani.

videos.title: Vishnu Joins Rudran
videos.overview: Nagini, a shape-shifting snake who resides in Naagalokam, vows to take revenge on the greedy human beings responsible for killing her parents for the Naagamani.

tt35657767.name: Office
tt35657767.description: Two types of work ethics clash when analogue meets digital in a rural government workplace, propelling the mundane to hilarious.

videos.title: New Arrival
videos.overview: Villagers protest at the Tahsildar Office for a 'just' cause. While the office staff prepares to welcome the Collector, a person arrives in a government-issued beacon car.

videos.title: Mistaken Identity
videos.overview: Paari gets baffled over the VIP treatment given by the government staff. Just when he realises the misunderstanding and is about to resolve it, he sees Indu, an old acquaintance.

videos.title: Burst Bubble
videos.overview: Paari's ruse gets exposed when Raghavan arrives. As the government staff lashes out at the IT team, the villagers' protest intensifies.

videos.title: Another Argument
videos.overview: Paari learns about the government staffers from his colleagues. Napoleon refuses to give the IT team access to confidential files. Paari and Indu get into another argument.

videos.title: Village Trouble
videos.overview: Napoleon assigns a menial job to the IT team. Indu is reminded of their first meeting when Paari gets a fish tank in the office. Murthy and Prakash struggle to deal with the villagers.

videos.title: House Hunting
videos.overview: Sani offers to help Paari find a house in the village, but the villagers refuse to rent out their place to him. Sharmi's food vlog ends up in a funny misunderstanding.

videos.title: Sleep Ritual
videos.overview: Indu loses her cool with her mom. Napoleon berates Paari for disturbing his sleep ritual. Raghavan asks Napoleon to let the IT team start their work. Paari finally finds a roommate.

videos.title: Father's Fury
videos.overview: Paari's disinterest in attending the UPSC interview makes his father furious. Sharmi's vlog in the office goes viral for the wrong reasons.

videos.title: Interview Call
videos.overview: Indu gets excited as she gets an interview call, but Paari mocks her. Mani feels overwhelmed when Raghavan signs a blank cheque to help Janu. The IT team complains about Napoleon.

videos.title: A New Enemy
videos.overview: Indu gets furious when she finds her missing book in Paari's bag. While Napoleon creates a ruckus about the files in the record room, Paari catches Hari taking a bribe.

videos.title: The Missing Wig
videos.overview: Paari gets berated by Raghavan when Hari frames him. Raghavan panics as his wig goes missing. Indu assumes Paari hid the wig.

videos.title: Matchmaking
videos.overview: Jambulingam fails to recognise Raghavan without his hair. Indu panics when she receives a call from home. Paari gets upset when he learns about a marriage proposal for Indu.

videos.title: Unwanted Guest
videos.overview: Paari joins Raghavan and Hari to inspect government lands in the village. An old lady arrives in the office to ask about her pension. She slips, falls and doesn't wake up.

videos.title: Hit and Miss
videos.overview: Paari suspects Hari's involvement in the encroached lands, but a mishap with Raghavan stops the inspection. The old lady's daughter-in-law comes to the office searching for her.

videos.title: Action, Reaction
videos.overview: Paari and Sani beat up Hari for misbehaving with Sharmi. Paari helps Indu's mother when she faints in the market. An error in a slogan creates chaos.

videos.title: The Start of Love
videos.overview: Indu gets irritated when her mother praises Paari. A sarcastic retort by Paari causes a misunderstanding among the villagers.

videos.title: Escalation
videos.overview: Paari's friends make fun of his weird behaviour towards Indu. Frustrated by the lack of work, Sharmi decides to resign, angering Paari who confronts Napoleon.

videos.title: Party Planning
videos.overview: Paari complains to his brother-in-law about not getting access to files. Prakash and Moorthy lie to convince Indu to attend Sharmi's farewell party and choose a frightening venue.

videos.title: Haunted Party
videos.overview: Indu gets irked to see Paari at the party, but the others convince her to stay. The guys keep sneaking away to drink secretly. What happens when Paari plays a prank on Indu?

videos.title: Resolution
videos.overview: The locals complain to Napoleon about the staff's partying on a disputed land. Raghavan gets an earful from the Collector for the IT team's stalled digitalisation work.

videos.title: Lease, Lies and Lost Goats
videos.overview: The news of lease expiration and relocation creates an uproar in the office. Prakash falls for a village girl who has lost her goat. Hari plots to stop digitisation.

videos.title: A Missing Goat and Hidden Truths
videos.overview: As Veni searches for her missing goat, tension brews in the office over a potential scam. While Napolean grows paranoid about a conspiracy, will the team uncover the truth in time?

videos.title: Truths Unravel and New Dilemmas
videos.overview: Paari and Murthy suspect a scam, but Napolean shuts them down. Indu's accident leads to an unexpected moment with Paari. Jambulingam faces trouble over missing land documents.

videos.title: Buried Truths and Broken Ties
videos.overview: Indu worries about her family pressuring her to marry. As Paari's missing file causes chaos at work, his past with Indu resurfaces, exposing old wounds.

videos.title: Who Took It?
videos.overview: When a vital file goes missing, Indu uncovers a shocking truth. Frantic to cover his tracks, Hari appoints a former thief for a secret mission.

videos.title: Echoes of Theft
videos.overview: While Indu faces pressure to marry, Jambulingam tries to hide his land troubles. Chaos erupts when computers and a gun go missing.

videos.title: A Risky Retrieval
videos.overview: With jobs at stake, the team plots to retrieve the gun and computers. Indu sneaks out in th dead of the night, unaware of the incoming danger.

videos.title: The Uninvited Guests
videos.overview: The IT team sneaks into the bungalow, tunknowingly crossing paths with two groups of thieves. Indu feels uncomfortable when Sathyan arrives in the office the next morning.

videos.title: Bro Code Broken
videos.overview: While Indu tries to evade her marriage, a drunk Paari visits her at night. Prakash informs Sathyan about Paari and Indu's friendship. What happens when Sathyan seeks Paari's help?

videos.title: Staged and Confused
videos.overview: Paari plays mind games with Sathyan, making Indu angry. With a fake proposal, a scam and the entry of a fierce lady cop, chaos brews around the office.

videos.title: Wrong Switch
videos.overview: Indu battles entitled relatives who misuse government schemes. Paari grapples with corruption, moral dilemmas and a humbling lesson about who truly merits help.

videos.title: Shortcut Denied
videos.overview: When Indu learns that her dream job was offered to her through backdoor dealings, she erupts, setting off a domino of confrontations.

videos.title: Between the Lines
videos.overview: A kabaddi mishap sparks an unexpected bond. While Sani's bold action angers Sharmi Prakash's weird antics rattle the office. The announcement of Indu's engagement shocks everyone.

videos.title: The Stamp of Truth
videos.overview: Veni's intimidating brother scares Prakash. While indu suffers silently, Sathyan gets a surprise from a drunken Paari. Sani's distress deepens after Sharmi rebukes him.

videos.title: The Moment of Truth
videos.overview: Paari challenges Indu's engagement, and tensions rise between heart and tradition. When Indu finally looks her uncle in the eye, silence speaks louder than words.

videos.title: Unravelled
videos.overview: Indu uncle's decision about the engagement shocks the family. Caught between gratitude and guilt, Indu gets advice from Raghavan. What is his motive?

videos.title: The Lone Stand
videos.overview: As Hari tightens his web of influence, Paari dares to defy him. Indu's quiet gestures hint at a change of heart, and Janaki's misunderstanding leads to embarrassment.

videos.title: Brake Point
videos.overview: As Paari stages a clever prank to win Indu's smile on her birthday, a hidden enemy plots a deadly move with the brakes. Emotions stir between old flames and failed engagements.

videos.title: Sympathy Syndrome
videos.overview: After surviving an accident, Paari fakes an injury to win Indu's affection. Meanwhile, a serious government audit looms over the team.

videos.title: A Clean Sweep
videos.overview: A surprise inspection throws the entire office into a tizzy. As the IT team comes under the microscope, Paari begins to suspect a deeper conspiracy.

videos.title: Trial and Error
videos.overview: Fired and desperate, the IT team pulls off an office heist, a fake divine sign, and a temple possession stunt to win back their jobs. What happens when their "miracle" goes awry?

videos.title: Served Cold
videos.overview: Raghavan's fury leaves the IT team in despair. Indu's plea to her famous uncle, Jeyaraj, sparks a tense meeting. While the team's fate is unknown, Indu and Paari have a fallout.

videos.title: Unspoken Farewells
videos.overview: As the team prepares to leave the village, Prakash, Sani and Paari try to tie up loose ends. But the weight of unspoken words and broken bonds leave them far from closure.

videos.title: The Spark Before the Storm
videos.overview: A goldfish leads Paari back to the office, where a shocking discovery exposes deep-rooted corruption. He tries to gather proof, but a desperate act threatens to erase everything.

videos.title: Burning Secrets
videos.overview: Raghavan files a police complaint against Paari for the fire at the office, and Napolean escalates it to the Collector's office. Will Paari become a victim of a deeper conspiracy?

videos.title: Unexpected Returns
videos.overview: Guru's intervention saves Paari, but Hari conspires with Jeyaraj. Jaanu's unexpected return scares the office staff. Can they get rid of Jaanu before she uncovers their secret?

videos.title: The New IT Team
videos.overview: When Sathyan arrives with a replacement IT team, arch-rivals Napolean and Paari are forced to team up - one to protect the office secret and the other to win back Indu's heart.

videos.title: A Missed Confession
videos.overview: After Paari is humiliated, the old IT team reunites to drive Sathyan out. As Indu decides to confess her love for Paari, he discovers a crucial lead about Hari's mysterious boss.

videos.title: The Assistant Officers!
videos.overview: Jeyaraj warns Paari to stay low, raising doubts. As playful office antics spiral into petty revenge and hidden agendas, a photo threatens to unveil secrets better left buried.

videos.title: Petty Revenge
videos.overview: As Jeyaraj balances belief and doubt, Indu fights for Paari’s attention. Raghavan helps Janaki from societal injustice. The office staff panics when Prakash goes missing.

videos.title: A Forced Marriage
videos.overview: When Veni's brother compels Prakash to marry her, Murthy disowns him. With the newlyweds feeling lost and the office in chaos, can Indu and Paari manage to change Murthy's mind?

videos.title: Just Friends?
videos.overview: Old feelings unfold, and new misconceptions take root as Paari’s mother visits his office. When Jeyaraj learns her truth, Indu is forced to choose between her heart and loyalty.

videos.title: Split Screens
videos.overview: Indu draws a line with Paari after his pranks go too far. While Raghavan is impressed by Jaanu's charm, Prakash and Veni take over Murthy's home and wallet.

videos.title: Misguided Missions
videos.overview: Jaanu likes Raghavan's new wig. Paari and Indu's road trip planned through deception, spirals into a public humiliation that shakes their fragile relationship.

videos.title: Blessings and Blunders
videos.overview: Paari draws a line with Indu after a rift. Veni's food cart brings hope and trouble. Raghavan takes Jaanu to the temple, but fate strips him of more than just his inhibitions.

videos.title: Things We Hide
videos.overview: Raghavan's wig mishap shatters him until Jaanu confides her problem to him. Paari retrieves Indu's stolen handbag, but his hopes are crushed when she asks for the unthinkable.

videos.title: Moves and Motives
videos.overview: Paari pretends to move on from Indu, while Raghavan sheds his inhibitions for love. Jeyaraj cautiously returns to the game just as a high-profile inspection looms over the office.

videos.title: Rejections and Recreations
videos.overview: Indu and Paari are teamed up as the office races to recreate the missing Patta documents before the Collector’s visit. Raghavan gets humiliated by Jaanu's judgemental parents.

videos.title: Signed and Sealed
videos.overview: Before the Collector's visit, an oversight by Indu threatens to expose their forgery operation. Paari takes a risky step, but his affinity with Indu goes through an emotional hit.

videos.title: Warmed Hearts, Cold Truths
videos.overview: Paari struggles to comprehend the deep reverence Indu holds for her uncle, Jeyaraj. His accidental discovery of a forged file threatens to expose a powerful man’s secrets.

videos.title: Operation Impress
videos.overview: Paari tries to impress Jeyaraj with food and books. Raghavan's mother meets Jaanu at the office. A public health project forces Paari and Jeyaraj into an unexpected alliance.

videos.title: Ground Realities
videos.overview: Jeyaraj's resistance threatens to ruin Paari and Indu's efforts with a health scheme. While Murthy is hurt when Napolean ignores a personal crisis, a property file sparks suspicion.

videos.title: The Cost of Truth
videos.overview: Paari unknowingly triggers a storm, unraveling Jeyaraj's carefully staged negotiation. A sickle-wielding saviour gets a desperate Murthy his leave.

videos.title: Framed!
videos.overview: Paari's bold revelation earns Jeyaraj respect from the villagers. A shocking twist exposing a hidden betrayal threatens to destroy everything Paari believes in.

videos.title: Truth or Trap
videos.overview: Paari uncovers shocking evidence pointing to Raghavan's corruption. While Jeyaraj plots to frame Raghavan, Paari is caught between exposing the truth and earning Jeyaraj's trust.

videos.title: Inside Job
videos.overview: While Paari works on a fake design at Jeyaraj's house, Sani tries to sneak out a file at the office. Paari suspects foul play when Dhamodharan secures a key government tender.

videos.title: Decorations and Doubts
videos.overview: The office celebrates Raghavan and Jaanu's surprise engagement announcement. Paari's secret probe uncovers proof of Raghavan's corruption, but a saint's warning could alter things.

videos.title: Tough Choice
videos.overview: As Raghavan gets engaged, Paari, struggling between love and justice, decides against exposing the truth for Indu's sake. But a dramatic showdown leaves the village in shock.

videos.title: Faith on Trial
videos.overview: Raghavan faces an inquiry over bribery charges. While evidence mounts, Paari is dazed by the unwavering faith of Raghavan’s mother and the speechless dignity of the accused himself.

videos.title: False Light
videos.overview: Tensed for having ruined an innocent man, Paari digs for the truth - only to find that he has been a pawn in a deeper game. His confession leaves Indu shattered and Raghavan enraged.

videos.title: Cracks and Clues
videos.overview: Indu wrestles with her heartbreak and distrust. As Napolean tightens his grip on the IT team, Paari takes the risk to get closer to exposing a deeper conspiracy.

videos.title: Blind Spots
videos.overview: As Raghavan drowns in betrayal and self-doubt, Paari tries to make him see the reality. A court notice arrives that could seal Raghavan’s fate unless the real mastermind is exposed.

videos.title: The Great Pretender
videos.overview: Paari convinces Raghavan to fake corruption in a frantic bid to access Dhamodharan's testimony and reclaim justice. Jaanu too plays her part as Raghavan stages his downfall.

videos.title: Confessions and Consequences
videos.overview: Paari and Indu's secret romance is finally out. A carefully orchestrated sting operation backfires when Hari flips the script, turning Raghavan's trap into his own public undoing.

videos.title: Echoes of a Prophecy
videos.overview: As Hari vanishes with the incriminating evidence, Paari, Indu and Raghavan are shaken as careers, trust and love are all on the line. Jaanu risks everything to defend Raghavan.

videos.title: Destiny's Detour
videos.overview: During Raghavan's inquiry, shocking revelations and personal ties surface at the Collector's office as an unexpected ally from his past rises to his defence. Will justice find its way?

videos.title: The Return and The Reckoning
videos.overview: Raghavan reclaims his position as the Tahsildar, shaking up the corrupt office. As tension rises, Hari goes missing. When things seem to calm, a knock at the door alters everything.

videos.title: The Hidden Guest
videos.overview: Indu and Paari's affinity finally comes to light, and it is celebration time. With secrets tightening around Jeyaraj, one error could unravel everything he is plotting to protect.

videos.title: Festive Fallout
videos.overview: As love and joy bloom with Indu's surprise morning lesson and Veni's festive Thaali ceremony, a hidden power move imperils the village's peace. Raghavan brings devastating news.

videos.title: Deadline Drama
videos.overview: News breaks that the office will shut down, and Paari plans to rally the villagers and impress the visiting Collector. However, an unexpected twist threatens to unravel everything.

videos.title: One Month to Go
videos.overview: In the last month of the office, Raghavan encourages each staffer to rise beyond their comfort zone. Indu faces resistance in office as she readies for a life-changing interview.

videos.title: The Shortcut and the Long Road
videos.overview: Paari races against time to sneak Indu into a surprise interview under Napoleon's watchful eyes. While Indu nails her shot, Paari faces a bitter truth about confronting his family.

videos.title: Civil Lies
videos.overview: Indu and Paari face Chezhiyan’s huge pride in government service. Prakash’s relentless study stuns Veni and his friends. An unexpected encounter at the bus stand sparks a new tension.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: Paari outwits Hari with a trap and closes in on the truth. A frantic call leads to shocking revelations. As loyalty is tested, a name is finally to be exposed, changing equations.

videos.title: The First Invitation
videos.overview: As police arrives at Jeyaraj’s door, secrets are unraveled. Indu faces the burden of hiding her career change from the one man who idolises her government status - Paari’s father.

videos.title: Cover-Up
videos.overview: Indu’s family tries to hide her IT aspirations from Chezhiyan. However, a confession and a kitchen eavesdrop unravel it all, leaving the future of the wedding hanging in balance.

videos.title: Between Pride and Apology
videos.overview: Indu’s hidden career choice shocks everyone. When Chezhiyan pays a surprise visit, apologies are made, and lessons are learnt. But unresolved tensions linger between him and Paari.

videos.title: Shadows at the Altar
videos.overview: At Raghavan’s wedding, tension arises as Paari and Chezhiyan’s strained father-son relationship plays out amid festivities. Unexpected guests threaten to disrupt the celebration.

videos.title: The Price of Blood
videos.overview: An accident at the venue throws everyone's lives into turmoil. Jeyaraj is forced to confront his past mistakes. Paari risks everything to save the person he once failed to protect.

videos.title: Hope Served Hot
videos.overview: Indu and Paari's attempts to lift a heartbroken Muthu’s spirits backfire hilariously. An unexpected confession from the ever-shy Chetta reveals a love that’s been simmering quietly.

videos.title: Silence of the Scold
videos.overview: Indu finally stands up to Napolean’s harshness. The team uncovers the silent sacrifices of the man they thought was their tormentor and give him the farewell he truly deserves.

videos.title: The Letter
videos.overview: A cheerful bachelor party at Jeyaraj’s farmhouse turns into a night of confessions and revelations. Paari stumbles upon a letter from his past, one that could change equations.

videos.title: A Friend in the Frame
videos.overview: Paari’s suspicions about Jeyaraj deepen after seeing a photo in Kumaresan’s home, triggering an investigation. Indu begins to connect the dots, uncovering secrets too risky to chase.

videos.title: Exit Protocol
videos.overview: As the digitisation project ends, heartfelt goodbyes, bold decisions, and budding romances fill the air. Paari is set to leave, but a startling revelation about Jeyaraj stops him.

videos.title: Locked Truth
videos.overview: Sangu seeks forgiveness from Prakash. Paari cleverly manipulates a family visit to infiltrate Jeyaraj’s guarded office and uncovers a game-changing secret, right under his nose.

videos.title: Fallen Mask
videos.overview: As Paari digs deeper into the land scam, powerful forces begin to close in. With secrets unraveling and loyalties tested, a tense encounter forces everyone to show their true faces.

videos.title: Burned Bridges
videos.overview: Paari must choose between exposing a vicious land scam or let a guilty Jeyaraj atone privately by sacrificing everything. Indu grapples between justice and protecting her family.

videos.title: Curtain Call
videos.overview: On the last day, the staff faces a moral dilemma when Jambulingam, the person behind the closure, asks for help before the doors shut for good. Will they choose duty over resentment?

videos.title: Judas Kiss
videos.overview: Paari confronts betrayal from someone closest to him. He learns the full extent of a land scam and faces a heartbreaking confession that challenges his trust and shakes his future.

videos.title: Red Wedding
videos.overview: A deeply personal revelation shakes Indu and Paari’s world, testing their trust and forcing them to face difficult choices that will change their lives forever.

tt30821976.name: Bench Life
tt30821976.description: Balu, Ravi and Meenakshi, three employees at an IT company, are desperate to be 'benched', each for their own personal reasons. However, when confronted by their flaws, can each of them learn to overcome their issues and grow? 'Bench Life' stars Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Vaibhav, Charan Peri, Ritika Singh, Aakanksha Singh, Nayan Sarika, Venkatesh Kakumanu and Tanikella Bharani.

videos.title: Code Error
videos.overview: Balu, Meenakshi and Ravi have grand plans on how to utilize their time on the bench. But fate has something else in store.

videos.title: Firewall
videos.overview: Prasad, an ex-IAS officer, joins the company. Does he have an ulterior motive?

videos.title: Debugging
videos.overview: Balu needs Prasad’s help to get the bench. Meanwhile, Meenakshi struggles to make a demo film, while Ravi plans for the Goa trip. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Testing
videos.overview: Life hits rock bottom for the trio as their loved ones question their motives and actions.

videos.title: The Real Bench
videos.overview: On the verge of losing their jobs, the trio realize that their personal lives are benched too. Will they survive?

tt39665097.name: Musafir Cafe
tt39665097.description: Chander feels an undeniable connection with Sudha. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with Preeti, but memories of the past linger.

tt28675376.name: Masterpeace
tt28675376.description: When marital discord becomes everyone's business and parents get way too involved in the "peace talks," family drama can become family trauma.

videos.title: Oh My Dog
videos.overview: Did they fight? Are they having problems? What is with the knife? Riya and Binoy's parents have more questions for the loving couple as they barge into their house unannounced.

videos.title: Om Shanthi Home
videos.overview: The parents' intervention complicates matters for Binoy and Riya, and the blame game begins. In the middle of all that, a guest arrives.

videos.title: Happy Hours
videos.overview: After the peace in the house is fully disrupted, the couple gets a call from their friend and neighbour, Adarsh, who is up to no good and wants their help to deal with his wife.

videos.title: Last Supper
videos.overview: Riya loses her patience with Aniyamma and Kuriyachan and blames them for insulting their guest. Things get worse when a prospective marriage proposal turns into a religious war.

videos.title: Song of Songs
videos.overview: Riya and Binoy realise that their parents' problems are more grave than theirs. Many surprises unfold as their inner conflicts come to light.

tt28675376.language: Malayalam, Tamil, Bengali, Kannada, Marathi, Telugu, Hindi

tt36167761.name: Seruppugal Jaakirathai
tt36167761.description: A pair of ordinary slippers becomes the center of chaos when a diamond smuggler uses them as a hiding spot, triggering a frantic search across town.

videos.title: The Birth of the Sandals
videos.overview: Rathnam hides diamonds worth 10 crores inside a pair of slippers and hands them to Thyagu, who misplaces them. When he realizes the worth of the sandals, he sends his son, Ilango, to find the pair.

videos.title: The Elusive Pair
videos.overview: Ilango arrives at Ekambaram's house and is shocked to see a large crowd gathered to pay their last respects. Just as Ilango finds the slippers, a man walks away with them.

videos.title: Sandals in Chaos
videos.overview: Ilango successfully retrieves the slippers. The father and son panic when they cannot find the diamonds inside the slippers. They return to Ekambaram's house, only to receive another shock.

videos.title: Sandals and Secrets
videos.overview: Thyagu and Ilango become restless in their search for the discarded slippers. On the other hand, Rathnam arrives at Ekambaram's house to look for them himself and confronts Thyagu.

videos.title: The Cursed Sandals
videos.overview: Thyagu tricks Rathnam and gets him beaten up by Ekambaram's family. The police arrest Rathnam as Thyagu celebrates thinking the diamond slippers will be his. However, his happiness is short-lived.

videos.title: The Vanishing Sandals
videos.overview: Thyagu and Ilango's final attempt to recover the diamond slippers fails when the police catch them. Surprisingly, no diamonds are found, leading to their release. But where are the diamonds?

tt15722548.name: Brinda
tt15722548.description: Young, socially awkward yet morally grounded SI cadet Brinda stumbles upon a brutal murder with a chilling modus operandi. As the killer slips through her grasp, she faces personal and bureaucratic turmoil, but the hardest challenge is the moral reckoning that could define her career and conscience. Will Brinda uphold justice, or lose herself in the chaos closer to home?

videos.title: The Chosen One
videos.overview: Brinda, a young, smart, and socially awkward SI, investigates the mystery behind a dead body in a drain, uncovering a bizarre modus operandi.

videos.title: A Little Deeper
videos.overview: Brinda finds an unusual object, defies bureaucratic approvals and uncovers a chilling decade-long history behind a seemingly simple case.

videos.title: Hit and Miss
videos.overview: The killer strikes again. A guilt-ridden Sarathi pushes to get Brinda into the SIT team. Is something still missing?

videos.title: The Bridge in Between
videos.overview: Brinda finds a crucial piece of paper and investigates Anand's past. Meanwhile, the killer is unexpectedly arrested at a police station.

videos.title: Light at the End of the Tunnel
videos.overview: Brinda spirals into chaos over her failure to stop a murder. Will she find light at the end of the tunnel?

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview: Brinda discovers that the serial murders are part of a bigger plan. Will she catch the mastermind and end it all?

videos.title: The Holy Past
videos.overview: Brinda and the team think the case is solved, but she discovers a revelation about the mastermind. Meanwhile, Satya's inner turmoil intensifies.

videos.title: Home Coming
videos.overview: Brinda knows everything now. Can she chase down the mastermind and confront her past to finally end the killings?

videos.title: Part 1
videos.overview: Thenks!- Part 1- Karikku- Comedy

tt35952274.name: Om Kali Jai Kali
tt35952274.description: Set in 1995, a tale of revenge, loyalty and redemption unfolds against the backdrop of the Dasara festival in Tamil Nadu.

videos.title: Surrendering to God
videos.overview: During the Pidari Pooja, a pregnant woman is found inside a well. Kaathadi and Koothaar's search for her brings them to Vanadesam.

videos.title: Cause and Vengeance
videos.overview: Neela reveals her bitter past to the villagers, where her lover was killed while fleeing from Rajadurai. During the Dasara festival, Mookandi dresses as Goddess Kali.

videos.title: Revenge Unfolds
videos.overview: Ganesan seeks revenge for Mookandi and Bama's murder. At Nagercoil court, Kaathadi apologises to Neela, who then takes Ganesan to Rajadurai and the murderers.

videos.title: Justice Served
videos.overview: Kaathadi joins hands with Ganesan and his group. After Barani's death, AJ makes a plan for his son Arun's future in politics. Meanwhile, a young widow is held hostage for Rajadurai.

videos.title: The Final Verdict
videos.overview: The conflict comes to a head when Rajadurai escapes, Arun is kidnapped, and the existence of Vanadesam is put in danger.

tt28756614.name: Bahishkarana
tt28756614.description: Pushpa, a courtesan, arrives in Peddapalli and falls in love with Darshi. While the couple prepares for their new life together, their dream to be married is shattered when Darshi gets forced to marry someone else.

tt27736464.name: Patharamattu
tt27736464.description: A mother seeks ideal matches for her three daughters. Two families: wealthy jeweler Ananthamoorthy's clan and modest Udayabhanu and Kanakadurga with their daughters.

videos.title: Kanaka Durga's Humble Dream
videos.overview: Meet Kanaka Duraga, who wishes to find perfect matches for her daughters but from wealthy families. Watch her journey as she tries to secure her family's future.

tt20873118.name: Suzhal - The Vortex
tt20873118.description: In a small South Indian town, a seemingly routine minor case explodes into a twisted crime thriller that rips apart its social fabric.

tt32539169.name: Paruvu
tt32539169.description: Years after Sudheer and Pallavi are disowned by their families for defying the caste system, a tragedy brings them back to their hometown. Soon, they find themselves entangled in an accidental death.

videos.title: The Invisible Trap
videos.overview: Sudheer and Pallavi return to their hometown after years and suspect a murder attempt on them. Soon, they find themselves on the run for their life

videos.title: Connecting The Dots
videos.overview: Sudheer and Pallavi sketch out a plan to prove that Chandrasekhar is still alive so that they can escape. Meanwhile, Swati suspects Ramayya, the local MLA and Chandrasekhar’s boss for his absence.

videos.title: Few Desperate Measures
videos.overview: Back in her hometown, Pallavi's past catches up to her as she attends a family function. Sudheer meets an ally in the form of Subhasham, a clan leader.

videos.title: A Shot In The Dark
videos.overview: In Swathi's search for Chandu's murderer, she comes across some people she believes are involved. Ramayya, unaware of Chandu's death, calls up an old associate to find him.

videos.title: Justice For All
videos.overview: Ramayya takes the help of cops to find his grandson and gets into a scuffle in a TV interview, which puts his election campaign off track. Meanwhile, Pallavi takes a stand for love.

videos.title: Art of Manipulation
videos.overview: Sudheer comes up with a twisted plan to get rid of the body, but he will need help from Pallavi’s family. Swathi finally meets her match.

videos.title: An Unforgivable Act
videos.overview: Sudheer receives a call from Ramayya, who confronts him about Chandu's murder. Later, Sudheer meets a grief-stricken Swathi. Kalloji’s attempt to save Akhilesh ends with an unexpected loss.

videos.title: The Missing Piece
videos.overview: Sudheer and Pallavi almost get away with their crime until they realise a flaw in their plan. On the other hand, an angry mob sets out to take revenge against Ramayya.

tt23727900.name: Samarthya Shastram
tt23727900.description: The series is about five strangers — Joe, Jude, Venu, Arun and Daisy — from different walks of life, who lose their money after they are all duped by a person. A sixth person, who is never seen, brings them together and informs them that all of them were cheated by one Akash Prince. He also suggests a plan to take revenge on Akash and they agree to it, unaware that there is more to it than revenge.

tt33509351.name: Company
tt33509351.description: Uncover hidden surprises and face thrilling challenges in each of 16 mystery boxes, all under the watchful eye of host Ma Ka Pa Anand. Who will conquer the game.

videos.title: The Box Battle Begins
videos.overview: Ma Ka Pa Anand presents a new show blending luck and smartness. Tune in as the Pandian Stores family tackles while opening cash boxes.

videos.title: Unlocking the Fun
videos.overview: Energetic contestants tackle surprise challenges while unlocking cash boxes. Don't miss the fun tasks they complete to win exciting cash prizes!

videos.title: Team Ooho vs Team Aaha
videos.overview: Aaha Kalyanam stars Akshaya, Vikram, Gayathri, and Vibish join the show, eyeing for the grand prize. And begins a neck-to-neck face-off!

videos.title: Fun With Vijay TV Stars
videos.overview: Your favourite Vijay TV stars go head-to-head in two teams for the cash prize. Tune in to find out which team will triumph!

videos.title: Nagai Kadai Vs Adagu Kadai
videos.overview: Don't miss this non-stop fun episode featuring comedian Vijay TV Ramar and prominent serial actors.

videos.title: Chinna Marumagal vs Ponni
videos.overview: The cast of Chinna Marumagal clashes with the cast of Ponni in a hilarious episode you won't want to miss!

videos.title: Team Singapore vs Team Thailand

videos.overview: In this rib-tickling episode, Sriranjani Sundaram, Aranthangi Nisha, and others bring wild bargains, funny guesses, and endless laughter. A must-watch!

videos.title: Marumagals vs Mamiyars
videos.overview: Experience a suspenseful yet hilarious episode as the marumagals challenge the mamiyars. Starring Vinusha Devi, Roopa Sri, Sharanya Turdi, and Nirosha Radha.

videos.title: Mahanadhi Vs Gomathi

videos.title: Team Kottaankuchi vs Team Theekuchi

videos.title: New Year Fun
videos.overview: In this New Year special, Makapa welcomes Priyanka, Irfan, Sunita, and Rakshan as contestants. Enjoy a hilarious episode with your favourite influencers!

videos.title: All Eyes on the Big Prize

videos.title: Siragadikka Asai Pongal Fun
videos.overview: Enjoy this hilarious Pongal special as the cast of Siragadikka Asai, including Vetri, Gomathi, Sri Deva, and Salma, face off in fun-filled challenges and laughter galore.

videos.overview: Yashika Aannand and Aishwarya Dutta join Mookuthi Murugan and Ramar for fun-filled company games. Watch this hilarious episode featuring Ramar's classical dance.

At their lowest point, these two unlikely souls, find each other to set off a crackling story of ambition, adventure, partnership and mainly friendship.

tt27908713.name: Vera Maari Office
tt27908713.description: Due to an ecommerce company digitizing, one branch faces downsizing. Experienced and newly hired employees form friendships and experience conflicts while turning work problems into humorous and exciting situations.

videos.title: Fire...Fire.... Fired
videos.overview: Ramya has an eventful day one at work as the fire alarm goes off, creating choas and panic in the building of the great indian company. a local inspector investigates each employee to find who caused the fire. Branch director nisha receives a shocker from the CEO.

videos.title: Smoking Hot
videos.overview: Ramya finds it difficult to make new friends with her co-workers. pankaj is on a mission to find out who is smoking in the bathroom.

videos.title: The Challenge
videos.overview: Nisha struggles to talk about the impending danger. Algatz meets Leena for the first time. Nisha's babysitter challenges her to care of her child Maaran for a day

videos.title: Activities and Atrocities
videos.overview: Things get complicated for nisha when maaran’s friends arrive at her House.Poorna tries to impress the freshers by orchestrating activities that Backfire on him in every way

videos.title: Freshers for Sale
videos.overview: Freshers list themselves for sale on the website and find that they are unable To pull it down it due to a bug, their jobs are in jeopardy now.

videos.title: Caught in the Act
videos.overview: Freshers eager to learn valuable knowledge from their seniors, learn things That are not related to work. Poorna is caught in a situation with the security. Keshavan suspects sharmi and maari to be a thing.

videos.title: Tick Tick Tick
videos.overview: Jo decides to fulfil his pet’s last wishes. Maari and keshavan are determined to Find who poorna is talking to. Sharmi has to finish work and leave in time to Attend an event but nisha has other plans for her.

videos.title: The One Night Stander
videos.overview: Things get awkward when ramya meets her cousin priya’s one off fling. Shyama Questions keshavan’s game and challenges him to propose to her and impress Her

videos.title: The Entanglement
videos.overview: Things become awkward when ramya learns that her client is the ex-fling of Her cousin priya. Maari and algatz pursue the impossible task of getting leave From poorna. Shyama’s engagement is in jeopardy due to an misunderstanding With keshavan

videos.title: It's Party Time
videos.overview: Jo invites the juniors to his houseparty. The party is taken to the next level by an Unknown guest.

videos.title: Wasted
videos.overview: Things between leena and algatz escalate beyond control. Drunk poornachandran Begins to share his secrets

videos.title: Girl Power
videos.overview: Ramya, sharmi and shyama forms a queens. Ram and maari finds algatz behaviour Weird when they find him with his ‘area’ friends.

videos.title: The Misunderstanding
videos.overview: A fight emerges between the queens gang after someone leaks all their personal Secrets. Poornachandran drops an e-mail that sends everyone into shock.

videos.title: Its Inspection Time
videos.overview: Algatz and Maari learn about jo's playboy side. A delivery lapse sends shyama and Sharmi to visit the warehouse for inspection. Ramya decides to apply for passport.

videos.title: The Mischievous Jo
videos.overview: Jo sabotoges nisha's overtime work and makes a play on nisha to go home. Sharmi Gets roasted by her followers in the lift.

videos.title: Love is Crazy
videos.overview: Sharmi tries to put on a smile on a grumpy Sathya after a job rejection. When Poorna discovers Algatz is constantly hanging out with Leena, he becomes possessive of her.

videos.title: The Challenge
videos.overview: With Jo’s assistance, shyama tries the impossible task of going on a diet. Maari and keshavan take on a mission to help poorna enter the world of online dating.

videos.title: Komanam underwear
videos.overview: Algatz and Leena were tasked with winning over a vendor with their design in order to secure a dealership for the business.Nisha is having a difficult time as she needs to compile a list of names of her staff to lay off.

videos.title: Layoff begins
videos.overview: A unexpected employee is fired after an unexpected guest arrives at the workplace. When the delivery personnel mix up the product accidentally, things become problematic.

videos.title: Confusions and Customers
videos.overview: Sharmi and Ramya battle to persuade a customer to delete the unfavourable reviews.Dhana steps in to sort out the delivery product mix-up.

videos.title: Mistaken Identity
videos.overview: Sharmi takes advantage of Sathya mistaking her for the anonymous mailer, which leads to Ramya becoming possessive.Lenna brings Algatz to his neighborhood for a client encounter when unforeseen events take place.

videos.title: The Surprise Visitor
videos.overview: Nisha’s son makes a surprise visit to her workplace and ends up meeting Joe. Keshavan introduces A.I to the office leading to wild assumptions about what A.I can do. Poorna plans to avenge the security for disrespecting him.

videos.title: Its Traditional Time
videos.overview: Nisha intervenes Maaran and interrogates him alongside Jo.For the first time, the entire office is dressing up in traditional to celebrate a festival occasion.

videos.title: True Lies
videos.overview: Jo and Sharmi are on a mission to make Sathya wear traditional clothes for the first time. Keshavan and Maari make up facts about their skills in order to get a job. However, it hits back when Poorna requests maari and keshavan to showcase their abilities. Sathya tells Ramya about his personal life during an emotional conversation.

videos.title: Crushed
videos.overview: An unknown girl arrives at the office and acts like she knows everyone in the office. When algatz finds out that leena is unwell, he goes to her house to take care of her.

videos.title: The Strike
videos.overview: Poorna takes on the challenge of delivering the goods to the clients during the warehouse workers' strike. In his own peculiar way, Jo intervenes to prevent a co-worker from committing suicide.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: Keshavan and Maari battle it out for the possession of a chair. Nisha begins to have paranoid thoughts that the senior staff members have learned about the layoffs. Shyama and Sathya attempt to find out whether Ramya is the anonymous mailer.

videos.title: The Breaking Point
videos.overview: Nisha tells Joe about her past for the first time at the party. Poorna tells Algatz to stay away from Leena, which leads to Leena kissing Algatz. Poorna reveals the truth about downsizing to seniors while drunk.

videos.title: After Effect
videos.overview: Following the shocking news the senior team is in a dilemma. Algatz makes an effort to make talk about the party night with Leena.

videos.title: Customer Care
videos.overview: Sathya tries to avoid Ramya for the sake of Shyama. Shyama plans to give more work pressure to maari by asking him to handle the customers through call.

videos.title: The Cold War
videos.overview: Keshavan is drawn into the conflict between Leena and Algatz. Jo decides to ask nisha directly about the downsizing in order to learn the truth.

videos.title: Secrets Revealed
videos.overview: Everyone at office are paranoid after a meme page starts publishing the darkest secrets of employees.

videos.title: The Backfire
videos.overview: Maari invites a friend to his workplace to show off but Shyama has other plans. Sathya defends Ramya when Poorna condemns her.

videos.title: Finding The Truth
videos.overview: Jo intends to question the laid-off Ram to learn the real reason for the downsizing. Maari extracts vengeance on Shyama for making him suffer at work.

videos.title: Reap What You Sow
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose qhen Ramya's father unexpectedly pays her a visit. Keshavan instils the fear of Poorna in Maari's mind.

videos.title: The Consultant
videos.overview: Unexpected news and an unexpected visitor arrive at the office. Ramya and Sathya open up to each other. Mari impersonates a person in order to win Poorna's confidence.

videos.title: The Investigation
videos.overview: Bad news Pathmanathan conducts a unique investigation to find out information about each office worker. In an attempt to demonstrate his dominance over Leena, Algatz fails miserably.

videos.title: The Ultimatum
videos.overview: Bad news Pathmanathan gives an ultimatum to the employees in order for them to continue working. Warehouse employees pay a visit to Poorna to request a Diwali bonus.

videos.title: The Brainstorming
videos.overview: Algatz struggles to come up with a presentation concept and ultimately decides to pay Leena a visit at her home. Bad news Pathmanathan forbids Jo from talking to any of the female employees. Keshavan and Shyama scratch their heads in search of a marketing campaign idea.

videos.title: The Chaos
videos.overview: Ramya's father invites Sathya to dinner, which causes confusion. Algatz and Leena's relationship spirals out of control and reaches new height.

videos.title: BP’s Atrocities
videos.overview: BP issues a warning to the TGIC staff for failing to submit the marketing concept. Perfect Badhmanadhan apprehends Algatz and Leena.Jo is accused by BP and an investigation is launched.

videos.title: Open Up
videos.overview: Algatz mum and BP, longstanding school mates, get back together.Maari lands at Poona’s feet to assist him in creating a marketing concept.Sathya professes his feelings for Ramya.

videos.title: The Viral Star
videos.overview: Police end up arresting the viral star that Poorna planned.Jo's mother shows up and urges her to get married shortly.Keshavan and Maari compete for a job at the tea shop.

videos.title: Couple Shopping
videos.overview: Leena is impressed by Algatz's couple shopping concept. Poorna finds himself in a sticky situation with BP.Leena requests that Algatz visit his home right away.

videos.title: The Negative in Positive
videos.overview: Ramya father has arranged a surprise groom for ramya and priya advice ramya to confess her love to sathya.in a shock of events, leena and algatz finds out that leena is pregnant

videos.title: Diwali Celebration
videos.overview: Poorna is asked by BP to organise the office's Diwali party. Algatz's fear of becoming a father follows him everywhere. It appears like BP has grand plans during the Diwali celebrations

videos.title: The Open Up
videos.overview: Leena and Algatz decide to manage the pregnancy together after being honest with one another. Ramya tells Sathya how much she loves her. The Diwali activity planned by Poocha turns out to be fun than expected.

videos.title: The End Game
videos.overview: Warehouse team comes to the office to ask Diwali bonus.BP announces the shocking news of downsizing the senior and fresher team in two months.

videos.title: The New Branch Director
videos.overview: Everyone comes to know Nisha's resignation. Poorna takes over as the new branch director and begins terrorising the employees.

videos.title: The Sudden Departure
videos.overview: Poorna abuses his power and treats the staff member’s horribly. To everyone's surprise, Jo resigns from his job and leaves the office.

videos.title: The Prankster
videos.overview: The warehouse workers are fired by Poorna. In an effort to find out what the staff members think of him, Poorna pulls a prank on them.

videos.title: The Interview
videos.overview: Maari, keshavan and Shyama made a plan to depromote Poorna, but it fails miserably. Poorna conducts an interview to hire new employees to replace the older employees.

videos.title: The Game is On
videos.overview: A surprise party is organised by Leena and her friends for Poorna. Algatz seek assistance from his friend Naalu Jordan for his plan.

videos.title: Let’s Get Fired
videos.overview: Poorna was demoted in accordance with everyone's plan. A surprise visitor enters the office and takes control of the situation

videos.title: Vera Maari Office Blooper Special
videos.overview: We might have seen what was on the screen, but we might not have seen what's happening behind the screen. Here’s an exclusive episode of the Vera Mari Office team sharing their behind-the-scenes experience with us.

videos.title: The Start Up
videos.overview: It's a new season, and our favourite colleagues from TGIC reunite to launch their own start-up in a new office. While the workplace buzzes with its usual fun, drama, and laughter, an unexpected twist awaits them, and their new office might be haunted.

videos.title: All Services Served
videos.overview: Nisha is determined to make the office a kick-ASS place to work, but each

videos.title: The Uninvited Guest
videos.overview: Keshavan despises his new role as HR and does everything in his power to get fired. Meanwhile, Maari experiences a string of misfortunes, convincing him that the new office is haunted. With nowhere else to go, Leena decides to stay with Algatz. But can the conservative Algatz handle this situation correctly?

videos.title: It's Playtime
videos.overview: Leena and Algatz attended Nisha's meeting at Algatz's house to try to manage the situation. But things take a tense turn when Nisha grows suspicious and demands they turn on their video. Meanwhile, Maari's day cannot get any worse as he encounters a ghost in the office. As Keshavan makes a final desperate attempt to escape his new promotion, will he succeed?

videos.title: All Is Not Well
videos.overview: When Leena expects Algatz to take care of her, she finds him unwell and now must care for him instead. Meanwhile, Syama’s fiancé Arun brings his sister to surprise Syama, but it backfires when they catch Syama smoking a cigarette. Determined to prove that he saw a ghost, Maari sets out to convince Keshavan, but can he pull it off?

videos.title: The Next Step
videos.overview: Algatz makes a bold decision to take their relationship to the next level. Meanwhile, Arun convinces his sister that Syama is a good person, but things worsen when his sister catches Syama and Keshavan hugging each other. As Maari tries to prove the ghost's presence by convincing Keshavan to stay overnight at the office, will the ghost reappear?

videos.title: Live in
videos.overview: Algates and Leena decide to move in together and act like a married couple to secure the apartment. Everything is going smoothly until their suspicious landlord decides to verify them. Meanwhile, Nisha assigns Keshavan the task of hiring interns for their startup. Will he succeed in it?

videos.title: The Omnipresence
videos.overview: Is there a real ghost in our office or not? this conversation creates a heated argument in the office, and in the middle of this chaos, the new interns enter the office. Meanwhile, Leena and Algates come up with a fake story to gain the trust of their landlord. Will they be able to manage it?

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Jenny, destined to be everyone’s favourite, joins the office as an intern. Meanwhile, the moment of truth has arrived for Algates and Leena as they confront their landlord. Can they successfully bluff their way out, or will their ruse be exposed? The tension builds as they prepare to face his probing questions.

videos.title: New Start
videos.overview: Energetic young interns have officially joined the office, bringing additional chaos with them. Just as Nisha and Shyama think things are going well, an investor calls with ridiculous ideas that must be implemented. A disagreement between the boys' and girls' teams soon arises, which the interns must resolve. Will they work together as a team?

videos.title: Liquor Delivery
videos.overview: Nisha and Shyama attempt to carry out the investor's plan but quickly realize it is a horrible idea. Meanwhile, Maari, who has always been single, is now hopeful of finding love. But with whom?

videos.title: Office Olympics
videos.overview: Keshavan organizes office games to break the ice, but all hell breaks loose during the game. Krish and Simbu fail to collect data from employees on their first day. Will they get fired or saved?

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: When Leena and Algates order condoms, Alagtes friend Naalu Juram comes as a delivery guy to deliver them and finds out Leena is staying with someone. Will Naalu Juram break the secret of the live-in relationship? or will he cover it up?

videos.title: The Next Victim
videos.overview: Thara starts noticing strange, unexplainable things happening around her in the office. It’s almost as if something, or someone, is after her. As the eerie presence tightens its grip, she tries to escape, but it feels like there’s no way out. Will she break free, or will she end up as the ghost’s next victim?

videos.title: Tom and Jerry
videos.overview: For the lovebirds, everything seems to be going smoothly until a sudden argument shakes their relationship. Tensions run high, and the fight threatens to pull them apart. Can they patch things up, or has their love story come to an end?

videos.title: Two Truths and a lie
videos.overview: The Interns play the game of “Two Truths and a Lie” for fun, but it becomes serious as it progresses, exposing hidden secrets and shocking revelations. Watch the full episode to discover the lies and truths.

videos.title: Love and Hate
videos.overview: As the Game “Two Truths and a Lie” continues, Jenny and Krish open up their inner feelings about love, which results in a heated argument between them. Will the game bring them closer or make them drift further.

videos.title: Ouija Board
videos.overview: Maari and Thara are on a mission to prove the presence of a ghost in the office by playing Ouija Board. Will they find others to play the game or will it be the end game for them?

videos.title: Maran
videos.overview: Thara, Maari, Naalu Juram and Shyama reach the end of the Ouija Board game, where an unknown evil ghost possesses Thara. Will they find the name of the Ghost or will they become the victims of the Ghost?

videos.title: Role Swap
videos.overview: Thara, Maari, and Naalu Juram are on a mission to learn more about Maran, and they come across a popular YouTuber’s vlog about the ghost. Will they find answers? Algats and Leena challenge themselves to a role swap to decide who is right. Who will win the challenge?

videos.title: Revelation
videos.overview: Finally, Maari, Naalu Juram and Thara find someone who knows about Maran and his Flashback. Watch the full Episode to uncover the truth behind Maran. Jenny makes one last attempt to change Krish’s opinion about love. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Death by Cake
videos.overview: The security continues the flashback of the ghost Maran. Maari, Thara and Naalu Juram are about to learn how Maran died and why he is taking revenge on people. Will they be able to find the reason?

videos.title: Halloween Celebration
videos.overview: People in the office celebrate Halloween despite Maari’s warning about ghost Maran in the office. Will the celebration go planned, or will they all be attacked by Maran? What happens next?

videos.title: Danger Ahead
videos.overview: Maari makes one last attempt to stop the Celebration, but it fails, and one of the Colleagues falls victim to Maran. Meanwhile, Krish and Jenny are trying to reconcile their differences with her. Can they succeed?

videos.title: Closure
videos.overview: Despite Maari’s warning, Keshavan and the team cut the cake, and one of their colleagues is attacked by Maran and found unconscious on the floor. Krish and Jenny’s bond grows deeper, clearing their indifferences.

videos.title: The Shaman
videos.overview: Maran creates chaos during the Halloween celebration, traumatizing everyone in the office. To stop him, the team calls a shaman to capture Maran. Will the shaman be able to succeed?

videos.title: Unfulfilled wishes
videos.overview: After understanding Maaran’s true intentions, Maari realizes that they were wrong about him. Maari makes a plan to save Maaran from the shaman. Investor Aadithya arrives at the office to investigate the employees.

videos.title: Investor’s Atrocity
videos.overview: The company's investor Adhithya, comes to India to check on the employees, He has an offer from Elon Musk to sell the company. Will he agree to it? What happens to the company and the employees?

videos.title: Poorna is Back
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose when Poorna enters the office again as a Creative Director. Employees are going crazy seeing him. Poorna starts his mind game with his old employees. Will he take revenge on them?

videos.title: Imperfect Love Story
videos.overview: Krish narrates his past love story to Jenny and brings us all back to our nostalgic college days. The happy love tale ends in a heartbreaking note. Does this story lead to a new beginning?

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: Algates takes Leena for a checkup, but she panics and runs away after seeing the pain of the pregnant woman. Meanwhile, Elon Musk mistakes Maari for an important office member, and Simbu proposes

videos.title: Misfire
videos.overview: Keshavan and Shyama find themselves in hot water with Poorna over their work backlogs, risking their jobs. At the same time, Maari and Simbhu face the consequences after trying to deceive Elon Musk.

videos.title: Run Baby Run
videos.overview: Leena's mom makes a surprise visit to Leena's apartment, putting Algates in a difficult situation about their live-in. Meanwhile, Maari and Naalu Juram compete to see who can impress Thara and win her heart.

videos.title: Power
videos.overview: Maari and Naalu Juram are on a mission to see who can impress Thara the most. Meanwhile, Algatez asks Leena about what her mom told regarding their relationship, and her response leaves him stunned. In a bid to assert his authority, Poorna introduces new rules in the office.

videos.title: Restrictionship
videos.overview: Keshavan and Maari make a plan to prank Poorna, but it backfires, leading to unexpected consequences. At the same time, Jenny and Krish are impressed by a couple visiting the office.

videos.title: Middle Finger
videos.overview: Jenny starts using the dating apps for the first time, ready to meet people. Meanwhile, Leena hides an important secret from Alagates after the hospital visit. Maari fakes an injury as an excuse to avoid his tasks.

videos.title: Brainwash
videos.overview: Algates approaches his mother to convince her to call off his upcoming marriage to Kalaiselvi. Maari tries to win Thara’s affection by playing the sympathy card, but things take a turn when Poorna intervenes. Simbu is caught by Keshavan while trying to use the office printer for personal purposes.

videos.title: App Launch
videos.overview: The employees celebrate the successful launch of their app, but their joy is short-lived when they discover a cloned version of the ASS app has surfaced. Algates surprises Leena by inviting her to a registration office dressed in traditional attire.

videos.title: Culprit
videos.overview: The entire office is devastated as their hard work has been stolen by someone, and they set out to find the person responsible for the theft. Meanwhile, the investor gives Nisha an ultimatum: either make their app a success or pay back his investment with significant interest.

videos.title: The Brand Ambassador
videos.overview: Leena suggests making their former employee, Sharmi, the brand ambassador for ASS and assigns Maari and Poorna to handle the execution. However, a twist emerges when Elan Musk also seeks to sign Sharmi as the brand ambassador for AZZ. Who will win her over?

videos.title: Revelations and Reckonings
videos.overview: Poorna orders Jenney to stay late at the office, despite her fear of being alone, until a surprise arrives. Meanwhile, Leena drops a bombshell on Algates, revealing that she’s not pregnant, sparking a fierce confrontation. The truth is out, and everything is about to shift.

videos.title: Wishes and Wars
videos.overview: The battle for Thara escalates between Maari and Naalu Juram, with Maari turning to Simbhu for help. Thara introduces the concept of 11:11, showing how the universe responds to our wishes. When Jenny makes her own wish, the universe delivers a surprising twist.

videos.title: Revealed
videos.overview: Maari transforms into Maari 2.0 in an unexpected attempt to win Thara's attention. When Algates and Leena cross paths, a post-separation lot of unexpected twists happen. Will they get back together?

videos.title: Pretend
videos.overview: Villupuram Sugumaran, a secretive employee, stirs chaos for Kesavan and the team. Meanwhile, Krish's ex shows up, forcing Krish and Jenny to pose as a couple. But in the act, their fake relationship begins to feel surprisingly real.

videos.title: Hacked
videos.overview: The ASS server is hacked, which puts Krish and Jenny into the trouble. Meanwhile, Leena’s ex-boyfriend arrives at the office, further complicating her already tense relationship with Algates. what happens next?

videos.title: Shocking Secrets
videos.overview: Leena goes for a routine checkup, only to have her friend reveal a shocking secret to her. The interns head to Keshavan to receive feedback on their performance, but Poorna intervenes and stops them. With only one week left in their internship, Jenny feels the pressure, and Thara encourages her to confess her feelings to Krish.

videos.title: Betrayal & Rejection
videos.overview: A covert spy within the office betrays Maari, revealing crucial information to Keshavan, which is then passed on to Poorna. Jenny gathers the courage to confess her love to Krish, but his response leaves her heartbroken. Meanwhile, Maari makes one last attempt to win Thara's affection, but it ends disastrously.

videos.title: Tangled Fates
videos.overview: Krish calls Jenny to express his feelings. Meanwhile, Naalu Juram comes to know about Leena's pregnancy, which creates unnecessary problems. Nisha and her team are facing major issues. Will they be able to manage this?

videos.title: Final Stand
videos.overview: The ASS app becomes a huge hit, and Nisha opens a new surprise to her team. Algates comes to know about Leena's pregnancy, Will this bring them together or not? What happens to the interns?

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: The ASS App becomes an overwhelming success, and Nisha surprises her team with several unexpected announcements. Algates learns about Leena's pregnancy—will this bring them closer or push them further apart? As the interns face a decision about their future, will they leave the office or stay to see where destiny leads them with the ASS App?

tt30852844.name: Miss Perfect
tt30852844.description: Cleanliness is her obsession. But what happens when this fetish leads to a highly qualified professional getting mistaken for a housemaid?

tt16763980.name: Kalakkachi
tt16763980.description: It revolves around the unique fish curry 'Kalakkachi'. The storyline takes an interesting turn when one of the hotels decides to ruin its competitor, by spoiling their unique dish 'Kalakkachi'. How the spoiled dish creates ruckus among the lives of four men forms the crux of the story.

videos.title: Part 1
videos.overview: As the name suggests revolves around the unique fish curry 'Kalakkachi'

videos.title: Final Part
videos.overview: This episode is about how they deal with the crisis they are in.

tt34265516.name: Parachute
tt34265516.description: Shanmugam does not spare the rod and spoil his children. But despite his strict nature, they go on a joyride on his bike and get lost. What will he do now?

videos.title: A Mother's Nightmare
videos.overview: Lakshmi goes to the police station to file a missing complaint about her children, Varun and Rudra. Where are they? How did they go missing?

videos.title: Love for Parachute
videos.overview: Varun plans a birthday surprise for his sister, Rudra, and it involves Parachute, their father's bike.

videos.title: Bikes and Bandits
videos.overview: Varun and Rudra desperately try to get their Parachute back, but an unforeseen incident occurs, which makes things worse.

videos.title: Kids in Danger
videos.overview: Kiruba and his team get the location of the stolen bike. He, along with Lakshmi, Shanmugam and Charles, race against time to save the children.

videos.title: Love Over Fear
videos.overview: Varun and Rudra get caught up in the middle of a riot. Will the kids get their Parachute back? Will Shanmugam and Lakshmi get to them before it's too late?

tt34265516.language: Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali

tt29764006.name: #90’s - A Middle Class Biopic
tt29764006.description: A nostalgic trip down memory lane, delving into the everyday life of a middle-class family.

tt11822206.name: Scoot
tt11822206.description: This series tells the story of two young men who work together and and their allie Shyam Kandithara they intends to construct a turf and Things take a turn when they set out to buy a place.

tt33983792.name: Aindham Vedham
tt33983792.description: Anu travels to Varanasi for her mother’s last rites, where a priest asks her to deliver an ancient relic to a temple in Tamil Nadu. While she plans to disobey his command, fate has other plans.

tt30490534.name: Karimnagar’s Most Wanted
tt30490534.description: In 'Karimnagar's Most Wanted' Four small-town dreamers face adversity after a real estate deal goes wrong. Framed by a corrupt politician, they endure prison horrors. Upon release, they turn the tables, becoming feared underworld figures. A clash with an influential foe tests their mettle, leading to a relentless battle for survival.

videos.title: Twisted Ambitions
videos.overview: A Collision of Fates in Karimnagar' Middle-class small-town boys seeking a chance at fortune, tread unconventional paths. Yet, destiny takes a twist. Simultaneously, the high-handed MLA aspirant Purushottam exploits every illicit avenue to seize control of Karimnagar, setting the stage for a collision of fates.

videos.title: The Intensifying Gamble
videos.overview: Ghani and the boys grapple with their newfound woes, but each choice they make only tightens the grip of complication. Meanwhile, Purushottam escalates ruthlessly, hell-bent on seizing the PMP party's MLA ticket, regardless of the toll. The stakes rise; trouble intensifies.

videos.title: Pawns in Peril
videos.overview: Ghani and the boys awaken to the harsh reality of being sacrificial pawns in a grander conspiracy, their lives abruptly shattered. Purushottam orchestrates their descent into a point of no return with relentless precision. The trap tightens; destinies hang in the balance.

videos.title: A Gritty Descent into Nightmares
videos.overview: The boys' dreams crumble, their world flipped, hope extinguished, leaving them numb within prison's confines. Enduring a new life, they confront bullying, torture, and manipulation from the merciless inmate Gattu Seenu. A brutal descent into a nightmarish reality unfolds.

videos.title: Karimnagar's Underworld Unleashed
videos.overview: The boys return to Karimnagar with a new creed: 'Never ask; take what's yours by any means necessary.' Ghani adopts a ruthless approach, while Tinku transforms into a volatile gangster, poised to challenge the reigning kingpins of Karimnagar's underworld. A reign of defiance and ruthlessness begins.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: The boys assert dominance, forging an alliance with Purushottam to expand their empire. Tinku's proclivity for violence catapults them into a perilous confrontation with an adversary they should have steered clear of. The battle for supremacy escalates, testing their mettle and alliances.

tt31914166.description: Siddharth, a resident of City, is the new Panchayat Secretary of Thalaivettiyaan Paalayam. His sudden village life, panchayat work and the people he meets in it do not lack comedy

tt30401803.name: Vyooham
tt30401803.description: A newly appointed police officer is assigned to a hit and run case, where a pregnant couple lost their child. What seems like a simple open and shut case, turns out to be a complicated web involving several seemingly unconnected people. To solve the case, the officer has to hunt down a serial killer, a trained Naxal, a suspended cop, and a terrorist organization, while facing his own painful past.

videos.title: Part 1
videos.overview:
