tt13331708.name: My Perfectt Husband
tt13331708.description: Saraswathi believes she is the only woman in her husband Bharathi's life. However, a marriage alliance for their son brings back a blast from the past.

tt29961423.name: Vadhuvu
tt29961423.description: A young bride's life is in peril when she marries into a mysterious household. Despite her dark past, she is determined to uncover the secrets of her new family.

videos.title: The Leaf
videos.overview: It is Indu's wedding day. Tensions are steaming both in the bride's and groom's families. On top of that, a mysterious gift and an uninvited guest mar the happy occasion.

videos.title: The Shadow
videos.overview: The wedding gets mired in mystery. A painful past and probing questions worry Indu, but a startling welcome at Anand's house leaves her in shock.

videos.title: Sherlock Holmes
videos.overview: Indu gets perplexed by the strange events that occur in her new home. A midnight guest adds to her bewilderment. She resolves to uncover the truth.

videos.title: The Secret
videos.overview: The mystery unsettles Indu. An anonymous letter with a warning leaves Anand feeling flustered. How will the newlyweds come to terms with these problems?

videos.title: The Stranger
videos.overview: Indu decides to delve deeper. Anand's suspicion fuels her determination to uncover Vaishnavi's mystery. Amidst the chaos, the family receives horrifying news.

videos.title: The Bookstore
videos.overview: The shocking news uncovers several dark secrets. The family opposes Indu's pursuit of the truth. Will she succumb to their pressure?

videos.title: The Investigation
videos.overview: Unfazed by the happenings around her, Indu confronts the 'intelligence' of the mystery maker. Will she expose the family's hidden skeletons and find answers?

tt28434030.name: Chutney Sambar
tt28434030.description: An orphaned street vendor unexpectedly becomes part of his wealthy stepbrother's family, navigating the challenges of gaining acceptance in his new circumstances.

videos.title: In Search of the Secret Ingredient!

tt19868374.name: Dhootha
tt19868374.description: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.

tt32270661.name: Thalaimai Seyalagam
tt32270661.description: When the Chief Minister faces the bars of prison, a power struggle brews among the members of the ruling party. Meanwhile, the CBI follows a trail of murders from Jharkhand that might have a connection with another murder case in Tamil Nadu. However, things take an unexpected turn when all the chaos seems linked to each other.

videos.title: The King's Gambit
videos.overview: A murder case in Jharkhand clashes with Tamil Nadu CM Arunachalam’s corruption trial, prompting his daughter, Amudhavalli, to intervene. CM advisor Kotravai has mysterious visitors.

videos.title: Thalaimai Seyalagam
videos.overview: CBI officer Nawaz Khan takes up the Jharkhand murder case. Meanwhile, in Tamil Nadu, DGP Manikandan probes into a horrifying discovery. Political unrest grows along with rising suspicions.

videos.title: Whispers of Deceit
videos.overview: Manikandan discovers a link between Kotravai and a mysterious figure named Durga. On the other hand, Nawaz Khan follows a trail of clues leading to an ex-journalist.

videos.title: Interlocking Circles
videos.overview: Nawaz Khan's investigation leads him to a police informer and a confrontation with Durga. Kotravai taking charge of politics sparks danger, while Manikandan faces betrayal.

videos.title: A Web of Intrigue
videos.overview: Nawaz Khan encounters a false lead, shifting his focus. A suspended Manikandan continues investigating the case with more determination but gets involved in a violent incident.

videos.title: Chasing Shadows
videos.overview: As Kotravai fights for her life, Arunachalam's fate hangs in the balance. Manikandan and Nawaz Khan follow separate leads to Delhi, seeking answers amidst escalating tension.

videos.title: The Final Stand
videos.overview: With the verdict looming, Kotravai returns, signalling a last-ditch effort to secure power. As the courtroom drama unfolds, Manikandan and Nawaz Khan stumble upon the truth.

videos.title: The Coronation
videos.overview: A twist of fate affects the CM's position. Nawaz Khan and Manikandan close in on their targets. Amidst the chaos, secrets emerge, and alliances break, changing Tamil Nadu's politics forever.

tt27577967.name: Mansion 24
tt27577967.description: When Kalidas, one of the most revered archaeologists in the country, accused of stealing precious artefacts and fleeing the country, his daughter Amrutha an investigative journalist, enters an abandoned mansion with a frightening past, to trace his whereabouts and restore his legacy.

videos.overview: Amrutha enters a deserted mansion while searching for her missing father. She meets a watchman who knows about the place and starts recounting the tale of a novelist.
The watchman tells the story of a drugstore girl who was tragically killed by her married boyfriend, a tale shrouded in darkness and sorrow.
A family that once lived in the mansion gets caught in the mire of superstition as they believe their godly dead matriarch will come back to life.
A classical dancer starts hearing a baby's cries in her apartment. Who is this child, and why is she hearing them?
A sculptor moulds his creations, seeking more than inspiration from real women. Everything goes fine for him until a sex worker visits his apartment.
Amrutha tells the watchman what really happened in 307. Through that discovery, she unlocks the mystery behind her father's disappearance.

tt31701070.name: Inspector Rishi
tt31701070.description: A sceptic one-eyed crime branch Inspector Rishi Nandhan assisted by his two trusted sub-inspectors Ayyanar and Chitra, investigates strange and mind-bending cases involving supernatural or paranormal phenomena. He stops at nothing in his efforts to find the truth behind unexplainable murders while also battling various challenges in his personal life.

videos.title: The Huntress
videos.overview: When a wildlife photographer’s mysterious death is blamed on a deadly forest spirit called Vanaratchi, Crime Branch Inspector Rishi Nandhan is sent to Thaenkaadu to investigate the case, along with sub-inspectors Ayyanar and Chitra.

videos.title: Devil is in the Details
videos.overview: The lack of physical evidence and the supernatural phenomena around the murder case baffles everyone. Rishi is haunted by a mysterious ghost from his past. Meanwhile, the Vanaratchi claims another victim.

videos.title: In the Shadows
videos.overview: During a search for an abducted man inside the forest, police sniffer dogs get scared and behave wildly. Rishi and the team consult an entomologist regarding webspinner insects. Meanwhile, a handmade Vanaratchi doll mysteriously ends up in the hands of a little girl.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: Rishi and Ayyanar have a clash of opinions. Fear spreads throughout the village as more Vanaratchi sightings are reported. Sathya assigns beat officer Kathy to help Rishi and his team in the investigation.

videos.title: Something Wicked
videos.overview: Sathya and Irfan try to track down poachers who conduct illegal activities in the forest. A forest night vision camera captures a horrifying video. Villagers hold an urgent panchayat meeting. Rishi and his team arrest a suspect and question her.

videos.title: The Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Panic strikes when Kathy and another forest guard go missing in the forest during a routine night patrol. Rishi’s traumatic past with Viji is revealed. Meanwhile, a young village woman gets a visit from the Vanaratchi.

videos.title: Deliver us from Evil
videos.overview: The exorcism of a Vanaratchi-possessed woman gets interrupted by a group of unruly villagers. While Rishi digs deep and studies the victimology, Chitra and Ayyanar lock horns and get into a heated argument.

videos.title: The Darkest Hour
videos.overview: Sathya and Irfan are abducted and tortured by poachers. While the rescue team searches for them in the forest, Rishi, Kathy, Ayyanar and Chitra conduct an investigation of their own to find the two officers before it’s too late.

videos.title: The Secret Cavern
videos.overview: Rishi, Ayyanar, Chitra and Sathya venture into a dark and mysterious cave to investigate a crime scene. The truth behind the tribal people’s deadly ritual is revealed. Kathy decides to confess her love to Rishi.

videos.title: Close Encounters
videos.overview: One major clue in the investigation leads Rishi to find shocking revelations and discoveries. The team realises that the lives of many innocent people are at stake if they don’t do something soon.

tt29225030.name: Kumari Srimathi
tt29225030.description: Srimathi is a 30 year old unmarried woman, with a dead end job, a dysfunctional family and a goal to win back her ancestral house. For that, she needs to raise a lot of money in a short period of time. Seeing a business oppurtunity, she decides to start a bar in her village. This is the journey of Srimathi, battling various societal and moral obstacles along the way.

tt21231814.name: Amudhavum Annalakshmiyum
tt21231814.description: Amudha's dream is to marry a teacher so she chose Senthil, a school teacher. His mother Annalakshmi, too is proud of his profession. But the twist is Senthil works as a peon in the school.

videos.overview: No description

tt28802669.name: Athidhi
tt28802669.description: Unexpected guests enter a loner's house and life, unleashing a series of horrific events. Everyone becomes a suspect and a victim.

tt25965602.name: Label
tt25965602.description: An attempt for justice gets squashed when forced to take an unjust path. Will an aspiring judge stand his moral ground despite the identity forced upon him?

tt28314319.name: Dayaa
tt28314319.description: A reserved freezer van driver gets pushed into a chaotic situation wants to escape to safety, an upright journalist chases the truth, a husband is on the hunt for his wife, a cop wants to make progress in his investigation, a woman is in search of her identity and a culprit is after power.

tt30150229.name: Koose Munisamy Veerappan
tt30150229.description: The series explores the life of Veerappan and the people involved in the hunt for the infamous bandit. It showcases interviews with Veerappan, journalists, politicians and the victims’ families.

tt28306899.name: Hostel Days
tt28306899.description: Set in an engineering college hostel, this series follows the life of Six engineering students and their struggles with friendship, identity, love, life and academics.

tt21882650.name: The Village
tt21882650.description: In the desolate hinterlands of Tamil Nadu, a stranded urbanite enlists the help of three locals to find his missing family believed to have been abducted by nefarious beings of a cursed village. Meanwhile, a maniacal heir to a pharma empire sends a group of mercenaries to the same village to retrieve something long forgotten. Will they come out of this terror-stricken night alive?

tt26915205.name: Dead Pixels (IN)
tt26915205.description: The journey of three young friends whose lives revolve around an online video game, with the ultimate goal of defeating a virtual villain.

videos.title: Big Green Woman
videos.overview: An 'emergency' spurs Gayathri to run away from her date. Later, when she meets Roshan at her workplace, she introduces him to the Battle of Thrones, but can he keep up with her?

videos.title: Motherless Boy
videos.overview: Miffed about the actor in the film version of their favourite game, Gayathri and Bhargav start an anti-campaign. Meanwhile, Roshan brings home a 'motherless boy'.

videos.title: The Wedding
videos.overview: Despite Aishwarya's warning, Gayathri and Bhargav get married in the game. While everyone avoids Roshan, Gayathri and Bhargav face hiccups in their relationship.

videos.title: The House Party
videos.overview: A famous YouTube streamer's death shocks Bhargav and inspires Gayathri to live-stream her gaming. As Aishwarya prepares for her house party, Anand reveals what his job is.

videos.title: Red Light Cafe
videos.overview: On the eve of Valentine's Day, Aishwarya invites her boyfriend home. Bhargav introduces his dad to gaming. Meanwhile, Roshan and Gayathri enter a lovers' area in the game.

videos.title: The Final Battle
videos.overview: Anand's wife is furious about his irresponsibility towards their marriage and kids. When Gayathri and Bhargav begin the final battle in cosplay, they get a surprising new teammate.

tt29548810.name: Siragadikka Aasai
tt29548810.description: Circumstances force Meena, a family-centric girl, to marry Muthu, a thug. Will this unfortunate marriage turn into love?

videos.title: Muthu Suspects Manoj
videos.overview: We don't have an overview translated in English. Help us expand our database by adding one.

tt26494170.name: Newsense
tt26494170.description: Shiva and his journalist friends make money unethically in Madanapally by publishing false news stories and colluding with local politicians who control the town. Will they choose to stand up for the people of Madanapally, or will their greed and corruption lead them down a dark path?

videos.title: Fourth Estate
videos.overview: MLA Karunakaran Reddy and his party members are involved in election campaigning, while journalist Shiva is engaged in taking settlements. Ayyappa, who has a land issue, visits Shiva to file a complaint with the press club. Amidst all this, will shiva help him in seeking justice?

videos.title: Whitewash
videos.overview: Karunakar Reddy punishes Subbayya's grand-daughter for defacing his political poster with mud water. She demands that the press club reveal her grandfather's killers. Meanwhile, Shiva arrives at the channel office to meet Neela. Will their encounter shed light on the mystery surrounding Subbayya's death?

videos.title: Coverage
videos.overview: Ayyappa passes away as his land issue remained unresolved, and the journalist Shiva takes on the case. Shiva investigates the circumstances surrounding Ayyappa's death, gathering evidence and following the leads. During the investigation, Shiva comes across some surprising clues that lead the case in unexpected directions. What are these clues?

videos.title: Limelight
videos.overview: Shiva reflects on the death of Ayyappa following a fake encounter, prompting a significant shift in his thinking. Ayyappa's wife's words stay with him, causing him to confront his past. However, Nagireddy sends people to attack Shiva, putting his survival in question. Will Shiva be able to make it out alive?

videos.title: The Glare
videos.overview: In the aftermath of Nagareddy's attack, Shiva is hospitalized and Suvarchala visits him. The new police sub-inspector, Edwin, arrests Karunakar Reddy's associates. While investigating, Shiva discovers a dead body with an unknown identity and cause of death.

videos.title: Watch Dog
videos.overview: Inspector Edwin tightens things up at the press club and with MLA Karunakar Reddy after taking charge. Karunakar Reddy and Shiva team up and plan something unexpected. Can Edwin come out of it?

tt28744259.name: MY3
tt28744259.description: A rich entrepreneur struggling with an allergy to human touch finds a solution in a robot. But when it crashes before delivery, a 'real' replacement is sent.

tt14783936.name: Bad Trip
tt14783936.description: A shared cab ride presents a group of people the opportunity to get rich quickly. What seems like an easy job turns into a web of nightmares for the gang.

videos.title: Shotgun
videos.overview: Ved visits Hyderabad to convince his parents that he is not ready for marriage. At the railway station, he books a shared cab and then befriends fellow riders. At one of the drop-points, they all get into a nightmarish situation.

videos.title: A Bridge Too Far
videos.overview: Ved, Abhi, and Santosh get a once-in-life opportunity to get rich but they part ways as it's too risky. They get back to their lives and try to forget the night's events but the allure of money is too strong to ignore.

videos.title: Crash Course
videos.overview: Jo joins Ved, Abhi and Santosh. They plan the kidnap and go after Reva. But Reva has her own plans for the night.

videos.title: Pit Crew Party
videos.overview: As the gang fight among themselves over the failure of their plan, a new opportunity to kidnap Reva presents itself. They improvise and go after her. But first, they have to find a way to work together as a group.

videos.title: Gasolina
videos.overview: The gang manages to get inside Reva's villa and tie her up. But they find out that Reva is hosting an all-nighter and her friends are on their way to the villa. As they scramble to find their next move, things take a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Clutch Control
videos.overview: The gang decides to cut out the middleman and contact the client directly. Ved comes up with an out-of-the-box idea to get client details from the girls. Jo has other plans.

videos.title: Changing Lanes
videos.overview: Jo tries to convince Ved and turn him to her side. Abhi finds out the information from the girls. But a man in a clown mask comes out of nowhere and changes the game.

videos.title: Nitro Nightfall
videos.overview: The gang finds out that the whole thing is a bad, bad trip.

tt27671508.name: Mathagam
tt27671508.description: A "dead" gangster resurrects, and he is a man with an elaborate plan. With the city under threat, IPS officer Ashwath's only choice is to be two steps ahead...

tt25836892.name: Anger Tales
tt25836892.description: An anthology bringing alive the various hues of anger, telling the stories of four ordinary people belonging to different socio-economic backgrounds.

videos.title: Benefit Show
videos.overview: Ranga organises a show of his favourite star's latest movie. When a local leader buys 200 tickets to show off his power, Ranga's self-respect is put at stake.

videos.title: Food Festival
videos.overview: A hard-core non-vegetarian, Pooja, gets married into a 'health-conscious vegetarian' family. Her dietary struggle continues until she falls ill and another struggle begins.

videos.title: An Afternoon Nap
videos.overview: Radha lives a tranquil life with her husband in an old house. Her peace is disturbed by her landlord, which puts her marital life in jeopardy.

videos.title: Helmet Head
videos.overview: Giri is unhappy about his baldness and the nature of his work. When he finally finds the solution to one of his problems, a shock awaits him.

tt21908802.name: Sweet Kaaram Coffee
tt21908802.description: Braving the unknown, three women of different generations living in the same house set off on an epic road trip as an attempt to put themselves before the people they are bound by for the first time.

tt26699205.name: Puli Meka
tt26699205.description: A serial killer is targeting police officers in Hyderabad. A female cop in charge of the Special Investigation Team and a forensic expert race against time to find the culprit.

videos.title: The Hunt Begins
videos.overview: The commissioner of police, Anurag Narayan assigns officer Kiran Prabha to the case of a serial killer targeting police officers. Forensic expert Prabhakar Sharma also gets appointed to the case.

videos.title: Case Closed?
videos.overview: Prabhakar Sharma falls in love with Kiran and tries to find ways to express his feelings. Meanwhile, the prime suspect gets arrested. Another police officer gets killed. Who is the culprit?

videos.title: Killer in Disguise
videos.overview: The investigation team discovers that the killer disguises himself as an animal. On the other hand, Prabhakar confronts his elder brother Karunakar, who tells him that he has disowned the family.

videos.title: The Twist
videos.overview: The department is shocked when the disguised serial killer attacks Kiran. Prabhakar realises who the real culprit is!

videos.title: Kiran's Past
videos.overview: Kiran's past reveals the incidents that have made her the vengeful police officer that she is today. However, the memories of a dear friendship help her in surviving.

videos.title: A Parallel Investigation
videos.overview: Karunakar has a moment of epiphany when he sees his father's popularity and respect in society. Commissioner Narayan starts a parallel investigation with suspended encounter specialist, Emmanuel.

videos.title: Justice
videos.overview: A series of kidnappings and interrogations lead to a shocking revelation about the story of a girl, Pallavi, who is cornered for objecting to the use of narcotics at a party.

videos.title: The Next Target
videos.overview: Emmanuel drops out of the case after sharing a few clues with the commissioner. His investigation reveals the commissioner to be the next target. Will the culprit be caught before it's too late?

tt21883062.name: Modern Love Chennai
tt21883062.description: An eclectic bouquet of love stories – funny, quirky, deep and puzzling. While the stories converse with your heart, you also catch a glimpse into the soul of Chennai with its unique terrains and diverse inhabitants.

videos.title: Kaadhal Enbadhu Kannula Heart Irukkura Emoji

tt26337419.name: Nuvvu Evaru
tt26337419.description: An NRI techie reunites with his wife after her two-month Indian vacation only to realize that her behavior, habits and actions have significantly changed. And hours later, his actual wife arrives.

videos.title: Programmed Chaos...!
videos.overview: Episode overview not available

tt27510191.name: Oru Kodai Murder Mystery
tt27510191.description: Vyom, the school principal's a nerdy teenager son is disliked by most of his classmates, has only four friends, and a crush, Tara. When Tara goes missing and found dead, Vyom decides to solve the mystery behind her death.

videos.title: The Game is Afoot
videos.overview: The only thing good in 14-year-old Vyom’s life is his quiz partner and potential life partner, Tara Venkat. But the universe seems to have different plans. Tara Venkat mysteriously disappears!

videos.title: Elementary
videos.overview: When Vyom becomes the prime suspect and is labelled a ‘murderer’ in school, he decides to clear his name with the help of his four friends. It looks like they have cracked the case open!

videos.title: The Plot Thickens
videos.overview: After the initial failure, Vyom is even more determined to find the real culprit. With his detective skills, he identifies three new suspects, a new ‘friend’ and a sworn enemy.

videos.title: Sleep-walking Detective
videos.overview: Vyom and his friends seem to be on the right track. Their number one suspect gets arrested for the murder, but there is something more than what meets the eye.

videos.title: No Ghosts Need Apply
videos.overview: With no more leads left, Vyom and his friends start chasing more clues and come across shocking revelations. Is the real culprit a human or something supernatural?

videos.title: An Obvious Fact
videos.overview: The stakes for Vyom are higher than ever when his mother, the school's principal is hounded by the press about Tara's mysterious death. What will he do to save her reputation?

videos.title: Logic is Rare
videos.overview: Shital’s accident pushes Vyom and his friends to speed up their investigation. But with no suspects, will the friends find the killer before more people get killed?

videos.title: Puzzled Out
videos.overview: Not all that ends well is well. The case is solved but is it really solved? Will Vyom be able to save the life of the one person he has just realised he loves more than himself?

tt21935310.name: Jhansi
tt21935310.description: Jhansi, a boutique owner, is an independent woman staying with her partner and his daughter, but an amnesiac. When she saves a girl from a molester at a wedding, Jhansi’s past catches up with her and rekindles several bitter memories from her childhood and the violence follows.

videos.title: Glitches
videos.overview: Memories of a horrid past haunt Jhansi and endanger the happy world she has made for herself. On top of that, an unexpected event forces her to face her other life.

videos.title: Man from the Past
videos.overview: Worried about what she has done, Jhansi meets a man from her past. International don John Caleb rules his cartel with a ruthless hand. Meanwhile, Dhruva fights for his love, Kriti.

videos.title: The Dark Box
videos.overview: A flash of her past puts Jhansi on the trail of Ripukumar, a notorious child trafficker. Back home, a little girl goes missing in Jhansi's colony.

videos.title: Another Murder
videos.overview: At Ripukumar's house, Jhansi meets Savithri, who gives her answers and tells her about her best pal, Barbie. Back home, a tragedy strikes Jhansi's colony.

videos.title: The Vigilante
videos.overview: As Sakshi probes Satya's murder. Amsa Begum reunites with her son, Thayib, who has an agenda. When Sankeeth worries about Jhansi, with Dhruva's help, she strikes again.

videos.title: Billu's Club
videos.overview: Sankeeth accuses Jhansi of neglecting the family. Sakshi begins suspecting Dhruva of the murders. Meanwhile, the breadcrumbs lead Jhansi and Dhruva to Goa.

videos.title: Love and Betrayal
videos.overview: Ameesha tells Jhansi about Billu and her past life at his club. With Barbie's whereabouts worrying her, she is shocked to learn about Ethan and his child.

videos.title: Italian Panna Cotta
videos.overview: Furious that Jhansi is alive, Caleb comes to India for her. As Jhansi shares her past with Sankeeth, Sakshi confronts her about the murders.

videos.title: The Wrong Turn
videos.overview: Amsa Begum recounts her past that's intertwined with Jhansi's. While Caleb gets ready for another consignment, a devastating piece of news reaches Jhansi.

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview: As Jhansi attends her friend's funeral, Sakshi arrives to arrest her. Caleb decides to eliminate Jhansi, Amsa Begum and the gang, resulting in a final face-off.

tt27139477.name: Sengalam
tt27139477.description: To take revenge, Rayar and his two brothers are on a ruthless killing spree. At the same time, a family ruling Virudhunagar corporation for 40 years is facing turmoil and their throne is being challenged.

videos.title: On The Run
videos.overview: Rayar and his brothers hide in the forest after committing three murders. Meanwhile, the state party in power devises a strategy to dethrone Rajamanikkam, the town's third-generation chairman.

videos.title: Honeymoon Journey
videos.overview: Rayar is close to his next target, but he is pushed into an emotional dilemma by the police. On the other hand, Rajamanickam is back in power after he counters the MLA’s plan to overthrow him.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Rayar must save his wife from trouble. Meanwhile, the ruling party initiates its plan to take overthrow the Sivagnyanam family. Aware of the state’s plan, Sivagnyanam looks for a worthy successor.

videos.title: Election Game
videos.overview: Rayar stays a step ahead of the police. On the other hand, the election for the post of the new chairman ends favourably for Sivanyanam. Suriyakala’s name emerges as the successor to the coveted post.

videos.title: Funeral
videos.overview: The police plan to catch Rayar and his brothers when they reach their hometown. Suriyakala chooses a trustworthy aide to support her against her relatives. The lives of Rayar and Suriyakala's families cross paths.

videos.title: Ruse
videos.overview: The police approach Rayar's trusted friend after the minister gives them an ultimatum to catch him. Nachiyar, Rayar’s sister, asks him to help out Suriyakala. They travel to Rajapalayam.

videos.title: Oath of Office
videos.overview: Rayar interrogates Ravi Chellappa. Meanwhile, Suriyakala challenges her father-in-law, Sivagnyanam, with the help of Nachiyar.

videos.title: Conspiracy
videos.overview: Suriyakala proves herself to be efficient in handling political power. The people are pleased with her. However, her success doesn’t sit well with her father-in-law.

videos.title: Crown
videos.overview: Rayar accomplishes his revenge mission but gets caught before he can find the mastermind behind all the incidents.

tt15211130.name: Meet Cute
tt15211130.description: Meet Cute takes you through five instances of Two strangers, unexpectedly, find solace in each other’s company while navigating through tricky phases in their lives, helping them look at themselves and their loved ones in a different light.

videos.title: Meet the Boy
videos.overview: An independent Swathi is forced by her mother to meet ‘dude no 11’ aka Abhi for dinner. He might look sweet and be chivalrous but she’s wary of anyone who seems too good to be true.

videos.title: Old Is Gold
videos.overview: An old man, Mohan Rao, keeping a young woman, Saroja as company as they wait in a long line at the consulate. The former might have a lot to teach the latter, especially when it comes to her relationship with her husband Jay.

videos.title: In L(aw)ove
videos.overview: Padma on a mission to find out more about Pooja, the girl her son Siddhu is apparently dating. While sceptical about her at first, she finds out they just might have more in common than their love for animals and her son.

videos.title: Star Struck
videos.overview: Dr. Aman offers a lift to popular actress Shalini on a rainy night. He doesn’t know who she is and she revels in the anonymity, even if for a few hours. The two get talking about love, romance and everything in between.

videos.title: Ex - Girl Friend
videos.overview: Anjana, frustrated with her stoic husband Ajay who’d rather take her on expensive dates than express his feelings. One fateful day, she finds herself in the company of his ex-girlfriend Kiran. Will this person from his past be the key to Anjana finally understanding Ajay?

tt39393261.name: Wheel Of Fortune India
tt39393261.description: Recognised by Guinness World Records as the world's most popular TV game show, Wheel of Fortune arrives in India in spectacular fashion, hosted by Akshay Kumar- Contestants enter a thrilling word game, decoding phrases spanning Bollywood, pop culture and everyday life- Blending entertainment with edge-of- the-seat moments, every alphabet can change the game as players compete for paisa and prizes!

tt26923717.name: Accidental Farmer & Co.
tt26923717.description: Inheriting a debt-ridden farming estate is hardly a dream come true, especially for a man with no direction in life. Just about having given up on the barren land, the man stumbles upon a mysterious medicinal herb. He decides to cultivate it so he can pay off the debt but ends up attracting wanted as well as some unwanted attention.

tt23321516.name: Aha Naa Pellanta
tt23321516.description: Seenu, a young man who is desperate for marriage, lands at a suitable match with great difficulty. While he's relieved about tying the knot at last, comes the twist, when the bride elopes with her boyfriend.

videos.title: Therasala
videos.overview: Sinu narrates a childhood incident that prompted him to vow to never flirt with any girl before marriage. Now an adult, he finally finds his match in Sudha, who elopes on their wedding day.

videos.title: Pani Grahanam
videos.overview: Sinu moves to Hyderabad to pursue a job and stays with his friends Dass and Bala. Sudha’s father meets Sinu and convinces him to abduct Sudha’s accomplice Maha.

videos.title: Brahma Mudi
videos.overview: Ready to avenge himself, Sinu and his friends abduct Maha a day before her wedding. While Sudha’s father plans to kill the girl, Sinu saves her. They together leave for Hyderabad to start afresh.

videos.title: Sapatha Padi
videos.overview: On reaching Hyderabad, Maha is rejected by her family. Stuck, helpless, and alone, she has nowhere to go. Sinu witnesses her situation and hesitantly offers her shelter at his place.

videos.title: Arundhati Nakshaatram
videos.overview: In order to stop Maha from filing a complaint, Sinu asks one of his friends to impersonate a police officer. As the footage of the abduction goes missing, Sudha’s father continues to threaten Maha.

videos.title: Jeelakarra Bellam
videos.overview: Friendship and love brew between Sinu and Maha during their stay together. Maha, however, faces problems with her ex over a house promised in dowry. An angry Maha reveals why she helped Sudha elope.

videos.title: Madhuparakam
videos.overview: Sinu helps in solving Maha’s house issue. As Sinu’s wedding gets fixed with another girl, both realise their love for each other. But Sudha’s father exposes Sinu as Maha's abductor to her father.

videos.title: Mangalasoothra Dhaarana
videos.overview: Maha decides to profess her love for Sinu but gets to know the story behind her abduction. A heartbroken Maha decides to leave the country, but the lovers are once again brought together by fate.

tt26351394.name: Engga Hostel
tt26351394.description: The relatable and curious life inside a Tamil Nadu engineering hostel by capturing the trials and tribulations of 6 engineering students and their struggles with identity, friendship, love, life and academics

tt21265148.name: Agent Anand Santosh
tt21265148.description: A quick-witted, aspiring detective strives to grow up as a professional, and he struggles to cope with the sluggish agency old personnel in which he is working.

videos.title: It's Meghana sir
videos.overview: Agent Anand Santosh runs a detective agency with his sidekick Ayomayam, dealing with petty cases in their neighbourhood. However, the situation escalated when he is tasked to find a missing girl. How our Agent using his quirky yet effective methods solves the case becomes the story.

videos.title: Are Entra Idi
videos.overview: The budding romance between Agent Anand Santosh and Alankrita takes a sudden turn when his livelihood of being a detective comes into question. Coincidently, he finds a job at a detective agency but has to deal with new problems.

videos.title: Chala Unnai... Dacham
videos.overview: Agent’s first case is to investigate and recover the stolen tire of an expensive car. Unlike his usual style, he has to devise a plan, present it to the team for approval, and work within a specific budget. However, Agent and Ayomayam find the robbers, but there is more to the case than the stolen tire.

videos.title: Daagudumoota Dandakor
videos.overview: After finding out drug papers in the stolen tyre, Agent returns the tyre without drugs to the owner and gives him a stern warning against dealing with drugs. Expecting appreciation for solving his first case, Agent left disappointed since he was asked to bear the expenses in return. A new case anchors that itself is a challenge.

videos.title: Pakdo Pakdo
videos.overview: As Agent struggles to find any clue in the iPhone theft case, he tries to build a new friendship to help him solve the case. With the help of his friend, he manages to locate the thief, but he has unwanted baggage in the shape of Sharma. The rest of the story is about how our Agent helps Sharma and manages to catch the thief.

videos.title: Haridas
videos.overview: Agent is assigned to deal with Agency's first costly case, the client was cheated when he placed an order for a branded shoe and he received a counterfeit.

tt25966494.name: Ayali
tt25966494.description: Young Tamizhselvi dreams of becoming a doctor. But her village, Veerappannai, has fearsome age-old customs and traditions which inadvertently suppress women of the village. Will she be able to overcome them?

tt21617580.name: Hello World
tt21617580.description: Eight youngsters join a renowned IT company assuming that their struggles are over. But, their excitement is short-lived when they realise that life has more in store for them than they had imagined.

videos.title: IT Calling
videos.overview: A bunch of youngsters from diverse backgrounds get an offer letter from PeopleTech. Later, they are shocked when a senior employee informs them that they will become permanent employees only if they fulfil certain conditions.

videos.title: Oops, Life Sucks Again
videos.overview: The interns rush out of their dorms to reach the office on time. Pravallika takes revenge on Varun for ragging her during their college days. Raghav, the Chief Learning Officer, has an important advice for the interns.

videos.title: Salary Credited
videos.overview: The first salary arrives, and the interns spend it as they wish. The boys decide to booze, but learn that alcohol is banned on campus. They devise a plan, but all hell breaks loose when the security guards see through their trick.

videos.title: Break-Point
videos.overview: Varun uses his uncle's influence and saves the gang from losing their jobs. Everyone attempts their first-term exams. The results are disappointing for Varsha, Suresh, and Varun.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Raghav promises to complete a challenging project with the help of the interns. A confidential document is found lying at the reception because of Suresh's ignorance, and Debashish threatens to fire him.

videos.title: Life Is a Scrum
videos.overview: Varsha decides to pursue the match suggested by her parents. Varun understands the importance of true love when Richa breaks up with him. Raghav kickstarts the project by onboarding the interns.

videos.title: Error 404
videos.overview: Prarthana takes a heartbroken Rahul under her wing. Debashish creates obstacles for Raghav's project, but the interns come together and take up the challenge to support Raghav.

videos.title: Exception Handling
videos.overview: Raghav suffers a heart attack. The interns are close to finishing the project but need Venkat's approval. Prarthana steps in to take up the responsibility in Raghav's absence. The team breaches office protocol to accomplish the impossible.

tt25151592.name: Story of Things
tt25151592.description: An anthology of five stories that follow characters who experience supernatural occurrences through material objects around them.

videos.title: Weighing Scale
videos.overview: When Ram and Titus, aspiring actors, are close to grabbing a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, a moment of carelessness endangers the life of a stranger. Titus, ridden with guilt, urges Ram to surrender to the police, but Ram refuses to let go of the aspirational life he craves. Things take an eerie turn when the latter is haunted by a weighing device he finds in his late grandmother’s belongings that weighs his sins in addition to his body weight.

videos.title: Cellular
videos.overview: Having been raised in the shadow of her mother, Vannamayil decides to do as she likes for once, and the unfortunate happens. But Vannamayil gets the scare of her life when she gets an otherworldly call.

videos.title: Compressor
videos.overview: When Raghu chances upon a bundle of cash, he asks his live-in girlfriend Shruthi to either plan a vacation for the two, or buy an air conditioner. She buys a second-hand AC, and the object begins to trouble Raghu. When he goes missing all of a sudden, Shruthi begins to investigate.

videos.title: Car
videos.overview: Britto is on a brave quest to overcome the fear of his abusive father and his car. Every time his mother questioned his father for beating him, little Britto would get locked up by his father in his car with a watchdog standing guard. Inside that dark and dingy car, Britto’s fears manifest in many forms. Decades later, Britto decides to fight back, but the ghosts of his past return.

videos.title: Mirror
videos.overview: After he is thrown out of his hostel, Sethu, who is suffering a terrible break-up, moves into the attic of an old house. He questions his own sanity for a moment when a ten-year-old girl named Nazia talks to him through an old dresser mirror.

tt21267508.name: Maa Neella Tank
tt21267508.description: In Buchivolu village, Sarpanch Kodandam's son Gopal threatens to jump off a water tank for his crush Surekha. With his image and career at stake, Kodandam appoints SI Vamshi to find Surekha, who is missing.

videos.title: The Idea of Self-Murder
videos.overview: Surekha runs away from home. Gopal climbs onto the tank and blames his father Kodandam for Surekha's disappearance. Gurumurthy requests inspector Vamshi to find Surekha. Vamshi learns about Surekha's whereabouts.

videos.title: A Favour And Fraud
videos.overview: Vamshi lies to Surekha to gain her trust and takes her back to the village. Surekha is shocked to discover the truth upon her return. Vamshi feels shattered after Gurumurthy's shocking revelation about the transfer letter.

videos.title: Celebrating the Chaos
videos.overview: Surekha has no choice and gets back to the fancy store. Her family is upset with her but decides to go ahead with her marriage to get rid of her.

videos.title: Alliance or Anguish?
videos.overview: Surekha's parents visit Gopal's house, and Chamundi approves of the marriage but puts forth a condition. Surekha is upset as the fancy store shuts and is taken over by a new owner.

videos.title: Planning the Twist
videos.overview: Vamshi learns some shocking facts from Gopal about his love for Surekha. Vamshi rushes to check on Surekha, who plans to leave again. At Kodandam's house, the priest is called to fix the marriage date.

videos.title: The Selfie-ish Love
videos.overview: Surekha and Vamshi believe that Narasimham can help Surekha get rid of her impending marriage with Gopal. Narasimham strikes a deal with Kodandam concerning the marriage and keeps the water tank repair in the loop.

videos.title: Love and Its Side Effects
videos.overview: Narasimham tries to establish himself as a true leader. Gopal and Surekha's engagement begins. Vamshi feels guilty for his mistakes and tries to apologise.

videos.title: Agreeing to Disagree
videos.overview: Vamshi and Surekha make some shocking revelations to the villagers. Will Surekha get married to Gopal? Will the villagers of Buchivolu hope for a better future as the next elections approach?

tt14075320.name: Naam
tt14075320.description: 6 mismatched individuals gel in a unique way to produce compelling music like never before. However, misunderstandings break the band. At present, an unwelcome entry of an intruder has given them the opportunity to reminisce their past.

videos.title: One Last Time
videos.overview: A whole year had passed. The band One Music are optimistic about their futures after coming out from a traumatic incident that had threatened their lives. With their eyes on the prize, they make plans for a successful re-launch when a man with a familiar name returns.

videos.title: Welcome to Rudhiranda
videos.overview: Jyothibala receives a distress call from a broken voice In the midst of a murder investigation. Nagamalani's death forces Shiva to find refuge on an uncharted island whilst an ex-cop gets reinstated on a cold case.

videos.title: The Purpose
videos.overview: Private security is hired after a masked gang attempts an assault on Aaryan whilst a sinister presence looms near. In a shack on the outskirts of Rudhiranda hides a secret. A beautiful secret.

videos.title: Breakthrough
videos.overview: All actions have consequences, a fisherman and a courtesan aid in an escape plan. A vital clue sends the police on a wild chase.

videos.title: Haunting Truth
videos.overview: A diary reveals the pain of love whilst two police officers settle their differences. Dhilip and Jyothibala are presented a ticket to paradise.

videos.title: Revelation
videos.overview: Shiva receives a daily token chip that sends him to work in a lab. A revelation in the truth sends the band into a spiral.

videos.title: Frequencies
videos.overview: Hidden wires and radio waves, Shiva puts together a communications box whilst Vettaiyan suspects an insider in the Taskforce.

videos.title: One More Perspective
videos.overview: Shiva escapes the island of no return to settle an old score. Aaryan's suspicion comes true when he comes face to face with his old enemy.

videos.title: Choose One
videos.overview: Ranna leaves Jyothibala helpless when he is left to choose between Dhilip and a reunion with Malar. In a rundown lair, Aaryan discovers the motive of his true nemesis.

videos.title: 2 Sides to Every Story
videos.overview: Ranna puts the search for Azhagi on hold when a big investor arrives on the island. In an undisclosed safe house, Sethu reveals to Vettaiyan there's more to Rudhiranda than just Shiva.

videos.title: One Love One Life - The Finale
videos.overview: He the protector. He the destroyer. Shiva frees the slaves while Aaryan ends his bane.

tt15128106.name: Parampara
tt15128106.description: When powerful, wily Naidu's ruthlessness becomes too much, his nephew, Gopi, steps up to avenge the injustice met to his father.

tt23642102.name: Fall
tt23642102.description: An accident followed by memory loss has Divya trying to piece her life together. Will her near and dear ones support her quest for the truth?

videos.title: Plunged into Darkness
videos.overview: It's been six months since Divya's fall, and she is still in a coma. Rohit and Daniel try to sell her sports centre. Upon hitting a roadblock, Rohit does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Waking Up from the Abyss
videos.overview: As Divya tries to recollect the events of the fateful night, Rohit panics when he learns that she is out of her coma. Meanwhile, Daniel gets closer to Maya.

videos.title: Web of Lies
videos.overview: Caught secretly filming women and selling drugs at the sports centre, Ilango becomes a suspect in Divya’s fall. Moreover, a break-in raises further suspicion.

videos.title: What Lies Beneath
videos.overview: Divya tries to piece her memories together. While Rohit learns the actual value of the property and acts swiftly to sell it, Daniel digs deeper into Rohit’s past to stop him.

videos.title: Prey in the Shadows
videos.overview: Divya's suspicion against her brother grows stronger when she learns of his financial troubles. With Divya on the warpath, Rohit and Daniel take desperate measures to stop her.

videos.title: Truth Unwinds
videos.overview: When Malar learns the truth about Rohit, she shares her concerns with Divya. Things take an interesting turn when she reveals his whereabouts on the night of her fall.

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: Divya confronts Maya and learns shocking truths about her accident. Lakshmi forces Jeeva to leave the country to stop Divya from finding the final missing piece in the puzzle.

tt18341722.name: Modern Love Hyderabad
tt18341722.description: A new generation of love stories, the love and fascination between the lovers, the dynamics of their relationships, their funny conversations and their conflicts.

videos.title: Fuzzy, purple and full of thorns...
Why did she leave me there…?
About that rustle in the bushes

tt22771498.name: Pettaikaali
tt22771498.description: To marry the girl he loves, the hero tames a bull that belongs to her with deceptive tricks. His frivolous act rekindles the bygone animosity between the families that prompts several problems.

tt21048590.name: Anya's Tutorial
tt21048590.description: Anya’s YouTube channel becomes popular when her viewers find hints of paranormal activity in her home. She uses the haunted house to her advantage, but dancing with the devil comes at a price.

videos.title: Deyyalu levu, Bhootalu levu
videos.overview: A wannabe influencer, Anya moves into an old apartment in the middle of nowhere just before the lockdown. The house seems to have a mind of its own. Is the house haunted or is it the demons of Anya's past that's haunting her?

videos.title: #girlinahauntedhouse
videos.overview: Anya's tutorial is trending across all social media platforms. Madhu reaches out for help to get her sister back home. Anya wants to stay trending and is ready to go to any lengths to do so. But a dance with the devil always comes with a price.

videos.title: Sevam ela paaripotundi?
videos.overview: Anya's tutorial needs to be banned - that's the talk everywhere and that only makes her trend more. Madhu is worried about what else 'Anya' is going to reveal to her followers. Madhu gives a comeback, but will that impact Anya's newfound fame?

videos.title: Followers kosame na idantha?
videos.overview: Anya's new friendship with a fan gives her all the courage to handle Madhu. There's Anyans and Anti-Anyans following her every move and their debate puts Anya in a spot. Anya's life is hanging by a thread while her fans are hunting for Madhu's whereabouts.

videos.title: #findtheevilsister
videos.overview: Anya's tutorial is now live 24/7. Anyans go on a digital hunting spree for Madhu. Anya breaks free into her new persona and decides to take her power back from Madhu. It's time for Madhu to hide.

videos.title: #justiceforanya
videos.overview: Anya has become a phenomenon that's loved, feared and hated all at once. Anya heads out to get her justice while her fans are hooked to her channel. The cops are trying to catch Anya. Meanwhile, Madhu decides to take matters into her own hands about Kira.

videos.title: It's too late
videos.overview: In the season finale, pressure is mounting to catch Anya and her hideout. With Hemanth vowing to protect her at all costs, Anya goes for her final justice - A face off with Madhu. With time running out and children vanishing from homes, the cops have to reach Anya before she breaks free.

tt21211254.name: TamilRockerz
tt21211254.description: Tamil Rockerz, an anonymous cyber pirates are threatening to release a highly anticipated film featuring a massively popular star. It's up to the cop Rudra to find the lawbreakers and bring them to justice.

tt20784064.name: Recce
tt20784064.description: Set in the backdrop of Anantapur, in 1993,  A dual murder takes place, setting off a series of unforeseen consequences and twists after a cop named Lenin embarks on an investigation.

videos.title: The Contract
videos.overview: A burnt body is found on the outskirts of Tadipatri village, and sub-inspector Lenin begins to investigate the murder. Kullayappa hires Paradesi and gang to kill the village sarpanch Varadarajulu

videos.title: The Sketch
videos.overview: Paradesi and gang plan to kill Varadarajulu during the flag hoisting ceremony. Lenin is off-duty due to his injury but continues his investigation. He visits a nearby police station when he finds a similar case.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Paradesi's men await his instructions to execute the plan, but Paradesi aborts the mission. Lenin finds out about Paradesi. Later, Paradesi demands to know the identity of the mastermind who hired him to kill Varadarajulu

videos.title: The Twist
videos.overview: Varadarajulu's men search all the hotels, but Paradesi and gang escape. Varadarajulu attends the temple procession with his family, where Paradesi and his men kill him

videos.title: The Clue
videos.overview: Lenin tracks Kullayappa's wife and finds out about his location. The MLA asks Varadarajulu's wife Devakamma, and Chalapathi's wife Bujjamma to contest the elections. Lenin and constable Swami find Kullayappa

videos.title: The Reveal
videos.overview: Lenin finds out some shocking details from Kullayappa about Chalapathi. Later, Lenin brings Rekha to the police station for interrogation, but his investigation meets a dead end

videos.title: The Revenge
videos.overview: Lenin checks the photos of the corpse and discovers a startling clue. Devakamma agrees to contest the elections and announces her nomination. The MLA asks Lenin to drop the case and gives him a promotion

tt21340072.name: Emoji
tt21340072.description: Aadhav and Deeksha, a vibrant young couple are about to be separated as passion pulls them apart. Can love win them back together?

videos.title: Emoji Episode 1
videos.overview: Aadhav visits Decathlon, by the twist of fate he meets Prathana there. He eventually becomes a regular customer for her sake, until one day he decides to let her know his real intention.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 2
videos.overview: When Aadhav and Dheeksha travel to a lively village, a new bond bloom between them. Meera tries to flirt with Aadhav which triggers Dheeksha’s possessiveness and prompts her to grow closer to Aadhav.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 3
videos.overview: The past unfolds where Prathana accepts Aadhav’s proposal and they wallow in love. A new couple moves next door to Aadhav’s flat, both the couples forge a friendship.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 4
videos.overview: Aadhav struggles to set his life back on an even keel after an unfortunate event. Simultaneously Dheeksha also goes through a rough phase because of her narcissistic boyfriend.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 5
videos.overview: Aadhav and Dheeksha’s friendship starts to flourish while they try to mend each other. Impulsive Aadhav dashes to the Bandhipur forest to pull off his heart’s desire.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 6
videos.overview: Impressed by Aadhav’s efforts, Dheeksha makes a big decision, her friends and family feels jubilant about it. Deeksha and Aadhav goes to her familial house in Kerala.

videos.title: Emoji Episode 7
videos.overview: An unforeseen plight disrupts their smooth sailing relationship. They both mutually come to a conclusion with a heavy heart.

tt20836266.name: 9 Hours
tt20836266.description: Three prisoners on run try to rob three banks. They are well-prepared and know how to run away with the booty. Is someone handling them from behind the screens?

videos.title: Hour 1
videos.overview: Three prisoners escape from Hyderabad Central Jail to form three teams to loot three banks. While two teams execute the heist successfully, what happens to the third team?

videos.title: Hour 2
videos.overview: Hearing about the heist, journalist Chitralekha arrives at the bank and argues with Circle Inspector Pratap. Meanwhile, Nagendra has bad intentions towards one of the hostages.

videos.title: Hour 3
videos.overview: Inside the bank, the robbers receive a call with an offer to harm Chandra Sekhar. However, the hostages devise a plan to attack the robbers.

videos.title: Hour 4
videos.overview: As the situation gets tense when the robbers throw the body of one of the hostages outside the bank, Pratap decides to attempt a rescue.

videos.title: Hour 5
videos.overview: Chidambaram gets caught, and Pratap finds a lead in the investigation. An impossible situation brings someone to Nagendra's attention.

videos.title: Hour 6
videos.overview: Nandu and Shravani try to get in touch with the police. Meanwhile, Purushottam makes a secret deal with the robbers.

videos.title: Hour 7
videos.overview: The prisons in Andhra Pradesh receive an order to conduct an impromptu roll call. On hearing this, Vishwanath wants to stop it anyhow.

videos.title: Hour 8
videos.overview: The robbers successfully flee from the bank in a vehicle. However, chaos erupts as fire breaks out in the prison and a few prisoners are discovered to be missing.

videos.title: Hour 9
videos.overview: When the robbers get surrounded by the police in the market, they come up with a new plan. Meanwhile, an unknown chapter of Dasaradha's life comes into the light.

tt21320334.name: Victim
tt21320334.description: Four different people fall victim to their situations and must face the consequences of their actions. The choices they now make will define their outcomes.

videos.title: Kottai Paaku Vathalum Mottai Maadi Sitharum

tt19336492.name: Dhahanam
tt19336492.description: The assassination of Sri Ramulu, a communist labourer, causes a stir. Sri Ramulu's oldest son, Hari, is a Naxalite rebel operating from the forest using guerrilla warfare against the landlords, and the news of his father's death infuriates him. He takes it upon himself to find the person responsible for his father's murder, which sparks a conflict between the village's most powerful goons.

videos.title: Back Stab
videos.overview: Anjana Sinha arrives at Obul Reddy's murder location. While looking into the details of the case, she comes across a murder that was a fabric for all the murders happening in the region, that is the murder of Sri Ramulayya. Soon, Anjana uncovers a deeper mystery behind all these murders. When Sri Ramulayya gets murdered, Hari, Ramulayya's son, vows to avenge his father's death.

videos.title: On the Run
videos.overview: Hari and his men gather and start hunting down all the people who helped Siddappa in killing Sri Ramulayya. Ravi persuades Hari to give up his revenge. Seeing that Ravi's brother Hari is down the wrong path, Sunitha's father denies her marriage to Ravi. Siddappa hides in the lodge, feeling guilty about killing Sri Ramulayya. However, Siddappa makes a mistake when he calls his wife which helps Hari's men to get Siddappa's location.

videos.title: The Plot
videos.overview: The motive and plan behind the murder of Sri Ramulayya are revealed. Chenna Reddy gets jealous of his friend Narayana Reddy and Sri Ramulayya's friendship and poisons Narayana Reddy's mind against Sri Ramulayya. It is revealed that Siddappa is only a cover for the evil deeds done by Narayana and Chenna Reddy.

videos.title: Warning
videos.overview: Chenna Reddy's son, Obul Reddy, rapes a teacher and kills her husband. To make an example, Hari hangs Siddappa's dead body in a tank and places a letter of warning for the perpetrators of his father's murder. This leads to an all-out war between both families. Narayana and Chenna reddy plan to kill Hari with the help of the police. When Subba Reddy is killed, the blame for the murder is put on Hari. The police start looking for Hari and his men.

videos.title: Game
videos.overview: Obul realizes that he was caught in Hari's trap. Obul gets injured and Chenna Reddy yells at him for not listening. Obul Reddy presents an offer to Kabir to capture Hari alive in exchange for anything he wants. Ravi meets with Hari and Sunitha before he leaves for Bangalore. Hari finds out that Chenna Reddy and Kabir are looking for him and plan to capture him.

videos.title: Attack
videos.overview: Pavani serves food to the Naxals, then Kanchi questions Pavani about her feelings for Hari. Pavani tells Kanchi about how her family was killed and she ran to the forest to save herself where she met Hari. He helped her kill her family's murderers. When the police start shooting, Kanchi dies on the spot, and Pavani hides. The police manage to capture Hari and Pavani finds out a shocking truth.

videos.title: Vow
videos.overview: Kabir informs Obul Reddy about Hari's capture. Obul hurries to the spot and kills Hari. Pavani and Naxals kill Sai, who was the police's informer. Chaman reveals to the Naxals that Kabir is behind Hari's murder. The Naxals decide to eliminate Kabir and filtrate his house to kill him. With Kabir's death, Narayana Reddy and Chenna Reddy feel the heat and decide to stop the Naxals. Ravi is back and vows to take revenge for his father and brother's murder.

tt21223050.name: Meme Boys
tt21223050.description: Four unassuming friends, launch an anonymous social media page "Meme Boys" shedding light on their oppressive college administration with a punch of humor. What starts as an innocent fun exercise, soon revolutionizes the entire college, birthing a movement of sorts in no time. With memes taking the college by storm, a cat-and-mouse game kicks off between the Meme Boys’ gang and the Dean.

videos.title: Expectation Vs Reality
videos.overview: As the new college year begins, Mojo actively tries to put a team together to take part in the Meme Fest. Meanwhile, Apoorva University gets a new dean who comes up with his own plans. Is there a conflict in the offing?

videos.title: Make This man Famous
videos.overview: With the popularity of the Meme Boys spreading, battle lines are drawn between the group and the dean, The dean tries to establish a task force to identify the faces behind the Meme Boys

videos.title: To Catch A Memer
videos.overview: The dean gets an unexpected ally in his crackdown on the Meme Boys. Meanwhile, as they get ahead of themselves, internal differences brew within the Meme Boys, leading to an unpleasant confrontation

videos.title: Confusions Of Apoorva University
videos.overview: As mistrust arises and the cracks widen, will the Meme Boys come together or disband their team? An unexpected move by the dean puts them at a further disadvantage.

videos.title: Mission Unpossible
videos.overview: With the bean tightening the noose and the deadline closing in to post their tournament-defining meme, the Meme Boys must pull off an impossible heist-like operation to save themselves.

videos.title: Gangs Of Apoorva
videos.overview: A rigged student union election orchestrated by the dean proves to be the last straw and leads to an all-out war between the students and the dean powered by the Meme boys. The issue becomes a matter of public and media debate

videos.title: The Dean Wants To Know
videos.overview: Apoorva University and the mediascape come to a standstill as they prepare to witness the epic showdown of Meme Boys vs Dean Narayanan on Primetime News. The Meme Boys must decide once and for all whether to reveal themselves to the public?

videos.title: Thoughts Become Things?
videos.overview: With the Meme Boys arrested under the pretext of issuing a death threat to the dean, they must do whatever it takes to prove their innocence while a vengeful Narayanan is out for blood. However, unexpected help arrives.

tt19372336.name: Gaalivaana
tt19372336.description: After newlyweds Ajay and Geetha are brutally murdered, their families come together in grief. But the situation takes a new twist when the suspected killer arrives at their doorstep.

videos.title: The Storm is Coming
videos.overview: Childhood sweethearts Ajay Varma and Geetha are brutally murdered on their return from the honeymoon. Soon, their devastated families discover the identity of the badly injured stranger who turns up on their doorstep.

videos.title: One Of Us Knows it All
videos.overview: Nandini, a police officer from Vizag is appointed to investigate the young couple’s murder. The two families have a new problem to deal with, as they realise they are not above crime.

videos.title: The Buried Truth
videos.overview: While both the families struggle to hide the crime, someone among them is hiding the truth from everyone. Saraswathi stumbles upon something that can either solve it all, or create a bigger dilemma for her.

videos.title: The Knife Knows the Killer
videos.overview: Savitri blackmails Komarraju to not reveal Srikanth’s visit to the cattle barn the night Srinu died. Nandini is terrified to see the news of the young guy’s death because of the drugs she supplied. Meanwhile, Ravindra Varma commits suicide, and Marthand gets arrested.

videos.title: Is it Right to Be Wrong?
videos.overview: David Raju warns Nandini to help him escape the city. Srikanth leaks a shocking information to the police. Nandini and the police team find the clue they’ve been searching for.

videos.title: A Truth Greater Than Confession
videos.overview: The two families are taken into custody. Finally, Marthand confesses to murder. Sravani's world shatters when Shakantulamma reveals the truth to her.

videos.title: An Innocent Mind Knows No Boundaries
videos.overview: Shakuntala reveals how overlooking something in the past has now caught up to destroy two families. Saraswathi unleashes a mother’s wrath. Tulasi crumbles while Komarraju realises everything that he has been holding on to is false.

tt39779938.name: Dil Dhokha Aur Desire
tt39779938.description: Duty spirals into a volatile triangle of love, loyalty and betrayal when the dreams of a young boxer lands him in the dangerous world of a ruthless businessman, entangling him with his wife, the one woman he was hired to protect. He must now choose who, and what, he's willing to lose.

videos.title: A Dangerous Deal
videos.overview: What begins as an act of courage turns into a deal that pulls Shaurya into a world where ambition, violence and desire are tightly controlled and never forgiven.

videos.title: Temptation
videos.overview: As Shaurya resists temptation and clings to his moral code, Malini turns desire into leverage, pulling him deeper into a dangerous power play; crossing the line starts to feel inevitable.

videos.title: The Reckoning
videos.overview: When restraint finally breaks, one reckless night rewrites loyalties and the past Shaurya tried to bury comes knocking at his door.

videos.title: Collateral Damage
videos.overview: Trapped between Malini's obsession, his lost love's return and a friend's sacrifice, Shaurya realizes every choice now comes with blood on it.

videos.title: Nowhere to Run
videos.overview: Caught between truth and manipulation, Shaurya's choice turns devotion into danger, exposing how far Malini is willing to go; escape may cost more than staying.

videos.title: The Bloody End
videos.overview: In the ruthless game with no safe choices, Shaurya's final act of courage ends the war, but the price of survival delivers a blow that shatters everything he fought to protect.

tt15561184.name: Kuthukku Pathu
tt15561184.description: A group of friends try sorting out issues between a couple. When one of them gets attacked by the relatives of the couple, all the friends react in a harsh manner. The entry of a few gangsters makes things complex from a hand fight.

videos.title: Thulluvatho Ilamai
videos.overview: Boopathi impulsively proposes to Manisha with a love letter enraging her brother Rohit Sharma. Vishnu’s girlfriend Abhi gifts him a new phone for his birthday and that gets him involved with the leader of the local gang called ‘Reservoir dogs’.

videos.title: Rangasthalam
videos.overview: The ‘Reservoir dogs’ gang up against Kathiresan and end up getting arrested. Professor Rangabhashyam gets on mechanic Fakir’s nerves and gets thwacked by his friends leading to a revenge plan by Rangabashyam.

videos.title: Onaayum Aattukuttiyum
videos.overview: Saravanan chases Samaan’s squad but accidentally finds himself in conflict with the MLA’s illegitimate son. Saravanan’s brother Murugesan wrangles over the issue with MLA Mazhuvazh Nediyon and takes a fateful decision.

videos.title: Mandhiri Madiyil Sundhari
videos.overview: Mazhuvazh Nediyon’s second wife causes a ruckus in his funeral and hires inspector Thiyagarajan to kill Murugesan. Fakir accepts Augustine’s race request to pay Saravan’s hospital bills. Dawood is pushed to the corner in a grave situation.

videos.title: Payum Puli Pathungum Nagam
videos.overview: Fakir finds that someone has burnt his bike and suspects Augustine. Samaan warns Rangabashyam to lie low in his friend’s place. Drunk Rangabhashyam gets involved with an unexpected group of people.

videos.title: Nadunisi Naaigal
videos.overview: Drunk Rangabhashyam records the deeds of the group. Fakir is also kidnapped to Mazhuvazh’s house to threaten Dawood. Dawood equips himself with enough protection and goes to the MLA’s house.

videos.title: Mirattal Adi
videos.overview: All of them converge at MLA’s house for different reasons. Dawood shows up at MLA’s house to rescue his son. Hell breaks loose.

tt15819134.name: Oka Chinna Family Story
tt15819134.description: Mahesh and his mother embark on an adventurous journey filled with hilarious situations as they try to make quick money to repay a huge loan.

videos.title: EP1
videos.overview: Mahesh is an unemployed youth who, along with his mother, must earn 25 lakh rupees to repay a loan taken by his dead father. As they struggle to make money, Mahesh realises the unsaid truth behind his dad's invaluable sacrifice.

videos.title: The First EMI
videos.overview: As the loan recovery agents swarm their house, Mahesh and his mother, Rukmini, are forced to work to repay the loan. Mahesh takes up a job but parallelly devises a plan with his mother to make easy money.

videos.title: Of the money, by the money, for the money
videos.overview: While Mahesh and Rukmini struggle to arrange for the money, Mahesh manages to break the ice with Keerthi. But with time running out and no concrete plan in place, what will Mahesh do?

videos.title: Ousting Days
videos.overview: As Mahesh fails to make money and win Keerthi's love, his resentment toward his belated father increases. He grows apart from his mother. But he gets an unexpected proposition that could malign his father's name.

videos.title: Truth or Dare
videos.overview: With a potential deal in front of him that could solve his money problem but spoil his father's good image, Mahesh must now decide on the next course of action. Will Mahesh solve his family's problems forever?

tt19733404.name: Anantham
tt19733404.description: Anantham has sheltered and nurtured families since 1964. When Ananth, the son of the house owner returns to Anantham, he learns about the many untold past stories of the house.

videos.title: Chapter 1 - Maragatham
videos.overview: Ananth, a successful writer, unwillingly revisits his family home. Meanwhile, an estranged father dives into the past to learn about the journey of Venkatesan and his wife Maragatham in their home called 'Anantham.'

videos.title: Chapter 2 - Seetha
videos.overview: Ananth learns the story of a married couple who lived in the house in 1971—Sundar and his visually impaired wife, Seetha. He witnesses Seetha's plight during the days she spent within the walls of Anantham.

videos.title: Chapter 3 - Rekha
videos.overview: Set in 1975, witness the struggling lives of Sandeep, an IIT graduate, Rekha, his happy-go-lucky wife, and their two children.

videos.title: Chapter 4 - Ananth
videos.overview: Ananth recalls the first time he fell in love in 1985 and how it changed his life forever.

videos.title: Chapter 5 - Krishnan Menon
videos.overview: Three beautiful women living in 'Anantham' experience laughter and love after Krishnan Menon, a new paying guest, moves into their home.

videos.title: Chapter 6 - Lalitha
videos.overview: Tenants Lalitha and Balu return to stay at Anantham. But, will they have a peaceful stay at Anantham despite the horrible sins committed during their previous stay?

videos.title: Chapter 7 - Parvathy
videos.overview: Ananth meets a young psychotherapist, Parvathy, who tells him about her painful journey and how she broke barriers and embraced her true potential while living at Anantham.

videos.title: Chapter 8 - Venkatesan
videos.overview: Venkatesan returns home to spend his remaining days at Anantham. As he nears his end, will he reconcile with his son and embrace peace?

tt14932842.name: Kudi Yedamaithe
tt14932842.description: A Food Delivery Guy, who finds a bloody corpse of a young woman in the middle of a night & A Female Police Inspector investigating a missing child's case collide into each other as they meet with a fatal accident, which sends both of them into a Never ending time loop until they figure out an Unimaginable way out of it.

tt16227378.name: Irai
tt16227378.description: To solve a kidnapping case of a high-profile politician and to investigate the mysterious disappearances of men from the city's affluent families, ACP Robert Vasudevan is appointed. Will he succeed in finding the culprit?

videos.title: The Ripple Effect
videos.overview: At the break of dawn, Kodaikanal suddenly becomes a hotspot for a high-profile influential politician missing case. Veteran police officer, ACP Robert Vasudevan is called in to investigate.

videos.title: Skeletons In The Closet
videos.overview: Traveling back to late 80's the story unearths Sivakumar's dark past like a can of worms. In the present, Anita, the officer-in-charge of the case, begins to have second thoughts about Robert's eccentric ways of dealing the case.

videos.title: The Past
videos.overview: Sivakumar dwells in torture in a dark and damp cellar. Robert takes a little detour to revisit a place that holds traumatic memories from the past. In Devi’s timeline, she takes an unexpected decision that will forever change Swarna's life.

videos.title: The Suspect
videos.overview: An international school in town, keeps catches Robert's attention in his investigation. Heera from the NGO becomes a primary suspect.

videos.title: Lost & Found
videos.overview: A janitor from the school falls into the radar of Robert's suspects. Meanwhile, Sivakumar tries to execute his escape plan. In a mix-up of things, Robert ends up arriving alone to what could very well be the hideout of the kidnapper.

videos.title: Truth Will Set You Free
videos.overview: Robert has a face-off with Sumithran. In a strange turn of events the other abductor surrenders to the police. As the case is being closed and normalcy returns, Robert is being lured to a door from the past.

tt14690100.name: In the Name of God
tt14690100.description: Love, Lust, Freedom, Greed, Beauty what drives people to do unimaginable things? What provokes them to shed Blood? Press the play button for a shocking tale.

videos.title: Aadhi Parvam
videos.overview: "Aadhi" after years of struggle and hard work is on the verge of upgrading his life for the better. "Rossi" a surprise guest at the party teases "Aadi" on the love life "Aadi" was missing. Instigating further to strike an affair with "Meena" the wife of "Ayyyappa" - The eccentric porn film director in the town. Discover what happens next?

videos.title: BIG BANG
videos.overview: The parcel and the jeep now in the woods. Thomas and Rossi threaten Aadi to leave the town forever. Will he do just the way they proposed? Discover what happens next?

videos.title: Lost & Found
videos.overview: Blood spills as Fakir get to know about his jeep being burnt. Vishnu having lost his brother Ayyappa, threatened by Fakir has no clue what had happened. Aadi realises he has no option but to fight back. Discover what Meena is planning in the middle of all this?

videos.title: Nayee Zindagee
videos.overview: Aadi displays his newfound courage to Thomas and warns him of breaking his secret drug business news to his Pastor father. Fakir is on the hunt for the one who burnt his jeep and looted the hawala money. Will Kalki stand with Vishnu in this fight? Discover in this episode.

videos.title: Vivaaha Bhojanambu
videos.overview: As Aadi gets married to Indra and tries to solve his problems, Vishnu vows to take revenge on those who killed his brother. What news Rossi breaks to turn things murkier, discover in this episode.

videos.title: Udyoga Parvam
videos.overview: Aadi is planning to start a new business with the support of Thomas but Thomas backstabs Aadi. Meena having moved her base to Hyderabad and after meeting her filmstar friend Apoorva is desperate to make a mark in Tinseltown. Will she succeed in her endeavour? discover the new threat that Aadi faces in this episode.

videos.title: Silk
videos.overview: Will Aadi survives the battle, Will Vishnu take his revenge, Will fakir gets his money, Will Meena gets what she desperate about, Discover the fitting finale

tt15716624.name: Vilangu
tt15716624.description: Paridhi, a cop undergoing a stressful personal situation, must solve a mysterious murder case that has put the police department on its toes.

videos.title: The Last Piece of the Puzzle

tt13429172.name: 11th Hour
tt13429172.description: Aratika Reddy is the CEO of Aditya Group and has a day to pay a debt of Rs 10,000 Cr. With rivals breathing down her neck to take over the company, stakes are high as she runs against time to save the day.

tt15163764.name: Akash Vaani
tt15163764.description: A recently divorced couple has to pretend to be happily married during a college reunion with their close friends.

videos.title: Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: Seeking inspiration for her novel, an aspiring writer Teena traces back to the celebrated love story of her college classmates Akash and Vaani. This leads to the re-union of their college batch after a decade.​

videos.title: Where Are You Now?
videos.overview: Sharath and Teena try to look for leads to connect with Akash and Vaani. The batch arrives at the re-union. Akash and Vaani face an unexpected surprise.​

videos.title: Something Fishy
videos.overview: Akash and Vaani try to lie low during the re-union dinner but a nosy Sharath won't leave them alone. In the past, Akash expresses his love through a grand gesture. ​

videos.title: Storm In A Teacup
videos.overview: In the past, Akash and Vaani get married and face issues as a newly married couple. The friends come to terms with a shocking revelation at the re-union.​

videos.title: Bite The Bullet
videos.overview: Problems between Akash and Vaani peak. In the past the college gang deals with the loss of a loved one. A drunk conversation lands Dileep in an awkward situation with Akash.​

videos.title: The Courage of Our Hearts
videos.overview: Akash and Vaani come together to help Anu re-unite with her husband. The friends look for an opportunity to make things happen. Akash opens up for the first time.​

videos.title: Through Thick And Thin
videos.overview: Vaani re-lives the promises she and Akash made with each other. Akash goes missing leading to a frantic search by the friends.​

tt12351276.name: Amrutham Dhvitheeyam
tt12351276.description: Amrutham Dhvitheeyam is a 2020 ZEE5 Telugu Original comedy series starring Harsha Vardhan, L B Sriram, Vasu, and Sivannarayana. In this sequel of Amrutham, the all-time popular Telugu sitcom, Amrutham and Anji continue to come up with creative ideas for their restaurant and fail with hilarious consequences.

videos.title: The Beginning of Amrutha Vilas
videos.overview: Amrutha Rao and Anji decide to start Amrutha Vilas again after losing all their money in a recent disaster. When they meet Sarvam and prepare to begin their new journey, Appaji re-enters their life, offering finance for their new venture. However, the duo rejects it and tries their luck at a venture capital firm.

videos.title: When Failure Becomes Your Friend
videos.overview: After being rejected by the venture capitalist, Anji and Amrutha seek an alternate approach. When all attempts seem destined for failure, they find a ray of hope in the form of an angel investor. Will their dream of starting Amrutha Vilas come true?

videos.title: The Angel in Disguise
videos.overview: After Anji and Amrutha recover from discovering the identity of their angel investor, they begin the preps for the launch of their new hotel, Amrutha Vilas. Sarvam vows never to be the cause for them losing any money. Will Sarvam keep up his word?

videos.title: Lockdown Special Part I
videos.overview: After Appaji decides to get his share of money even during the lockdown, he informs Amrutham, Anji, and Sarvam, to transfer Rs. 1000 to his account. The trio decides to teach him a lesson and play a prank on him.

videos.title: Lockdown Special Part II
videos.overview: After Appaji expresses his desire to eat Pesarattu, Sarvam convinces him to follow his recipe and make it at home. However, Appaji's efforts of eating his favourite dish go in vain after he finds himself in an unexpected situation, thanks to the lockdown!

videos.title: Mosquito bite
videos.overview: The dengue outbreak in the city makes Amrutha Rao take extreme precautionary measures. Meanwhile, Anji comes up with a new scheme to attract customers by promising the highest level of safety measures.

videos.title: Kitty Party
