videos.overview: After hearing about Santha's kitty party and the savings involved, Sanjeevini floats the idea of conducting similar kitty parties at Amrutha Vilas. On the other hand, Anji plans an elaborate scheme involving the same kitty parties which can free them from Appaji’s partnership forever. Will Anji's plan work?

videos.title: The Booksellers!
videos.overview: After Sarvam attends a book launch, Anji plans to conduct a book launch event at Amrutha Vilas with the help of Rubber Balaji. When the publisher offers them a share in the sale of the books instead of their payment, Amrutha Rao gets tempted and agrees. However, their attempts to recoup their investment only get worse with unimaginable twists and turns!

videos.title: Sick Sock-Mind Block
videos.overview: Sanju’s new smartphone leads to trouble for Amruthavilas. When she starts to upload videos to the popular Sick Sock app, her soaring popularity makes her an addict. Anji’s idea threatens her new-found celebrity status and Sanju responds in the most unexpected manner.

videos.title: Crazy Chef's Tasty Menu
videos.overview: Anji wakes up with the idea of celebrating "World Opposite Day" at Amruthavilas. On the same day, a famous food blogger visits their restaurant to review their food. Will they succeed in pleasing her, or will the opposite happen as is usually their fate?

videos.title: Final Destination
videos.overview: Appaji forces Amrutha and Anji to accept the offer of celebrating the birthday of an old man. Will this lead them to profits or unexpected consequences?

videos.title: Krishnashtami
videos.overview: Anji hosts Krishnashtami at AV4D where Amrutha undertakes safety protocols fearing legal troubles. This leads to bigger problems than he can envision.

videos.title: Door Delivery
videos.overview: Anji starts a new door delivery service to earn huge profits. Appaji overpowers them by trying to snatch the high profits from them. What new problem can this lead to?

videos.title: 21 Varieties of Leaves
videos.overview: Anji performs a traditional pooja on the occasion of Vinayaka Chaturthi but ends up inviting the wrath of God. Will they be able to overcome this?

videos.title: The Colourful Dream
videos.overview: Sanju and Sarvam receive a scam message promising money. Appaji garners followers who also launch a fan club for him. Could these events be linked?

videos.title: Rummy and Fireworks
videos.overview: Appaji forces AV4D to follow a smokeless Diwali. Anji comes up with ideas where the kids and adults get to enjoy. Will this lead to consequences?

videos.title: Monstrous Stew 1
videos.overview: Amrutha plans on hosting a Halloween party at AV4D. Even after been stopped by Anji, Amrutha goes ahead with his plan. Will this land them in trouble?

videos.title: Monstrous Stew 2
videos.overview: Kids at the Halloween celebrations in AV4D plan revenge on Appaji who had stolen their chocolates. How are the others trapped in this play?

videos.title: Happy New Year
videos.overview: Anji plans a universal party to celebrate New Year's as per different time zones. Appaji sells fake passes to make a quick buck but lands in trouble.

videos.title: Festival Rooster
videos.overview: Parandamayya’s main intent is to keep his prized rooster away from Amrutha and hence he decides to celebrate the festival at AV4D at any cost.

videos.title: A Happy, Flying Birthday Cake
videos.overview: Anji and Amrutha need to fulfill a special clause to celebrate the birthday of a 4-year old girl. Will the party be a success or will they face hurdles?

videos.title: Gravity of Fish Gravy
videos.overview: Anji decides to host a special cooking event for his customers. A food inspector adds spice to the gravy. Will this spicy gravy cause tears to Amrutha?

videos.title: Two Cooks Spoil the Broth
videos.overview: Cooking videos are shot to help increase Anji’s fame but frustrated with the expenses, Appaji launches a new cost-cutting exercise. Will it be a futile attempt?

videos.title: Uma Devi's Wedding Festivities
videos.overview: Sarvam gets shocked when someone from his past shows up at AV4D. A misunderstanding makes Appaji swear that he will get Uma married to anyone but Sarvam.

videos.title: Amrutha Vilas, a reality show set?
videos.overview: Anji and Amrutha Rao, along with Rubber Balaji, sign a deal to rent out Amrutha Vilas as a location for two popular reality shows. Appaji agrees too. But when he realises that Sarvam and Uma Devi have entered the house, he tries to force himself into the house as a contestant with unexpected results.

videos.title: Appaji in the house!
videos.overview: Appaji’s surprise entry extends the duration of the contest by a week. He campaigns for Uma Devi’s exit from the house. Meanwhile, Uma Devi and Sarvam too try to get him evicted. With more surprise entries and exits and crazy tasks, this season finale is a truly shocking one.

tt15509558.name: Putham Pudhu Kaalai Vidiyaadhaa
tt15509558.description: This is a Tamil anthology series comprising five episodes. All five tales hark back to themes of love, hope and togetherness in trying times

tt13878800.name: Pitta Kathalu
tt13878800.description: Four different women, four journeys of love and betrayal. The common thread? They all want to dismantle the patriarchy.

videos.title: Ramula
videos.overview: Exasperated by her lover’s unwillingness to commit to her, a young woman accepts help from a politician whose agenda could prove dangerous.

videos.title: Meera
videos.overview: After reading an excerpt of his novelist wife’s writing, a controlling husband grows increasingly suspicious of her possible infidelity.

videos.title: xLife
videos.overview: The callous founder of a virtual reality company dismisses warnings that his product is destroying love, until his own heart is captured by an employee.

videos.title: Pinky
videos.overview: The messy layers of an extramarital affair are rapidly peeled back as the couple’s respective realities overlap with their secret relationship.

tt15195094.name: Survivor
tt15195094.description: Popular celebrities participate in this reality show that takes them to an island where their instincts of human survival are tested through demanding mental and physical challenges

videos.title: The Exciting Dangers of Zanzibar
videos.overview: Arjun describes the pristine beauty and lurking dangers of the Zanzibar islands. He welcomes the participants and tells them the rules as well as the tasks involved in the game.

videos.title: The Participants Gear Up for the Challenge
videos.overview: The participants gear up for the challenge set by Arjun and swim towards the boat in the middle of the sea to take the food items. The teams, ‘Kaadargal’ and ‘Vedargal’, proceed towards the island.

videos.title: A Challenge for the Tribe Leaders
videos.overview: While Arjun sets a challenge for the tribe leaders, Gayathri from Team Kadargal gears up to compete with Laxmi Priya from Team Vedargal. Parvathy argues with Srushti Dange when she pokes fun at her.

videos.title: Which Team Will Win the Reward Challenge?
videos.overview: The teams gather the items on the island as part of their task. Arjun informs the team about the Reward Challenge. Later, the teams push a sledge in order to win the Reward Challenge.

videos.title: The Survivors Share Their Stories
videos.overview: Vikrant snaps at Gayathri for reprimanding her team. Team Kadargal and Vedargal unfold the stories of their lives. The elimination of weak contestants baffles the teammates.

videos.title: A Surprise Awaits Indraja and Srushti
videos.overview: Arjun instructs Gayathri and Lakshmi Priyaa to eliminate the weak contestant from the team. Indraja and Srushti disapprove of the tribe leader’s decision. Later, a surprise awaits Indraja and Srushti.

videos.title: Vikranth and Gayathri Have A Row
videos.overview: Team Kadargal and Vedargal prepare for a tough competition, wherein they have to cross a log of wood as part of a task in the Immunity Challenge. Vikranth argues with Gayathri for eliminating Indraja.

videos.title: Team Kadargal Vote Against Gayathri
videos.overview: Arjun questions Vikranth and Gayathri about their disagreement at the tribal panchayat. Team Kadargal vote against their team leader Gayathri.

videos.title: Srushti and Gayathri Compete with Each Other
videos.overview: Gayathri, Indraja, and Srushti take on a task that will help them rejoin their team. As a part of the task, Srushti and Gayathri compete to build a block. A contestant bids adieu to Survivor.

videos.title: A Face-Off for the Tribe Leader
videos.overview: To win the title of the tribe leader, Besant Ravi and Amzath Khan, and Lady Kash and Vijayalakshmi face off in a boxing match. Two contestants qualify for the title.

videos.title: The Teams Face A Grit Challenge
videos.overview: Vijayalakshmi shares her strategy with the team to win the challenge. Both the teams struggle to place huge boxes in order and ring the bell, as a part of the challenge. One team emerges victorious.

videos.title: Team Kadargal Is Asked to Serve Team Vedargal
The Teams Meet the Maasai Tribe
videos.overview: Teams Vedargal and Kadargal meet the Maasai tribe, who teach them some basic survival skills. Later, the teams entertain the Maasai tribe with their dancing and singing skills as a part of the task.

videos.title: A Tough Underwater Challenge
videos.overview: Parvathy, Aishwarya, Vijayalakshmi and Lady Kash compete in the underwater challenge. The team that manages to withstand the task would be announced as the winner.

videos.title: Besant Ravi Disapproves of Parvathy's Views
videos.overview: At the Tribal Panchayat, Parvathy shares her views about the team with Arjun, but Besant Ravi and the others disapprove of them. Team Vedargal loses one of its weakest team members.

videos.title: Parvathy Complains to Arjun About Her Team
videos.overview: Team Vedargal disapproves of Parvathy's letter, so she complains to Arjun. Further, Gayathri and Indraja prepare to face a formidable challenge to rejoin the team.

videos.title: Who Will Become the Tribe Leader?
videos.overview: Nandha and Aishwarya from Team Vedargal and Umapathy and Ram Charan from Team Kadargal face the weightlifting challenge to become the next tribe leader. Parvathy and Gayathri criticise their team.

videos.title: Arjun Talks about His Struggle
videos.overview: Arjun talks about his struggles with the team. He informs them about a challenge of stacking logs. When one team gets the reward on winning the challenge, Nandha visits Team Kadargal.

videos.title: Ram Charan's Action Irks Vijayalakshmi
videos.overview: Nandha sings a song for Team Kadargal. While Ram Charan’s action annoys Vijayalakshmi, Vikranth and Umapathy argue with Ram for ridiculing them. Team Vedargal discuss about a weak contestant.

videos.title: Parvathy and Gayathri Look For the Treasure
videos.overview: Parvathy and Gayathri look for the hidden treasure. Kadargals and Vedargals talk about the contestants who would like to stay back and the ones who plan to back off. Inigo and Vanessa meet the team.

videos.title: Kadargals and Vedargals Face a Challenge
videos.overview: Vanessa and Inigo face the challenge of standing on the nail. Vanessa is selected for the Kadargal team and Inigo is selected for the Vedargal team. Kadargals compete to reach their goal.

videos.title: A Row Between Umapathy and Ram Charan
videos.overview: Arjun questions Umapathy during the tribal panchayat. While Arjun interrogates about the disagreement between Ram Charan and Umapathy, Team Kadargal casts a vote to eliminate a contestant.

videos.title: Ram Charan Arrives at the New Island
videos.overview: Ram Charan’s action on the new island irks Parvathy and Gayathri. As Parvathy and Ram Charan take up the task to align the wooden blocks, one contestant wins the challenge.

videos.title: Lakshmi Priyaa Argues with Aishwarya
videos.overview: Lakshmi Priyaa argues with Aishwarya. Furthermore, Aishwarya, Narayan Lucky, Saran and Vikranth take a tic-tac-toe challenge. The teams divulge the truth about their unfulfilled wishes.

videos.title: The Teams Face a Tough Challenge
videos.overview: When the teams celebrate Vanessa’s birthday, she misses her family and shares her grief with Arjun. Later, the teams face the daunting challenge of climbing a pyramid and hitting the target.

videos.title: The Team Opposes the Punishment
videos.overview: While Aishwarya tells the team about the scroll that asks to choose a non-performing contestant from the team, the team opposes the punishment mentioned in the scroll and later takes up a task.

videos.title: A Swapping of the Teams
videos.overview: Arjun interrogates Aishwarya, who fails to abide by the rules of the game. Arjun further informs the teams about a quiz challenge. Later, the teammates swap their places.

videos.title: Arjun Condemns Saran
videos.overview: Aishwarya welcomes Nandha to their team. Arjun condemns Saran for violating the rules of the game. The teams struggle hard to grapple the rope on the wire. Then one team emerges a winner.

videos.title: Saran Apologises to Arjun
videos.overview: Arjun asks about Aishwarya’s leadership qualities at the tribal panchayat. Saran apologises to Arjun for violating the rules of the game. Saran chooses a contestant to leave the team on his behalf.

videos.title: A Surprise Awaits Vijayalakshmi
videos.overview: Vijayalakshmi shares her doubt about Aishwarya voting for her with Arjun. Gayathri and Parvathy’s presence on the new island astonishes Vijayalakshmi. Parvathy and Gayathri take up a difficult task.

videos.title: Which Team Will Win the Number Challenge?
videos.overview: Team Kadargal disapproves of Vijayalakshmi’s elimination. Furthermore, Arjun scolds Aishwarya and Saran for their unusual demand. Both the teams struggle in the Odd-Even Number challenge.

videos.title: Who Will Win the Task?
videos.overview: Team Vedargal sends Narayan Lucky into the leader’s shack. Arjun explains the rules of the task which asks the contestants to cross an ‘A’ frame and climb a tree to hit the buzzer.

videos.title: Gayathri and Vijayalakshmi Receive a Task
videos.overview: The Kadargals enjoy the biryani. Gayathri and Vijayalakshmi compete for a gift. The two teams receive a scroll announcing the 'Ayudha Puja'. The participants bathe in fresh water and wear new clothes.

videos.title: Arjun Organises a Food Auction
videos.overview: The contestants get an opportunity to send gifts to their families. Arjun organises a food auction for the two teams. Later, the contestants read letters sent by their families.

videos.title: Vanessa Shares Her Strategy to Win the Task
videos.overview: Narayan Lucky and Vanessa share their strategy to win the immunity challenge. Team Kadargal and Vedargal take up the challenge of climbing the wooden wall and filling a basket with tender coconuts.

videos.title: Ravi Tells Arjun About his Injury
videos.overview: Inigo complains about Saran at the tribal panchayat. Arjun asks team Vedargal about Umapathy’s behaviour. Ravi tells Arjun about his injury. The Vedargals cast their votes to eliminate a contestant.

videos.title: Who will win, Besant Ravi or Vijayalakshmi?
videos.overview: Besant Ravi is shocked when Arjun tells him about the new island. The Vedargals get emotional upon reading Besant Ravi's letter. Later, Vijayalakshmi and Besant Ravi take on the maze challenge.

videos.title: Vanessa-Lady Kash Compete with Aishwarya-Saran
videos.overview: Team Vedargal misses Besant Ravi. Arjun questions Umapathy when Inigo shares his opinion about Umapathy. Later, Lady Kash and Vanessa compete with Aishwarya and Saran in a tug-of-war challenge.

videos.title: Aishwarya Argues with Saran
videos.overview: Saran tells Arjun his strategy to win the reward challenge. Team Kadargal and Vedargal struggle to win, but one team manages to win the reward challenge. Later, Aishwarya argues with Saran.

videos.title: A Pleasant Surprise Awaits Inigo
videos.overview: Team Kadargal gives a pleasant surprise to Inigo. Team Vedargal discusses the cause of their defeat with Inigo. Later, Inigo's jokes leave Team Kadargal in splits.

videos.title: Team Vedargal Search for the Treasure
videos.overview: Inigo shares the events with the team on his return. Amzath Khan reads the scroll that asks the teams to write letters to their loved ones. Team Vedargal search for a hidden treasure during a task.

videos.title: A Task Awaits Vijayalakshmi and Gayathri
videos.overview: Vikranth shares a bitter experience with Arjun. Arjun tells the teams about the immunity challenge, in which one team emerges as the winner. Later, a new task awaits Gayathri and Vijayalakshmi.

videos.title: Arjun Questions Lady Kash
videos.overview: Vanessa and Lady Kash talk about casting a vote for Amzath Khan. Arjun questions Lady Kash about the reason behind losing the immunity challenge. A contestant bids adieu when the team casts its votes.

videos.title: A Letter Makes Gayathri Emotional
videos.overview: Amzath Khan informs Arjun of the reason for being eliminated. Gayathri gets emotional on receiving a letter from her mother. Gayathri and Amzath Khan try hard to arrange the log as a part of a task.

videos.title: A Challenge to Choose the Tribe Leader
videos.overview: Aishwarya and Saran wish Nandha on his birthday. Nandha reads Amzath Khan’s letter, which makes the team emotional. Two contestants from each team take up a task to win the tribe leader challenge.

videos.title: The Teams Struggle to Win the Reward Challenge
videos.overview: Team Vedargal relish the 'samosas' prepared by Lakshmi Priyaa. Both the teams struggle hard to stack the wooden logs to win the reward challenge. Later, one team wins the reward challenge.

videos.title: Umapathy Accepts the Punishment
videos.overview: The Vedargals rejoice when they get food as a reward. Umapathy accepts the punishment for Team Kadargal’s defeat. The team members receive a scroll that asks them to make revelations about their life.

videos.title: Inigo Talks about Paveen and Tarun
videos.overview: Both the teams face difficulties during an unexpected downpour. The Vedargals and Kadargals take up a challenge and try to win. Later, Inigo tells his teammates about his nephews, Paveen and Tarun.

videos.title: Kadargals Compete with Vedargals
videos.overview: Narayan Lucky shares the chocolates received as a gift with his teammates. Kadargals and Vedargals pair up in the immunity challenge. Vikranth talks to Umapathy about the contestant to be eliminated.

videos.title: Narayan Argues with Inigo
videos.overview: Arjun welcomes both teams to the tribal panchayat. The teams give scores to Aishwarya as a tribe leader. One contestant is eliminated from Survivor. Narayan Lucky and Nandha argue with Inigo.

videos.title: Amzath Khan Returns to the Team
videos.overview: The teams cast votes for Vijayalakshmi, Amzath Khan, and Lakshmi Priyaa to return to the team. Amzath Khan succeeds in the task and rejoins Team Vedargal. Umapathy helps Lakshmi Priyaa in the task.

videos.title: One Contestant to Lead the Kombargals
videos.overview: The teams are named as Kombargal tribe. Vijayalakshmi, Aishwarya, Vikranth and Narayan take up the tribe leader challenge. One contestant wins to lead the Kombargals. Later, Vikranth reads a scroll.

videos.title: Amzath Khan Performs a Hilarious Skit
videos.overview: The teams paint the Survivor logo as part of the painting task. Vikranth speaks highly about his cousin, actor Vijay. The Kombargals have a hearty laugh as Amzath Khan performs a hilarious skit.

videos.title: The Rewards Delight The Winners
videos.overview: Umapathy comforts Aishwarya, who is angry with him. Furthermore, Arjun divides the Kombargals into two teams to play the reward challenge. The winners are delighted when the rewards are announced.

videos.title: A Story That Scares Vijayalakshmi
videos.overview: Saran, Umapathy, and Nandha are delighted by the luxurious treatment that they receive. The contestants are named according to the fireworks. Inigo tells a story that scares Vijayalakshmi.

videos.title: Who Will Win the Immunity Challenge?
videos.overview: While the contestants individually participate in the immunity challenge, Vanessa points out Aishwarya’s mistake while playing the task. Nandha and Narayan Lucky compete in the immunity challenge

videos.title: Arjun Interrogates Saran
videos.overview: Umapathy and Vijayalakshmi disapprove of Aishwarya’s opinion about Saran. Arjun interrogates Saran as he criticises the contestants. One contestant is eliminated after the Kombargals cast the votes.

videos.title: Will Saran or Aishwarya Win the Challenge?
videos.overview: The Kombargals cast the votes to eliminate a contestant once again. Aishwarya and Saran arrive on the new island. Later, Aishwarya and Saran take up the challenge of balancing the ball.

videos.title: A Competition between Inigo and Umapathy
videos.overview: The Kombargals get emotional as they read Saran and Aishwarya’s letter. Amzath Khan feels guilty for casting a vote against Aishwarya. Umapathy and Inigo compete in the tribe leader challenge.

videos.title: The Teams Take Up the Reward Challenge
videos.overview: Arjun informs the contestants about speaking to their families. The contestants split into two teams and ride the boat to complete the puzzle challenge as part of the reward challenge.

videos.title: The Kombargals Cook For Arjun
videos.overview: Umapathy asks for more chicken from the woman, who serves him food. The Kombargals cook food for Arjun while Aishwarya works out on the island. Later, the Kombargals have a fun chat.

videos.title: The Ice Challenge
videos.overview: The Kombargals take up the Yoga challenge. Inigo selects the best five performers, who later compete in the Ice challenge. Later, the team participates in the quiz.

videos.title: The Teams Question Arjun
videos.overview: Saran shares Vikranth's words with Aishwarya. Meanwhile, the team question Arjun. The Kombargal struggle to overcome the bundle-loading challenge to win the immunity challenge.

videos.title: Amzath Khan Criticises Vanessa
videos.overview: Arjun questions the team for casting the votes based on scores. Amzath Khan criticises Vanessa. Later, a contestant bids adieu to the Kombargals after the elimination round.

videos.title: Will Aishwarya or Nandha win the Challenge?
videos.overview: Aishwarya and Saran are glad to see Nandha on the new island. Nandha and Aishwarya strive hard in the pinball challenge by pulling the rope placed on an uneven table.

videos.title: A Task To Win the Tribe Leader Challenge
videos.overview: The Kombargals share their opinion about Nandha. Vanessa, Vikranth, Lady Kash and Narayan Lucky take up a daunting task to win the tribe leader challenge.

videos.title: Arjun Talks about Shivaji Ganeshan
videos.overview: Lady Kash and Vanessa talk about Amzath Khan. The Kombargals take up a daunting task to win the reward challenge. Arjun talks about the eminent actor Shivaji Ganeshan and recounts an incident.

videos.title: Saran Plays the Game of Truth and Dare
videos.overview: Amzath Khan, Lady Kash and Umapathy are delighted to speak to their families. On the new island, Aishwarya, Saran and Nandha indulge in a game of Truth and Dare. Umapathy flicks at the Survivor store.

videos.title: A Daunting Challenge for The Kombargals
videos.overview: The Kombargals gear up for the task of smashing the pots. A pleasant surprise awaits the team as they play another task on losing the reward challenge. The Kombargals talk about their families.

videos.title: Who Will Win the Challenge?
videos.overview: The team members share the joy of talking to their families when Arjun quizzes them. The Kombargals take up the task of standing on an unbalanced table to stack the bars. One team wins the challenge.

videos.title: Vikranth's Words Make Inigo Emotional
videos.overview: Arjun tells Amzath Khan, Inigo, Narayan Lucky, and Vijalakshmi why the other contestants are not a part of the tribal panchayat. While Vikranth's video leaves Inigo in tears, Vanessa's words cheer him.

videos.title: Aishwarya and Saran Perform a Task
videos.overview: Arjun informs the Kombargals about the main game. Saran and Aishwarya strive hard to untie the rope with their legs and stack the logs. Arjun cheers Aishwarya as she sings a song.

videos.title: One Team Receives Rewards
videos.overview: The Kombargals share their opinion about Aishwarya as she takes up the challenge with confidence. While Arjun rolls the dice, the Kombargals gear up for a game of monopoly. One team receives rewards.

videos.title: Arjun Talks About General Manekshaw
videos.overview: Arjun informs the Kombargals about Field Marshal General Sam Manekshaw. Inigo and Aishwarya take up the task to win the tribe leader challenge. The Kombargals share their views about two contestants.

videos.title: Will Aishwarya Win the Reward Challenge?
videos.overview: In the reward challenge, the Kombargals take up the task of unwrapping the wire around a disc. Later, the Kombargals strive to untie the knotted rope. Aishwarya and Narayan compete in the last round.

videos.title: An Emotional Moment for The Contestants
videos.overview: Aishwarya partakes in eating the food with Amzath Khan and Vijayalakshmi. The contestants get emotional on seeing their family video. Nandha and Saran compete in the reward challenge.

videos.title: Narayan and Inigo Gear Up For A Task
videos.overview: Inigo and Narayan Lucky gear up to cook as part of the reward challenge. During the immunity challenge, the Kombargals look for the hidden board. Later, the contestants proceed for the treasure hunt.

videos.title: Aishwarya Criticises Inigo
videos.overview: Inigo accuses Amzath Khan of contradicting his statement. At the tribal panchayat, while Vijayalakshmi informs Arjun about Saran’s statement, Aishwarya criticises Inigo. The Kombargals cast votes.

videos.title: Will Saran Enter The Main Game?
videos.overview: Saran and Nandha sow the Cassava sticks as part of the task. They take up a daunting challenge to enter the main game. The Kombargals share their opinions about Nandha.

videos.title: Who Will Lead, Aishwarya or Vijayalakshmi?
videos.overview: Arjun asks Saran about his experience playing the main game. Aishwarya and Vijayalakshmi take up the task of building a wooden tower. Arjun informs them about the final tribe leader challenge.

videos.title: Vikranth Rejoins the Team
videos.overview: Vikranth, Umapathy, and Vanessa’s return delights Inigo and Vijayalakshmi. The Kombargals split into two teams and strive hard to place a ball on the ring as a part of the reward challenge.

videos.title: Aishwarya Argues with Vanessa
videos.overview: The team winning the reward challenge gets a chance to speak to their loved ones. The team pulls a prank on the Survivor storekeeper. Aishwarya argues with Vanessa for voting against her.

videos.title: Saran Leads the Kombargals
videos.overview: Vijayalakshmi reads the scroll that asks to find the immunity idol. Saran leads the Komabargals as they take up a daunting challenge. Amzath Khan and Vikranth reach the final round of the game.

videos.title: The Kombargals Enjoy the Night
videos.overview: The Kombargals take up the challenge to form the word ‘Better Survivor’. Nandha speaks to his family on a video call. Later, the Kombargals enjoy the beauty of the night.

videos.title: Amzath Khan Saves Aishwarya
videos.overview: The Kombargals are shocked by an announcement made by Arjun at the tribal panchayat. Later, Nandha joins the team members. Amzath Khan uses his power to save Aishwarya.

videos.title: Vijayalakshmi Criticises Aishwarya
videos.overview: Amzath Khan, on his way to the Jury Villa, meets Nandha. The Kombargals split into two teams and face the first elimination immunity challenge. Vijayalakshmi criticises Aishwarya and Umapathy.

videos.title: Umapathy Gets Upset
videos.overview: Umapathy gets upset after his team loses. Arjun and the Kombargals bid a tearful farewell to a couple. The Kombargals look at the pictures of the contestants who bid adieu to Survivor.

videos.title: Vikranth Upsets Umapathy
videos.overview: Vikranth's change of mind upsets Umapathy. Arjun informs the Kombargals about the rules of the elimination. The Kombargals are given a task, which is to survive underwater.

videos.title: Vijayalakshmi Complains to Arjun
videos.overview: The jury members meet the Kombargals at the tribal panchayat. Vijayalakshmi and Umapathy complain to Arjun about the disagreements amongst themselves. Later, the elimination takes place.

videos.title: An Incident Upsets Vanessa
videos.overview: The Kombargals take up the task of standing in a narrow place. Vanessa is heartbroken when she is disqualified from the challenge. Later, one contestant is eliminated from the final round.

videos.title: Who Will Win the Sole Survivor Title?
videos.overview: Vijayalakshmi selects Vanessa to compete with her. Saran is disheartened when Umapathy loses the final round. A contestant wins the Sole Survivor title based on the votes cast by the jury members.

tt13411726.name: Sam Jam
tt13411726.description: Sam Jam is a happy and fun-filled talk show hosted by our favorite actress Samantha in her style. This show features celebrity interviews, fun games, spotlights some inspiring real-life stories and talent, and indulges in philanthropy activities.

videos.title: Vijay Devarakonda
videos.overview: He shared about his personal life and many more.

videos.title: Rana Daggubati, Nag Ashwin
videos.overview: Rana shared about his health issues while Ashwin told about his Mahanati journey.

videos.title: Saina Nehwal, Parupalli Kashyap
videos.overview: Kashyap and Saina shared about their personal life. India's first Flute Boxer, Sudhir performed flute beatboxing on the stage.

videos.title: Tamannaah
videos.overview: She shared memories about her long journey in Tollywood and many more.

videos.title: Rakul Preet Singh, Krish Jagarlamudi
videos.overview: Both of them revealed how they faced controversies. They also shared their experiences in Tollywood.

videos.title: Chiranjeevi
videos.overview: Megastar Chiranjeevi reminiscing his childhood memories, opens up on his family, his definition of success and many more.

videos.title: Allu Arjun, Allu Aravind
videos.overview: Allu Arjun opens about his definition of style, unconditional love and his exciting experiences in life.

videos.title: Naga Chaitanya
videos.overview: Real life couple Naga Chaithanya and Samantha at their candid best in this Season Finale.

tt36812904.name: Ekaki
tt36812904.description: A group of friends plan a fun weekend getaway to the mysterious Ekaki Villa, only to find themselves caught between laughter and fear when strange haunting begin. Filled with hilarious chaos, spooky twists, and emotional moments

videos.name: Chapter 1 : Presence
videos.overview: Seven friends reunite for a weekend getaway at a secluded villa, hoping for a fun break from routine. Their cheerful atmosphere slowly shifts as strange, unsettling events begin to occur around the house. What starts as harmless banter turns into confusion and fear as the group senses an unseen presence lurking within the villa.
videos.description: Seven friends reunite for a weekend getaway at a secluded villa, hoping for a fun break from routine. Their cheerful atmosphere slowly shifts as strange, unsettling events begin to occur around the house. What starts as harmless banter turns into confusion and fear as the group senses an unseen presence lurking within the villa.

tt15198122.name: LOL: Enga Siri Paappom
tt15198122.description: 6 hours, 10 diverse comedians, 2 hilarious hosts, Dare you to laugh. We have a bag of all-star comedians including Rowsu-baby Maya, Mr. Over-the-top Pugazh, Peter Party Baggy, Kalaai King Vigneshkanth, Single Payyan Premgi, Chellakutty Harathi, Rascal-Boy Abhishek Kumar, self-proclaimed king of comedy Powerstar Srinivasan, Ragala Rani Syama and Jagajaala Killadi Sathish.

tt12929228.name: Shootout at Alair
tt12929228.description: Akhtar kills a policeman every year on the day of the Mecca Masjid blasts. Soon, Akhtar is encountered. However, after several years, when a policeman gets killed on the same day, IG Praveen Chand suspects Akhtar's involvement. Is Akhtar still alive.

tt28106758.name: Bandwaale
tt28106758.description: Mariam, a young poetess, finds herself trapped in a sleepy town, where every young girl's future lies in wedlock. Mariam hopes to find her freedom against all odds, by uploading her poetry on the internet through an anonymous account.Along with her band of misfits - Robo and Psy, Mariam discovers the power of her poetry and her own voice.

videos.title: Mynah
videos.overview: When her anonymous poem about a kiss creates a scandal in college, Mariam, a young poetess, is forced to find a way to continue to express herself without causing a stir. Escaping her father David's ire, Mariam turns to the internet to express herself.

videos.title: 128 GB
videos.overview: Mariam struggles to find a way to increase the views on her channel. She looks for the right music to pair with her words. In an unlikely turn of events, she ends up seeking help from Robo, unaware of his contrasting musical sensibilities.

videos.title: Black Mamba
videos.overview: DJ Psy, a mysterious boy, catches Mariam's attention. Robo feels threatened with the arrival of a new prospective collaborator. Robo and his gang call him the Black Mamba.

videos.title: Muqabala
videos.overview: DJ Psy has introduced Ratlam to a new kind of music that is trending with the young. Mariam is in awe of his sound and his charm. Rafi believes this is what will revive the ailing New Modern Band. He invites Psy to join the band. Robo and gang are incensed at this subterfuge. Ismail, to placate flared tempers, calls for a 'Muqabala' between the New Modern Band and DJ Psy.

videos.title: Neela Moza
videos.overview: Mariam is distraught when her mother is confronted with a medical emergency which lands her in hospital. It doesn't help that things with Psy are awkward. Dark family secrets are revealed. On David's return from Kerala, father and daughter have a bitter showdown. Mariam's words fail her when she needs it the most.

videos.title: Bandwaale
videos.overview: Mariam has to make it to the influencer conclave organized by Book My Sitara at Jabalpur. However dodging David's ploys of getting her to impress prospective grooms is harder than she thought. Meanwhile Psy struggles to fight his demons. Mariam discovers his secret and takes Robo's help to save him from a dangerous situation.

videos.title: Haklaati Haseena
videos.overview: At Jabalpur, the band of misfits comes together. It's a whole new world of influencers, social media managers and algorithms. The band is off to a great start but falters when Mariam is faced with her biggest fear. The event is ruined when the band and the audience get into a violent scuffle.

videos.title: Knock Knock Knock
videos.overview: The Jabalpur debacle makes Mariam famous in a way she least expects. Mariam has to choose between capitalizing on internet fame and being true to her poetry.

tt17493716.name: Thendral Vanthu Ennai Thodum
tt17493716.description: An unforeseen incident forces a traditional girl to marry a rogue. Despite their differences, can love blossom between these opposites?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Vetri, a local thug who works under a goon in the town. On the other hand, Abhinaya is a well-educated woman. What will happen when their paths cross?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Abhi refuses to fulfill her fiance Dharshan's wish. Elsewhere, Aranganathan lashes out at Vetri for bringing the money.

tt13249204.name: The Software DevLOVEper
tt13249204.description: A group of four people including Shannu work in a software company when a new girl, Vaishnavi, joins their team. Shannu falls in love with Vaishnavi and tries to spend time with her but she treats him like a friend.

videos.title: Episode-1
videos.overview: Shanmukh Jaswanth a software engineer and his friends don, Harika, and Manohar are introduced. Shanmukh is a workaholic. Vaishnavi gets assigned to shannu's team. Vaishnavi is a character who likes to live every moment in her life.

tt39601175.name: Amar Vishwas
tt39601175.description: Amar Vishwas is a gripping legal drama about a fearless lawyer who believes that the law has value only when it protects the truly innocent. Shaped by a painful past, Amar has built his life around one unbreakable principal - if a person is innocent in reality, justice must be delivered, even if it means crossing boundries.

tt13357946.name: Navarasa
tt13357946.description: The nine episodes represent a different emotion or rasa such as anger, compassion, courage, disgust, fear, laughter, love, peace and wonder.

tt13241324.name: Addham
tt13241324.description: Moral conflicts, life altering decisions and contrasting situations converge in this three tale anthology revolving around the idea that "Morality is a changing goalpost"

videos.title: The Road That Never Ends
videos.overview: A 16-year-old runs away from home only to meet and befriend a kind truck driver while hitchhiking. But fateful troubles come knocking when the driver dies enroute, leaving a stash of money in the vehicle. Torn in between survival, greed and kindness, what secrets will the boy unearth?

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: Struggling to deal with his wife's constant accusations, a man decides to break his vows and spend the night with a sex worker. However a chance encounter and constant calls from his wife break this reverie of infidelity. But what lies in the future of their marriage

videos.title: The Unwhisperable Secret
videos.overview: Therapist Shruti gets caught in a moral dilemma after learning a dark secret from a businessman seeking her help to wards off his inner demons. Will she compromise her integrity to bring the businessman's closet of skeletons out in the open?

tt39282141.name: The Roommate Contract
tt39282141.description: The Roommate Contract is a drama series that follows a group of young adults who move in together under a written agreement designed to maintain order and harmony in their shared living space. What begins as a practical solution to everyday conflicts soon becomes a source of tension as personal boundaries are crossed and unspoken expectations come to light. As relationships evolve and disagreements intensify, the contract is repeatedly tested, forcing each roommate to confront their own values, responsibilities, and understanding of trust.

videos.title: Tadka
videos.overview: Two strangers, broke and desperate, accidentally land the same “couples-only” apartment. Aryan, a struggling freelance designer, and Rhea, fed up with her chaotic home life, fake a relationship to survive Mumbai’s brutal rental scene. What starts as a harmless lie turns into a legally signed Roommate Contract—with rules, boundaries, and zero romance allowed. Or so they think.

videos.title: Ek Myan Do Talwarein
videos.overview: Living together turns chaotic as Aryan and Rhea clash over space, habits, and basic human decency. From midnight noise wars to bathroom battles and ego-fueled standoffs, their “roommate contract” is tested hard. But amid the chaos, awkward silences, accidental tenderness, and unexpected concern hint that this war of egos might just be the beginning of something deeper.

videos.title: Phool Aur Kante
videos.overview: Jealousy enters the apartment as unexpected guests, awkward dates, and crossed signals turn Aryan and Rhea’s fragile truce into an emotional minefield. With egos bruised, drinks flowing, and boundaries blurring, both begin to realize that pretending not to care might be harder than actually caring. Between laughter, chaos, and late-night honesty, something dangerously real starts to bloom.

videos.title: Something Something
videos.overview: Morning chaos turns into emotional confusion as boundaries blur and unspoken feelings surface. Between awkward breakfasts, misunderstood intentions, and a growing emotional dependency, Aryan and Rhea begin to realize that their “temporary arrangement” is starting to feel dangerously permanent — even as outside relationships complicate things further.

videos.title: Sawaal
videos.overview: A surprise visit from Aryan’s mother explodes into chaos, misunderstandings, and heartbreak. What starts as comic panic quickly spirals into emotional damage when Rhea is forced to leave the house she thought was safe. Trust cracks, truths remain unsaid, and both are left questioning where they stand — and whether this arrangement was ever just a contract.

videos.title: Jawab
videos.overview: With emotions at their breaking point, Aryan and Rhea are forced to confront everything they’ve been avoiding. Confessions surface, egos clash, and love finally speaks out loud — just as life threatens to pull them in different directions. Choices must be made, and not all answers come without loss.

tt12299774.name: November Story
tt12299774.description: A celebrated crime novelist suffering from Alzheimer's is found at a murder scene with no memory of what happened. Now, it is up to his daughter to save him.

tt12127974.name: Locked
tt12127974.description: The story of Dr Anand Chakravarthy ( Satyadev ), a neurosurgeon, and what happens when he is trapped inside his own house.

tt31844233.name: Daldal
tt31844233.description: Haunted by the guilt of her past and dealing with the demons of her present, a newly-appointed DCP, Rita Ferreira, must embark on an investigation of a series of murders that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded serial killer.

tt13387706.name: Kalluri Saalai
tt13387706.description: The series revolves around a guy and his friends - a gang of five, who take up a promise that they would never associate with girls throughout their lifetime. Does he keep up the promise to his friends or pursues his love?

tt39313294.name: Space Gen: Chandrayaan
tt39313294.description: Indian space engineers face mounting pressure to redeem themselves following the Chandrayaan 2 lunar mission's unexpected outcome.

videos.title: Finding Vikram
videos.overview: Chandrayaan-2's failure sparks national disappointment. Contact with the Vikram lander is lost, causing anxiety for programmer Arjun and doubt for mission coordinator Yamini.

videos.title: Man vs Machine
videos.overview: The Failure Analysis Committee probes Chandrayaan-2's failure. Although Yamini defends her team, Arjun faces scrutiny. Meanwhile, Ramaiah reluctantly agrees to be the ISRO chief.

videos.title: Science Finds a Way
videos.overview: Chandrayaan-3 faces setbacks from budget cuts and political pressure, causing compromises. Yamini and Ramaiah clash, testing his leadership.

videos.title: Make in India
videos.overview: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupts Chandrayaan-3. A failed launch threatens the mission, but Mohanty plays defence for the ISRO team.

videos.title: Where the Mind is Without Fear
videos.overview: The launch is smooth, but the Moon race intensifies with Russia's Luna-25. As the ISRO team faces pressure, Arjun seeks solace in the memories of his father.

tt12299732.name: Live Telecast
tt12299732.description: A TV crew goes to a haunted house, where a family lives, to create a new live show that captures ghost on camera, only to be trapped inside with no way of getting out.

tt35335046.name: Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
tt35335046.description: At customs, Superintendent Meena's elite team faces a crucial mission: stop rising contraband trafficking and take down global crime boss Bada Choudhary's syndicate.

tt13206988.name: Paava Kadhaigal
tt13206988.description: At times dark, at times disturbing, four short films explore stories of those who dare to dream and desire — and those determined to stand in their way.

tt39227709.name: Honeymoon Se Hatya
tt39227709.description: A five-part true-crime docudrama uncovers real cases where wives kill their husbands. The series dives deep into how love, control, betrayal and hidden marital fractures can lead to fatal breakdowns

videos.title: Meghalaya - Sonam Raja Raghuvanshi Case
videos.overview: The romantic getaway turns fatal for Indore's Raja Raghuvanshi. Sonam Raghuvanshi, his wife, conspires with her lover to hire contract killers and kill him during their honeymoon in Meghalaya.

videos.title: Bhiwani - Influencer Case
videos.overview: Restrictions to following her social media dreams lead Ravina Rao to strangle her husband to death, with the help of her alleged lover. As Ravina’s reels get popular, her real life turns tragic.

videos.title: Mumbai - Tile Case
videos.overview: 32-year-old Chaman Devi strangled her husband to death and then buried his body under the floor. Vijay’s body concealed under a new set of tiles revealed the extremes emotional neglect can lead to.

videos.title: Delhi - Electric Shock Case
videos.overview: Betrayal turns electric for Dwarka's Karan Dev. His wife, Sushmita, and his cousin, Rahul, electrocute him to death and claim that it was an accident that took his life.

videos.title: Meerut - Blue Drum Case
videos.overview: Meerut's Saurabh Rajput has his life cut short by his wife, Muskan, and her lover, Sahil. The two poisoned him and hid his cut-up body in a drum of cement. The details of the crime shocked the nation.

tt12299956.name: Triples
tt12299956.description: Three friends set out to Goa to deal with a major problem that threatens to ruin their business, and lives. A loan shark, a politician who is on the lookout for his daughter, an ex-wife and a current girlfriend make their journey adventurous.
tt12299956.language: Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Bengali, Telugu, Kannada, Marathi

tt39333253.name: C.E.O
tt39333253.description: Meera turns dangerous when the company’s Managing Director Kavya also sets his sights on Arjun. Caught between true love and a shortcut to success, which path will Arjun choose?

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: Arjun is drawn to Meera, the powerful CEO. When chance brings them closer, can he truly capture her attention and his desire?

videos.title: Chosen For More
videos.overview: Arjun and Meera’s intense relationship hits a roadblock with the arrival of Kavya, the ambitious MD. Will their bond survive?

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: Kavya sets her sights on Arjun with an irresistible offer. Will he stay loyal or give in to temptation?

tt13300674.name: Mugilan
tt13300674.description: Socio-political events that led to the rise of one of the most dreaded gangsters of Kanchipuram in the 1970s called Mugilan.

videos.title: The First Strike
videos.overview: A hasty decision by Mugilan proves fatal, as a series of chaotic events leave him in despair. He gets reminiscent of his initial days of working as a henchman along with Saravanan.

videos.title: Deceit
videos.overview: While trying to set things right, Mugilan finds himself in a situation where his most trusted aides have let him down. Mugilan retaliates to Rajendran's action to pressurise him.

videos.title: Lost In love
videos.overview: Maghi’s affection towards Mugilan grows stronger with each passing day. But, their relationship changes when someone else makes a foray into Mugilan’s life unexpectedly.

videos.title: The Rise Of The Underdog
videos.overview: After Reddy makes an unexpected move, it puts Mudhalaiyar in a spot. While Saravanan tries to make the best of this situation, Mugilan has his own plans.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: In the race to become the prime confidant, Saravanan and Mugilan play games. But the tables are turned due to a sudden change, giving one of them an edge to become the successor.

videos.title: Red Eagles
videos.overview: Trying to pick up the pieces, Maghi tries to reach out to Mugilan in distress. Unfortunately, things go haywire on Mugilan’s front leaving him vulnerable.

videos.title: Allegiance And Betrayal
videos.overview: Going back and forth in the occurrence of events, the life of the undisputed gangster starts to crumble, drawing a thin line between allegiance and betrayal.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: With his family's safety and his image at stake, Mugilan must now take a tough decision that can make his plans topsy-turvy.

tt38990492.name: Mrs. Deshpande
tt38990492.description: Behind a mask of beauty lies a darkness she's ready to unleash.

tt13090856.name: Time Enna Boss!?
tt13090856.description: Bala - an average IT guy, is forced to host 4 random time travellers who land up in his new house until they find their way back. But will they ever leave?

videos.title: Flush In
videos.overview: After seeing his family off, Bala peacefully settles down in his new apartment, only to find random time travellers from different periods popping out of his bathroom, one by one. Will he be able to stop this madness before anyone else finds out?

videos.title: Jobs
videos.overview: Until they find a way to get back to their original time periods, the time travellers in Bala’s place decide to find jobs in today’s world. Can they safely land in sustainable jobs, despite their quirks and limitations?

videos.title: Midnight Masala
videos.overview: Rubbishing a delicacy that Killi prepares at home, the housemates decide to go out for dinner. Unfortunately, the city shuts down due to the sudden death of a politician. As they hunt for food around the city through the night, back home Killi is looking for someone to test his delicacy on. Who ends up getting what they wanted?

videos.title: Adhaan Plan!
videos.overview: Bala’s family arm-twists him into meeting a girl for the prospects of marriage. In view of his American Dream, Bala decides to kill every possibility of getting married. Bharathi and the housemates, arrive at a ‘brilliant’ plan to help Bala create a bad impression on the girl. But the gods have their own plans!

videos.title: Crush Next Door
videos.overview: Hannah loses heart to Kabir- a stranger, the moment she meets him at the apartment elevator. When Kabir later visits Bala’s apartment asking for a favor, Hannah goes out of the way to hold him back and make an impression. As she starts going overboard, her conscience pops out to question her. How much of her nature would she compromise to impress Kabir?

videos.title: Shrooms
videos.overview: Killi by mistake consumes magic mushrooms (hallucinogen) stored secretly at his restaurant by his assistant. When he reaches home he starts hallucinating that the house is a battlefield; that he is a warrior of the Cholan army, and that the housemates are from the enemy camp. As he locks the door, the housemates have no choice but to play along until they find a way to get out.

videos.title: Run Buggy Run!
videos.overview: During a heated argument in their office, Bala challenges his macho colleague Britto, that Buggy would beat him at the upcoming office marathon. With no rhyme or reason, Buggy suddenly gains a crazy fan following, and the housemates put immense pressure on him to train for the marathon. Could any of this affect the ever so emotionless Buggy?

videos.title: Bottle Neck
videos.overview: When Bala’s work-from-home session is marred by Hannah’s music audition video shoot, he reacts in a fit of rage and accidentally spoils her voice forever. With the main music event scheduled for the very next day, Hannah is unable to come to terms with her pathetic new voice. Will Bala be able to make up for his mistake in time and salvage the mess for Hannah?

videos.title: Horoscope
videos.overview: Bharathi reads out the horoscope of all the housemates for the day, and it says that Bala would ‘meet the woman of his life’. Buggy being a rationalist, challenges to prove the horoscope wrong. Luckily for Bala, the office party is on that very evening and he might find ‘the woman’ there. Now, to what lengths would Buggy go to beat the stars?

videos.title: Flush Out
videos.overview: Bharathi finally manages to create a time machine for the housemates to get back to their original time periods. She starts off by testing it on herself. Does it work? Do the other time travellers in the house risk it too? How happy would Bala feel to see his friends off forever?

tt35674970.name: Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Story
tt35674970.description: Gaurav Tiwari, a paranormal investigator, faces his greatest challenge when his pursuit of the truth behind unexplained phenomena leads him into a deadly spiral. As his mysterious death leaves questions unanswered, a journalist delves into his eerie and celebrated legacy, unearthing secrets that blur the line between reality and the supernatural.

tt37062070.name: Single Papa
tt37062070.description: When Gaurav finds a baby in the back of his car, he must defy his eccentric family, the adoption agency and societal norms to become a single papa.

tt39014717.name: Naa Tum Jaano Naa Hum
tt39014717.description: Aditi feels an unexpected attraction to her father's friend, Sandeep, sparking a complicated and intense connection. As social pressure grows, hiding their bond becomes harder. Can their relationship survive society's judgment?

videos.title: The First Spark
videos.overview: Feeling distant from her boyfriend Karan, Aditi meets her father’s friend Sandeep, and an unexpected spark of attraction quietly takes root. Could this be the start of something unexpected?

videos.title: Crossing Lines
videos.overview: A sudden, accidental moment sparks unexpected emotions in Sandeep. Torn between what’s right and what he feels, can he resist the pull of this forbidden connection?

videos.title: Point of No Return
videos.overview: Aditi and Sandeep’s closeness pushes every boundary, taking their secret bond to a point of no return. How long before the world uncovers the truth?

videos.title: The No-Ball Lie.
videos.overview: A family watches cricket as Sandy avoids lunch, lying about a meeting. Aditi waits for him, feels ignored, confronts him privately, and seductively reveals the “gift” she prepared.

videos.title: Forced Fate.
videos.overview: Aditi confronts Sandy after he lies about traveling. Feeling used and betrayed, she demands marriage immediately, giving him till midnight—otherwise she threatens to force the relationship forward.

videos.title: House Of Lies.
videos.overview: Aditi demands marriage and threatens to expose everything. Sandy panics, torn between guilt and fear. Nitin unknowingly asks Sandy to counsel her. As pressure peaks, Sandy’s wife walks in, exposing his lies.

tt39161477.name: Vinny Ki Kitaab
tt39161477.description: Vinny appears to be an ordinary housewife living a quiet, routine life — but behind closed doors, her mind is a world of erotic fantasies and secret desires. Through these vivid, intimate stories she escapes the monotony of everyday life with her husband. Only one person knows the truth about her hidden world: her best friend, Sarla. But when her private stories are stolen and published, she is shocked to discover that betrayal comes from those she trusted most. Forced out of the shadows, Vinny sets out to reclaim her voice, her truth, and her life.

videos.title: Hot Pink Nighty
videos.overview: On her 10th wedding anniversary, Vinny prepares to turn her secret fantasies into reality, dressing up in a hot pink nighty and an expensive perfume to surprise her husband. As anticipation builds, one question hangs in the air - will the night fulfill her desires, or will her dreams remain locked in her imagination, to be shared only with her best friend Sarla?

videos.title: Dil, Dosti, Dhokha
videos.overview: Vinny's world shatters when her most private stories and deepest secrets are exposed for everyone to read. Consumed by shock and shame, she is forced to confront a devastating truth — the ultimate betrayal has come from the people she trusted most.

videos.title: Women On Top
videos.overview: Crushed by guilt, Vinny struggles to hold herself together. And just as she begins to feel her self worth again , the discovery of Navneet’s betrayal shatters her world, igniting a storm of anger, pain, and resolve that will change everything.

videos.title: Haseen Badla
videos.overview: Armed with her charm and sharp wit, she sets out to outsmart and punish those who betrayed her — determined to reclaim what was always rightfully hers. She will spare no one.

videos.title: Neeli Shirt
videos.overview: Vinny deepens her dangerous game of seduction with Manish, while Navneet faces a brutal reckoning of his own. At the same time, Sarla makes a shocking discovery that sends the Saxena household into complete chaos.

videos.title: Haq Aur Husn
videos.overview: Sarla publicly exposes Vinny as the author of the erotic bestseller Vinny Ki Kitab. What was meant to destroy her, instead ignites a fierce transformation — Vinny finds her voice, embraces her truth, and rises in a roar of empowerment, reclaiming her identity, her power, and the life that was always hers to own.

tt38236377.name: Real Kashmir Football Club
tt38236377.description: Inspired by the true story of a Kashmiri Hindu Pandit and a Kashmiri Muslim responsible for the formation of the Real Kashmir Football Club, the first ever club from Jammu and Kashmir to compete in any top-flight football league in India.

videos.title: Kickoff
videos.overview: Disillusioned with journalism, Sohail wants to change Kashmir for the better by starting a professional football club. He attempts to recruit his oldest friend Mustafa to coach RKFC and solicits funding from businessman Shirish - who knows nothing about football.

videos.title: Pressing
videos.overview: With financier Shirish and coach Mustafa onboard, and having selected a squad of players, Sohail must take care of formalities to ensure RKFC complies with league requirements.

videos.title: In Possession
videos.overview: In order to be accepted into a league-qualifying tournament, RKFC must recruit local star Shah - which proves difficult for Sohail as Shah has a confrontational history with Mustafa.

videos.title: Transition To Defence
videos.overview: Shah joins the club and they travel to Delhi for the tournament, where things couldn't go worse - both on and off the field.

videos.title: Own-Goal
videos.overview: After the Delhi fiasco, strife has increased and it appears that various players have dropped. Sohail must find a way to keep Mustafa, re-sign Shah, and appease Shirish, who now wants to be more involved with club management.

videos.title: Regroup
videos.overview: After Sohail agrees with Shirish that they should bring in an international coach to increase RKFC's chances for success, it gets ugly when he informs Mustafa of this decision.

videos.title: Counterattack
videos.overview: After international coach Douglas arrives and sees what a challenge it is to mount a club in Srinagar, Sohail and Shirish slowly move the club closer to league qualification.

videos.title: Goal!
videos.overview: When the players learn that RKFC's pathway to qualification is to play a security forces team at the local cantonment, a debate ensues as to whether they should participate in the match or not.

tt39028852.name: Aukaat Ke Bahar
tt39028852.description: A small-town boxer enters an elite Delhi college to fulfill his brother's dream. He faces bullying and class discrimination while falling for an ambitious senior student, forcing him to fight for love and dignity.

videos.title: Safeedon Se Dilli Tak
videos.overview: Rajveer Ahlawat, a fearless boxer from Safidon, Haryana, joins Delhi’s elite St. Collin’s College to fulfill his brother’s dream of becoming a suited-booted-jaat. But when Rajveer is humiliated at the fresher’s party for being a small-town boy, he takes on a bold challenge: to date a senior girl within three months.

videos.title: Dream Wali Girl
videos.overview: After the fresher’s party, Rajveer dreams of a girl in a mustard field. The next morning, he spots Antara Shukla and follows her to the Literary Society. When Antara stands up for him against bullies, Rajveer declares that she is the senior he will date—unaware that she’s already seeing a Master’s student Devraj.

videos.title: Chhora Hua Viral
videos.overview: Rajbala questions why someone like Antara would ever date Rajveer. He has no answer but stays determined. When Antara’s rival Manas Chauhan steals credit for her cleanliness drive, Rajveer makes a video exposing his ruse. Antara watches the video in rage —who asked for his help? Rajveer has unknowingly sparked a storm.

videos.title: Plan Hua Backfire
videos.overview: Antara publicly berates Rajveer for making the video, even dragging his late brother into it. Unable to hear a word against his brother, Rajveer storms off to Safidon. At home, memories of Karanveer flood back. On the terrace, he recalls the fated night - when Karanveer’s body was brought home.

videos.title: Bhool Chook Maaf
videos.overview: Rajveer’s friends, Jogi and Rajbala visit Safidon to cheer Rajveer up. Meanwhile, Antara regrets berating Rajveer after his video goes viral. When Rajveer returns to Delhi, Antara apologizes to Rajveer invites him to join her party. He agrees—on one condition: she must teach Rajveer, Jogi and Rajbala, English.

videos.title: Jahan Chah Wahan Raah
videos.overview: Rajveer starts English lessons with Antara and joins her student political party. Proud, he messages his late brother, telling him how he has finally become part of the “shehri log”. But spotting Antara with Devraj crushes him. Then comes a chance: to support Antara in a fundraising race, and prove Dev wrong.

videos.title: Main Hoon Naa
videos.overview: Focused on fundraising, Rajveer begins to drift apart from Jogi and Rajbala. Rajbala gets suspended for giving his proxy, but Rajveer ignores her message. Heartbroken, she leaves for Safidon. Meanwhile, Antara’s pregnant sister goes into labor—and Rajveer steps up to take control of the situation and help.

videos.title: Ek Nayi Shuruaat
videos.overview: At the hospital, Antara shares her abandonment issues with Rajveer, bringing them closer. For the fundraising Rajveer creates a video urging brands to invest in their college, and students like them. The video goes viral, and bond grows—but a jealous Devraj watches from the shadows and begins plotting his revenge in cahoots with Manas.

videos.title: Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Du?
videos.overview: At Antara’s niece’s naamkaran ceremony, Rajveer impresses Antara by helping out with work and shutting down her jijuand Dev’s sexist remarks. When Rajveer learns that it’s Antara’s birthday the next day, he plans a surprise. But before he can act, Dev proposes to Antara—leaving Rajveer heartbroken in the crowd.

videos.title: Bade Bhai Ka Sach
videos.overview: Heartbroken, Rajveer vents to Jogi on the terrace—until a call changes everything: his mother’s had a heart attack. Back in Safidon, Rajveer’s haunted by memories of Karanveer’s death, how it was Rajveer’s impulsiveness that caused it. Meanwhile, Antara finds Rajveer’s surprise birthday setup—and realizes she misses him.

videos.title: Besht Junior
videos.overview: Rajveer returns to Delhi, still weighed down by grief. Meanwhile, Antara learns of Manas’ shady campaign tactics in the PG area and decides to rally there. Dev tips off Manas, who incites a riot. Chaos erupts, and just as Antara gets hit by a bottle bomb, Rajveer charges in heroically — catching the bottle with his hand and saving her.

videos.title: Sports Quota Zindabad!
videos.overview: Rajveer saves Antara and inspires her to lead, reminding her that true leaders rise in crisis. Antara steps up, gives a fiery speech and controls the crowd. But moments later, Antara faints from exhaustion. Rajveer carries her to the clinic, where they share some tender moments—until Antara receives a shocking video.

videos.title: Farak Padta Hai
videos.overview: Neel posts a video accusing Antara of two-timing Devraj and Rajveer. Furious, Rajveer storms into the gym and beats Neel. Antara urges him to calm down, but Rajveer confesses his love and walks away. Stunned, Antara realizes he’s always supported her. When Dev confronts her, she breaks up with him.

videos.title: Pehli Wali Chahat
videos.overview: That night, Rajveer realises that the girl in his dreams has been Antara all this while - realizing He's in love. But their joy is short-lived as Rajveer’s mother needs urgent surgery, and their home is being sold. Determined, Rajveer vows to raise the funds. Antara suggests a DU boxing match with a prize money, but soon learns Rajveer’s been expelled for beating Neel.

videos.title: Knockout!
videos.overview: Rajveer searches for Antara at the arena, unaware she’s struck a deal with Manas to stop his expulsion, at the cost of withdrawing her own candidature. After Rajveer wins the match, they go on their date. But even there, Dev intrudes and shows Antara the ‘date with senior’ bet that Rajveer made. Heartbroken, Antara leaves, and Rajveer loses everything.

tt37660537.name: Two Much with Kajol and Twinkle
tt37660537.description: Two of India’s sharpest women, Kajol and Twinkle, host a talk show that’s fun, unhinged and sneakily insightful - featuring celebrity guests, wild takes, and total chaos. Like the fun table at the party - everyone’s invited.

videos.title: Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan

tt38947670.name: CO-ED
tt38947670.description: Twins Shikha and Nikhil couldn't be more different. But when their all-boys and all-girls schools suddenly go co-ed, the chaos of teenagehood hits them head-on. Now, both must confront new feelings, friendships, and the messy business of growing up together.

videos.title: Unity, Learning, And Respect
videos.overview: Two sister schools in Udaipur announce they'll merge into one co-educational school. Shikha's thrilled, Nikhil's anxious. At home, parents chase their own dreams as old walls begin to break.

videos.title: Scarmates
videos.overview: The co-ed term begins in chaos. Students fight over seats and rules till a handball match sparks new friendships. Nikhil loses his topper spot but finds a friend who changes his view.

videos.title: Am I your Type?
videos.overview: When their parents are away, the twins make plans with friends and get caught. Shikha must now pass her test to prove she can stay in co-ed!

videos.title: We Will Win This Together!
videos.overview: Sports Day brings excitement, rumors, and rivalry. As competition intensifies, the twins realize the importance of learning what it truly means to stand together.

videos.title: ⁠Efforts Waala Sorry...
videos.overview: Shikha and Nikhil skip school after a Sports Day incident. Their day out builds bonds but leads to trouble at home. An investor's interest in their mom sparks family conflict.

videos.title: Sweet Sixteen
videos.overview: It's the twins' birthday, but nothing feels normal. Tensions rise at home as unspoken conflicts surface. The Parwanis must find a way to hold on to each other as things start to change.

tt32104971.name: First Copy
tt32104971.description: In the heart of Mumbai during the 1990s, 'Arif,' a notorious and desperately romantic figure, rises to infamy as the kingpin of film piracy. As he weaves an intricate web of distribution, his audacious exploits attract the attention of law enforcement, Bollywood celebrities, and the criminal underworld, leading to a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase.

tt38235589.name: Kurukshetra: The Great War of Mahabharata
tt38235589.description: An epic 18-day battle unfolds through the perspectives of 18 warriors, revealing their inner struggles and ethical challenges during a war between brothers.

tt38509140.name: Search: The Naina Murder Case
tt38509140.description: A veteran cop gets mired in a high-profile murder case when a girl is found dead in a politician's car. With multiple suspects, how will she unmask the killer?

videos.title: Skeletons in the Closet
videos.overview: Just as ACP Sanyukta Das prepares to sign off, a new case lands on her desk. Forced to team up with her eccentric replacement, ACP Jai Kanwal, she faces a day unlike any other.

videos.title: Writing on the Wall
videos.overview: As Sanyukta and Jai follow the victim's trail, the grieving parents face harsh realities. Meanwhile, Tushar scrambles to contain the scandal threatening his political career.

videos.title: Et Tu, Brute?
videos.overview: Tushar hunts for the mole jeopardising his election campaign. Sanyukta and Jai's investigation points uncomfortably close to the victim's inner circle.

videos.title: End of the Rope
videos.overview: Sanyukta and Jai realise they've been looking for answers in the wrong places. Meanwhile, the victim's father, consumed by loss, decides to take a drastic step.

videos.title: Devil in the Details
videos.overview: With every theory falling apart, along with Sanyukta's marriage, she and Jai find themselves at a dead end. But a sudden discovery propels the investigation into a new direction.

videos.title: Cat and Mouse
videos.overview: Sanyukta and Jai begin to suspect the killer has been hiding in plain sight all along. But when she uncovers damning new evidence, it forces her to rethink everything.

tt33028833.name: 13th: Some Lessons Aren't Taught in Classrooms
tt33028833.description: 13th tells the story of Ritesh, a successful venture capitalist who reunites with his maverick IIT-JEE mentor, Mohit Tyagi Sir, to help scale his visionary educational institute. The series unfolds against the backdrop of India's most gruelling academic competition and a startup culture fixated on valuations. At its heart, 13th is a deeply nostalgic, human story of a master and his pupil-bound by ambition, respect, and the lessons that shape a lifetime.

videos.title: Paanch Sawaal
videos.overview: Ritesh, a sharp and successful venture capitalist, is sent to Jaipur by his firm to pitch a nationwide expansion plan to MT Sir, a legendary yet low-profile IIT JEE coach. But this meeting stirs up more than business-it reopens a chapter from Ritesh's own past, where a single mark and a simple challenge from MT Sir had changed everything. As old memories resurface and new ambitions collide, Ritesh is forced to confront not just the intent behind this potential investment but a deeper question: what truly defines success? The past and present intertwine, setting the stage for a decision that could reshape both their lives.

videos.title: Kuch Bhi Ho Sakta Hai
videos.overview: With his corporate ties cut, Ritesh dives headfirst into building something meaningful with MT Sir-but not everyone shares their vision. A tense investor meeting tests their commitment to authenticity in a world obsessed with optics. Meanwhile, flashbacks to Ritesh's time in Kota reveal an intense rivalry, mounting pressure, and a crucial lesson about speed versus intelligence. As the academic battlefield heats up and personal struggles deepen, a beautiful new connection offers Ritesh solace. But just as he finds his footing, a sudden shift threatens to upend everything he believed about success. Some lessons arrive too late-and hit the hardest.

videos.title: Cheating
videos.overview: Ritesh finds himself torn-between loyalty and logic, passion and practicality, as MT Sir enters an entrepreneurship competition without consulting him. Ritesh is skeptical; the prize feels too small, the odds too big. But for MT Sir, it's a matter of belief, not scale. Flashbacks reveal a younger Ritesh, thrown off course by sudden changes in the JEE pattern, losing focus just as his connection with Sheena deepens. In the present, Ritesh's ego gets battered when he learns that an old colleague will be judging the competition. With a crucial decision looming, Ritesh stands at a breaking point. As echoes of the past return, will he succumb to his own demons?

videos.title: The Clock Is Ticking
videos.overview: As the E-Summit nears, cracks begin to show-both in the present and the past. Ritesh wrestles with a decision that could impact MT Sir's moment in the spotlight, while memories of youthful jealousy and failure resurface. A tangled past with Sheena and a bitter rivalry with Abhishek reveal the emotional toll of ambition. In the present, even MT Sir isn't immune to pressure, questioning his place among slick-talking entrepreneurs. As doubts creep in and fears resurface, the story draws powerful parallels between past breakdowns and present reckonings-testing how far each man is willing to go to rise again.

videos.title: Handshake
videos.overview: Defeated by doubt, MT Sir returns from the E-Summit-but a new investment opportunity reignites hope. As he and Ritesh prepare for a fresh pitch, whispers from the past return: a younger Ritesh spiraling after a major debacle, only to be pulled back from the edge by MT Sir's wisdom. As past failures slowly transform into lessons of humility and focus, the present challenges begin to mirror them. With an unexpected second chance knocking, both mentor and mentee must decide-will they let fear dictate the future, or rise above it? Sometimes, the bravest move is just showing up.

tt38390994.name: Janaawar - The Beast Within
tt38390994.description: As SI Hemant Kumar explores a missing person's case in the jungle town of Chhattisgarh, he is determined to solve it. Trouble follows when that leads to a string of bodies and a likely serial killer.

videos.title: Devta Aur Dand
videos.overview: SI Hemant’s request for a week off is cancelled due to two urgent cases. The disappearance of MLA Jagtap’s brother, Sarju, and a gold theft. Later, the police find a mutilated corpse in the jungle.

videos.title: Aur Ek Ganth
videos.overview: Hemant and his team begin a desperate search for the missing head of the body. Shambhu is arrested and beaten up in custody. Meanwhile, Hemant’s son is born, and he rushes to Garima, his wife.

videos.title: Jaati, Kabhi Nahi Jaati
videos.overview: The mystery around the dead body and Sarju’s murder grows deeper. The tribals protest against Shambhu’s arrest. Hemant is shocked to learn that he must now choose between his identity and his duty.

videos.title: Purana Paap
videos.overview: Mamaji and Gopi, arrested for Sarju’s murder, are beaten up. They confess to the crime, but something seems off. Hemant is stunned when the loose ends of the case lead to his trusted ally, Kailash.

videos.title: Apsara
videos.overview: Kailash, once the police’s trusted ally, is now in custody as a suspect. A brutally beaten-up Kailash opens up to Hemant about his wife, Manda, and his connection to Sarju’s case.

videos.title: Aur Kaun?
videos.overview: The entire unit is stunned at Kailash’s confession, but the case is far from being solved with new revelations. Suspecting Kailash’s relation to more crimes, Hemant plays a trick.

videos.title: Sala, Janaawar!
videos.overview: Kailash claims that he was forced to lie in front of the DSP. Hemant fears transfer to a Naxal area. He requests Kailash to save his son from a life of struggles. Will Kailash give in?

tt34683290.name: The Ba***ds of Bollywood
tt34683290.description: An entertaining ride through the adventures of an ambitious outsider navigating the glitzy yet tricky world of Bollywood, with self-aware humor, cameos, and larger-than-life characters for a tongue-in-cheek take on Indian cinema.

tt31925787.name: Do You Wanna Partner
tt31925787.description: Best friends Shikha and Anahita turn entrepreneurs with an exciting craft beer brand, Jugaaro, to stand out in the crowded NCR beer market. However, they face gender discrimination every step of the way. To fight for an equal place in this male dominated sector, they decide to invent a fictitious male partner to help smooth their way. Invariably, things don’t go exactly as planned. What follows are their collective adventures & misadventures in trying to build a successful start-up amidst the current boom, as the bunch of misfits band together and become a family.

tt31918578.name: Andhera
tt31918578.description: In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.

tt37813837.name: Sena - Guardians of the Nation
tt37813837.description: A dedicated Indian Army Captain and his father are captured by militants in Kashmir, forcing them to reconcile their past differences while planning a daring escape that could save their lives and thwart a terrorist plot.

videos.title: Ambush
videos.overview: Captain Kartik Sharma is ambushed and kidnapped along with his father, by terrorists seeking revenge for Abu Bakar's arrest; The army begins a search operation.

videos.title: Manhunt
videos.overview: While Kartik is held captive, the Army track a suspect vehicle, as terrorists take Kartik's father, leaving Kartik begging them to stop.

videos.title: Camouflage
videos.overview: Kartik, held captive, pretends to join terrorists to plan his escape. The Army tracks his secret signals.

videos.title: The Run
videos.overview: Kartik escapes with his injured father, fleeing through the jungle while terrorists chase them. The Army tracks them for rescue.

videos.title: Pyare Papa
videos.overview: Kartik, rescued but broken, decides to leave the Army. Months later, a letter from his proud father gives him strength to return. He joins a mission to track the terrorists, leading them to Masood's hideout in POK.

tt35665851.name: Saare Jahan Se Accha: The Silent Guardians
tt35665851.description: In the 1970's, a resilient Indian spy must defeat his counterpart across the border in a battle of wits and trade craft to sabotage a nuclear program.

links.name: Saare Jahan Se Accha: The Silent Guardians

tt35077054.name: Salakaar
tt35077054.description: When an undercover agent discovers a plan involving a nuclear weapon, a battle-hardened spymaster must revisit his clandestine history to thwart a catastrophe.

tt31898339.name: Rangeen
tt31898339.description: After discovering his wife's betrayal, a straight-laced husband dives into the hidden world of paid intimacy as a twisted act of revenge. Clueless and out of his depth, he stumbles through misadventures that mix awkward hilarity with raw self-discovery - forcing him to question his notions of love, manhood, and morality.

videos.title: Dimaag Ke Keedey
videos.overview: A seemingly upright newspaper editor's life goes awry when he discovers that his wife is sleeping with a paid lover. Feeling emasculated, he makes a radical decision.

videos.title: Sanki
videos.overview: A raw confrontation with Naina drives Adarsh into a vengeful spiral, but he is out of his depth in an unfamiliar world. Naina doesn't know who to turn to, and Sunny finds himself stuck between the two.

videos.title: Cheenti
videos.overview: Adarsh pressures Sunny's agent Sitara to hire him. Sitara arranges a trial, during which he leaves a lasting impression. Naina feels unwelcome in her parent's house.

videos.title: Sooja Hua Mooh
videos.overview: Adarsh is pursued by a young girl online. At a family function, Naina and Adarsh cross paths for the first time since their explosive argument. Meanwhile, Sunny spends time with Sitara's kids, and things get complicated.

videos.title: Magarmachh
videos.overview: Adarsh replaces Sitara's blue-eyed boy Sunny and is paired with the volatile and capricious Jugnu. With Sitara out of his life, Sunny loses his sparkle.

videos.title: Daldal
videos.overview: Adarsh moves up the ladder as he gets paired with the aristocratic Roshni, and Sunny sinks into a low as he accepts an uncomfortable arrangement. The boundaries of both gigolos are tested in different ways.

videos.title: Junglee Suar
