videos.overview: Vishakha is stunned when Vikrant reveals that he and Mannat are married. Meanwhile, Mannat gets ready for Shruti's final ceremonies and bids her a loving farewell.

videos.title: Vikrant Tries to Console Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat gets hurt by the divorce papers Vikrant sends during Shruti's funeral. Later, Vikrant tries to reach out, but she remains angry over his actions.

videos.title: Dhairya, Vikrant's Heated Clash
videos.overview: Vishakha injures herself to mislead Vikrant, sparking a fight between him and Dhairya. Later, Mannat plans to leave the city after bidding farewell to Shruti's ashes.

videos.title: Mannat Stands Strong
videos.overview: Mannat feels remorse as memories of Vikrant haunt her, yet she gathers strength to stay firm. Later, Ronny tells Neetu that Dua's habits closely resemble Vikrant's.

videos.title: Dua's Apology to Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant requests a Power of Attorney from Vishakha, causing her to become upset. Meanwhile, Dua expresses her regret to Mannat for her actions, which reminds her of Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat Haunted By Memories
videos.overview: Dua excitedly shares her new learnings as Dhairya bonds with her. Later, Mannat is left speechless when a song Dua plays brings back inescapable memories of Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat Clarifies Dhairya's Doubt
videos.overview: Yashika apologizes to Vikrant for playing unwanted music as Dhairya and Dua plan a surprise for Guddi's family. Later, Mannat tells Dhairya that Dua has no ties to Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat Refuses Wedding Contract
videos.overview: Mannat tells Dhairya that Vikrant might be Dua's biological father, but he is not her real father. Later, Mannat declines a wedding food contract on learning it's in Mumbai

videos.title: Mannat Sets Out For Neetu's Surgery
videos.overview: Dhairya suggests that Mannat take Mrs Sinha's contract so she can pay for Neetu's surgery. Later, Mannat feels uneasy and tells Ronny and Dhairya before leaving for Mumbai.

videos.title: Dua's Wish to Meet Vikrant
videos.overview: Dua feels happy as she dreams of meeting Vikrant and introducing him to Mannat. Later, Vikrant is stunned to see Shruti's name listed in the book for the langar at the gurudwara.

videos.title: Dua's Hopeful Gamble
videos.overview: Dua decides to enter the Dawate Ishq competition to win prize money for Mannat. Later, Mannat hides being in Mumbai as she unknowingly crosses paths with Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat Avoids Vikrant
videos.overview: Mannat is shocked to see Vikrant, though he does not notice her. She runs away before he can see her, leaving him emotional as he recalls their marriage.

videos.title: Malla Suspects Arzoo
videos.overview: Mannat feels she has no place in Vikrant's heart, even as he senses her presence. Later, Vishakha and Malla grow suspicious of Arzoo's behaviour.

videos.title: Mannat Scolds Dua
videos.overview: Aish confronts Malla and Vishaka for not keeping a proper watch over Vikrant's life. Meanwhile, Mannat reprimands Dua as she insists on participating in the competition.

videos.title: Dua's Conversation With Vikrant
videos.overview: Dhairya tells Ronny he feels Mannat is trying to hide her meeting with Vikrant in Mumbai. Later, Dua calls Vikrant and confesses that she is his biggest fan.

videos.title: Vikrant Spots Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat tells Dhairya she feels Dua is hiding something from them. Later, Vikrant stops the car upon seeing Mannat and rushes over to her.

videos.title: Dua's Risky Journey
videos.overview: Dua quietly slips out of the house while Mannat sleeps. Later, she shares her and Dhairya's carefully planned future with Mannat included.

videos.title: Mannat Worries For Dua
videos.overview: Mannat panics after reading Dua's letter, realizing she is stranded without a bus ticket. Later, Dua hides in a bag when Mannat and Dhairya spot her at the bus station.

videos.title: Dhairya Gives Mannat Hope
videos.overview: Dhairya tries to calm Mannat as she fears about Dua, assuring her that they will find her. Later, Ronny and Neetu feel that destiny might be hinting at Dua and Vikrant's union.

videos.title: Vikrant's Shocking Truth
videos.overview: Vikrant learns Dua is his daughter and lashes out at Mannat.Later, Vikrant shames Mannat and forcefully takes Dua away.

videos.title: Vikrant Saves Dua
videos.overview: Vikrant heroically saves Dua from falling off the bus and cares for her while she is asleep. Later, panic ensues when Dua goes missing at their destination.

videos.title: Vikrant Disqualifies Dua
videos.overview: Vikrant finds Dua on the road and fights the goons to save her. Later, Vikrant announces the competition rules and disqualifies Dua over lack of parental approval.

videos.title: Dua's Culinary Triumph
videos.overview: Dua quickly prepares a delicious sandwich when she gets a chance. Later, Vikrant learns that the most tastiest sandwich was made by Dua, who he already disqualified.

videos.title: Vikrant Reconsiders His Decision?
videos.overview: The judges push Vikrant to give Dua another chance, while Yuvi humiliates Deepak, sparking conflict with Vishakha. As tensions rise, Dhairya and Mannat cheer Dua up.

videos.title: Mannat's Fight to Protect Dua
videos.overview: Mannat fights off the men who attempt to abduct Dua with fierce determination. Later, Dhairya intervenes and beats up both men as he, Mannat, and Dua escape together.

videos.title: Dhairya's Promise to Mannat
videos.overview: Dhairya assures Mannat he will always stay united with Dua and protect her. Meanwhile, Yashika manipulates Yuvi into convincing Vikrant to take them to Indore with him.

videos.title: Mannat's Prayer Against Vikrant
videos.overview: Mannat urges Dua to play without a phone while Vikrant receives her photo and location. Later, Neetu begins to walk as Mannat prays to never see Vikrant again.

videos.title: Neetu's Collapse Shocks All
videos.overview: Vikrant and Mannat pray at the same place to never meet again, unaware of each other. Later, Neetu collapses unconscious as everyone panics for her safety.

videos.title: Mannat's Prayers For Family
videos.overview: Vikrant starts imagining Mannat is in front of him and begins asking why she is here. Later, Mannat thanks God to keep her family the same as Dhairya lifts Dua's mood positively.

videos.title: Arzoo's Plan Against Yashika
videos.overview: Arzoo devises a plan and asks Malla and Vishakha to uncover Yashika's true side. Later, Mannat's kite beats Vikrant's, unaware they're competing against each other.

videos.title: Vikrant Destined to Meet Mannat!
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant meet at the kite festival, as Vikrant feels destiny brought them together. Later, Vikrant is shocked to learn that Mannat is the head chef at Mr. Jindal's hotel.

videos.title: Mannat Faces The Consequences
videos.overview: Mannat apologises to Dhairya for the consequences caused by Vikrant. Later, Mr. Jindal reprimands her for being careless about the food quality at the event.

videos.title: Dhairya Stands By Mannat
videos.overview: Dhairya firmly defends Mannat against Vikrant and Yashika's accusations, assuring her of his trust. Later, Vikrant gets emotional upon seeing Ronny at the police station.

videos.title: Yashika Fuels Vikrant's Enmity
videos.overview: Yashika provokes Vikrant's anger against Mannat. Later, Dua and Mannat trick Guddi into confessing that she forged Mannat's signature, while Dhairya records the confession.

videos.title: Vikrant, Mannat's Heated Clash
videos.overview: Dhairya arranges a press meet, disclosing Guddi and Bhushan's plan to defame Mannat. Later, Vikrant and Mannat get into a heated conflict as he accuses her of betraying him.

videos.title: Neetu's Request to Dua
videos.overview: Neetu urges Dua to take part in the cooking competition and hopes to reveal the truth to Vikrant. Later, Vikrant identifies Mannat's dish and recalls a memory from their past.

videos.title: Vikrant Misses Neetu
videos.overview: Yashika schemes to win Vikrant, while the latter remembers Neetu as he feeds Yuvi. Later, the paralysed Neetu starts walking after seeing Vikrant. Will Neetu and Vikrant meet?

videos.title: Neetu's Accusation Breaks Dhairya
videos.overview: Dhairya breaks down as Neetu accuses him of trying to replace Vikrant's place in Mannat and Dua's lives. Later, Mannat stops Neetu from going to Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat Defends Dhairya
videos.overview: As Neetu doubts Dhairya's intentions, Mannat defends him, highlighting his support and sacrifice. Later, Ronny and Vikrant cross paths and get into an argument over past incidents.

videos.title: Mannat's Emotional Turmoil
videos.overview: Mannat tells Dhairya she cannot live without Dua and panics at the thought of losing her. Later, Neetu gets emotional seeing Vikrant's visit while Mannat stands shocked.

videos.title: Neetu Acts On False Hope
videos.overview: Neetu leaves her wheelchair and runs after a car, mistaking it for Vikrant. Later, Mannat feels helpless as she prays for operation money, watching Dua help.

videos.title: Mannat's Desperate Quest
videos.overview: Arzoo tries to convince Vikrant to come to Mumbai, but he prioritises Yuvi's health over travel. Later, Mannat seeks his colleague's financial help to afford Neetu's treatment.

videos.title: Mannat Seeks Mr. Sinha's Help
videos.overview: Vikrant urges Mannat to seek Mr. Sinha's help for Neetu's treatment expenses. Later, Mannat comforts Neetu and calls Mr. Sinha to request a loan for her treatment.

videos.title: Ronny Acknowledges Dhairya
videos.overview: Dua and Yuvi get into a fight. After Mannat requests financial help, Mr. Sinha turns to Vikrant for payment. Later, Ronny thanks Dhairya for supporting him after Vikrant left.

videos.title: Mannat Challenges Yashika
videos.overview: Mannat uncovers the truth behind Dua and Yuvi's conflict through video evidence and protects Dua from Yashika's wrath. Later, she boldly challenges Yashika to call Vikrant.

videos.title: Vikrant Faces His Fallout
videos.overview: Dhairya confronts Vikrant for ruining his own relationship through mistrust. Later, Yashika feels relieved as Vikrant agrees to leave for Mumbai and reassures Yuvi.

videos.title: Mannat, Vikrant's Clash
videos.overview: Vikrant learns that Mannat asked Mr Sinha for money, which he refused. Later, Mannat confronts Vikrant for criticising Dua and shows him a video of Yuvi's behaviour.

videos.title: Dhairya's Concern for Neetu
videos.overview: The doctor urges Mannat to take Neetu to Mumbai for treatment. Later, Guddi offers support, and Dhairya worries about managing the expenses for Neetu's treatment.

videos.title: Yuvi's Desperate Move
videos.overview: Influenced by Yashika's words, Yuvi decides to run away from home. Later, Vikrant panics upon reading Yuvi's letter and feels guilty for driving him to such a drastic step.

videos.title: The Past Overwhelms Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant thanks Mannat for dropping Yuvi home and invites her inside. Later, memories resurface as Mannat enters the Saluja mansion, leaving her emotional.

videos.title: Mannat Learns Arzoo's Truth
videos.overview: The doctor tells Mannat that surgery is the only permanent solution for Neetu's recovery. Later, Mannat is shocked to see Arzoo and realises she is actually Aishwarya.

videos.title: Vikrant Stands by Yuvi
videos.overview: Yuvi tells Vikrant that he's eager to join the competition, as Vikrant encourages him to become a good chef. Meanwhile, Mannat follows Arzoo to uncover her true identity.

videos.title: Arzoo Slips Away Unseen
videos.overview: Mannat is baffled when Arzoo vanishes while being followed. Meanwhile, Yuvi's arrogance disrupts the shoot, as Dua's quiet grace unexpectedly draws the photographer's attention.

videos.title: Vikrant's Worries for Neetu
videos.overview: Arzoo lashes out at Malla and Vishakha for their recklessness and reveals that Mannat saw her today. Later, Vikrant worries why Mannat didn't inform him about Neetu's health.

videos.title: Malla Strategises With Yashika
videos.overview: Malla urges Yashika to become Vikrant's life partner to remove Mannat from his life. Later, Arzoo informs Malla and Vishakha that Vikrant visited Neetu at the hospital.

videos.title: Arzoo Plots Against Mannat
videos.overview: Arzoo plans to stop Mannat from coming to the hospital with money to prevent Neetu's surgery. Later, Malla disguises herself as a driver to stop Mannat from reaching the hospital.

videos.title: An Attack on Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant prays for Neetu's recovery. Later, Malla and Arzoo mask themselves and attack Mannat, snatching her money bag, and then Dhairya rushes the injured Mannat to the hospital.

videos.title: Vishakha Sets an Emotional Trap
videos.overview: Vishakha emotionally manipulates Vikrant, forcing him to vow not to meet or help Mannat or Neetu. Meanwhile, Dua insists on joining Mannat to pray for Neetu at the temple.

videos.title: A Shattering Moment for Yuvi
videos.overview: Mannat and Dua walk barefoot to the temple and receive blessings from the priest. Meanwhile, shock erupts as the cooking competition poster reveals Dua's picture instead of Yuvi's.

videos.title: Neetu's Condition Breaks Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat and Ronny break down as Neetu's health worsens. Tensions spike when Vikrant visits, while Dua is stunned to see herself on his cooking competition hoarding.

videos.title: Vikrant Faces Mannat's Wrath
videos.overview: Mannat furiously rejects Vikrant's attempts to take Dua. But Neetu's critical health shocks Vikrant, leaving him torn and conflicted.

videos.title: Vikrant's Ultimatum Shocks Mannat
videos.overview: Vikrant agrees to fund Neetu's surgery if Mannat lets Dua join the cooking contest. Later, Dhairya persuades Mannat to accept his deal.

videos.title: Dhairya Comforts Mannat
videos.overview: Dhairya urges Mannat to stay strong as she worries about Neetu's surgery. Later, Yuvi gets furious when Vikrant tells him that Dua will participate in the cooking competition.

videos.title: Malla's Sneaky Plot
videos.overview: Vishakha confronts Vikrant for funding Neetu's surgery. Meanwhile, Malla plans to use Yuvi to get close to Vikrant and suspects Yashika of introducing fake parents.

videos.title: Yashika Proposes to Vikrant
videos.overview: Seeing each other, Mannat and Vikrant are flooded with memories of their past and imagine a heartfelt reunion. Later, Yashika shocks everyone by proposing to Vikrant at the party.

videos.title: Mannat Walks Away
videos.overview: Vikrant agrees to marry Yashika, leaving Mannat shattered yet composed. Later, Mannat refuses his cruel condition and pulls Dua out of the competition.

videos.title: A Shocker for Mannat
videos.overview: Tensions rise as Mannat is shaken upon seeing Arzoo. Meanwhile, Vikrant tries to explain that Arzoo isn't Aishwarya, but Mannat insists on calling the police.

videos.title: Mannat's Desperate Deal
videos.overview: Mannat accepts Vikrant's conditions so he can pay for Neetu's treatment. Later, Mannat plans to catch Aishwarya red-handed by staying at his home for the wedding catering.

videos.title: Malla's Sinister Scheme
videos.overview: To afford Neetu's treatment, Mannat signs the agreement to cater to Vikrant's wedding. Later, Malla and Arzoo plot to eliminate Dua from the competition.

videos.title: Vishakha Faces Mannat's Warning
videos.overview: Vikrant feels a deep connection with Dua as he ties a sacred thread on her hand. Later, Mannat sternly warns Vishakha not to reveal the past to Dua, sparking a heated argument.

videos.title: Mannat, Dhairya's Secret Plot
videos.overview: Mannat and Dhairya secretly plan to conduct Arzoo's DNA test to uncover her true identity. Later, Malla stirs Yashika's insecurity, highlighting Mannat's return in Vikrant's life.

videos.title: Malla Plots Against Dua
videos.overview: Malla instructs Yuvi to place a firecracker in Dua's barbecue grill to eliminate her from the competition. Unaware of the danger, Dua confidently focuses on preparing her dish.

videos.title: Vikrant Faces Mannat's Wrath
videos.overview: Mannat fumes at Vikrant over their negligence during the competition, and Bunty reveals that Yuvi hid crackers in the grill. Later, Dhairya suspects Aishwarya is behind the blast.

videos.title: Dhairya's Plan Against Arzoo
videos.overview: Dhairya plots to collect Arzoo's sample for a DNA test to expose her. Meanwhile, Vikrant reconducts the first round of the competition, and Dua confidently prepares the dish.

videos.title: Dua Shines in Round One
videos.overview: Vikrant declares Dua as the winner of the first round of the cooking competition, igniting Yuvi's jealousy. Later, Vishakha and Malla confront Yashika's fake parents.

videos.title: DNA Report Shocks Mannat
videos.overview: Yashika threatens Malla and Vishakha to expose Arzoo's true identity to Mannat and Dhairya. Meanwhile, Mannat is stunned as the DNA report fails to confirm Arzoo as Aishwarya.

videos.title: Arzoo Allies With Yashika
videos.overview: Arzoo joins hands with Yashika, plotting to use Dua against Mannat to drive her out of Vikrant's life. Later, Mannat feels happy overhearing Vikrant praise Dua's cooking.

videos.title: Yuvi's Scheme to Swap Dua's Dish
videos.overview: Dua confidently focuses on her dish while Yuvi plans to swap it with Yashika's help. Meanwhile, Dhairya plots to make Arzoo drink a spiked beverage to expose her reality.

videos.title: Vikrant's Holi Glimpse
videos.overview: Mannat tends to Vikrant's injury as Yashika expresses gratitude to all at her engagement. Later, Vikrant and the family joyfully celebrate the Holi festival together.

videos.title: Vikrant's Confession to Mannat
videos.overview: As Vikrant confesses his love for Mannat, she confronts him for leaving her during difficult times. Meanwhile, Dua gets trapped inside a freezer.

videos.title: Mannat Hits Yashika
videos.overview: Mannat angrily slaps Yashika for making accusations against Dua and Shruti. Meanwhile, Dua tries to lift the freezer door to escape, but Arzoo pushes her back inside.

videos.title: Mannat's Quest for Dua
videos.overview: Mannat panics as she discovers Dua is missing and checks the CCTV footage to track her. Meanwhile, trapped in a freezer, Dua recalls Dhairya's words and stays strong.

videos.title: Arzoo's Evil Plan
videos.overview: Arzoo brings the police to search for Dua, feigning innocence. Later, Yuvi gets trapped in the freezer while rescuing Dua, but Arzoo chains it shut and sends it away.

videos.title: Dua's Rescue Signs
videos.overview: Dua and Yuvi struggle to escape the freezer, while she leaves clues to guide their rescue. Later, Mannat shares her doubts about Arzoo's role in Dua's disappearance with Dhairya.

videos.title: Mannat Tracks Dua, Yuvi
videos.overview: Arzoo and Yashika try to stop Mannat from reaching Dua. Mannat, Vikrant, and Dhairya follow the clues Dua left while being taken away in the freezer and find her with Yuvi.

videos.title: Vikrant Saves Dua and Yuvi
videos.overview: Vikrant rescues Yuvi and Dua from the locked freezer with Mannat's help. He thanks Mannat for saving Yuvi, while Dua reveals that Yuvi pushed her inside and locked her in.

videos.title: Dhairya Is Furious at Vikrant
videos.overview: Vikrant decides to send Yuvi to boarding school as Dhairya confronts him for ignoring Yuvi's mistakes. Mannat saves Yuvi as he nearly falls while escaping the house.

videos.title: Mannat, Dhairya Doubt Arzoo
videos.overview: Mannat and Dhairya suspect that Arzoo planned against Dua to remove them from Vikrant's life. Elsewhere, Yashika and her fake parents act innocent and create drama to trap Vikrant.

videos.title: Mannat's Plan Unfolds
videos.overview: Mannat tells Yashika about her agreement for Vikrant's wedding catering. Additionally, Dhairya and Mannat plot to install a camera in Arzoo's room and stage a drama.

videos.title: Vikrant's Attachment to Neetu
videos.overview: Dua shares her concern for Neetu and appreciates Vikrant. At the hospital, Vikrant becomes emotional and reminisces about his memories with Neetu after seeing her.

videos.title: Vikrant Stands by Mannat
videos.overview: Everyone applauds Mannat's singing at Yashika's henna ceremony. Vikrant feels guilty about his actions and stands up for her when Yashika's mother tries to humiliate her.

videos.title: Dua's Sneaky Move
videos.overview: Dua cleverly unlocks Arzoo's room and manages to place a hidden camera. Elsewhere, Neetu grows emotional seeing Vikrant comfort Dua and decides to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Dhairya, Mannat Spy on Arzoo
videos.overview: Dhairya and Mannat monitor Arzoo's activities after placing a hidden camera in her room. Then, Neetu tells Ronny that Vikrant and Dua visited her while she was unconscious.

videos.title: Arzoo Confronts Dhairya
videos.overview: Mannat recalls her wedding memories while choosing a dress with Yashika. Arzoo sparks tension by questioning Dhairya for entering her room without consent.

videos.title: Dua Comes to Mannat-Dhairya’s Rescue
videos.overview: Dua’s timely arrival saves Mannat and Dhairya from big trouble. Further, Vikrant feels a special connection with Dua, while Aishwarya raises suspicions about Mannat.

videos.title: Mannat's Truth Unravels
videos.overview: Neetu goes missing as she tries to reveal the truth to Vikrant. Mannat's secret slips out, leading to shocking revelations and her decision to expose Arzoo with proof.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Will Aarambhi Save Mannat?
videos.overview: Mannat fails to expose Arzoo's truth and plots to deceive Vishakha, while an angry Vishwas throws Aarambhi out of his life. Soon, Aarambhi spots a car rushing toward Mannat!

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Uplift Each Other
videos.overview: Mannat and Aarambhi share their struggles and pain, draw strength from each other, and resolve to fight together for their children's safety and a secure future.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat and Aarambhi Unite
videos.overview: Vishwas throws Aarambhi out, but she fights back legally. As Mannat spirals in fear, she turns to Aarambhi for help to expose Arzoo's dark secrets.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Dua's Drama Deceives Vikrant
videos.overview: Aarambhi gains courage from Dhairya's words and decides to fight for Vihaan. Dua and Dhairya stage a drama to stay in the competition, and Vikrant agrees.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Yashika Invites Tandons
videos.overview: Dhairya discloses to Mannat that he plotted Vishakha's allergy as a ploy to stay at Vikrant's place. Yashika invites the Tandons to her wedding with Vikrant.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Steal Spotlight
videos.overview: The Tandons arrive at Vikrant and Yashika's Sangeet. Mannat and Aarambhi dance together joyfully, and later Mannat makes Vishwas realise Aarambhi's importance.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Aarambhi Outsmarts Avantika
videos.overview: Dhairya, Aarambhi, and Mannat plot to get Arzoo admitted to the hospital, while Aarambhi smartly pushes Avantika to handle the party responsibilities to impress the Saluja family.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat and Aarambhi's Master Plan
videos.overview: Mannat and Aarambhi attempt to alter Arzoo's lab reports to reveal her true identity as Aishwarya. They plan to make Arzoo's health condition seem serious without harming her.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat's Faith in Aarambhi
videos.overview: Aarambhi decides to attend her doctor's license renewal interview despite the risks. Mannat encourages her and diverts Yashika's attention when she tries to spy on them.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Aarambhi's Gratitude to Mannat
videos.overview: Aarambhi feels thankful to Mannat for sending Vishwas out of the interview cabin. When Dimple blames Aarambhi for party issues, Mannat tries to expose Avantika.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Raj Uncovers Manmeet's Truth
videos.overview: Aarambhi is praised, but Arzoo suspects Mannat's manipulation. Raj is shocked by Manmeet's kidney donation, while Avantika fumes and hosts a grand cocktail party.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat's Plan Targets Arzoo
videos.overview: As the cocktail party begins and couples dance, Mannat and Dhairya move forward with their plan against Arzoo. Meanwhile, Avantika slyly cuts Aarambhi's dress on the dance floor.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Arzoo's Collapse Sparks Chaos
videos.overview: Mannat and Aarambhi's plan succeeds when Arzoo suddenly collapses, causing panic. Accusations rise as tensions explode among everyone.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Yashika, Vikrant's Wedding Drama
videos.overview: As Vikrant and Yashika clash over cancelling the wedding, past love between Vikrant and Mannat resurfaces. Meanwhile, Aarambhi alters Arzoo's medical reports, leaving her in shock.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat, Aarambhi Outplay Arzoo
videos.overview: Raj promises Manmeet to keep her kidney donation a secret from Aarambhi. Arzoo unknowingly walks into Mannat and Aarambhi's trap after Malla is found to be an incompatible donor.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Vikrant's Heart Gets Divided Again
videos.overview: Vikrant's emotions spiral as Dua's arrival sparks joy, leaving Mannat hurt and furious. As truths unravel, Aarambhi's secrets fuel intense drama.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat Trapped in Arzoo's Plot
videos.overview: As Mannat faints, Malla and Vishakha lock her in a trunk as per Arzoo's plan, leaving Dhairya and Aarambhi worried. Soon, Yashika and Vikrant begin their wedding rituals.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Mannat Fights Fate Amid Chaos
videos.overview: As Harry prepares for Arzoo's surgery, Mannat's shocking discovery puts her in danger. Amid chaos, Vikrant's wedding rituals continue, but Aarambhi's arrival changes everything.

videos.title: Mahasangam: Dhairya Fumes at Vishakha
videos.overview: Aarambhi informs Vikrant that Mannat has been kidnapped and blames Arzoo and Malla. Dhairya lashes out at Vishakha, demanding that she reveal Mannat's whereabouts.

videos.title: Race Against Time to Find Mannat
videos.overview: Arzoo feels happy to learn that Mannat is a suitable liver donor. Aarambhi, Dhairya, and Vikrant struggle to trace her location, while Dua records proof against Vishakha.

videos.title: Mannat Fights Back
videos.overview: As Mannat's escape turns into a deadly chase, Dhairya risks everything to protect her while enemies close in from all sides. Yashika kidnaps Dua while Mannat takes a bold stand.

videos.title: Vishakha Blackmails Mannat
videos.overview: As Ronny and Bunty search for Dua, Vishakha and Yashika abduct Dua to threaten Mannat. Vikrant fights fiercely with the goons to protect Mannat.

videos.title: Vikrant and Mannat Strike Back
videos.overview: Vikrant breaks down and angrily confronts Vishakha for joining hands with Arzoo. Soon after, Mannat blackmails Arzoo by pointing a gun at Malla, demanding Dua's release.

videos.title: Bunty Helps Dua
videos.overview: Mannat and Vikrant capture Malla to trace Dua, only to find Dhairya injured and unconscious. Bunty distracts Vishakha and rescues Dua, while Vikrant pays ransom to Arzoo.

videos.title: Vikrant Seeks Forgiveness
videos.overview: Racked with guilt, Vikrant pleads for Mannat's forgiveness. Yashika cleverly steers Ronny away to keep her secret support for Mannat hidden.

videos.title: Dua's Life in Danger
videos.overview: Vikrant confides in Mannat about his unexplained bond with Dua. Tensions rise as Arzoo seizes Dua and pushes her off a cliff before fleeing, leaving everyone devastated.

videos.title: Arzoo Faces Mannat's Wrath
videos.overview: Vikrant and Dhairya team up to save Mannat and Dua from a cliff. Later, Mannat stops Arzoo's car and confronts her to avenge Shruti's death.

videos.title: Vishakha Drops the Bombshell
videos.overview: Malla and Yashika fear Vikrant and Mannat's wrath after Arzoo's death. Meanwhile, Vishakha exposes Yashika's role in Dua's kidnapping, leaving Vikrant and Mannat shocked.

videos.title: Mannat's Reunion Plan
videos.overview: Vikrant recalls his actions against Neetu and Ronny and regrets about it. Mannat decides to reunite Vikrant with them after seeing his regret.

videos.title: Vikrant Seeks Forgiveness
videos.overview: Vikrant apologises to Ronny, expressing regret for his actions. Mannat confides in Dhairya that she will hide the truth that Vikrant is Dua's father.

videos.title: Ronny's Advice to Mannat
videos.overview: Neetu promises Ronny to keep Dua's identity secret from Vikrant. Ronny advises Mannat on life and relationships, urging her to remove herself from Vikrant's life for peace.

videos.title: Dhairya's Ultimatum to Vikrant
videos.overview: Dhairya warns Vikrant not to interfere between him and Mannat. Malla tells Yashika to leave, declaring that Vikrant's heart still belongs to Mannat.

videos.title: Vikrant, Neetu's Emotional Reunion
videos.overview: Neetu and Ronny are overwhelmed with memories as they enter the Saluja mansion. Vikrant, filled with regret, apologises to Neetu, leading to a heartfelt reunion.

videos.title: Yashika's Deadly Move
videos.overview: At Baisakhi, Yashika secretly sets hay ablaze and pushes Mannat into the fire. Vikrant risks his life, leaping into the flames to save her.

videos.title: Neetu's Secret Plan
videos.overview: Mannat tends to Vikrant's wounds. Neetu vows to expose Dua's truth before Vikrant, prompting Dhairya to grow suspicious of her plan for Dua's DNA test.

videos.title: Dhairya Fears Losing Dua
videos.overview: Tension rises as Neetu suddenly collapses, while Yashika suspects that Neetu is hiding a secret. Dhairya fears losing Dua if Vikrant learns that she is his daughter.

videos.title: Vikrant Discovers Dua's Truth
videos.overview: Vikrant is stunned to learn that Dua is his daughter, while Mannat uncovers Neetu's plot to ensure Vikrant learns it. Dua requests Vikrant to accompany her home.

videos.title: Neetu Vows to Reunite the Family
videos.overview: Neetu vows to reunite Mannat, Vikrant, and Dua. Moments later, Mannat warns Vikrant that he has no right over Dua, as he abandoned her and their family in the past.

videos.title: Dua's Emotional Confession
videos.overview: Neetu strongly urges Vikrant to fight for his rights over Dua as his daughter. Later, an emotional Dua tearfully opens up to Vikrant about her deep bond with Dhairya.

videos.title: Vikrant's Plea to Dhairya
videos.overview: Vikrant pleads with Dhairya for a chance to watch Dua grow from afar. Mannat kindly asks Vikrant to stay away and let them live independently.

videos.title: A Shock for Dhairya
videos.overview: Ronny guides Mannat as she faces a dilemma over choosing Vikrant or Dhairya as Dua's father. Mannat shocks Dhairya by revealing that Vikrant has filed for Dua's custody.

videos.title: Dhairya Doubts Mannat
videos.overview: Mannat is shaken to learn that Vikrant has filed for Dua's custody, sparking tension at home. While Neetu defends Vikrant, Dhairya grows furious and doubts Mannat's intentions.

videos.title: Yashika's Secret Plot
videos.overview: Vikrant opens up to Yashika about the custody case, but her hidden agenda begins to influence him. As Mannat lashes out and vows to keep Dua, tensions escalate within the family.

videos.title: Mannat Fights to Save the Dhaba
videos.overview: Mannat Khanna joins Mannat Juneja to save the dhaba from demolition. Meanwhile, Kabir helps a child in trouble as the Junejas celebrate Seema's anniversary.

tt33094114.name: India's Got Latent
tt33094114.description: Samay Raina and the guest judges hilariously critique the untapped, undeniably entertaining "latent" talents of aspiring performers, testing their self-awareness with a unique scoring system.

EP2 ft. Harssh Limbachiya, Kiku Sharda, Chandan Prabhakar
EP3 ft. Raghu Ram, Vishal Dadlani, Tanmay Bhat, Yashraj

series|tmdb:331758.name: Bigg Boss The Common Man
series|tmdb:331758.description: From ordinary lives to extraordinary drama. Aspiring contestants fight to earn a spot in the Bigg Boss house.

tt40856820.name: Chaar Yaar
tt40856820.description: Chaar Yaar is a story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

series|tmdb:327594.name: Gurthukosthunnayi
series|tmdb:327594.description: After an accident wipes his memory just days before his wedding, Santosh forgets his entire life and his love for Vaishali.

series|tmdb:339474.name: Matargashti
series|tmdb:339474.description: Dhara's plan to explore her sexuality puts her at odds with her horrified father, who becomes determined to sabotage her love life.

series|tmdb:338390.name: Apsara
series|tmdb:338390.description: Braving modern-day evils, power-blessed Sunheri is the sole protector of her celestial clan! But her blood sister Dhara stands in her way! Can she fight her?

series|tmdb:339010.name: Madam Inspector
series|tmdb:339010.description: When brides preparing to remarry begin dying in eerily similar ways, Inspector Chitra races to find the hidden link connecting their deaths.

series|tmdb:313313.name: Ee Puzhayum Kadannu
series|tmdb:313313.description: Tragedy befalls a happy meddle-Class family after their father Aravindan's sudden demise. Now his daughters must find hope while overcoming the conflicts in life

series|tmdb:335963.name: Sayoneee
series|tmdb:335963.description: For young Saanvi, the word mother equals world. When fate brings her close to her long-lost mother, a promise stands between their reunion! But for how long?

series|tmdb:335533.name: Jungle Tales with Mowgli
series|tmdb:335533.description: Mowgli and his friends explore the jungle, facing dangers while learning courage, friendship and survival.

series|tmdb:331932.name: Ali Baba Aur 40 Bhoot
series|tmdb:331932.description: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

series|tmdb:315927.name: Local Times
series|tmdb:315927.description: What happens when four friends try to save a dying newspaper with nothing but blind ambition, street smarts, and each other? Local times is a heartfelt comedy of misadventures, where the real headline is the friendship that keeps them going-even when nothing else does.

series|tmdb:334611.name: Gunehgar Rishtey
series|tmdb:334611.description: Delve into the real-life cases centred around relationships that took an ugly turn! Wrong choices, betrayals—what turned their stories into crime sagas?

series|tmdb:308656.name: Nayanam
series|tmdb:308656.description: Nayan, an ophthalmologist, runs an eye clinic for people in need. But he secretly carries out experiments in the clinic that help him look at the personal lives of his patients through their lenses.

tt34748043.name: Heartbeats: Pyaar aur Armaan
tt34748043.description: Heartbeats is a hospital drama that follows Akshat as he pursues his dream of becoming a neurosurgeon while navigating a budding romance with Sanjh, a "nepo kid" from a family of doctors.

videos.title: Pehla Case, Pehla Pyaar, Pehla Siyappa
videos.overview: In lockup, Akshat recalls his internship days with fellow interns Rishi, Pulkit, Ruchi, and his rival-turned-interest, Sanjh. When they're assigned to assist a stubborn politician, a mishap lands them in near-legal trouble. Akshat, however, uncovers the true cause of the issue. Will his insight save them from facing the consequences?

videos.title: Dengue and Heartache
videos.overview: Akshat reflects on his rocky history with women and his growing interest in Sanjh, who remains distant. Sanjh feels pressured by her family's strict oversight, leading to a tense exchange when Akshat playfully teases her about her background. Amid a dengue outbreak at the hospital, Akshat connects with a patient's son, seeing a glimpse of himself in the young boy.

videos.title: Doctorgiri vs Herogiri
videos.overview: Akshat fakes an emergency to bypass insurance delays, convincing a hesitant Sanjh to help after she's touched by the family's bond. The interns pitch in their stipends, but Dr. Sandip warns them against playing heroes, emphasizing professional boundaries. Later, Pulkit surprises Ruchi with a hospital date, while Rishi and Dr. Chetna grow closer.

videos.title: The Toughest Call
videos.overview: Dr. Chetna regrets her moment with Rishi, frustrated by his ongoing flirting. Akshat and Sanjh must inform parents of a child's low survival chances, sparking a clash over honesty vs. hope. In surgery, Ruchi and Pulkit struggle due to Pulkit's lack of focus, raising tensions. Sanjh ultimately offers the parents false hope, complicating things. Stay tuned!

videos.title: You Look Handsome
videos.overview: Dr. Ananda reprimands Sanjh and Akshat for lacking essential doctor skills. Meanwhile, Ruchi and Pulkit manage pediatrics, discovering young Agasthya faked his pain. Later, Sanjh and Akshat advise a critical child's family on end-of-life decisions but urge them to remain hopeful. At Dr. Sandip's party, his tense past with Chetna surfaces, as Sanjh and Akshat grow closer.

videos.title: The Accidental Date
videos.overview: At the club, Sanjh and Akshat bond over drinks, with Akshat confessing he misses his mom and Sanjh surprising him with her charm. Meanwhile, Ruchi and Pulkit clash over an inappropriate patient, and Rishi and Chetna's romance faces tension. At the hospital, Mr. Chaddha opens up about his personal life, complicating their workday.

videos.title: Moral Compass
videos.overview: Mr. Chaddha has gonorrhea and insists the doctors keep it secret from his wife, Komal, frustrating Sanjh. Dr. Sandip warns her about confidentiality. Komal gets aggressive with her husband, and Rishi steps in to comfort her, discovering her injury is from Mr. Chaddha. Sanjh confesses her feelings for Akshat, while Rishi reveals the truth to Komal.

videos.title: Supply Room
videos.overview: Sanjh offers to help Akshat after his long shift, but when he invites her for coffee, she thinks he likes her. Ruchi tells her she’s being illogical. Akshat later agrees to provide a fake medical certificate for Anirban, motivated by Rishi. Sanjh learns about this, gets furious, and confronts him, risking their relationship.

videos.title: Confusion & Chaos
videos.overview: A senior doctor catches Akshat in the supply room, but he and Sanjh manage to cover up the fake medical certificates. Grateful for her help, Akshat hugs Sanjh, strengthening their bond. Meanwhile, Chetna and Rishi's relationship remains physical, leaving Rishi disappointed. Dr. Sandip finds the fake certificates and threatens Akshat.

videos.title: Struggle Ki Aaadat
videos.overview: Akshat is anxious as he faces Dr. Sandip, trying to avoid punishment for his fake medical certificates. To his relief, Sandip agrees not to punish him if Akshat praises him in front of Sanjh. However, Sanjh grows frustrated with Akshat's constant talk about Sandip. In a confrontation, she reveals she doesn't want to date Sandip but actually wants to go on a date with Akshat.

videos.title: Chalaang
videos.overview: Akshat reveals to Sanjh that Dr. Sandip asked him for a favor, so she arranges a meeting with her mom. As Akshat thinks about asking Sanjh out, he seeks advice from Rishi and Pulkit. Dr. Sandip impresses Sanjh's mom in the meeting but faces criticism over hospital fees. Chetna’s therapist hints she may have feelings for Rishi, which she denies.

videos.title: Meri Selection Ho Gai
videos.overview: Sanjh pauses, turns to Akshat, and finally says yes to his date proposal, leaving him thrilled. The next day, Mr. Bakshi arrives, and Rishi warns everyone to hide as he's a frequent visitor with no real issues. Sanjh reassures him and prescribes placebos. Meanwhile, Rishi flirts with Chetna and asks her out, while Dr. Sandip and Chetna discuss their past.

videos.title: Triple Date
videos.overview: Mr. Bakshi starts having seizures, and Dr. Sandip rushes to help, questioning Sanjh about the placebo she prescribed. Panicking, Sanjh runs away and hides in the washroom, crying. Sandip consoles her, easing her anxiety and reassuring her that she'll be a great doctor. Meanwhile, Akshat's remarks upset Sanjh, and Ruchi and Pulkit's date turns serious.

videos.title: Anxiety
videos.overview: Sanjh walks away, but Akshat follows her. Later, at the hostel, Rishi reveals he's seeing Dr. Chetna, but his friends don't believe him. Sanjh and Akshat meet over tea, and she opens up about her anxiety struggles. They're then assigned to the cancer ward, where they meet Shivansh, a boy who wants to celebrate Diwali. Akshat promises to help him burst crackers despite the risks.

videos.title: Time Kam Hai, Worth It Bana
videos.overview: Akshat and Sanjh are fighting over his promise to a cancer patient, which Sanjh believes is dangerous. Despite their argument, the interns praise Akshat for bringing smoke-free crackers, impressing Sanjh, but she remains upset. Dr. Sandip punishes them with 16-hour shifts. Rishi discusses Sanjh's anxiety with Akshat, who mistakenly reveals he told Rishi, causing more tension between him and Sanjh.

videos.title: The Sabotage
videos.overview: Dr. Ananda warns interns this is their last chance for an LOR and scholarship. Akshat and Sanjh become highly competitive. Rishi and Akshat prank Sanjh, tricking her into congratulating Dr. Ananda for a fake pregnancy. In revenge, Sanjh gives Akshat a sedative, making him miss his project deadline. Biji submits it for him but then collapses.

videos.title: Life or Death
videos.overview: Biji ignored her symptoms, hoping she'd recover on her own. When her condition worsened, Akshat felt guilty. The interns worked tirelessly to find a heart donor, but hope faded when a match fell through. Biji's son, angry, slapped Akshat. Later, he apologized. Everyone gathered by Biji's side; she awoke briefly, shared one last story, then passed away peacefully.

videos.title: Press Pause
videos.overview: Ananda gives a moving speech on Biji's passing, acknowledging her impact on everyone. Sanjh, emotional, admits she feels like a 'nepo kid' and Akshat comforts her. Later, she bonds with Dr. Sandip, who confides in her. When a critical patient's emergency contact is found to be Dr. Sandip, they find him unconscious. Pulkit and Ruchi perform a procedure, and Sandip later walks in.

videos.title: The Breaking Point
videos.overview: Dr. Sandip admits to being on sedatives and alcohol, feeling trapped in a rat race, and resigns, seeking a break. Ananda accepts his decision, bidding him farewell. Pulkit sees Sanjh’s name on the LOR list, sparking Akshat’s anger. He accuses Sanjh of nepotism, leading to a heated exchange. However, Ananda names Akshat as the best intern, with a surprising twist yet to come!

videos.title: The Day Akshat's Dream Shattered
videos.overview: New season begins at Veridian Super Speciality Hospital, Bhopal. Akshat remains a workaholic doctor who's forgotten life beyond the hospital, while Rishi tries to bring him back to the real world. Saanjh's return forces him to confront their past, Aditya's presence fuels tension. With interns Nayantara, Pooja & Kaushik joining, money and medicine soon collide behind the polished facade.

videos.title: She Trusted His Gut, Not The Reports
videos.overview: Akshat struggles between his feelings for Saanjh and Aditya's growing presence in her life. A tough case forces the young doctors to unite, reminding Akshat why he chose medicine. Rishi and Nayantara's bond deepens beyond attraction, while Pooja gets drawn to Samar. Meanwhile, Akshat begins to see the gap between the ideal hospital he envisioned and the reality of Veridian.

videos.title: He Was In Love With Her First
videos.overview: Akshat grows closer to Saanjh but realises Aditya isn't leaving, turning rivalry personal. Rishi & Nayantara's flirtation deepens, while Pooja and Samar slowly connect despite complications. At Veridian, Akshat notices expensive treatments pushed over cheaper options. Khurana justifies it as world-class care, leaving Akshat impressed yet increasingly uncomfortable and conflicted

videos.title: Is This Even A Date?
videos.overview: A patient under Jeevan Suraksha gets a huge hospital bill, shocking Akshat since treatment was supposed to be covered under the scheme. He confronts Khurana, who quietly cancels it but warns Akshat to focus on treating, not billing. Akshat lets it go for now. Meanwhile, Aditya finally asks Saanjh out, further complicating things between her and Akshat.

videos.title: Two Dates, One Broken Heart
videos.overview: Akshat struggles to understand what Saanjh wants while Aditya becomes more protective of her. Rishi and Nayantara find their casual relationship harder to keep casual. Pooja sees a softer side of Samar, although he keeps his personal life separate from work. At Veridian, doctors are increasingly encouraged to consider revenue alongside patient treatment.

videos.title: This Isn't My Home Anymore
videos.overview: Akshat and Saanjh work on the same case and their old chemistry returns. Aditya becomes insecure as he sees them grow closer. Rishi and Nayantara try to define their relationship but avoid calling it one. Pooja touches a nerve when she asks Samar about his personal life. Akshat also sees another troubling link between medical treatment and money at Veridian.

videos.title: Told To Stay Away From Her
videos.overview: Rishi and Nayantara insist their relationship is only physical, but their chemistry keeps bringing them back together. Akshat becomes more proactive in pursuing Saanjh, while Aditya feels threatened and makes a mistake trying to compete. Pooja tries to make peace with Samar. Akshat also begins seriously questioning Khurana when an expensive treatment is presented as the only option.

videos.title: She Asked Him, Not Aditya
videos.overview: Akshat helps Saanjh find a new house, bringing them closer. Aditya asks Saanjh to move in with him, but she says she has already asked Akshat for help. Rishi and Nayantara decide to stop sleeping together but cannot stay apart. Samar's personal problems affect Pooja. Veridian launches its cosmetology wing with Khurana and the MLA, while a Jeevan Suraksha patient is denied the scheme benefit.

videos.title: A Car He Could Never Give Her
videos.overview: Akshat and Saanjh begin to feel like a real couple, but Aditya refuses to step away. Saanjh questions whether the relationship her mother wants for her is what she truly wants. Rishi and Nayantara struggle to define a normal relationship. Pooja and Samar grow closer despite his fears. Akshat connects the Jeevan Suraksha cases and suspects that the problem is not isolated.

videos.title: The Party That Ended In Blood
videos.overview: The tension between Akshat, Saanjh and Aditya begins affecting their work. Saanjh is torn between her feelings for Akshat and her family's expectations, while Aditya becomes more desperate to keep her. Rishi and Nayantara remain complicated, and Pooja and Samar struggle with their age and hierarchy difference. Akshat still trusts Khurana, but doubts about Veridian are becoming harder to ignore.

videos.title: I Love You, Please Wake Up
videos.overview: After an emotional confrontation, Saanjh drives away and suffers a serious accident. Akshat finds her and stays with her as her condition deteriorates. As her vitals crash, he finally admits that he loves her. Saanjh responds by squeezing his hand and slowly regaining consciousness.

videos.title: Suspended For Trying To Help Her
videos.overview: Saanjh survives but is not cleared to return to work. She begins psychiatric counselling and confronts the emotions she has kept controlled. Akshat and Aditya keep their distance, while Rishi and Nayantara try to remain professional after ending their casual relationship. Saanjh admits she was running from her feelings, which helps her receive medical clearance and return to the hospital.

videos.title: She Finally Admits Why She Crashed
videos.overview: Saanjh returns to work but remains emotionally unsettled. Akshat wants to celebrate her return, but she struggles with the aftermath. Aditya continues presenting himself as the safer choice. Rishi and Nayantara realise their feelings are becoming serious, while Samar and Pooja grow closer despite his fears. Akshat's doubts about Veridian's financial practices continue to grow.

videos.title: Their Sabzi Mandi Almost - Kiss
videos.overview: Akshat and Saanjh finally talk, but they want different things from their relationship. Saanjh wants control over her own life, while Akshat wants clarity. Dr Arora tries to control Saanjh's choices again, but Saanjh draws a line with her mother. At the hospital, Akshat begins looking more closely at the money behind Veridian Cares.

videos.title: Their First Kiss, At The Charity Ball
videos.overview: The emotional distance between Akshat and Saanjh grows, and Akshat suspects she may know more about Khurana's activities than she admits. Aditya uses the uncertainty to get closer to her. Rishi and Nayantara struggle to behave like a normal couple. Samar remains afraid of being judged for his feelings for Pooja. Veridian's charity initiatives look increasingly suspicious to Akshat.

videos.title: The Trap Is Being Set
videos.overview: The Veridian Cares charity ball presents Veridian as a hospital for people who cannot afford treatment. Akshat believes the money will help patients like the driver's daughter. Behind the celebration, the funds are redirected to cover hospital losses. Akshat begins to understand that the charity is not what it appears to be, while doubts about Saanjh's loyalties affect their relationship.

videos.title: An Offer He Couldn't Refuse
videos.overview: Akshat discovers that Veridian Cares funds have been used elsewhere and new patients are no longer accepted under the scheme. The driver's daughter is among those denied treatment. Furious, Akshat realises the charity ball solved nothing. Aditya offers to help find another doctor for the girl, briefly bringing the rivals together, but Akshat knows the problem is bigger than one patient.

videos.title: Locked Down And Framed
videos.overview: An outbreak creates chaos at Veridian and pushes the doctors to their limits. Akshat investigates the Veridian Cares money while the medical team works long hours. Rishi and Nayantara try to discuss their relationship honestly. Samar realises fear of judgement is costing him his relationship with Pooja. The crisis pushes all three love stories toward a breaking point.

videos.title: Her Family's Hospital Is For Sale
videos.overview: The outbreak forces Veridian into lockdown. Akshat continues tracing the scheme money. The driver's daughter's condition worsens and the hospital refuses to spend more on treatment. Akshat sees the scale of what Khurana and the MLA have been doing. Saanjh begins investigating after realising Akshat may be right, while Aditya must confront the truth he knew more about than he admitted.

videos.title: One Gunshot Changes Everything
videos.overview: Akshat is ready to leave Veridian, Bhopal and possibly medicine. Before he can resign, the driver returns with a gun and takes everyone hostage, demanding treatment for his daughter. Saanjh finds proof of Khurana's financial fraud and gives it to Akshat despite the risk. She ends her relationship with Akshat, while Aditya admits the truth. Rishi supports Nayantara and Samar chooses Pooja.

series|tmdb:315194.name: Thadayam
series|tmdb:315194.description: In 1999, a string of brutal midnight murders terrifies tamil nadu's border villages but when a sharp new officer arrives, he uncovers a chilling pattern.

series|tmdb:322484.name: Podarillu
series|tmdb:322484.description: In a bid to escape her ill-fate, Maha becomes the daughter-in-law of a family with a tainted past. Can she restore their lost hope, or will it shatter hers?

series|tmdb:273771.name: Soul Stories
series|tmdb:273771.description: Soul Stories is a Malayalam web series directed by Sanil Kalathil, featuring Anarkali Marikar and Renji Panicker in lead roles. Produced by Manorama Max, the series focuses on the often-overlooked experiences of women living in a patriarchal society, providing a compelling narrative that encourages viewers to reflect on social issues.

series|tmdb:300515.name: Rambo in Love
series|tmdb:300515.description: An almost bankrupt entrepreneur needs funds urgently to save his business. What happens when the new investor turns out to be his ex, whom he had betrayed?

series|tmdb:310127.name: Thalapathy Thiruvizha - Jana Nayagan Audio Launch
series|tmdb:310127.description: The Jananayagan Audio Launch unveils the soundtrack with thrilling performances, exciting moments and exclusive insights, building emotional connect and excitement ahead of the film’s grand release.

series|tmdb:298957.name: Bigg Boss Telugu: Agnipariksha
series|tmdb:298957.description: Bigg Boss Agnipariksha is a digital pre-show of Bigg Boss 9 Telugu and a spin-off of the Indian reality television show Bigg Boss. The pre-show involves selecting commoner contestants for the main show.

series|tmdb:297839.name: Mothevari Love Story
series|tmdb:297839.description: Parshi and Anitha, two spirited youngsters from rural Telangana, are madly in love and decide to elope. Meanwhile, a shocking twist emerges.

series|tmdb:275993.name: Valsalyam
series|tmdb:275993.description: Nandhini's husband Jayaram abandons her for another woman, Madhuri. After Madhuri's death, Nandhini gets the custody of Madhuri's daughter who hates her. Will time heal old wounds?

series|tmdb:294077.name: Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting
series|tmdb:294077.description: Set in the 1980s in the remote and fear-stricken, eerie village of Viraatapalem, which faces a strange chilling curse – every bride dies mysteriously on her wedding day, halting marriages for over a decade. A determined police constable refuses to believe this superstition and, along with a reformed convict, begins to unearth shocking secrets the villagers want hidden.

series|tmdb:332299.name: Clean Up Company
series|tmdb:332299.description: 3 boys stumble upon an opportunity to make easy money by getting rid of dead bodies in a small city marred by gang wars. Things quickly take a turn for the worse and they end up neck deep in trouble fighting to survive.

series|tmdb:328818.name: 108 Base Hospital Uri
series|tmdb:328818.description: Resilient army doctors at 108 Base Hospital, Uri, navigate personal and professional battles whilst saving lives in a conflict-torn zone.

series|tmdb:275992.name: Subhadram
series|tmdb:275992.description: Subhadra helps her siblings flee her home with her newborn baby when she learns that her husband Meghanathan wants to kill them for their wealth. The plot unravels the challenges they face in life.

series|tmdb:294178.name: Good Wife
series|tmdb:294178.description: Lawyer-turned-homemaker Tharunika's 16 Years of marriage life and her peaceful world is shattered and is forced to return to the courtroom after her husband, becomes embroiled in a high–profile sex and political corruption scandal.

series|tmdb:332022.name: Laziness Saves
series|tmdb:332022.description: Launched by HDFC Bank, 'Vigil Aunty Says - Laziness Saves', a fraud awareness campaign featuring its Vigil Aunty character alongside seven stand-up comedians.

series|tmdb:282467.name: Sivarapalli
series|tmdb:282467.description: Shyam, an engineering graduate from Hyderabad, reluctantly takes up the job of Panchayat Secretary in Sivarapalli, a remote village in Telangana, due to a lack of job options. The show follows Shyam as he navigates the idiosyncrasies and absurdities of village life and his job while preparing for the GMAT, hoping to leave the village and move to the USA.

series|tmdb:275988.name: Parvathy
series|tmdb:275988.description: Parvathy is gifted with a sense of foreseeing dangers and the future. She marries Vishal under unusual circumstances and battles to save his life after sensing he is in danger.

series|tmdb:278073.name: Harikatha: Sambhavami Yuge Yuge
series|tmdb:278073.description: When 'god' goes on a killing spree in an idyllic village, a police officer with a traumatic past gets inadvertently pulled into the mystery.

series|tmdb:278203.name: Vere Level Office
series|tmdb:278203.description: Vere Level Office' welcomes you into the digital age. An e-commerce branch faces the threat of downsizing. Experience the daily chaos, where experienced employees and fresh newcomers clash and connect, turning work problems into funny and surprising moments. Who knew office life could be so much fun..! Don't miss it.

series|tmdb:282063.name: Geetha Govindam
series|tmdb:282063.description: A middle-aged businessman Govind, falls in love with Geethanjali, a young girl. Their unusual love story takes a hit when his past overshadows his present.

series|tmdb:275991.name: Shyamambaram
series|tmdb:275991.description: Shyama, a talented singer, marries a rich man, Akhil, who helps her overcome her insecurities about her looks and gain success.

tt43588323.name: Yeh Fitoor Tera
tt43588323.description: Saumya, a reclusive young woman burdened by traumatic past fears, lives a quiet life shielded from the world. Everything changes when she meets Jeet, a bold, free-spirited rebel who enters her life with fierce intensity.

series|tmdb:236891.name: Mizhirandilum
series|tmdb:236891.description: Lakshmi, an orphan, has endured bad treatment from her stepmother her whole life. She meets her potential groom, Sanjay, but she suffers another painful blow from fate.

tt31843251.name: Snakes & Ladders
tt31843251.description: Curated by Karthik Subbaraj, set in the 2000s, this story is about four reckless kids trying to cover up an accidental crime, only to find themselves caught in worse situations - chased by cops, dim-witted thugs, and their own bad choices!

series|tmdb:275676.name: Ayalum Njanum Thammil
series|tmdb:275676.description: Life gives the duo a second chance when Abhiram, a widowed father of twin girls, and Vasundhara, a divorced mother with a son, marry each other. But their paths are strewn with obstacles.

series|tmdb:270760.name: Goli Soda Rising
series|tmdb:270760.description: In the bustling Koyambedu Market, four boys rise from obscurity to carve out their own identity. However, they realise that the pursuit of identity is endless.

tt32590226.name: Laughter Chefs Unlimited Entertainment
tt32590226.description: Colors presents an innovative blend of celebrity personalities, culinary skills, and comedy, all coming together for a delightful entertainment experience.

videos.title: The culinary battle begins!
videos.overview: Crispy jalebi with three rings is the challenge for celebrity couples. Who will win the golden star and claim the season's first victory?

videos.title: It's time to cook Shaadi Ke Laddu
videos.overview: Laddu showdown! Celebrity chefs battle it out under Chef Sokhi's watchful eye. Hilarious twists and intense competition‚Äîwho'll be crowned Laddu King?

videos.title: Sonam savours the Desi dishes
videos.overview: Desi delights take center stage as contestants cook up a storm. Sonam Bajwa and Ammy Virk judge the feast. Who will impress the stars and win?

videos.title: It's a birthday cake challenge!
videos.overview: A surprise birthday cake challenge throws contestants for a loop.  The chef simplifies it: decorate, but follow the rules! Who will bake the best?

videos.title: Sweet laughs, sweet dishes
videos.overview: Bharti Singh brings the laughs as contestants face a sweet challenge: making masala milk and ras malai. Can they handle the heat and complete the task?

videos.title: A challenge for steady hands
videos.overview: Chocolate Balloon Bowls: a culinary challenge that tests nerves and skills.  Amidst the chaos, laughter fills the room. Who will emerge victorious?

videos.title: A spicy challenge!
videos.overview: Get creative with Chaat and Pani Puri! Contestants battle it out for culinary supremacy.

Simple conversations quickly escalate into heated arguments, revealing fragile alliances and bruised insecurities. The episode establishes the show’s core theme—where confrontation equals relevance—and positions Rajat as a polarizing catalyst whose presence guarantees chaos from the very start.

tt28102595.name: Freedom at Midnight

Congress and Muslim League leaders feverishly speculate over which town will fall on which side of the border, as communal tensions continue to flare across the country.

videos.title: Tryst With Destiny
videos.overview: India and Pakistan prepare for their respective days of independence, but the celebrations are fraught with tension and violence. India steps into a new era at the midnight hour, but partition and the division of the army loom large.

videos.title: Exodus
videos.overview: The Boundary Award is announced, igniting outrage on both sides. Gripped by fear, a mass exodus of minorities across the border begins as Nehru and Patel grapple with the consequences of partition. Punjab descends into chaos and horror while Gandhi tries to save Bengal from the same fate. And one refugee vows revenge against the Mahatma.

videos.title: Basket Of Apples
videos.overview: Sardar Patel, V.P. Menon, and Lord Mountbatten strategically approach the various princely states to solidify their accession into India. But the Nawabs and Maharajas of some states refuse to accede without a fight.

videos.title: Kashmir
videos.overview: A tribal invasion into Kashmir instigates the first war between India and Pakistan. Amid the tension in the war-room, Nehru and Patel form opposing views on how to find an end to the war.

videos.title: The Last Fast
videos.overview: Gandhi announces a fast unto death to help restore some semblance of peace between the two communities, and nations. Nehru and Patel have a falling out over the state of the country. Madanlal Pahwa and his allies make their way to Delhi to carry out their sinister plan.

videos.title: Hey Ram!
videos.overview: Gandhi deals with the growing rift between Nehru and Patel. An unknown gunman makes his way to the daily prayer meet held at Birla House. The nation is forced to confront its grief.

series|tmdb:328398.name: Marham
series|tmdb:328398.description: When his wife Shweta goes missing, Call center employee Saurabh turns the world around him upside down. While the needle of suspicion points at various people from her father to their neighbors, the final revelation shakes the ground of trust beneath his feet.

series|tmdb:308964.name: Bhabiji Ghar Par Hai 2.0
series|tmdb:308964.description: To secure the mansion, Tiwari pretends to marry Anita while Vibhuti pairs up with Angoori, but their ruse falls apart when Gayatri Devi recovers and Vidya Sister-in-law's ghost traps them in Ghunghatganj.

tt32379268.name: Jamnapaar
tt32379268.description: Depicting life from the humble homes of East Delhi to the glamourous skyscrapers of South Delhi, the narrative revolves around Shanky’s life.

videos.title: Kuyein Ka Mendhak
videos.overview: Shantanu Bansal aka Shanky is living an unremarkable life in Laxminagar, Jamnapaar. However, one day a chance visit to a fancy Gurgaon client puts things into perspective for him and Shanky comes back totally enamoured by the corproate dream across the Yamuna river and a false sense of acknowledegement.

videos.title: Hath Ko Aaya, Muh Na Laga
videos.overview: Shanky is determined to go back to Lunatek, the fancy Gurgaon firm, by hook or by crook. Meanwhile all Jamnapaar forces align against him, making him feel more claustrophobic about his Jamnapaar life.

videos.title: Darr Ke Aage Jeet Hai?
videos.overview: Shanky, after failing to secure the Gurgaon client, finds out there's still a chance to secure an articleship transfer in a Big 4 across Yamuna. His quest ends in public embarrassment as he swears to leave Jamnapaar for good.

videos.title: Papa Kehte Hain!
videos.overview: After securing AIR 5 in all of Delhi in CA Finals, Shanky's father announces him as the successor of KD Bansal classes. However, things go really south when Shanky tells his father he has already secured a job in south delhi and has no interest in running his coaching classes.

videos.title: Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: After a major showdown with his father, Shanky has left jamnapaar and is struggling to adapt in his South Delhi life. However, a lecture leak scandal involving his father makes him take a resolve that he will never return to Jamnapaar.

videos.title: Fake It Till You Make It
videos.overview: Despite becoming Shan from Shantanu and undergoing a 360 degree makeover, Shantanu is still not able to fit in South Delhi. However, one chance encounter with his gorgeous cafe owner client, Sara, gives him a unique mantra to win South Delhi over and that he does!

videos.title: Heart Vs Brain
videos.overview: Shantanu is thriving in South Delhi and enjoying his fancy new clients, cool friend circle and blossoming romance with Sara. However, Shantanu soon finds himself very torn as a very lucrative partnership offer presents itself but in exchange of his morals that also costs him an important family event.

videos.title: Father Figure
videos.overview: Shantanu's mother Pushpa Bansal meets with an accident which brings Shantanu back to Jamnapaar. Ego clashes between Shantanu and KD Bansal erupt again and Shantanu realises his father will never understand his feelings or potential and goes in the tutelage of his childhood idol, newfound mentor and star entrepreneur, Rajat Thapar.

videos.title: Jamnapaari Sab Pe Bhaari
videos.overview: Shantanu is arrested by the Economics Offence Division (EoD) over financial fraud charges in partnership with Rajat Thapar. When all his South Delhi friends and acquaintances fail to stand by him, Shantanu realises it is ultimately Jamnapaar, his own neighbourhood, which rallies behind him in support and brings him out of the custody.

videos.title: Gharwapsi
videos.overview: Shantanu comes back home to Jamnapaar as he awaits the CA council's decision in his case. In the meantime, he makes amends with everyone he had judged and hurt in Jamnapaar. He loses his CA license for a year but realises a much more valuable lesson i.e. it's not which part of the city you're born in, it matters what people are you born amongst.

videos.title: Paisa Ya Morals
videos.overview: Suspended CA Shantanu “Shanky” Bansal battles between ambition and integrity as scams, love, and family ideals collide. Just as he begins to find his moral compass, a tragic fire at Bansal Classes forces him to question the ethics he thought he stood for.

videos.title: Kehni Aur Karni
videos.overview: Amid audits and political heat after the Bansal Classes fire, Shanky clashes with his father over bribery and ethics, losing both faith and love. Pushed by desperation, he finally joins his friends’ scam ring—only to step into the perilous world of Shaukeen Bhaiyya.

videos.title: Chance Pe Dance
videos.overview: Trapped in Shaukeen Bhaiyya’s shady empire, Shanky dives into cons to survive as Bansal Classes crumble and family tensions erupt. In a daring move, he saves his home through deceit—marking the start of his moral downfall

videos.title: Apne Paraaye
videos.overview: As Jamnapaar turns on the Bansals, Shanky’s uneasy alliance with Shaukeen fuels suspicion and chaos. When a violent sabotage forces the family to flee their own home, Shanky faces the haunting cost of power and betrayal.

videos.title: Full Power
videos.overview: Exiled to Shailja's place and disillusioned, Shanky finds power and purpose in Shaukeen’s e-waste empire. But as Ramneek closes in and KD Bansal grows wary, Shanky’s newfound success begins to smell of danger.

videos.title: Morals Vs Progress
videos.overview: As Shanky hides Shaukeen’s empire behind a designer façade, the return of his ex, Sara, tangles business with buried emotions. But when KD uncovers family secrets and erupts, a storm tears through the Bansals—pitting father against son once and for all.

videos.title: CA - Calling
videos.overview: As Shanky rises as Shaukeen’s trusted lieutenant, his buried CA instincts resurface - blurring lines between pride and peril. But just as he finds purpose again, a family tragedy strikes Shanky.

videos.title: Pehchaan
videos.overview: KD returns from the brink of death with newfound humility and perspective on identity, mending his family and faith. As Shanky exposes a powerful conspiracy and fights for justice, the long-divided Bansals finally unite—just as a deeper storm looms ahead.

videos.title: Aakhri Attempt
videos.overview: As the Bansals rediscover unity and compassion, Shanky exposes the dark underbelly of Uncoaching’s online education empire. In a fiery showdown at an educational event, he turns the tide—toppling Saransh’s façade and reigniting Jamnapaar’s spirit.

videos.title: Galat Raste Ki Bus
videos.overview: Haunted by his past and craving redemption, Shanky’s world unravels just as hope returns to the Bansals. But Shanky’s search for truth explodes into a deadly face-off with Shaukeen himself leaving with him a big moral dilemma.

tt27303022.name: Gutar Gu
tt27303022.description: Ritu joins a coaching class in Bhopal and notices Anuj on the first day. She introduces herself to Anuj, which startles him. He seeks advice from friends on how to impress her. Ritu asks Anuj to help her explore the city but he cancels at the last minute. Anuj writes a love letter and must now confess his feelings to Ritu and pray she feels the same way.

videos.title: Welcome to the Club of Aashiqs
videos.overview: Ritu joins a coaching class in Bhopal and notices Anuj on the first day. She introduces herself to Anuj, which startles him. He seeks advice from friends on how to impress her. Ritu asks Anuj to help her explore the city but he cancels at the last minute. Anuj writes a love letter and must now confess his feelings to Ritu and pray she feels the same way.

videos.title: Darr Ke Aage Kiss Hai
videos.overview: Ritu joins a coaching class in Bhopal and notices Anuj on the first day. She introduces herself to Anuj, which startles him. He seeks advice from friends on how to impress her. Ritu asks Anuj to help her explore the city but he cancels at the last minute. Anuj writes a love letter and must now confess his feelings to Ritu and pray she feels the same way.

videos.title: Eent Ka Jawab Patthar Se
videos.overview: Ritu unknowingly catches the eye of Samrat, the school's boxing champion. Samrat warns Anuj to back off from Ritu or else there's going to be a fight. Initially, Anuj is scared stiff but soon he realizes that to keep Ritu as his girlfriend and to save his own face, he must prepare for this mano-a-mano showdown. He's gotta fight for his girl. He just doesn't know how.

videos.title: How Well Do You Know Ritu?
videos.overview: Anuj gets prepared to meet Ritu's Gurgaon friends but the whole experience gets sour for him as they end up constantly making fun of him. Ritu tries to console him but they end up arguing and Anuj leaves. What follows is the first major fight between Anuj and Ritu. Will this lead to their break up or will someone apologise for their mistakes?

videos.title: Why Do You Love Me?
videos.overview: Ritu and Anuj plan their first valentine's date but they fear getting caught by the local love-hating political gang. They ask Adi, Umair and Sonal to accompany them for safety. They end up going to a fancy restaurant in Bhopal but the bill is beyond their expectation. Ritu tries to get the money while Anuj is held hostage at the restaurant.

videos.title: Sab Sambhal Lenge
videos.overview: After dating each other for more than six months Anuj and Ritu have to face what the future holds for them. Anuj's mom finds out about the relationship and grounds him completely for his exam preparations. Ritu has an important decision she needs to discuss with him but they have been completely separated by Anuj's mom. Will their relationship stay intact?

videos.title: Will You Be My Sukhi Puri?
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu's relationship faces a challenge when Ritu gets admitted to a college in Ahmedabad. Desperate to follow her, Anuj and his friends try to convince his parents that studying in Ahmedabad is the best move. Unfortunately, Anuj's mother catches on to the plot and discovers that Ritu is also going to Ahmedabad. As Ritu and Anuj prepare for the final goodbye, tensions escalate.

videos.title: Long Distance Wali Gutar Gu
videos.overview: Ritu and Anuj begin their long-distance relationship with caution and sincerity. They set alarms for breakfast, lunch, and dinner to text and call each other, ensuring their 'Gutar Gu' continues. As the pressure of fitting into their respective colleges and pursuing their passion takes a toll on their schedules, Anuj grows anxious about weakening his bond with Ritu.

videos.title: Fresh Friendship Brewing
videos.overview: Shivangi enters the world of Gutar Gu as Anuj's playwright. Little does she know that this play is Anuj's ticket to meeting Ritu in Ahmedabad and she starts to make a move on Anuj and the real test of his fidelity for Ritu begins. Shivangi and Anuj end up in situations that make Ritu question Anuj's loyalty. Anuj comes clean to Ritu but will she forgive and forget this one mistake?

videos.title: Am I Ready Yet?
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu are going to see each other after months of long-distance separation in Ahmedabad. Both are getting unsolicited advice from their respective friends on the possibility of them getting intimate with each other. As Anuj arrives in Ahmedabad, the tension between them begins to build as both try to follow the advice given by their friends.

videos.title: 3,2,1… Happy New Year
videos.overview: Ritu and Anuj have glorious and hopeful New Year's Eve plans, which also include the possibility of Anuj booking a hotel room for them. Ritu takes up an internship where her experience is not what she anticipated. Anuj stands with Ritu like a rock and comforts her. On New Year's Eve, the duo dines together in a unique set-up and we know that long distance has only strengthened their bond.

videos.title: Baat Se Hi Toh Baat Banti Hai
videos.overview: Anuj lands the final audition for a two-season web show and Ritu surprises him in Bhopal and tells him about an upcoming internship opportunity in Mumbai. If Anuj lands the part both can head to Mumbai together. Ritu declines a major internship in Singapore just to be with Anuj in Mumbai but the latter comes out of the audition without appearing for it fearing his parents will never send him.

videos.title: Welcome To Mumbai
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu finally make it to Mumbai to live out their pehla live-in! But the universe, and mummy ji, had other plans. While Anuj juggles auditions and odd hours, his mom’s mostly home, wondering where he is. Just when things couldn’t get messier, Ritu’s apartment ceiling collapse. With no hotel money and no way she's calling her parents, she turns to Anuj for help.

videos.title: Kebab Mein Mummy
videos.overview: With mummy ji still around, things at the flat start getting cramped for our favourite couple. Ritu begins house hunting, accompanied by Anuj’s Mom. Meanwhile, Anuj, desperate to send his mom back to Bhopal, ropes in his crew for a dramatic fake emergency call. These antics make Ritu even more upset, and what follows is Ritu and Anuj’s releaization.

videos.title: Live-in Waali Gutar Gu
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu finally begin living together properly as Anuj’s Mom leaves for Bhopal. They enjoy setting up their home, navigating chores, and bonding over routines. However, differences start surfacing — Anuj’s carelessness and Ritu’s growing professional responsibilities strain their relationship. Ritu starts questioning the emotional balance between love and habit.

videos.title: The First Time
videos.overview: Anuj and Ritu plan to get intimate for the first time. When the moment finally arrives, nerves and awkwardness kick in. Things don’t go as expected, leaving both feeling awkward and insecure. As the tension lingers, unspoken insecurities start to creep in, about themselves, and each other. With a little help from unexpected corners, they slowly begin to navigate the messy side of intimacy.

videos.title: Gupt Gyaan 2.0
videos.overview: It’s Anuj’s birthday, and he expects a surprise. But Ritu seems distracted, leading him to feel neglected. Meanwhile, Ritu plans a surprise party with the Bhopal Gang. As the day unfolds, unexpected emotions surface, pushing both Anuj and Ritu to reflect on their future in ways they hadn’t before.

videos.title: Do We Have a Future Together?
videos.overview: The Gutar Gu gang goes on a trekking trip. Amid breathtaking views and playful moments, Anuj and Ritu’s contrasting attitudes about the future emerge. They meet ex-couple trek leaders who broke up over life goals but remain friends. This resonates with Anuj and Ritu, sparking an argument about whether love is enough when ambitions don’t align.

videos.overview: Kamala's memories reveal a new clue, giving Lekha the upper hand. As husband and wife face off in court, Madhav scrambles to defend Raj with mounting evidence against him.
videos.description: Kamala's memories reveal a new clue, giving Lekha the upper hand. As husband and wife face off in court, Madhav scrambles to defend Raj with mounting evidence against him.

videos.name: Sins of the Privileged
videos.overview: With 2 days to prepare, Madhav faces Kamala on the stand. Lekha changes tactics with a surprise witness. Her closing argument casts doubt on the Nagpal family, pushing Madhav to the edge.
videos.description: With 2 days to prepare, Madhav faces Kamala on the stand. Lekha changes tactics with a surprise witness. Her closing argument casts doubt on the Nagpal family, pushing Madhav to the edge.

videos.name: The Missing Link
videos.overview: As Raj's defence begins, Madhav calls a new witness. Meanwhile, Ratna and Deep uncover crucial evidence, rushing to court and shifting the trial's dynamics dramatically.
videos.description: As Raj's defence begins, Madhav calls a new witness. Meanwhile, Ratna and Deep uncover crucial evidence, rushing to court and shifting the trial's dynamics dramatically.

videos.name: The Higher Law
videos.overview: As the trial nears its end, Anju's testimony unveils new secrets. A closed-chamber meeting calls an unexpected witness, and Madhav senses the case is far from over.
videos.description: As the trial nears its end, Anju's testimony unveils new secrets. A closed-chamber meeting calls an unexpected witness, and Madhav senses the case is far from over.

tt36072066.name: Don't Fly Too Much
tt36072066.description: A high-flying comedy where Goldie, a privileged heir in disguise as Gopal, navigates crazy crew antics, wild passengers, and in-flight chaos to prove his worth!

videos.title: Goldie’s Flight to Chaos Begins
videos.overview: Goldie’s birthday bash turns tragic when his tycoon dad dies mid-flight. Now heir to Air-Aasman, he must juggle a double life as a steward with chaos, love, and turbulence.

videos.title: Mystery in the Air, Panic on Board
videos.overview: A mysterious note threatens to reveal Gopal’s secret! As he investigates mid-air, he suspects his quirky crew, but a mid-flight chaos could be the thing that blows his cover.

videos.title: Sabotage in the Skies
