videos.overview: An enraged Lakshman threatens the villagers, demanding to know Luv and Kush's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush offer prayers to Shani Dev, seeking his assistance. Later, Shri Ram instructs Bharat to confront the Rishikumars.

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ki Duvidha
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan devises a scheme to create conflict between Shri Ram and his sons. Meanwhile, Bharat intervenes to calm Lakshman’s rising anger. Lord Hanuman attempts to persuade Luv and Kush to return the Ashwa.

videos.title: Ashwa Ki Raksha
videos.overview: Luv and Kush grow anxious as the Ashwa is taken away by the Asur. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman is ensnared by a serpent, and Lakshman prepares to confront Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Ashwa Ki Talash
videos.overview: Luv and Kush, accompanied by Lord Hanuman, search for the Ashwa, while Mata Sita grows anxious when Somkaran returns to the Ashram without them. Will Luv and Kush succeed in finding the Ashwa in time?

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ka Rajdroh
videos.overview: Luv, Kush, and Lord Hanuman race against time, with only until sunset to locate the Ashwa. Meanwhile, Lakshman arrives at the Ashram in search of the Rishikumars, as Shri Ram addresses the people of Ayodhya about the missing Ashwa.

videos.title: Bhakti Ka Marg
videos.overview: Luv and Kush choose to battle Lord Hanuman for the Ashwa and manage to capture him. Meanwhile, Mata Sita's prayers are interrupted by a group of men.

videos.title: Devi Ki Pooja
videos.overview: Mata Sita is advised not to pray to Mata Tripura Sundari as King Dhanyamali is expected to arrive. Meanwhile, Lakshman issues a final warning to Luv and Kush and confronts them with a challenge.

videos.title: Luv Aur Kush Ka Sahas
videos.overview: Mata Sita remains steadfast in her prayers, undeterred by the threats to her life. Meanwhile, Lakshman confronts Luv and Kush in a face-off. Later, Shri Ram receives the news of Lakshman's defeat.

videos.title: Udandta Ki Seema
videos.overview: Shri Ram, enraged upon learning about Lakshman's defeat, decides to confront Luv and Kush personally. Meanwhile, Mata Sita and Luv-Kush face off against King Dhanyamali and his army.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ka Prahaar
videos.overview: Luv and Kush fiercely battle King Dhanyamali's army to safeguard Mata Sita, while Lord Hanuman defends the Ashwa from Sahasramukh Ravan's forces. Eventually, King Dhanyamali's men apologize to Mata Sita.

videos.title: Bharat Ke Mann Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Bharat confides in Shri Ram, expressing his feelings of failure. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush worry that Mata Sita might discover the truth about the Ashwa and reprimand them. Will Mata Sita uncover what happened?

videos.title: Bharat Ki Chetavani
videos.overview: Kush pleads with everyone at the Ashram to keep the missing Ashwa a secret from Mata Sita. Luv and Kush offer Lord Hanuman food prepared by Mata Sita. Later, Bharat confronts Luv and Kush, issuing a warning as he readies his bow against them.

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ke Praan Ko Sankat
videos.overview: Bharat confronts Luv and Kush, while Lord Hanuman intervenes to stop him. Meanwhile, the crops at the Ashram are destroyed, and Bharat’s army overpowers the Rishikumars. Will Luv and Kush remain safe?

videos.title: Luv Aur Kush Ki Ranneeti
videos.overview: Luv and Kush find themselves encircled by Bharat and his army. Meanwhile, Mata Sita enters the fire to rescue a child. Later, Sugriva and Vibhishan arrive to confront Luv and Kush after Bharat is injured.

videos.title: Antaraatma Ka Dharm
videos.overview: Mata Sita emerges unscathed from the fire, thwarting Sahasramukh's plan. Sugriva and Vibhishan confront Luv and Kush, demanding they surrender the Ashwa. Later, the Vanar Sena engages in battle with Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Sugriva Ka Gussa
videos.overview: Mata Sita bravely confronts the wolf, while Luv and Kush stand against Sugriva's fury. Will Sugriva overpower the Rishikumars?

videos.title: Van Devi Ka Satya
videos.overview: The residents of the Ashram demand answers about Van Devi. Lord Hanuman turns to Mahadev for guidance to safeguard Mata Sita. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush confront Angad.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Gaurav
videos.overview: Luv and Kush boldly challenge the formidable Angad to a battle. Meanwhile, Mata Sita grows anxious for their safety and sets out in search of them. Later, Shri Ram raises his arrow against the Rishikumars.

videos.title: Yagya Ka Antim Charan
videos.overview: Shri Ram embarks on a mission to retrieve the Ashwa. Meanwhile, Asurs disguised as Luv and Kush set fire to the village, enraging Shri Ram. Later, Shri Ram and the real Luv and Kush come face to face.

videos.title: Shri Ram Aur Luv-Kush Ki Beth
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Luv-Kush come face to face as Mata Sita searches for her sons. Will the Rishikumars engage in battle with their revered Shri Ram?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ke Nirnaye Par Prashna
videos.overview: Luv and Kush confront Shri Ram, urging him to search for Mata Sita, while Shri Ram accuses them of burning down the village. Will this misunderstanding lead to a battle between them?

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ka Dharm Aur Kartavya
videos.overview: Mata Sita ventures out alone to confront the impending danger, keeping her departure a secret from everyone at the Ashram. Meanwhile, Shri Ram questions Luv and Kush about whether they informed their mother about the battle. Later, Mata Sita finds herself surrounded by Asurs.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Maan Sammaan
videos.overview: Maa Parvati safeguards Mata Sita from Sahasramukh Ravan’s wicked scheme. Shri Ram and Luv-Kush exchange arrows in a fierce confrontation. Meanwhile, the Gods grow anxious, witnessing the father and sons in conflict.

videos.title: Niyati Ka Antim Avsar
videos.overview: As the sun sets, Shri Ram issues a final warning to Luv and Kush. Lord Hanuman advises the Rishikumars to summon their mother. Meanwhile, Sahasramukh Ravan fears for his life.

videos.title: Dharm Ki Shakti
videos.overview: Shri Ram reunites with his army, wounded by the arrows of Luv and Kush. Meanwhile, the Rishikumars resolve to confront Shri Ram despite his warnings. Elsewhere, Mata Sita comes face-to-face with Sahasramukh Ravan.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ravan Ki Chunauti
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan issues a challenge to Mata Sita as Luv and Kush search for her. Later, Mata Sita transforms into Goddess Lakshmi to face Sahasramukh Ravan.

videos.title: Bhalai Ki Lau
videos.overview: Luv and Kush discover Mata Sita lying unconscious. Sahasramukh Ravan confronts Shurpanakha for hiding the truth about Mata Sita being an incarnation of Goddess Lakshmi. Meanwhile, Shri Ram rescues Lakshman from the raging fire.

videos.title: Prahaar Ka Samay
videos.overview: Shri Ram rescues his army from the raging fire as Mata Sita moves closer to reuniting with him. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush offer food to Lord Hanuman and seek his guidance.

videos.title: Ashram Ka Marg
videos.overview: Shurpanakha spies on Luv and Kush, disguising herself as an old woman. Later, the Rishikumars cleverly escape the cave and make their way to the battleground to confront Shri Ram.

videos.title: Kalank Aur Lanchan
videos.overview: As Arya Sumant leads the Ashwa, Luv and Kush prepare to confront Shri Ram by raising their bows. Lord Hanuman attempts to reveal the truth to both Shri Ram and the Rishikumars, but his words go unheard. What destiny awaits Luv and Kush?

videos.title: Mahadev Ka Samay Chakra
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Luv-Kush come face-to-face as Sahasramukh Ravan revels in his triumph. Lord Shiva offers solace to a distressed Lord Hanuman, while Mata Sita grows increasingly anxious for her sons' safety.

videos.title: Kaha Hain Luv-Kush?
videos.overview: Mata Sita questions Somkaran about Luv and Kush's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Shri Ram and the Rishikumars remain locked in an intense battle. Concerned for her sons, Mata Sita prays fervently to Lord Shiva for their protection.

videos.title: Upastithi Ka Rahasya
videos.overview: Luv and Kush return and confront Shri Ram, standing resolutely before him. Maharishi Bharadwaj arrives with a remedy to heal Shri Ram's injured brothers. Meanwhile, Mata Sita reunites with her sons, and later, Luv and Kush reveal the entire truth to her.

videos.title: Pita Ki Chhaya
videos.overview: Mata Sita, disappointed by Luv and Kush's actions, decides on a severe punishment for them and questions Lord Hanuman about the ongoing battle.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ka Dukh
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are deeply remorseful for causing pain to their mother. Mata Sita begins her tapasya, seeking the well-being of her family. Meanwhile, Shri Ram expresses gratitude to Maharishi Bharadwaj for saving his brothers' lives.

videos.title: Hanumanji Ki Chinta
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman grapples with confusion over Rishi Bharadwaj’s silence about Luv and Kush’s true identity to Shri Ram. Mata Sita ends her tapasya following Lord Valmiki’s intervention. Later, Luv and Kush vow to uphold Mata Sita’s purity in Ayodhya.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ka Krodh
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan erupts in anger as Shurpanakha attempts to pacify him. Meanwhile, Shri Ram shares a meal with his brothers and army. Later, Luv and Kush embark on their journey to Ayodhya.

videos.title: Mrityu Ka Marg
videos.overview: Luv and Kush set out for Ayodhya, facing obstacles created by Sahasramukh Ravan along the way. Meanwhile, Shri Ram proceeds with the Ashwamedh Yagya.

videos.title: Luv-Kush KI Yojana
videos.overview: Luv and Kush venture into the cave to rescue the villagers, while Ayodhya eagerly awaits their arrival. Will they succumb to Sahasramukh Ravan's cunning trap?

videos.title: Shudhhata Ka Marg
videos.overview: Luv and Kush thwart Sahasramukh Ravan's trap by rescuing the villagers from the cave. Later, the Rishikumars work to inspire a shift in the villagers' perspectives on women.

videos.title: Sansaar Ka Uddharan
videos.overview: Luv and Kush, determined to restore their mother's honor, continue their journey. However, they encounter a fierce lion, a trap cunningly laid by Shurpanakha. Will they overcome this challenge?

videos.title: Kush Ki Peeda
videos.overview: Kush gets injured as Luv and Rishi Bharadwaj work to heal him. Meanwhile, Mata Sita grows anxious for her sons' safety.

videos.title: Mamta Ka Bal
videos.overview: Luv rescues Kush from the scorching lava and battles the demons as the poison in Kush's body spreads quickly. Later, they encounter a challenging maze. Can they find their way through?

videos.title: Sahayta Ki Pukaar
videos.overview: Luv and Kush turn to Shri Ram in prayer, seeking his guidance and support. Meanwhile, Shri Ram questions Lord Hanuman about how Luv and Kush managed to capture him. Later, Kush's condition worsens significantly.

videos.title: Uddeshya Path Ka Marg
videos.overview: The residents of Ayodhya block Luv and Kush from entering the city as the brothers attempt to explain their stance. Later, they make their way to the royal court and come face-to-face with Shri Ram.

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ki Maafi
videos.overview: Luv and Kush apologize to Lakshman for their earlier accusations and confront Shri Ram in the royal court. Meanwhile, Sahasramukh Ravan and Shurpanakha strategize their next plan.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Saral Jeevan
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are astonished to witness Shri Ram leading a humble life despite being a king. Determined to transform the people of Ayodhya's perception of women, they take action. Later, all the women in Ayodhya mysteriously disappear. What could Luv and Kush be planning?

videos.title: Purush Ki Soch
videos.overview: The women fear being abandoned by the men due to their recent actions. Luv and Kush try to reason with the men, but their efforts go unheard. How will they bring about a change in society?

videos.title: Stree Aur Purush Ka Samman
videos.overview: The women of Ayodhya, supported by Luv and Kush, take a stand against the men. Meanwhile, the men struggle to handle household chores on their own. Will this teach them to value and respect women?

videos.title: Luv-Kush Ka Dusra Uddeshya
videos.overview: At Luv and Kush's request, the people of Ayodhya gather in the royal court before Shri Ram. The brothers sing the Ram Katha, moving everyone to tears. Overwhelmed with emotion, the people apologize to Shri Ram for exiling Mata Sita from Ayodhya.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ke Putra
videos.overview: Luv and Kush disclose in the royal court that they are the sons of Shri Ram and Mata Sita. Later, Lord Hanuman and others request Shri Ram's permission to bring Mata Sita back home.

videos.title: Luv Kush Ka Naman
videos.overview: Luv and Kush reunite with their grandmother and seek a way to convince Shri Ram to bring Mata Sita back to Ayodhya. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman visits Mata Sita.

videos.title: Raghukul Ke Viruddh Yudh
videos.overview: Sahasramukh Ravan unleashes Atharvasur, determined to prevent the completion of the Ramayana. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman presents Shri Ram with food prepared by Mata Sita. Lakshman, Luv, Kush, and others devise a plan to bring Mata Sita back to Ayodhya.

videos.title: Sahasramukh Ka Badla
videos.overview: Shri Ram resolves to take on Sahasramukh Ravan and his forces alone. Meanwhile, Kausalya, Lakshman, and others arrive at the Ashram to bring Mata Sita back home. Later, Shri Ram confronts Sahasramukh, while Lord Hanuman battles Atharvasur.

videos.title: Dharm Sthapna
videos.overview: Shri Ram confronts Shurpanakha meanwhile Lord Hanuman fights with Atharvasur. How will this battle end?

videos.title: Vibhishan Arrives To Aid Shri Ram
videos.overview: Vibhishan tells Lord Ram that only a woman can defeat Sahastramukh. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman attempts to convince Mata Sita.

videos.title: Khatre Mein Luv Aur Kush
videos.overview: Mata Sita and Lord Hanuman are frantic with worry as they search for Luv and Kush, but the twins are nowhere to be found. Will they be reunited safely?

videos.title: Mrityu Ke Liye Sajj
videos.overview: As Sahasramukh overpowers Shri Ram, Mata Sita arrives and reunites with him after years. Taking the fierce avatar of Goddess Kali, she slays Sahasramukh Ravan.

videos.title: Ram Parivaar Ka Milan
videos.overview: Mata Sita puts an end to Sahasramukh Ravan's tyranny and confronts Shurpanakha after her brother's demise. Later, she returns to Ayodhya, where the residents seek her forgiveness for their harsh words.

videos.title: Ayodhya Mein Shubh Din
videos.overview: Shri Ram, alongside Mata Sita, addresses the people of Ayodhya, while Shurpanakha schemes her next act of revenge.

videos.title: Maleen Charitra
videos.overview: All of Ayodhya rejoices at Mata Sita's arrival. Meanwhile, a peasant suggests that she should undergo an Agni Pariksha angering the other citizens.

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Dhwaj
videos.overview: Raja Janak reunites with Mata Sita and her grandsons. Meanwhile, the Asurs invade Ayodhya in search of Luv and Kush. Will the brothers remain safe?

videos.title: Saam Daam Dand Bhed
videos.overview: Luv and Kush confront and defeat Shurpanakha. Later, as a lady's saree catches fire in the darbar, the peasant approaches Shri Ram to talk to him about Mata Sita.

videos.title: Aadharheen Prashna
videos.overview: A few people of Ayodhya approach the darbar, demanding that Mata Sita undergo an Agni Pariksha, angering Lakshman, Lord Hanuman, and others. How will Shri Ram respond?

videos.title: Ayodhya Ka Durbhagya
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman, Lakshman, and Bharat apologize to Mata Sita for all she has endured. Later, Bhagwan Valmiki blesses her and gives her a solution.

videos.title: Stree Ki Pariksha
videos.overview: The residents of Ayodhya gather to witness Mata Sita's Agni Pariksha. As she arrives at the darbar, Luv and Kush step in, questioning the crowd.

videos.title: Maryada Ki Raksha
videos.overview: Mata Sita stands before the darbar, refusing to undergo the Agni Pariksha. Instead, she chooses to surrender herself to the Earth, as Luv and Kush desperately try to stop her.

videos.title: Mata Sita Ki Mahanta
videos.overview: Mata Sita breaks down in the darbar as she faces everyone. Soon, Maa Dharti appears and prepares to take her away. How will Shri Ram respond?

videos.title: Siya-Ram Ek Hain
videos.overview: Shri Ram refuses to let Mata Sita leave with Maa Dharti and confronts her. Will he be able to stop her?

videos.title: Siya-Ram Ka Sachha Prem
videos.overview: Shri Ram and Luv-Kush are devastated after Mata Sita's departure. In his grief, Shri Ram vows to take a harsh step, but Lord Shiva and Brahma Dev intervene. Will they be able to calm Shri Ram?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Parichay
videos.overview: Lord Shiva helps Shri Ram realize his true purpose, while Luv and Kush long for their mother. Later, they are entrusted with their responsibilities

videos.title: Raghukul Ki Parampara
videos.overview: Luv and Kush seek Shri Ram's blessings as he presents three paths for the children to complete their education. Determined to learn through experience, they embark on their journey and arrive at a village.

videos.title: Maharaj Harishchandra Ka Tyaag
videos.overview: Luv and Kush narrate the story of Raja Harishchandra to persuade the villagers to respect women. Meanwhile, a Rishi arrives in Ayodhya with a ring and requests to meet with Shri Ram.

videos.title: Kaal Ka Chakra
videos.overview: Shri Ram meets the Rishi in private while Lakshman stands guard to ensure no one interrupts. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush urge the villagers to speak out against injustice.

videos.title: Aatma Samarpan Ya Mrityu
videos.overview: Luv and Kush attempt to rescue the baby from the tribe, while Shri Ram converses with Yama. Meanwhile, Rishi Durvasa arrives, but Lakshman stands in his way.

videos.title: Mrityu Dand
videos.overview: Rishi Durvasa meets Shri Ram, after which Shri Ram confronts Lakshman, who accepts the Mrityu Dand.

videos.title: Kaal Ki Chaaya
videos.overview: Luv and Kush stumble upon skeletons in a village and find themselves trapped in a swamp. Meanwhile, Lakshman urges Lord Hanuman to persuade Shri Ram to grant him 'Mrityu Dand'.

videos.title: Ahankar Aur Bahubal
videos.overview: Luv and Kush discover a way to defeat Ashtbahu, while Lord Hanuman creates his Pratibimb to safeguard Ayodhya and Shri Ram. Meanwhile, Sheshnag arrives to meet Shri Ram.

videos.title: Raj Anuj Lakshman Ki Jal Samadhi
videos.overview: Shri Ram grants Raj Anuj Lakshman permission to take the Jal Samadhi. Later, Lakshman addresses the people of Ayodhya.

videos.title: Vish Ka Prakop
videos.overview: Luv and Kush recount the tale of King Bhagirath, who sought Lord Shiva's blessings to bring the River Ganga to Earth. Can they find a way to cleanse the village of the poison?

videos.title: Luv Aur Kush Ka Tap
videos.overview: Luv and Kush pray to Lord Shiva for guidance but find themselves swallowed by a snake. Meanwhile, Shri Ram comforts a heartbroken Bharat as he grieves for Lakshman.

videos.title: Kaushal Rajya
videos.overview: Nagraj Vasuki meets Luv and Kush, guiding them to resolve the village crisis. Later, Kush takes an oath as the village king.

videos.title: Dharm Aur Vachan Ka Uddharan
videos.overview: Luv-Kush and Lord Hanuman learn about Lakshman's Samadhi. Later, they receive a warning about Kumbhakarana's son.

videos.title: Narayan Ke Naye Avatar Ki Leela
videos.overview: Bharat overcomes challenges on his journey, while Kumbhakarana's son prepares for vengeance.

videos.title: Putro Ka Sanghaar
videos.overview: Dev Rishi confronts Devamit in his darbar while Shri Ram prays for Bharat's safety. Later, Devamit's men trap Luv and Kush.

videos.title: Sankat Ka Nivaran
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman seeks out Narad Muni for answers, while Shri Ram arrives in Ayodhya and faces Brahma Dev's questions about Hanuman.

videos.title: Pratishod Ki Jwala
videos.overview: Luv and Kush are captured by Debamit's army. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman battles Kal Purush's forces to prevent them from taking Shri Ram.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Raksha
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman stands firm against Yamdev and his army. Meanwhile, Luv and Kush suffer injuries while battling Debamit. How will they overcome him?

videos.title: Shri Ram Ka Shubh Chintak
videos.overview: Shri Ram sends Lord Hanuman to Patal Lok to retrieve his ring. Meanwhile, Brahma Dev grants Yamdev permission to enter Ayodhya and take Shri Ram. Will Hanuman allow this to happen in his absence?

videos.title: Deh Tyaagne Ka Nirne
videos.overview: Luv and Kush learn of Shri Ram's decision to leave his mortal form, while Lord Hanuman searches for his ring. Later, Luv and Kush confront Shri Ram about his choice.

videos.title: Niyati Ka Chakravyuh
videos.overview: Luv and Kush resolve to stop Shri Ram from leaving his mortal form. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman faces an attack from the Naags. Later, Luv and Kush deliver a powerful message to Yamdev.

videos.title: Raghukul Ke Vanshaj Ka Margdarshan
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman encounters Nagraj Vasuki, while Brahma Dev instructs Rishi Vashisht to confront Luv and Kush. Later, Shri Ram shares a meal with his sons.

videos.title: Raja Ka Antim Daitva
videos.overview: Shri Ram addresses the people of Ayodhya and entrusts Bharat with his duties. Meanwhile, Lord Hanuman grows furious with Nagraj Vasuki.

videos.title: Shri Ram Ki Leela
videos.overview: Lord Hanuman takes Shri Ram's blessings and bids him farewell. Meanwhile, Shri Ram instructs Rishi Vashisht to arrange a yagya before his departure. Later, the Gods prepare for Shri Ram's arrival.

tt15910280.name: The Waking of a Nation
tt15910280.description: ‘The Waking of a Nation' explores the events surrounding the Jallianwala Bagh massacre through the eyes of Kantilal, a fictitious member of the Hunter Commission. When General Dyer orders his troops to open fire at a gathering in Jallianwala Bagh, Kantilal takes it upon himself, with his life under threat, to uncover the dark conspiracy that led to the massacre.

videos.title: Kaala Qanoon: A Dastardly Act
videos.overview: In April 1919, as protests against the Rowlatt Act sweep through Amritsar, Punjab’s British administration decides to exploit the people’s anger to its advantage. Childhood friends Kantilal, Hari, and Allahbaksh meet after years. In December 1919, Kantilal Sahni decides to lay the truth bare at the Hunter Commission despite a threat to his life.

videos.title: Danga: Anatomy of a Riot
videos.overview: Following the arrest of popular leaders Dr. Satyapal and Dr. Kitchlew, and a British firing on Indian protestors, Amritsar spirals out of control. Riots engulf the city and tear into the friendship between Kantilal and Allahbaksh, while innocent British civilians are placed at the mercy of the mob.

videos.title: Marham: A Healing
videos.overview: In April 1919, British officer Major Macdonald’s sensitive handling of the situation restores peace in Amritsar. His approach annoys Punjab’s administrators, who want to use force against the native population. In December 1919, Kantilal receives an unwelcome visitor with a subtle agenda, and he is made an offer that he might find hard to refuse.

videos.title: Qahar: The Massacre
videos.overview: Even as General Reginald Dyer threatens Amritsar with a promise of violence, a devious plan is hatched to draw the unsuspecting public to Jallianwala Bagh. The general leads his troops into the Bagh to unleash terror on the city’s innocent. As casualties mount, Kantilal and Allahbaksh set aside their differences to mourn the loss of a friend.

videos.title: Saazish: The Conspiracy
videos.overview: In April 1919, Amritsar reels under the effect of General Dyer’s brutal repression of civilian rights. In December 1919, a murder and a shocking revelation stir Kantilal’s conscience. At the inquiry, Kantilal finds holes in General Dyer’s testimony and proves that the general lied before the Commission.

videos.title: Shaatir Khiladi: The Ringmaster
videos.overview: As Kantilal draws a noose around General Dyer, the actual perpetrators of the massacre risk being exposed. But in a masterstroke, the tables are turned on Kantilal as a damning secret surfaces. Shamed and shunned by his own people, Kantilal resolves to fight back and unmask the mastermind.

tt15340954.name: Dabba Cartel
tt15340954.description: In VivaLife Society, men and women lead parallel lives - one caught in a pharma investigation, the other in drug peddling through a dabba delivery business.

tt35661000.name: Medical Dreams
tt35661000.description: Three NEET aspirants from diverse backgrounds pursue medical dreams at Allen, guided by Biology teacher Subrat Sinha. Their journey shows resilience and growth while preparing for India's challenging medical entrance exam.

videos.title: 53% Pe Medical Ki Tayyari
videos.overview: Shree steps into Kota with a dream bigger than her reality and meets Dhwani and Samarth on the same road to NEET. But is courage enough when the odds are 53%?

tt35683314.name: Crime Beat
tt35683314.description: Small-town crime journalist Abhishek finds his life and career affected by a fugitive gangster. As he gets trapped in a web of lies and motives, what price will he pay- to become a renowned reporter?

tt28717624.name: School Friends
tt28717624.description: A slice-of-life show that explores the lives of 5 quirky school teenagers who've just entered 11th Commerce, as they navigate friendships, heartbreaks, peer pressures, more importantly figuring out who they really want to be. All this in a society that finds it difficult to cope with the fast-changing Gen Z world.

videos.title: Bhutte Bane Popcorn
videos.overview: It’s first day for Class 11 commerce students at KLPD. BBFs Anirban and Raman have their very first fight as Anirban decides to change his section to be with her all-time crush, topper Stuti. Meanwhile, Stuti is sad as principal announces that this year’s headgirl and headboy will be only from science section.

videos.title: Stuti Ko Kaise Pataun?
videos.overview: Dreams come true for Anirban as Stuti chooses to sit next to him. In a hilarious act, Raman interviews candidates to replace Anirban from the position of his best friend. On the other hand, Stuti is shocked when she gets to know that her best friend Kudrat has been chosen as the perfect head girl.

videos.title: Kisne Mara Atom Bomb?
videos.overview: Raman comes up with a 3-rule strategy to help Anirban impress Stuti, but Dimple doesn’t agree. Stuti is facing a difficult choice, and finally she. makes a radical decision to save her Head Girl dream.

videos.title: POV: CCTV
videos.overview: Stuti’s decision to switch to Science has left Anirban in great turmoil. Stuti’s crazy plan ‘to have it all’ has Kudrat worried. Stuti pays the price of her bad choices but Anirban manages to save the day for her, and finally the ice is broken.

videos.title: Masala Mass Bunk
videos.overview: An act of discrimination by Principal Shukla against commerce students pisses Dimple off and she decides to put him in his place, by planning a mass bunk. Stuti is against it, but Dimple lies to her and puts her in a difficult position.

videos.title: Stuti Ko Kaise Manau?
videos.overview: After the whole bunking mess, Stuti is now ignoring Anirban. Anirban who really want to make things better, try all the things to make her feel better. While Mukund is now after Raman. He has decided to make his life hell.

videos.title: Mistri Bane Kalakar
videos.overview: Anirban apologizes to Stuti but she is adamant. Mukund gets in a big fight Raman and Dimple. A crazy prank takes place in class, and Raman is wrongly pulled up.

videos.title: 200 Ka Ek
videos.overview: Stuti forgives Anirban. Raman wants revenge from Mukund. Dimple makes a nasty plan, but at the time of execution, Raman screws up and their BIG plan to avenge their ‘image’ bites them back and how!

videos.title: Surprise Test Pro Max
videos.overview: The principal drops the surprise test bomb on commerce students. Dimple ends up smuggling Topper Stuti’s notes to earn a quick buck! Mukund uses the ace up his sleeve to deal with the test. Anirban and Stuti are in for a surprise that may put a dent in their newly blossoming friendship.

videos.title: Stuti Kahan Hai Yaar?
videos.overview: Stuti gives Anirban a serious dressing down, following which, he has a spat with Raman and Dimple. Determined to show students their place, Principal Shukla springs up a Surprise Test 2.0. A bizarre fallout of the test leaves Anirban, Stuti, Raman, Dimple and Mukund accidentally locked inside the store room with no network. The only way for them to get out is by working together as a team.

videos.title: Who's the hottie?
videos.overview: The first parent-principal meeting doesn’t go well for Mukund. Raman decides to cheer up Mukund, realizing that the big bad bully is actually just a lonely kid. Stuti is missing from the school the next day after the meeting. Commode Raja’s news of her accident shatters Anirban.

videos.title: Gaurav-Bhagao Andolan
videos.overview: As Cancel Commode Raja’s scoop on Stuti turns out to be fake, Cancel Commode Raja trends in school. Anirban finally musters courage and decides it’s time to tell Stuti how he feels. But hilarity ensues when his hopes are dashed by Mr Perfect – the new brawn with brains boy in school. While Dimple has finally cracked the formula for her start-up.

videos.title: That's What Friends Do
videos.overview: Anirban and his buddies finally expose the new dazzling and discover what the handsome truth hidden behind his face is.

videos.title: Dosti Ka Interval
videos.overview: Anirban is furious with Stuti, but Stuti makes every attempt to reestablish his friendship with Anirban, while mobile phones are still banned in school, which has a significant impact on Dimple's life. Finally, Stuti hands over her notes to Anirban, and the two share a moment together.

videos.title: Analysis-e-Anirban
videos.overview: In this episode, unexpected emotions begin to surface within Stuti as she realizes there is a burgeoning affection for Anirban deep within her heart. Simultaneously, Dimple finds herself contemplating whether she has stumbled upon the love of her life

videos.title: School Bani Pathshala
videos.overview: The school was thrown into chaos when the principal introduced a new rule segregating boys and girls, creating a deep division among the students. Dimple's heart shattered as she was affected by the consequences of this rule, feeling the pain of separation and loss.

videos.title: Gender-Bender!
videos.overview: As a bizarre reaction to the canoodling couple, Principal tops the phone ban rule - Girls and boys can’t talk to each other! The school suddenly gives off a black and white era vibe. The only lucky one is Dimple, who can arrange a meet-cute with her crush with no fear of being caught – because her crush is a girl.

videos.title: Head Girl Kaun Hai?
videos.overview: Dimple confesses her feelings to Harshita. Anirban, Raman and Mukund face the threat of suspension. The whole school turns up in support of them, but in a new avatar. Gender Bender it is! Meanwhile, Principal Shukla’s ad hoc actions are questioned by a well-meaning school board member.

videos.title: Abey Yeh Kya Ho Gaya?
videos.overview: Anirban wants Stuti to stay back at any cost. But how? With both anger and hormones raging, he executes his amateur plan to get the principal sacked, and have Stuti become the head-girl. Surprisingly, he even succeeds well almost. Just as he’s about to confess his feelings to Stuti, things take an unprecedented turn.

videos.title: Stuti Roko Andolan
videos.overview: When Anirban musters up the courage to confess his feelings to Stuti, she reveals that she is leaving the school, shocking everyone. Anirban and his friends hatch a plan to convince her to stay. Will they succeed in keeping their friend at school?

videos.title: Stuti Roko Andolan 2.0
videos.overview: Despite their best efforts, Anirban and his friends fail to convince Stuti. Unyielding, Anirban initiates Plan B. These persistent efforts make Stuti realize how important her friends are to her, and she decides she cannot leave them behind.

videos.title: RamBan Ka Jhagda?
videos.overview: While everyone is happy for Stuti, Principal Cholla has different plans for her responsibilities. Additionally, Cholla's announcement about new house allotments has left her school friends extremely worried. What are they planning next?

videos.title: The House Of School Friends
videos.overview: When Gaurav cleverly separates everyone into different houses, Dimples uncovers his ulterior motive. Determined to thwart his plans and reunite her friends, she devises 'The House of School Friends' operation.

videos.title: Aswachata Abhiyan
videos.overview: School friends plan to get revenge on Principal Cholla by meddling in ACIS visit, forgetting how it might negatively impact Stuti's position as head girl. Despite Anirban's efforts to stop them, it's already too late.

videos.title: Honest Anirban
videos.overview: Zorawar gets angry seeing litter everywhere and notes it in his diary. Anirban uses paint thrown on a blackboard to create a painting. ACIS inspector Zorawar is impressed by Anirban's art, which covers Raman's mistake.

videos.title: And The Oscar Goes To
videos.overview: The drawing teacher admires Anirban’s art. The group persuades Raman to audition, and he agrees to participate. However, Raman gets cold feet and disappears, prompting the entire group to search for him.

videos.title: Stuti Is Punished!
videos.overview: All friends, exhausted from searching for Raman, are surprised when he enters the auditorium in a new avatar. Raman auditions but isn't selected. Dimple despite all the stress manage to celebrate Mukund's birthday.

videos.title: Golgappa Overflow Ho Gaya!
videos.overview: Gaurav has forced the gang to do his work. Mukund devises a revenge plan against him. As a result, Gaurav is punished, and the gang is now plotting to remove him from his position as head boy.

videos.title: Head Boy Haye Haye!
videos.overview: The gang learns Gaurav is forging the Principal's signature and devises a plan. Caught on CCTV, Gaurav is demoted from Head Boy. Anirban decides to help Nilesh.

videos.title: And The Head Boy Is…
videos.overview: Principal appoints Anirban as Head Boy, shocking the gang. Stuti reveals she convinced the principal. Mr. Mehta informs us about the quiz. Stuti, initially upset, changes her mind seeing Principal using the stress bag.

videos.title: Dimple Ki Toh Lag Gayi
videos.overview: Stuti preps the auditorium for the quiz while Anirban, confused and panicked, is taken to the stress relief corner by her. Raman and others sing to welcome Mr. Zorawar, who starts the quiz with the audience.

videos.title: Unit Test Ya Picnic?
videos.overview: Students of KLPD face unconventional punishments after a surprise inspection by Mukund's strict mother. With the school at risk, they must choose between a picnic or saving their 11th and 12th grades.

videos.title: Padhai-Vadhai Sabh Dhokha Hai
videos.overview: Facing pressure from upcoming exams and a retest, students discuss their struggles and strategies. The results bring mixed emotions, and attention shifts to the cultural fest, a crucial factor in the school's evaluation.

videos.title: Movie Kaun Kaun Dekhega?
videos.overview: To convince their strict principal for movie, students turn a surprise celebration into an appreciation event. However, the movie is a dull documentary, prompting students to sneak out, leading to unexpected twists in relationships.

videos.title: Haww, Kiss???
videos.overview: After the video emerges, Raman, Mukund, and Dimple confront Anirban and Stuti, triggering chaos. Stuti grapples with the fallout while Anirban tries to repair their friendship amid school tensions and peer judgment.

videos.title: Clash Of The Genders!
videos.overview: Stuti's rejection of Anirban sparks a dare-filled rivalry between boys and girls. Rising tensions lead to pranks and challenges that strain friendships and reveal underlying emotions.

videos.title: Rehearsal Time!
videos.overview: In a chaotic library escape, Mukund injures himself, prompting the group to rally around him. This leads to heartwarming moments and a reconciliation between Stuti and Anirban.

videos.title: Kya Phata Raman!
videos.overview: In the school auditorium, cultural performance rehearsals create tension when Raman is excluded. Ananda Ma'am pairs Kudrat with Gaurav, but Raman's return in high-heeled shoes surprises everyone. Tables turn when he injures his ankle.

videos.title: Stuti, Yeh Tune Kya Kiya?
videos.overview: In the school auditorium, chaos ensues when Ananda Ma'am falls ill during cultural performance preparations. Anirban steps up to create a last-minute background, but backstage revelations of Chola's deceit spark a student rebellion.

videos.title: New Girl In Class
videos.overview: Stuti and Anirban's almost-love story faces new hurdles, while Principal Bhola's ban on extracurricular activities stirs up tension. In the midst of canteen laughter, they cross paths with a new girl, Yashika.

videos.title: Mission: Who Is Yashika?
videos.overview: A new student, Yashika, joins the school, quickly catching Anirban's attention as he begins to show genuine care for her. Stuti, noticing Anirban's growing interest in Yashika, starts to feel a pang of jealousy. As these emotions surface, tension brews between Stuti and Anirban, complicating their friendship.

videos.title: KLPD Mein Junk Food Ban
videos.overview: Principal Cholla implements a strict ban on junk food in the school canteen, replacing it with healthier options in an effort to promote student well-being. However, not everyone is on board with the new rules. Raman and his group of friends, unhappy with the change, secretly smuggle in junk food, distributing it among the students.

videos.title: Business Girl Dimple Rocks!
videos.overview: Chaos erupts in the school as several students begin vomiting, seemingly due to food poisoning. Concerned and determined to find the culprit, Dimple takes it upon herself to investigate the canteen's ingredients, suspecting foul play. Her suspicions quickly fall on Raju, and she sets out to trap him, believing he's responsible for the incident.

videos.title: Kebab Mein Haddi?
videos.overview: Students in class were asked to do a marketing survey in pairs, Since Yashika is a new student, she was given the previlege to chose her partner first, she picked Anirban. Stuti was seen being jealous of this. Then Mukund chose Dimple, which left Stuti with no choice but Raman. They all head to Agarwal sweets for survey where Stuti and Anirban are seated next each other.

videos.title: And The Best Jodi Is...?
videos.overview: Students had a presentation after the market survey wherein Yashika was seen having panic attacks. She was feeling uneasy, Anirban noticed it and tried to console her by holding her hands. She eventually started feeling better. Stuti was sitting with Raman, she noticed them holding hands which made her feel jealous.

videos.title: Fight For Seat!
videos.overview: Cholla punishes the students and replaces the benches with mattresses. The students jump over it and have fun, Stuti sees it and tries to stop everyone, Anirban is dragged away by Yashita, Stuti goes and sits next to gaurav. Anirban gets jealous. Students eventually are fed up of the mattresses. The canteen guy offers students to sit on a chair in exchange of money.

videos.title: Tables Have Turned
videos.overview: Gaurav enters, everyone is furious. Everyone warns him not to tell Cholla, he replies that he himself is frustrated with his dad. Anirban says that they cannot trust him, Stuti takes Gaurav's side. Anirban is now jealous. Gaurav helps in cutting the wire. The power has been cut not only in Cholla's cabin but the whole school. Everyone blames Gaurav, Stuti takes his side and speaks on his behalf.

videos.title: Walk Of Shame
videos.overview: Everyone tries to find Dimple, that's when they come across scrabble competition, Stuti and Yashika decide to team up for it. Cholla punishes Raman and Mukund. Stuti gets on stage for preparation, Anirban wishes luck to her. Yashika gets panic attacks seeing the stage, Anirban tries to comfort her, Stuti sees it and is jealous.

videos.title: May The Best Girl Win
videos.overview: Anirban finds the owl gifted to Stuti on floor. Raman and Mukund finally reach Dimple in the hospital. They all chill together. Stuti and Yashika win the 1st round. Gaurav and his partner win too. Now it is Stuti vs Yashika and Gaurav vs his partner. Gaurav makes it look like his partner is cheating, Principal bans all extra curricular activites.

videos.title: No More Masti In KLPD!
videos.overview: Stuti tries to convince Cholla to remove the ban but he ignores her request. Anirban comes on stage and blames Gaurav for falsely accusing his partner, Stuti interferes and asks Anirban to stay out of their fight. Everyone leaves Anirban alone on stage, except Yashika, she thanks Anirban for being there for her. She is shown admiring Anirban. Everyone gathers and welcomes Dimple.

videos.title: Matter Ab Serious Hai
videos.overview: Principal walks out of his office and observes furious students protecting by performing a street play, Cholla is still not convinced. Dimple warns Cholla if he doesnt lift the ban, Yashika would post the street play video online and everyone would blame Cholla. He then says that due to this, student's marks would be deducted. Stuti pleads him not to deduct marks.

videos.title: Commode Raja's Face Revealed
videos.overview: Raman and Mukund's antics have finally exhausted the principal's patience, leading him to humiliate them by making them do a chicken dance in front of the entire school. Dimple, determined to expose the prankster Commode Raja.

videos.title: School Friends Ka Plan Backfired
videos.overview: Thinking they've caught Commode Raja, the students ambush a figure in a hoodie only to find it's Principal Cholla, sick and annoyed. Just then, Commode Raja sends a taunting message, prompting the group to try a seance.

videos.title: Mission Red Flag To Green Flag
videos.overview: Anirban tries to impress Stuti, frustrated by her misunderstandings, and sets out to prove he's a "green flag." However, his attempts, including praising Yashika as a "whole green forest," only make Stuti jealous and push her further away.

videos.title: Scream Out Loud
videos.overview: Yashika teases Anirban, saying he could be her boyfriend, but he laughs it off, insisting they're just friends. Determined to prove he's confident and tackle one of Stuti's "red flags," Anirban suddenly starts dancing, hoping to impress her. Meanwhile, he and Stuti, as head boy and head girl, are called to the principal's office.

videos.title: Sitare vs Bechare
videos.overview: Dimple reveals Principal Cholla's truth to the trustee, exposing how Cholla had restricted extracurricular activities due to their seniors' poor performance. Cholla, in turn, proposes a competition where extracurriculars will be allowed for the winning team. The students are divided into two teams: those who scored above 70 and those below.

videos.title: My School Friends
videos.overview: After much turmoil, Stuti and Anirban finally reconcile, putting their differences aside and coming together as a team. Determined to set things right, they decide to approach Principal Cholla and convince him to lift the ban that has been troubling everyone. Just as their plan begins to take shape, an unexpected twist shakes things up.

tt35528920.name: Oops Ab Kya
tt35528920.description: An accident during a medical check-up changes Roohi's life completely, she must face whatever fate has in store for her.

tt35671338.name: Pyar Ka Professor
tt35671338.description: A seduction coach with a body count of 99 women decides to pursue the beautiful wife of a menacing politician for his 100th; only to realize that his 5 step 'Pyar Ka Professor' plan leads him to discover the one thing he's always run away from, love.

videos.title: Peacocking
videos.overview: Vaibhav has a few rules which the men have to follow in order to win a woman over. He meets a woman named Mallika who he is instantly attracted to and he tries his ways to woo her.

videos.title: Disqualification
videos.overview: Vaibhav remembers that he had slept with Anamika a few years ago and she is also in the same team as him.

videos.title: Qualification
videos.overview: Anamika gets to know about Vaibhav's classes on "Womanipulation" through her brother who is Vaibhav's student. She wants to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Escalation (Physical)
videos.overview: Things get complicated as Vaibhav agrees to help Pankaj impress Mallika. Vaibhav uses Pankaj to get some alone time with Mallika.

videos.title: Escalation (Emotional)
videos.overview: Mallika finally gets satisfied in her dream but by Vaibhav and not Pankaj. She wakes up disturbed and meets Ridhi to discuss.

videos.title: F - Close
videos.overview: Malika is about to meet Vaibhav. Alone. In a hotel room. Pankaj finds out.

tt35657903.name: Pyaar Testing
tt35657903.description: Dhruv and Amrita, potential marriage partners, decided to live together before the wedding to test their compatibility. As they spend time together, the question arises that whether they develop romantic feelings between them.

videos.title: Rishta Confirmed Ya Rejected?
videos.overview: Dhruv and Amrita meet as they help their closest friends elope. Soon, they meet again as prospective partners in an arranged marriage. While Dhruv agrees to the match, Amrita has an unusual condition.

videos.title: Shaadi Pending, Live-In Trending
videos.overview: Amrita almost calls off the alliance with Dhruv when she finds he is a hardcore non-vegetarian. Dhruv decides to give up meat for the live-in period, and all’s well.  But is it?

videos.title: Bach Gaye, Par Phas Gaye
videos.overview: Amrita and Dhruv manage to convince their parents of their innocence. The two return home and find a shocking secret about Dadi. The couple finally finds a moment of bonding.

videos.title: Pyaar Ka Double Shot
videos.overview: Dhruv’s day has a rough start, and Amrita lends a helping hand. Later, Dhruv spends his time with Amrita’s family, and everything goes well until Dadi’s secret comes out.

videos.title: Dil Ya Deal?
videos.overview: On a particularly difficult day, Dhruv makes a poor decision and ends up violating an important rule from the contract. Will he ever confess this to Amrita?

videos.title: Kya Pyaar Abhi Baaki Hai?
videos.overview: A fight between Amrita and Dhruv leads to them ending the contract. While they try going back to their normal lives, Amrita agrees to another marriage proposal. Is this the end for Amrita and Dhruv?

videos.title: T&C Removed, Pyaar Approved
videos.overview: Amrita and Dhruv finally realise that love means never having to impose terms and conditions on one’s partner. The families also admit that the trial period isn’t all that bad.

tt30784379.name: Bada Naam Karenge
tt30784379.description: Rishabh and Surbhi, two young individuals, find themselves at the crossroads of an arranged marriage. The story unfolds in two timelines: one in Mumbai, in the past, and another in Madhya Pradesh, where their families meet. In Mumbai, they find themselves alone in his room due to the lockdown, creating a pivotal moment in their relationship. In the present, Rishabh is hesitant to reveal his past with Surbhi to their families, his being a much more traditional one, fearing disapproval.

tt33083754.name: The Secret Of The Shiledars
tt33083754.description: A secret society unravels a hidden treasure belonging to Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, with Rajeev leading the quest to protect it from falling into wrong hands, ultimately becoming the chief of the Shiledars.

tt31189484.name: The Roshans
tt31189484.description: This documentary series chronicles the trials and triumphs of Bollywood's iconic Roshan family — musician Roshan Lal Nagrath, Rajesh, Rakesh and Hrithik.

videos.title: Even If We Are Not There…
Little we have, a bit more is needed
Didn’t know where I was going

tt35310553.name: Ek Farzi Love Story
tt35310553.description: Two contrasting worlds collide when an aspiring content creator Kritika and social media-averse CA, Manav find themselves stuck together thanks to an unexpected encounter. A viral video of their unique banter becomes the foundation of an unconventional partnership, where they have nothing in common, common except the fact that they agree to disagree on everything. As they become unlikely best friends offline, they pretend to be a fake couple online for the sake of their followers, who perceive them as a couple and as their fandom explodes they become an internet sensation.

videos.title: Kiss Me Manav!
videos.overview: Kritika, an aspiring content creator, and Manav, a CA with creative side hustles, meet at a creator event in Chandigarh. A chance encounter leads to a viral video, thrusting them into the spotlight. As their unexpected fame grows, they must navigate their contrasting personalities and values, questioning their choices. Can they find common ground, or will their story fizzle out before it begins?

videos.title: Anti-Friends
videos.overview: Kritika ropes Manav into a chaotic collaboration, sparking a unique 'anti-friendship.' Just as she starts finding her groove, a brand backlash threatens everything. Can Kritika salvage her dream, or will it all come crashing down?

videos.title: Experiment Fail Ho Gaya
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav navigate the chaos of a viral meme, testing their unconventional bond. As Kritika battles self-doubt and Manav wrestles with his own past, unexpected truths surface. Just as Kritika starts to reclaim her voice, a startling discovery threatens to change everything. What happens next?

videos.title: Just Friends
videos.overview: Manav helps Kritika re-start her social media account, forming an unexpected friendship. But just as Kritika begins to reclaim her voice, a shocking twist changes everything. What's next?

videos.title: Best Friends
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav's friendship is tested as they navigate a personal crisis and a high-stakes brand collab. A misunderstanding spirals into chaos, leaving their bond hanging by a thread. Can they weather the storm together?

videos.title: Nayi Aashiqui
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav's lives spiral after their followers start to think they are a romantic couple online. While Kritika struggles with public perception, Manav's growing bond with Samara complicates matters further.

videos.title: Reel Love Story
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav battle the decision of faking a romantic relationship online as they offline love lives get involved in the situation. Will they choose offline love or online fame? what will the loose if they choose the other?

videos.title: Collab Hi Collabs
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav juggle rising fame, personal dilemmas, and a tempting Maldives opportunity. While Manav debates his future in content creation, Kritika's world shatters with an unexpected setback. Can they handle the fallout, or will it change everything?

videos.title: Red Flags
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav's bond grows, but secrets about Samara and Deven create new problems. With tough choices ahead, everything could change.

videos.title: Asli Love Story?
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav deal with big career choices and changing relationships. After a fight with Deven, Kritika starts questioning her feelings for Manav. Is this the start of something new, or is it too late?

videos.title: Pyar Ki Maa Ki
videos.overview: Kritika faces a professional and personal storm as her social media account’s suspension threatens her content career, while her complicated dynamics with Manav and Akshat unravel. With secrets exposed and decisions looming, will they salvage their identities or let their crafted lives crumble?

videos.title: Best Birthday Gift
videos.overview: Kritika battles to revive her content, while Manav faces burnout and hidden feelings. His surprise return sparks their leap into full-time creation - but will it lead to triumph or chaos?

videos.title: More Than Best Friends?
videos.overview: Manav steps into the spotlight with his face reveal, sparking a whirlwind of online fame and brand opportunities, while his bond with Kritika deepens in unexpected ways. But as the line between real and fake love blurs, Manav faces a startling realization - does he truly love Kritika, or is it all just part of the act?

videos.title: Ek Tarfa Pyaar
videos.overview: A high-pressure ad shoot tests Manav and Kritika’s partnership. As lines blur, one question remains - can their partnership survive the cracks forming beneath?

videos.title: Baat Bigadh Gayi
videos.overview: Their careers hit rock bottom after a betting app scandal, pushing Kritika and Manav’s friendship to the edge. As tensions rise, will they fix what’s broken or lose everything for good?

videos.title: Tanha Safar
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav’s world turns upside down when rumors of their fake relationship ignite a social media frenzy. As their reputation crumbles, can they regain control, or will the backlash destroy everything they’ve built?

videos.title: Partnership Over
videos.overview: After a brutal fight, Manav decides to walk away for good. Left with no choice, they agree on one last campaign - will this mend their bond or break it forever?

videos.title: Jaane Nahi Dungi Tujhe
videos.overview: Kritika and Manav share a kiss during a staged shoot, but the moment stirs something real in her. Will she face her feelings or keep them buried?

videos.title: She Loves Him Too!
videos.overview: Manav and Kritika finally confess their love for each other, but Manav’s doubts about her sincerity lead to a heartbreaking fallout. As he walks away, Kritika is left devastated - can their relationship withstand this moment of truth?

videos.title: Ek Asli Love Story
videos.overview: Kritika takes the blame as their fake relationship is exposed, and Manav, despite his resentment, fights to protect her career. But with everything laid bare, is this the end of their story or the start of something real?

tt35064818.name: Black Warrant
tt35064818.description: A newly appointed jailer at Tihar Prison confronts widespread corruption and injustice within its walls, forcing him to choose between maintaining the status quo or fighting for reform.

tt35267191.name: Agra Affair
tt35267191.description: Akash struggles to save his family's crumbling hotel while pursuing his dream restaurant. He falls for tour guide Tanvi, but their romance faces hurdles. Akash's path intertwines with Megha's, leading to a poignant story of love, ambition.

videos.title: Mujhse Partnership Karoge
videos.overview: With the unusual tactics of running Hotel Aalishan exposed to his father, Aakash seeks to repair the damage. In this quest, he crosses paths with Tanvi, a tourist guide, leading to an unprecedented collaboration.

videos.title: Tum Mile Dil Khile
videos.overview: As Aakash's and Tanvi's partnership flourishes, overcoming several challenges, Aakash realizes his feelings for Tanvi. However, his family protests against the partnership, recalling a past bitter experience that led to his father's heart attack, and expressing concerns about his involvement with a girl.

videos.title: Tum Se Tu Tak
videos.overview: Reluctant to express his feelings, Aakash learns about his best friend Kookie's romantic involvement with a Russian girl and plans for marriage. Kookie encourages Aakash to confess his feelings to Tanvi, dreaming of them getting married together. However, Aakash is unaware that it is not him but destiny that is writing his love story.

videos.title: Koi Aane Ko Hai
videos.overview: As a broken Aakash accepts reality and tries to reconcile with his life, he finds comfort with someone special at Kookie's wedding, leading to a bittersweet incident.

videos.title: Chahiye Thoda Pyaar
videos.overview: As Tanvi struggles with her feelings and new revelations, she makes some unprecedented decisions regarding her life, while Aakash finds himself in a catch-22 situation as Megha expresses her feelings to him.

videos.title: Ek Mulakaat Zaruri Hai
videos.overview: Aakash and Tanvi find themselves at a crossroads as they discover many things previously unknown to them. However, on a big day, both have confessions to make and decisions to take that will change their lives forever.

tt35049431.name: Khoj - Parchaiyo Ke Uss Paar
tt35049431.description: Ved searches for his missing wife Meera, experiencing bizarre events and clues that blur reality. As a skeptical cop questions him, Ved doubts his sanity, wondering who Meera truly is and what sinister secrets lie beneath.

videos.title: Woh Kaun Thi
videos.overview: Ved’s life unravels on his birthday when his wife, Meera, goes missing. While searching for her, he deals with a dismissive police officer and a shocking revelation about his wife’s identity.

videos.title: Kaun Hai Meera
videos.overview: Ved denies Meera’s claims of being his wife, even when she provides intimate details about the two. Meera’s intentions get questioned when she’s caught adding a mysterious powder to Ved’s coffee.

videos.title: Aar Ya Paar
videos.overview: Ved discovers a shocking mark on Meera. He brings Tia to identify her and, after a face-off with Mrs. Fernandes, ultimately accepts Meera—meanwhile, Ved interrupts Amol at his door.

videos.title: Chupa Pehlu
videos.overview: Ved suspects Meera and decides to investigate. He arranges a DNA test and enlists Devraj to monitor her actions. Soon, he discovers secret codes and learns about mysterious meetings at a cafe.

videos.title: Nehle Pe Dehla
videos.overview: Devraj steals Meera’s purse and gives it to Ved, who discovers troubling information about himself. Meera takes him to a doctor, who suggests tests to uncover the truth behind his memory loss.

videos.title: Aakhri Raasta
videos.overview: Ved experiences disturbing flashes after the MRI. His medical reports reveal serious mental health issues. Meera sends a divorce lawyer. Meanwhile, Ved realises Tia is missing from the hostel.

videos.title: Kahaani Uss Raat Ki
videos.overview: An angry Ved attacks Meera after he learns that she is the one who took Tia away. However, he gets arrested by Amol. What are the charges against Ved?

tt34986597.name: Moonwalk
tt34986597.description: Moonwalk follows two thieves, Tarik Pandey and Maddy Kapoor, as they go head-to-head to steal the heart of a local heartthrob, Chandini Lakhani. Their rivalry and competition lead to dangerous yet hilarious consequences and something far more valuable...and out of this world- a piece of rock from the Moon that lands on Earth!

tt34958392.name: Karate Girls
tt34958392.description: Fireworks fly when Komal (a tough, underprivileged, problem teenager) is made to join Karate coaching to deal with her anger issues. There, she meets Abha (the Principled Coach’s non-serious, social media-savvy daughter), who has her own reasons to strive to become the best student and impress her father.

videos.title: Matter Ho Gaya
videos.overview: A spat with local boys prompts the police to visit Komal’s house. Noticing her anger issues and responding to her mother’s desperate pleas, the policewoman decides to give Komal another chance. Meanwhile, Abha struggles to juggle college, building a social media profile, and attending her father’s karate classes.

videos.title: Sensai Please!
videos.overview: Komal and Abha realize that karate could be the answer to all their problems, so they decide to set their differences aside and convince Sensei Ajay to let them participate in the upcoming NKFT.

videos.title: Dil Dosti Viral
videos.overview: As the rigorous training for NKFT continues, a friendship begins to bloom between Abha and Komal, with Vicky’s support. Meanwhile, Ajay struggles to balance the pressure from a loan shark with preparing for NKFT.

videos.title: Kauva Ya Mor?
videos.overview: Komal joins Firebolt Dojo and discovers that JD’s karate methods are brutal and ruthless, while Abha finally opens up to Ajay about her true career aspirations.

videos.title: Haath Mat Laga
videos.overview: After months of rigorous training, obstacles, and setbacks, Navodaya Dojo finally arrives at NKFT to compete against Firebolt Dojo and other contenders.

tt34861364.name: Mohrey
tt34861364.description: In the heart of Mumbai’s underworld, gangster Bosco and ace cop Jabbar reignite their decades-old rivalry. As loyalty and betrayal collide, their deadly game sets the stage for a battle that will shake the city to its core.

videos.title: Dushman Ka Dushman Dost Hota Hai!

tt34710668.name: Divorce Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
tt34710668.description: Reporters Nikki and Ashu are at loggerheads trying to become the next prime-time news anchor. Their competition takes a hilarious turn when a sting operation leads to an accidental marriage.

videos.title: Who's The Best?
videos.overview: Ashu, an ambitious news reporter, meets Nikki, a celebrated senior reporter at the news channel office. Sparks fly, but soon, the office turns into a warzone as they are forced to work together.

videos.title: Marriage Scam
videos.overview: Nikki and Ashu’s banter becomes a source of entertainment for their colleagues. When they are forced to collaborate for a sting operation, they pose as a couple to expose a marriage registration scam.

videos.title: Yeh Shaadi Nahi Ho Sakti
videos.overview: The tension between Nikki and Ashu reaches its peak when they fight for control over the prime-time slot. In a twist of fate, their pranks are broadcast live, leading to a TRP spike for the channel.

videos.title: Divorce Lawyer Ki Talaash
videos.overview: Nikki and Ashu are shocked when they realise their marriage from the sting operation was registered. They approach a lawyer to get a divorce but are told to wait for six months.

videos.title: Counselling Ke Side Effects
videos.overview: Ashu and Nikki begin mandatory counselling sessions. Nikki comes up with a story to get out of the sessions, putting Ashu in a bad spot. Their fake marriage starts affecting their personal lives.

videos.title: Jaan Pehchan
videos.overview: Nikki and Ashu continue to attend the counselling sessions, but the lies are getting harder to maintain. They try to gather personal details about each other, but things take a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Pyaar Toh Hona Hi Tha
videos.overview: Nikki’s revelation of the marriage leads to a confrontation between her fiance and their families. While they deal with their personal and professional dilemmas, the date for their divorce arrives.

tt34479867.name: Paithani
tt34479867.description: Godavari, an artisan, is globally famous for her handmade Paithani sarees. When she decides to retire, her daughter sets out to get her the gift of a lifetime - the last Paithani she wove.

videos.title: Phir Se Hui Subah Hai
videos.overview: Godavari, a skilled weaver, crafts magnificent Paithani sarees despite her deteriorating eyesight. Her daughter, Kaveri, is a school teacher who dreams of gifting her mother the last saree she weaves.

videos.title: Dhagon Ke Bol
videos.overview: Kaveri takes a loan for the Paithani and places an advance order. However, when the order is misplaced, Kaveri’s grandmother steps in to recover the lost money with a selfless act.

videos.title: Main Paithan Se Hoon
videos.overview: Kaveri’s efforts to recover the Paithani order lead her to the vendor who misplaced the order. She decides to go to Mumbai to sort out the issue. Although hesitant, Godavari gives her blessings.

videos.title: Sherni Hai Wo Sherni
videos.overview: Kaveri’s journey in Mumbai is full of setbacks when she loses her phone. However, her determination helps her find the phone back and get close to finding the other person who made the order.

videos.title: Sapne Aur Hunar
videos.overview: Kaveri tries to get in touch with Vinay Bhanushali, the other person who has ordered her mother’s Paithani. Back home, Godavari worries about her daughter’s well-being.

videos.title: Hum Dharohar Manne Wale Log Hai
videos.overview: Kaveri tries to convince Vinay to return the payment for the Paithani she wanted. Meanwhile, Godavari faces a dilemma when she receives an order for a modern design for the saree.

videos.title: Viraasat
videos.overview: Kaveri faces a dilemma when her brother gets into an accident, and she struggles to gather funds for his treatment. Meanwhile, Godavari decides to personally deliver the saree she has woven for Vinay.

tt29473170.name: Half Love Half Arranged
tt29473170.description: A rom-com of two 30 year millennials, Riya and Jogi, discover the world of ‘arranged dating’ and find themselves in the crazy circus of bad arranged matches, set-ups, matchmakers, astrologers and well-meaning aunties in an endeavor to get them to “settle down”.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Riya
videos.overview: Dr. Riya Tanwar has big plans for her 30th birthday as she expects a marriage proposal from her boyfriend of 3 years. However, her day keeps getting from bad to worse. Will she finally get engaged tonight, or does fate have other plans for her?

videos.title: Siyappa
videos.overview: While on a quest to find a husband, Riya meets Deepak Rathi, who seems perfect for her on paper. However, her plans are disrupted when her childhood crush resurfaces.

videos.title: Zor Se Bolo, Jai Mata Di
videos.overview: An orchestrated chance encounter with a potential groom creeps Riya out but the groom has his sights set on another Tanwar lady. To Riya's surprise, Jogi shows up as her knight in shining armour.

videos.title: Kuch Toh Hua Hai
videos.overview: When Riya meets Siddhant Gupta, everything seems to fall into place. They share the same values, but have different goals. Will they be able to overcome this challenge or will Riya find herself alone, again?

videos.title: Bermuda Triangle
videos.overview: Alone, hurt and heartbroken, Riya finds herself on the cusp of giving up on her hunt for a husband. While Jogi manages to cheer her up, an encounter with Arf leaves Riya perplexed.

videos.title: Kya Yahi Pyaar Hai
videos.overview: A heart to heart with Tanvi and an honest conversation with Arf leaves Riya wondering - has love finally snuck up on her? Was her Mr. Perfect right in front of her, all this while?

videos.title: Kya Karein Kya Na Karein
videos.overview: Riya's world is upended when she uncovers Jogi's hidden secret. Meanwhile, an unexpected guest plunges the Tanwar household into chaos. Can Riya and Jogi overcome these obstacles, or will their love story end before it even begins?

videos.title: Chup Chup Ke
videos.overview: As Riya and Jogi's secret romance blossoms, the Tanwars remain completely unaware. Can Riya keep their love under wraps, or will a slip unravel everything?

videos.title: Dard-e-Disco
videos.overview: Riya and Jogi are on a mission to merge their worlds, but when they bring their friends together, unexpected sparks fly. Can they overcome the friction and unite their circles, or will their efforts lead to even greater chaos?

videos.title: Bhaagam Bhaag
videos.overview: Riya is on edge, gearing up for a career-making interview, while Jogi faces a tense showdown at Aashi's birthday party, where a looming threat jeopardises his custody battle. As their lives intertwine, can Riya balance these escalating challenges, or will the mounting pressure test their relationship to its limits?

videos.title: Tere Mere Pyaar Ke Charche
videos.overview: As a heartbroken Riya struggles to hide her pain behind a forced smile, the Tanwars and Ved go all out to lift her spirits. Amid their efforts, an unexpected quest uncovers a surprising revelation that adds a new twist in Riya's life.

videos.title: Kuch Khaas Hai
videos.overview: Are Riya's dreams finally within reach, or is she about to face a paralysing choice that could change everything?

tt28282670.name: The Magic of Shiri
tt28282670.description: In 1996 Delhi, globalization shuts down Shiri's family business and due to insurmountable pressure, her husband leaves home. Left alone and penniless with her kids, she flouts all social norms to become a stage performing magician. In an era when everyone believed that women can’t stand on their own, she did.

videos.title: I Am So Magical
videos.overview: It's the delightful time of 90s Delhi. Meet the cheerful and charming Shiri Shroff, whose world revolves around her husband Naveen and 2 kids. When Naveen's business goes bust, she is shell shocked when he takes a life altering decision that threatens to destroy her blissful family.

videos.title: Idiota Kusok
videos.overview:
Shiri decides to pursue her childhood dream of becoming a stage-performing magician. She joins a magic troupe as a simple assistant, where she meets yesteryears' great magician Jadugar Saleem. While a cruel twist of fate has made Saleem lose his love for life, will Shiri be able to

rekindle his passion and make him teach her the tropes?

videos.title: DSP
videos.overview:
While Saleem begins to find a way to showcase the new budding performer, the owner of the magic group, Viktor tells Shiri a devastating truth - women can't be magicians. While she tries to grapple with the world turning against her, she is devastated by a stunning decision made by

her own daughter.

videos.title: Sapna Hai Ya Maksad?
videos.overview: Shiri runs pillar to post to bring her daughter Mini back home, who believes Shiri is responsible for her father leaving. Shiri is helped by a strange man Akash who sees her financial struggles and offers her a job. Shiri's father-in-law Jigar tries to bring Naveen back to re-unite the family.

videos.title: Saajan
videos.overview: Running a scam to raise money, Saleem sets up funds and a show for Shiri. But Shiri's new job has begun to offer her comfort and she is in two minds about pursuing her dream. While she contemplates her next step, a startling revelation about the ever so helpful Akash stuns her.

videos.title: Asli Jadugar
videos.overview: Shiri stumbles upon a trick which she believes can put her on the map - the dreaded 'Canon Ball Act' which nobody had successfully performed in the last two decades. She sets on the journey to find the great magician who last did it, but soon hits a roadblock as she learns only an 'Asli - Jadugar' (extra ordinary mastermind) can track him down.

videos.title: Toofan
videos.overview: While the meeting with an ace magician Toofan makes her doubt her whole decision to pursue this path, her past comes back to haunt her. With everyone telling her to give up on her dream, will she succumb to the pressure or rise to the occasion?

videos.title: Dastan-E-Kabul
videos.overview: At the Grand Magic Marathon, Shiri's first real performance comes under threat as her nemesis Viktor is determined to make her fail by any means possible. While in her personal life, lines have been drawn for a legal battle with Naveen.

videos.title: Husnapari
videos.overview: Tired of being at the receiving end of everyone's betrayal and threats, Shiri decides to take back the reins of her life. Her tit-for-tat actions put her at loggerheads with her closest associate Saleem.

videos.title: Mera Show Ab Shuru Hua Hai
videos.overview: With the whole world pining for her failure, Shiri takes up the mammoth risk of doing the unthinkable - attempt the life threatening 'Canon Ball Act'. With everything on the line, will she succeed?

tt33144102.name: Reeta Sanyal
tt33144102.description: Reeta Sanyal lands the case of a lifetime when a guilty killer narrates a ‘perfect murder’ story. In the trial for truth, she must brave against the big guns.

videos.title: Main Kaatil Hoon!
videos.overview: Advocate Reeta Sanyal is eyeing a career-defining case. An opportunity arises in the form of a high-profile murder case, but her client demands execution instead of freedom!

videos.title: Chhoti Bachhi
videos.overview: A deadly attack on Keshav leaves Reeta scrambling to find the truth behind the murder of Parav Rane. At the hospital, a sinister killer lurks to make her next move.

videos.title: The Perfect Murder
videos.overview: Chasing down a new lead, Reeta and her assistant-cum-friend Ishaan crack the code behind Keshav's so-called 'perfect murder'. But will the truth be as flawless as the crime?

videos.title: Ek Filmy Twist
videos.overview: With Inspector Jai by their side, Reeta and Ishaan search for the murder weapon that will crack this case wide open. On the first day of trial, a major setback ruins it all!

videos.title: Lady Undercover
videos.overview: Reeta goes undercover at Club Platina to dig up dirt on Parav Rane but ends up with more questions than answers. Chaos ensues when her cover gets blown!

videos.title: The Lost File
videos.overview: To solidify her defence, Reeta revisits the crime scene and uncovers explosive leads. A new intel on her father's death may open the Pandora's box!

videos.title: Ms. Killer
videos.overview: Footages from Parav’s cellar bring disturbing scenes and an unexpected eyewitness to light. A viral meme helps Reeta close in on the prime suspect.

videos.title: Yamraj Thakral
videos.overview: After Jai files crucial evidence against Rane, Reeta reevaluates her trial strategy. But with Thakral being one step ahead, her plan may hit another hiccup.

videos.title: A Bait
videos.overview: A witness’ testimony on the stand shifts the direction of the court proceedings. Jai and his team lay a trap for the elusive lady assassin. Will she get caught?

videos.title: The Defence Rests
videos.overview: The truth about Ishaan’s real identity comes to light. Ahead of the final verdict, Reeta struggles with her defence. But a new testimony shakes up the courtroom!

videos.title: Blood Is the Only True Ink
videos.overview: Reeta tries to piece together the truth behind her father’s death. An attack on the mysterious girl brings a bigger conspiracy to light but the only clue is a British-era coin.

videos.title: The Girl with a Superpower
videos.overview: With her razor-sharp ideas, Reeta signs the mysterious girl as her client. Eyeing for new leads on Joseph Jahazi, a trap is laid for Khushboo. But the plan backfires!

videos.title: High Alert
videos.overview: After a close call at the restaurant, Reeta uncovers the truth of a smuggling racket involving her father. New findings at a murder scene hint at a possible terror threat.

videos.title: Guilty Mind
videos.overview: Facing off Thakral in court, Reeta follows an unorthodox approach to prove her point. Taking the mystery girl to a hypnotist opens doors to a new maze.

videos.title: Who Killed My Father?
videos.overview: Reeta and Jai spring back to action, nabbing the infamous Acid Anna. As missing pieces of Subhash’s murder come together, Reeta braces for a fightback!

videos.title: Blood Sisters
videos.overview: Reeta unravels the past and present of the secret society ‘Blood Sisters’. As she tries to connect the dots, a nationwide threat comes to the picture.

videos.title: Honey Trap
videos.overview: A new avatar helps Reeta uncover the modus operandi of the Blood Sisters. Racing against time, Reeta takes a dangerous chance but the plan hits a snag!

videos.title: The Real Bookkeeper
videos.overview: Decoding a 200-year-old riddle, Reeta and Ishaan try to defuse a volatile situation. The real bookkeeper steps out of the shadows. And this is just the beginning!

videos.title: Who’s a Friend, Who’s a Foe?
videos.overview: In the game of power grab, the Blood Sisters plan to uproot the government. Reeta joins forces with Thakral to salvage the situation while a new enemy comes into the picture.

videos.title: The Score Is Settled!
videos.overview: Revelations, regrets, and secrets surface! In a bid to neutralise the national threat, Reeta pulls out all the stops in one final showdown. But she’s yet to face one hard truth.

tt30790577.name: Dus June Kii Raat
tt30790577.description: A farcical tale of Panauti, a hapless man with notorious bad luck, and his quest to reopen his father's theatre. Packed with hilarious misadventures and colorful characters, his journey with cousin Battu for love and luck is a hilarious.

videos.title: Lo Bhai, Lag Gayi Panauti
videos.overview: Panauti and Battu hope to revive Menka theatre. Panauti's bad luck brings trouble; Battu rescues him. The theatre's secrets attract Sahab Singh and Rumpa. A mysterious girl, Puppy, enters Panauti's life. When he's finally about to meet her, Panauti finds Puppy dead at the theatre.

videos.title: Panauti Ho Na Ho
videos.overview: Panauti is feeling distraught about the dead body. Inspector Devraj and his constables find a body at Menka Theatre. Devraj, who holds a grudge against Panauti, catches him trying to escape. Devraj plots Panauti's encounter. A mystery girl enters the police station.

videos.title: Tera Battu Sambhal Lega
videos.overview: Puppy files a report for her missing friend, not knowing that its linked to Menka theatre's murder. Battu reassures Rekha about Panauti's release. Battu tries to free Panauti from Devraj's claws. Panauti receives a call from Puppy.

videos.title: Battu Ke Panauti Ki Puppy
videos.overview: Puppy tells Panauti that she suspects Tarun killed Neha. Puppy learns Sahab Singh has claimed Neha's body. Aneesha warns Vaani about drugs. Puppy confronts Tarun, informs Panauti and Battu. They investigate and find Tarun meeting Sassy Kajal.

videos.title: Neha ki Maut ka Raaz, Ek Chaalbaaz
videos.overview: Devraj finds new evidence against Panauti. Rumpa orders a search for the map. Battu provides proof from Kashi's vlog clearing Panauti. Battu and Puppy steal a phone, realizing its Neha's. Battu finds a key detail in Neha's case.

videos.title: Kaatil ki Khoj hui Fail, Panauti Pohoncha Jail!
videos.overview: Panauti lands up in jail. Meanwhile, Bijon tells Rumpa about Gogoi's kidnapping. Panauti seeks evidence against Tarun with Battu and Puppy's help, while Panauti deals with jail life.

videos.title: Assman se Gira, Khajoor mein atka Panauti
videos.overview: In prison, Battu vows to free Panauti. Battu and Satya plot Panauti's escape from the jail kitchen. Satya aids Panauti for someone else's benefit. Devraj faces trouble as Panauti escapes, only for Panauti to fall in trouble again.

videos.title: Theatre ka Raaz…Raaz hi rehne do
videos.overview: Panauti escapes Rumpa's captivity and locks her out. Battu tries to prove Panauti's innocence, but Devraj creates a fuss. Menka suggests Panauti to sell the theatre for answers he wants.

videos.title: Nakshe ki Talash mein Bhagam Bhaag
videos.overview: Panauti decides to open the theatre alone despite Battu and Puppy's refusal. Rumpa and Bijon find Gogoi. Dinkar denies Panauti funds, but has his own share of secrets. As the theatre prepares to reopen, and Panauti tries to propose Puppy, a new threat appears.

videos.title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhi Panauti
videos.overview: Rumpa traps Panauti, Battu, and Puppy at the theatre for the treasure map. Panauti falsely claims knowledge under threat. Battu questions Rumpa about Sassy Kajal. Chaos ensues when Saheb Singh reaches there. Panauti and Battu investigate Rahul's house for clues.

videos.title: Pehla Kaam Duja, Phir Hogi Pooja
videos.overview: Panauti tells the SP about Rahul's killer. At the haveli, Battu stops Rekha's suicide attempt. Panauti focuses on the theatre mystery.
