Dinkar pushes Sahib Singh to sell, but he plans to reopen it. Panauti invites Puppy to the theatre's inauguration, where they find a clue linking to Neha's death.

videos.title: Panauti Zaroor Lagegi Dobara
videos.overview: Panauti and Puppy discover Neha's killer. Battu forces Panauti a choice between him and Puppy. Menka reveals a secret to Panauti about his father's death. Panauti seeks Devraj's aid in his father's case, discovering missing case files and chaos ensues, yet again. Just when Panauti thought his jinx is over, a new blunder is awaits.

videos.title: Saade Teen Pheron Ki Shadi
videos.overview: Panouti's long-awaited wedding to Puppy is derailed when a mysterious "radio man" crashes the ceremony, leaving guests in shock. As Battu digs for proof against Puppy, a gunshot turns the festive occasion into a chaotic turning point.

videos.title: Panouti Aur Maut Ka Silsila
videos.overview: Panouti and Devraj begin investigating a fresh murder tied to the family's tangled past, and suspicions rise against Puppy. Meanwhile, Battu and Rumpa uncover connections to a hidden treasure.

videos.title: Kaun? Kiska? Kya?
videos.overview: Panouti confronts his mother about his father's dark history, learning chilling details of "Dus June Ki Raat" when everything began. Battu and Panouti's suspicions shift toward Sahab Singh and Puppy, leading them to shocking discoveries.

videos.title: Sabka Badla Lega Re Tera Panouti
videos.overview: With Puppy's origin story as an orphan unveiled, Panouti is torn between love and loyalty to Battu. An attack on Sahab Singh casts doubt on his connection to the murders, but the lurking presence of the "radio man" raises the stakes further.

videos.title: Kaun Hai Mystery Radio Man?
videos.overview: Panouti's focus on solving his father's case intensifies, with Menka urging him to halt the theatre's operations. A sinister poisoning attempt adds to the chaos as the "radio man" strikes again.

videos.title: Khel Gayi Puppy Pishachini
videos.overview: With trust faltering and Puppy joining Menka in questioning Panouti's choices, the true culprit appears more elusive than ever. A cryptic message suggests Rumpa may be involved.

videos.title: Double Role Ka Jhol
videos.overview: Panouti's loyalties waver as Sahab Singh's message implicates Puppy in the murders, and Battu urges him to act. Battu begins investigating Puppy's past, uncovering a mysterious phone call from her "Mom" that hints at hidden connections.

videos.title: Batasha Ke Aadhe Nakshe Ki Kahani
videos.overview: Battu's suspicions about Puppy grow, leading him to Devraj, who reveals shocking information about Rumpa. With Puppy's intentions questioned, a shadowy pursuit of the theatre's treasure intensifies, drawing Panouti and Battu into a dangerous alliance.

videos.title: Asli Rasmon Waali Nakli Shadi
videos.overview: Kajal reveals her twin connection to Rumpa, showing Panouti and Battu clues about the hidden treasure. Menka and Batasha enter the mix as conflicting motivations and secrets surface.

videos.title: Panouti Ki Shadi Ke Side Effects
videos.overview: With Panouti's wedding celebrations back on, he secretly prepares to expose Puppy, while Devraj and Aneesha uncover a disturbing twist involving Vaani. The mystery deepens as Dinkar kidnaps Kajal, leading Rumpa into a frantic search to rescue her.

videos.title: Parde Ke Peeche Kya Hai?
videos.overview: During a high-security wedding, Panouti makes a dramatic revelation about the serial killer. Panouti and Battu uncover connections between Rumpa and Vaani while racing to save Kajal. As the web of betrayal tightens, they confront the final truths about family, loyalty, and the hidden treasure.

tt34265526.name: Gaming Insaan
tt34265526.description: Gaming Insaan follows YouTuber Nischay Malhan, aka Triggered Insaan, as he leaves his comfort zone to chase an impossible dream: becoming a pro-gamer in just three months. Battling fierce rivals, self-doubt, and overwhelming pressure, Nischay must prove he's more than an entertainer. As tensions rise, will he conquer the esports world or crack under the weight of expectations?

videos.title: Spawn Point
videos.overview: Nischay Malhan, aka Triggered Insaan, frustrated by critics who dismiss him as not being a true gamer, seeks help from Tanmay 'Scout OP' Singh. After a brutal firsthand taste of the pro gaming world, Nischay embarks on a daring 3-month journey to prove himself. With intense challenges ahead and critics waiting for him to fail, will he rise to the occasion, or will the pressure be too much?

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: Nischay Malhan steps into the intense world of Orangutan Esports bootcamp, where seasoned pros grind relentlessly and the pressure to succeed is suffocating. Torn between his YouTube career and the demands of going pro, Nischay faces crushing self-doubt. As tensions rise and a pivotal match looms, can he survive or will the weight of it all break him?

videos.title: Pressure Cooker
videos.overview: Nischay’s journey at the bootcamp takes a dark turn as the relentless grind begins to break him. With a mysterious pro joining the team and tensions boiling between teammates, Nischay finds himself at a breaking point. As pressure mounts for a high-stakes match, can Nischay hold it together or is this the start of his unraveling?

videos.title: Two IGLs
videos.overview: The fragile alliance within Gaming Guerillas is starting to crumble as tensions between Marzil and Psy threaten to tear the team apart. Nischay, already struggling with exhaustion and a seething self doubt, finds himself caught in the middle of a growing power struggle between the two in-game leaders.

videos.title: The Glue Player
videos.overview: As the pressure mounts, Gaming Guerillas faces a crisis like never before. After a crushing loss and a heated fight Nischay Malhan, overwhelmed by the weight of expectations and the guilt of being blamed for the team's failure, has vanished. His absence leaves the bootcamp in chaos, with Marzil and Psy's unresolved rivalry threatening to tear the team apart.

videos.title: Match Found
videos.overview: The journey that began with high hopes and overwhelming challenges now reaches its climactic conclusion. The UnderGods 2024, the final LAN tournament. Months of hard work, relentless practice, and personal growth have led to this moment. For Nischay Malhan and his team, it's the ultimate test of everything they've learned, but the pressure is immense, and the stakes couldn't be higher.

tt33984553.name: Fisaddi
tt33984553.description: A final-year student Goldie gains local fame in Prayagraj despite failing exams. When his brilliant younger brother Vimal joins the same college, Goldie has to choose: match Vimal's success or accept the role as family's underachiever.

videos.title: Freedom Fighter
videos.overview: Goldie, a struggling college student and an imposing elder brother, pushes his reluctant younger brother Vimal into university life. As Vimal faces unexpected challenges and temptations, Goldie tries to hide his own failures.

videos.title: Shakespeare Sankat Mein
videos.overview: Vimal balances his attraction to Geetanjali with Goldie's strict control. A plan to gain freedom backfires, leading to chaos and an impulsive confession to Geetanjali. As their relationship seems to spark, Goldie unexpectedly appears.

videos.title: Narr V/S Maada
videos.overview: Vimal's birthday celebration sparks tension with Goldie, who feels increasingly sidelined. As Vimal grows closer to Geetanjali, Goldie attempts to assert his own masculinity, with comical and disastrous results.

videos.title: Sangam Pe Sangram
videos.overview: As Goldie and Vimal's rivalry intensifies, their parents' unexpected visit forces a temporary truce. Family tensions surface during a trip to Sangam, revealing deeper issues. With exams looming, the brothers face their own challenges.

videos.title: Goldie Flake
videos.overview: Vimal's comedy roast backfires, landing him in trouble with university authorities. Goldie, despite their rivalry, reluctantly seeks favours to save his brother from suspension.

videos.title: PCO Dada Amar Rahein
videos.overview: PCO Dada's sudden death shakes Goldie to his core. As he struggles with grief and academic pressure, Goldie makes a desperate attempt to cheat on his exams. Meanwhile, Vimal tries to reconnect with his brother.

videos.title: Kaun Hai Fisaddi?
videos.overview: Goldie's risky gamble during exams leads to unexpected consequences. As Vimal rises to the top, dark secrets threaten to tear the brothers apart. A confrontation with Deepti's husband forces Goldie to redefine his values.

tt30819853.name: Raat Jawaan Hai
tt30819853.description: Shows the unpredictable lives of three besties- Radhika, Avinash and Suman, as they embark on the wildest adventure of all: raising kids.

videos.title: Film Dekhne Chalein?
videos.overview: Three parents, who are childhood friends, want to watch a film together on a weekday, a simple wish from life.What follows is two days of a roller-coaster ride full of constipated children, grandparents not willing to babysit, expensive phones being flung in the air and toddlers' emotional blackmail when a parent is leaving. Will they make it to the film?

videos.title: Baap ki Baapta
videos.overview: Radhika is triggered by a random person calling her a housewife and starts looking for a job, while Avinash faces intense challenges at home as takes up a ‘work project’. Meanwhile, Suman for the first time in life, spends some quality time with her ‘un-involved’ father.

videos.title: Finding Sunita
videos.overview: The three friends go on a day-trip to pick up a nanny for Kadambari, as an endless misadventure is masterminded by an unexpected nemesis.

videos.title: Abadaba Issues
videos.overview: Suman and Avinash are invited to a dreamy birthday party which is the first project for Radhika’s event company.

videos.title: Jaale Toh Nahin Lag Gaye?
videos.overview: The friends deal with the lack of intimacy in their relationships after having kids and realise the immense difficulty of bringing up these issues in a marriage.

videos.title: Mercury Retrograde
videos.overview: Radhika gets envious of the bond Kadambari has with her school teacher. Meanwhile, Avinash deals with social anxiety as he faces his family and extended family who challenge his masculinity over his decision to be a stay at home parent, and Suman starts feeling like a guest in her own house after her in-laws come to visit.

videos.title: Worst Birthday Ever
videos.overview: Radhika is on her worst behaviour on her 33rd birthday. It’s a house party where for the first time, all three families are present together. Suman grapples with confronting Sattu about the in-laws moving in, while Avinash deals with the decision of taking up a full-time job. However, no one can focus on their own drama because Radhika locks herself in the bathroom.

videos.title: Sabudana Khichdi
videos.overview: Radhika chooses to terminate her pregnancy and is dealing with immense physical and mental pain for which Rishi cannot be present. Avinash and Suman hold her through this life altering experience.

tt33609561.name: Zindaginama
tt33609561.description: An Anthology series that highlights the stigmas around mental health and mental illness in India. According to the latest World Health Organization report on depression, almost 7.5% of Indians suffer from major or minor mental disorders that require expert intervention. The brainchild of Dr. Neerja Birla, Zindaginama strives towards creating an environment where mental health dialogue is encouraged. It's okay not to be okay. Six different stories from six creators with a common theme - to encourage us to be sensitive to our environment and peers and to show openness to acknowledging mental health struggles in our lives.

videos.title: One Plus One
videos.overview: Set in two timelines, 'One Plus One' follows the story of twin sisters Maya and Mira through key moments in their life. The bond between them strains and frays under the weight of Mira’s eating disorder, and one fateful night when it all comes to a breaking point. Will the sisters find a way through together?

videos.title: Swagatam
videos.overview: The episode explores the lives of a young married couple living in a small-town in Maharashtra. The husband, diagnosed with schizophrenia, is keen to attend his friend's wedding. Swagatam portrays what it’s like for an individual to actually live with schizophrenia, without primarily focusing on traditional media stereotypes of violent episodes.

videos.title: Bhanwar
videos.overview: Vaidehi, a mother of three in rural Bihar, and Namrata, a newlywed in the bustling city of Kolkata, confront identical fears and deep-rooted anxieties. Grappling with the heavy weight of societal stigmas and personal traumas, each must find a way to heal before their lives spiral out of control beyond repair.

videos.title: Caged
videos.overview: Set in the coastal village of Bhaatgaon, Raju, a high school student with undiagnosed psychological issues, embarks on a transformative journey as he embraces his true identity and experiences the challenges and triumphs of his transition. As the people around him fail to understand him, Raju finally gets support when Keith, a land owner who lives in the city, arrives in Bhaatgaon.

videos.title: Purple Duniya
videos.overview: 30-year-old Raag battles keeping up with professional and personal commitments as his life is controlled by a fictitious Purple World. To his family and friends in Delhi, Raag is a victim of bad timing - a broken relationship and failing career prospects, but will they find out the real reason behind his behaviour?

videos.title: The Daily Puppet Show
videos.overview: Twenty-six-year-old Lila has lived with her Obsessive Compulsive Disorder diagnosis for most of her life and finally feels she’s in a place where she’s able to live with it. That is, until young filmmaker, Sahil Gupta, appears in her life, asking questions, challenging her status quo and making her world open up in new and scary ways.

tt27991703.name: Highway Love
tt27991703.description: When a confident and feisty girl fixes an awkward but endearing guy's car on the expressway, a warm-hearted love story starts to take life. As the guy finds himself smitten by this enigmatic girl, he learns to come out of his shell. Meanwhile, the girl learns to believe in the existence of true, unconditional love as they navigate the diversions, detours and pit-stops of their romantic journey.

videos.title: Detour
videos.overview: Inaaya, abandoned on the highway by her ex-boyfriend, crosses path with Kartik, who is ses agling with a flat tire. As they exchange stories and learn more about each other, king Inaa finds comfort & calm in On the other hand, Inaaya finds comfort & calm in a friendly Kartik after h finds comfort & calm in a friendly Kartik after her break up.

videos.title: Diversion
videos.overview: Kartik brings Inaaya to his house to celebrate his birthday party. Meanwhile, Inaaya tries hard to turn down her ex-boyfriend's efforts to give him another chance.

videos.title: Milestones
videos.overview: Kartik ghosts Inaaya's attempts to stay in touch with him, fearing rejection. Kartik chases her down in an attempt to mend the damage he has done and to win her heart.

videos.title: Destination
videos.overview: As Kartik & Inaaya come back home after Alibaug trip, Kartik prepares to move to Spain while Inaaya continues living her life, trying to heal from her heartbreak.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Inaaya and Kartik navigate a strained long-distance relationship as Kartik faces challenges in Barcelona. Inaaya's plans are derailed by Varun's accident, drawing Kartik back to Mumbai. Tensions arise with the arrival of Rishi, sparking conflict over Inaaya's career ambitions.

videos.title: House Warming
videos.overview: Inaaya and Kartik navigate trust issues after Kartik's job revelation sparks a heated argument. They reconcile, but Kartik's guilt over a hidden secret threatens their newfound harmony. Meanwhile, problems rise as Inaaya's collaboration with Rishi tests Kartik's insecurities.

videos.title: Truth
videos.overview: Kartik plans a romantic surprise for Inaaya during a trip to Rishi's farmhouse, but old and new conflicts among their friends threaten their relationship. A game of truth or dare exposes secrets and misunderstandings, culminating in a revelation that shakes their trust.

videos.title: Dare
videos.overview: Issues escalate as Inaaya's newfound success and rumors with Rishi stir jealousy in Kartik. Meanwhile, Kartik's unresolved issues with Nidhi complicate matters, leading to a crucial client presentation. A misunderstanding leads to hurt feelings as Inaaya and Rishi's bond deepens during a trip to Alibaug, culminating in a moment that threatens to unravel their relationship.

videos.title: Distractions
videos.overview: As tensions simmer following a turbulent trip, Sahil's disapproving glances and Meera's engagement preparations heighten the strain between Inaaya and Kartik. Emotions reach a boiling point at the engagement, where a proposal turns into a confrontation, triggering a dramatic chain of events involving Rishi and Sahil.

videos.title: Strangers
videos.overview: Things ease after a tumultuous engagement fallout, Inaaya and Kartik join forces to organize Sahil and Meera's impromptu wedding. Amidst unconventional rituals and heartfelt moments, Kartik wrestles with his emotions and offers Inaaya a poignant token of their shared journey, leaving their future uncertain.

tt33441658.name: Honeymoon Photographer
tt33441658.description: Newlyweds Adhir and Zoya Irani's Maldives trip turns tragic when Adhir's body is found buried on a beach. Suspicion falls on their friends, family, and Zoya herself as the investigation unfolds.

tt33399687.name: Ishq in the Air
tt33399687.description: A chance encounter collides the fates of Naman and Kavya on a flight propelling them on an unforeseen journey of love. But as time unfolds, will they surpass the turbulent complexities of their contrasting worlds and backgrounds to embrace the love that’s in the air?

tt32809315.name: Aapka Apna Zakir
tt32809315.description: Zakir Khan, along with his four panelists - Shweta Tiwari, Rithvik Dhanjani, Gopal Datt and Paresh Ganatra, host quirky news debates, candid conversations with celebrities and influencers, and special guests who present their unique talents.

videos.title: Karan Johar Ke Saath Guftagoo
videos.overview: With heartwarming conversations and a slice of comedy, Zakir Khan and his four panellists, Shweta Tiwari, Rithvikk Dhanjani, Paresh Ganatra and Gopal Datt, welcome the renowned director and producer, Karan Johar, followed by the diligent and inspiring Ankit Baiyanpuria, to the first episode of 'Aapka Apna Zakir'.

videos.title: Zakir With The Cast Of Stree 2
videos.overview: Zakir and the esteemed panellists have a joyful discussion with the cast of Stree 2, Shraddha Kapoor and Rajkummar Rao. Enjoy an evening filled with comedy, dance, and entertainment, along with a captivating poetry session by well-known poet Azhar Iqbal.

videos.title: Hasseen Dillruba Ke Saath Guftagoo
videos.overview: Zakir and the panellists interact with the cast of the Hindi movie 'Phir Aayi Hasseen Dillruba', Taapsee Pannu, Vikrant Massey and Sunny Kaushal.

videos.title: Fun, Laughter And Frolic With The Cast Of Vedaa
videos.overview: The hilarious panellists Shweta Tiwari, Rithvikk Dhanjani, Paresh Ganatra, and Gopal Datt, engage in a lively conversation with the cast of Vedaa, John Abraham, Sharvari and Abhishek Banerjee along with director, Nikhil Advani. Himanshi Babra joins the celebration with her heartwarming poetry.

videos.title: Star Studded Laughter With The Cast Of Gyaarah Gyaarah
videos.overview: The laughter levels soar as the cast of 'Gyaarah Gyaarah', Raghav Juyal, Kritika Kamra, and Dhairya Karwa, make a special appearance on the show.

videos.title: Singers Aur Zakir Ka Purana Rishta
videos.overview: Zakir and the panellists welcome the talented singers Neeti Mohan, Jubin Nautiyal and Shekhar R to the show for a fun-filled musical evening.

videos.title: Zakir And The Judges Of India's Best Dancer
videos.overview: Zakir and the panelists welcome the judges of season four of India's Best Dancer, Karisma Kapoor, Geeta Kapur and Terence Lewis, to enjoy an evening of laughter and heartening conversations.

videos.title: Getting Candid With Raveena
videos.overview: Zakir and the panellists celebrate Raveena Tandon's journey in the film industry. A viral guest - Deepak Utwal, surprises Raveena with his impersonation of one of her favourite co-stars.

videos.title: Zakir And The Cast Of IC814
videos.overview: Zakir and the panelists welcome the renowned artists, Dia Mirza, Vijay Varma, Patralekhaa and Anubhav Sinhaa, for a night full of laughter and entertainment.

videos.title: Zakir With Sonu Sood
videos.overview: The talented heartthrob of Bollywood who has touched millions of hearts through his philanthropy, Sonu Sood gets candid in an interview with Zakir.

tt21908964.name: Call Me Bae
tt21908964.description: Downsized from heiress to hustler, 'Bae' discovers her most valuable assets aren't her diamonds, but her street-smart style. Broke, but refusing to be broken, she navigates the newsrooms of Mumbai and her better self while breakin...

videos.title: Bae Tries to be a Journalist

tt28106741.name: IC 814: The Kandahar Hijack
tt28106741.description: Indian Airlines flight hijacked en route Kathmandu-Delhi on Dec 24, 1999, diverting to Kandahar under Taliban control.

tt14866598.name: Angry Young Men
tt14866598.description: Angry Young Men is the story of Salim-Javed, legendary screenwriters of 1970s Hindi cinema. Together, they created the archetype of the Angry Young Man - a brooding anti-hero who captured the imagination of an entire nation with his rage, defiance, and quest for social justice. Like the character they created, Salim Khan and Javed Akhtar, two outsiders to the Hindi film industry, defied all odds, questioning the position of writers and demanding recognition as much as the reigning stars of that time. Their break-up made headlines for many years and Indian cinema never saw a cultural collaboration as powerful again. This is a personal and candid account of their lives, their writing and their legacy.

videos.title: Main Phenke Hue Paise Nahin Uthata

tt27411674.name: Shekhar Home
tt27411674.description: Set against the backdrop of a sleepy town called Lonpur in Bengal in the early 1990s. Shekhar meets Jayvrat Sahni, who becomes his housemate due to a twist of fate. The duo end up solving mysteries across East India.

videos.name: It's Elementary
videos.overview: Shekhar & ex-army doctor Jayavrat Saini team up to solve a series of murders in Lonpur marked by a "horse shoe" symbol. As Jayavrat evolves from roommate to partner, a shadowy figure known as "M" ominously watches Shekhar from the shadows.
videos.description: Shekhar & ex-army doctor Jayavrat Saini team up to solve a series of murders in Lonpur marked by a "horse shoe" symbol. As Jayavrat evolves from roommate to partner, a shadowy figure known as "M" ominously watches Shekhar from the shadows.

videos.name: Dasbabu Ki Dulhan
videos.overview: Shekhar dives into a village scam where a jungle adventure leads to a bank heist. With a bride-to-be's father missing, he uncovers a tangled plot revealing a cunning robber with a grudge, while the looming threat of "M" draws ever closer.
videos.description: Shekhar dives into a village scam where a jungle adventure leads to a bank heist. With a bride-to-be's father missing, he uncovers a tangled plot revealing a cunning robber with a grudge, while the looming threat of "M" draws ever closer.

videos.name: Phir Milenge
videos.overview: Shekhar & Jayavrat are in Bihar for a blackmail scandal involving a famous politician. Shekhar is fascinated by the enigmatic Iraboty, while Mrinmoy discovers a classified file on "M," adding a new layer of intrigue to their investigation.
videos.description: Shekhar & Jayavrat are in Bihar for a blackmail scandal involving a famous politician. Shekhar is fascinated by the enigmatic Iraboty, while Mrinmoy discovers a classified file on "M," adding a new layer of intrigue to their investigation.

videos.name: Bhaskarvilla
videos.overview: Iraboty's arrival in Lonpur sparks intrigue as she convinces Shekhar to investigate the 150-year-old Skhondokhata legend in Purulia, linked to recent deaths in the Bhaskar family. Shekhar suspects a deeper conspiracy.
videos.description: Iraboty's arrival in Lonpur sparks intrigue as she convinces Shekhar to investigate the 150-year-old Skhondokhata legend in Purulia, linked to recent deaths in the Bhaskar family. Shekhar suspects a deeper conspiracy.

videos.name: "M" For Mastermind
videos.overview: Mrs. H & Pintoo are held hostage at Khasha Blanca forcing Shekhar to confront his past where he had uncovered a deadly gas weapon linked to M, a criminal mastermind. Now they must find the vial or his friends lose their lives.
videos.description: Mrs. H & Pintoo are held hostage at Khasha Blanca forcing Shekhar to confront his past where he had uncovered a deadly gas weapon linked to M, a criminal mastermind. Now they must find the vial or his friends lose their lives.

videos.name: Kahan Chippe Ho Tagore?
videos.overview: Racing against time, Shekhar and Jayavrat hunt for clues across Calcutta left by the scientist Gupta, aiming to find a vial with the secret gas formula. As they near the final code, Shekhar faces M in a deadly struggle.
videos.description: Racing against time, Shekhar and Jayavrat hunt for clues across Calcutta left by the scientist Gupta, aiming to find a vial with the secret gas formula. As they near the final code, Shekhar faces M in a deadly struggle.

tt26915338.name: Gyaarah Gyaarah
tt26915338.description: Investigative drama following events in 1990, 2001, 2016. Intertwining storylines blending mysticism, science and mystery across the decades.

tt33022421.name: Life Hill Gayi
tt33022421.description: ﻿Siblings turn rivals when they are put on an inheritance race by reviving a down-in-the-dumps hotel in the hills. Who will emerge victorious?

tt31032285.name: Raisinghani VS. Raisinghani
tt31032285.description: Anushka and Virat, two young lawyers once in love, find their destinies intertwined again. This time though, the stakes are higher with the complexities of love entwined with professional rivalry and starkly different work ideologies.

videos.title: Emergency Meeting At The Raisinghani Firm
Madhu And Rajdeep Come Face To Face

tt32324501.name: Tujhpe Main Fida
tt32324501.description: In Cole Town, Aira Rajkishore, trapped by duty to her ailing mother, faces the return of Marcus, who seeks to rekindle their past romance. Amidst mysterious deaths in town, they must navigate danger and protect loved ones. As they confront the town's dark secrets, can they save their love, or will Cole Town's mysteries tear them apart? Aira and Marcus's fate hangs in the balance.

videos.title: Welcome To Cole Town
videos.overview: Marcus arrives at Cole Town with the hopes of apologising to and rekindling his romance with the town's mystery girl, Aira. The discovery of Violet's dead body causes uproar among the residents of the town.

videos.title: What Happens In The Jungle
videos.overview: Aira's refusal to listen to Marcus's apologies causes the rift in their relationship to deepen. In the Jungle, Marcus and Aira overhear someone who may have something to do with her death. Marcus offers to help Aira solve this mystery.

videos.title: New Leads
videos.overview: After learning about the rumours circulating about Aira's house, Marcus decides to help her put a stop to them. Meanwhile Aira learns that Violet had been followed by a student of the college the night of her death. Aira begins to look for the person who followed Violet.

videos.title: The Secrets They Hide
videos.overview: A comment from Aira causes Marcus to lose his cool at her. Meanwhile, Isha tells Marcus the secrets of Aira and her family. Instead of succeeding in keeping him away from Aira, her revelations end up bringing Marcus and Aira closer as he goes to Shanti Sadan to check on her.

videos.title: Deep Wounds
videos.overview: Worried about Aira, Marcus sneaks into the eerie Shanti Sadan for the first time. Aira finally reveals to Marcus what she went through in the past two years. A gunshot fired in the compound of the house causes chaos.

videos.title: Rumours & Reality
videos.overview: Having vowed to not bother Aira again, Marcus keeps his distance from her. When Aira suspects that Veer was the boy who followed Violet, she seeks Marcus's help to confirm her suspicions. He ignores her initially but later helps her confirm her suspicions about Veer.

videos.title: Killer Party (Part 1)
videos.overview: Marcus and Aira team up to find the cap that'll prove Veer had been following Violet the night she died. Meanwhile Isha, Nirvan and Iraz plan to set up Veer to keep themselves out of the police's radar. Marcus and Aira find his cap in the college locker room but before they can leave, someone arrives there.

videos.title: Killer Party (Part 2)
videos.overview: As the students of White Flower Hall play a game of Killer, Aira and Marcus confront Veer about his own crimes. Jesse's presence at the college also raises some suspicions. Marcus and Aira pursue Jesse and Veer respectively. Veer is able to prove his innocence while Marcus injures Jesse so he's not able to escape the town.

videos.title: The Unexpected Hero
videos.overview: With Violet's murder getting seemingly solved, Marcus and Aira are once again at an impasse. Working on a Hindi Project together gives them an excuse to continue spending time with each other. Unbeknownst to anyone, a new tragedy strikes the town when Yug disappears in the forest

videos.title: The Past Returns
videos.overview: Francis's visit to Cole Town leads to the revelation of what had caused Marcus to abandon Aira two years ago. Aira is finally able to forgive him. The news of Yug's disappearance spreads in the town. Marcus and Aira found a set of keys in the forest but aren't able to identify them as Yug's

videos.title: The First Date
videos.overview: Marcus and Aira's secret date gets interrupted when Inspector Divya wishes to speak to them regarding Yug's disappearance as they had found his keys. Marcus and Aira rush to reach Shanti Sadan before Inspector Divya can reach there.

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: Marcus meets Aira's mother, Tara for the first time. While the strange encounter fascinates Marcus, Aira is anything but happy about this. They accompany the police to the forest to help them look for Yug. Later Yug's dead body is found in a tree.

videos.title: Tara
videos.overview: Tensions in Shanti Sadan are palpable as Marcus and Aira return from the forest. Aira is reluctant to leave Marcus alone with her mother but is forced to. The news of Yug's death causes Tara to react violently.

videos.title: Broken Trust
videos.overview: Marcus decides to seek help from his teacher Sanchit to find out if there's anything wrong with Shanti Sadan. Sanchit arrival discovers the truth of Tara's illness. Aira begs for him to keep this a secret. When she finds Marcus's I'd card in her bedroom, she realises who sent Sanchit and is furious.

videos.title: The Great Divide
videos.overview: Inspector Divya finds evidence against Sanchit and arrest him as a suspect in Yug’s murder case. Livid with Marcus for sending Sanchit to Aira’s house, Aira decides to not speak with Marcus. When he sneaks into her room, the two of them have a massive argument. Aira tells him that their relationship is over.

videos.title: Ways Parted
videos.overview: Frustrated by the rumours spreading about Sanchit and Yug, Aira decides to sneak into Yug’s room to look for evidence. Meanwhile, in the aftermath of the breakup, Marcus is convinced that Aira doesn't share the feelings he has for her. Will he help Aira in her quest to prove Sanchit's innocence?

videos.title: Hurtful Past
videos.overview: An argument over Sanchit's involvement in Yug's death makes Aira determined to prove his innocence to Marcus. Elsi sees Marcus and Aira together and decides to reveal some unpleasant truths to Aira. Later Aira finds a crying Isha in the forest, who makes a shocking revelation to her.

videos.title: The Prophecy
videos.overview: Aira travels to Jamshedpur to gather evidence that'll prove Sanchit's innocence, not knowing that she is walking straight into danger. Despite his decision to put some distance between himself and Aira, Marcus follows her. Will he be able to keep Aira safe?

videos.title: Reunited
videos.overview: A conversation with Tara makes Aira realise that she shouldn't let go of her feelings for Marcus so easily. Meanwhile, Marcus is determined to distance himself from Aira and focus on his match the following day. A miner with a distinctive scar on his face gets a mysterious call that might spell danger to Aira’s life.

videos.title: The Big Match (Part 1)
videos.overview: With Marcus on the verge of losing the most important cricket match of his life, Aira decides to confess her true feelings to him. As the two share a romantic moment, the scarred miner enters the college. Is Aira’s life in danger?

videos.title: The Big Match (Part 2)
videos.overview: After seeing Aira kiss Marcus, Isha loses her temper and picks a fight with her. Amidst the fight between the two girls, Inspector Divya is able to prevent a life threatening attack on Aira. Later, Isha comes upon something suspicious near the abandoned mines.

videos.title: Founders Day
videos.overview: At the Founder's Day Party, Nirvan plans a special surprise to win back Isha’s favour that puts Aira’s life in danger. Can Marcus save her? Or is this the end for Aira?

videos.title: No One’s Safe
videos.overview: Marcus and Aira’s romantic moment is interrupted by Amma, who informs Aira of Tara’s disappearance. Frantic over this news, Aira tells Marcus the truth about her mother's condition. Things take a dark turn when Marcus comes face to face with Tara, dressed in the miner’s costume.

videos.title: Shot’s Fired
videos.overview: Marcus finds an injured Isha in the forest but is arrested by the police for attempting to murder her. Aira sees the police take Marcus away but is unable to leave her mother's side and go to him. At the hospital, Veer hears something very alarming. Are Marcus and his family’s lives in danger?

videos.title: End of the Road
videos.overview: Amidst the chaos in the town, Aira is finally able to find Marcus. However it is too late. Can Marcus forgive Aira for not coming to the police station sooner? Is this the end for Marcus and Aira's love story?

tt32458829.name: Bad Cop
tt32458829.description: Twin brothers on the opposite sides of the law get caught in a complex web of deceit, loyalty and betrayal.

tt28558661.name: Amber Girls School
tt28558661.description: Ojaswini, a 15-year-old, sincere, sanskaari student of 9th grade chases her dream to be the Head Girl of Amber Girls School with focus and passion. This puts her ambition in direct conflict with her desire to explore all things ‘teenage’ and 'grown up' while dealing with the financial crisis her family is going through. Will she pursue her Head Girl dream or find her voice through this journey?

videos.title: Adam, Ojas And The Garden Of Amber
Ganda Hai Par Dhandha Hai Ye
Kyunki Dish Bhi Kabhi Cable Tha

tt32468359.name: BLUETICK
tt32468359.description: #BLUETICK ☑️ portrays the compelling narrative of a young influencer from a middle-class background who relentlessly pursues fame. She stops at nothing to maintain her status, blurring the line between reel and real, which ultimately leads to her downfall. The story unfolds as she navigates the consequences of her actions and strives to find redemption.

videos.title: The Talent Management Agency
videos.overview: In the vibrant city of Mumbai, Pallavi, an influencer seeking to transcend social media fame, clashes with her best friend Ritu over a career move. Neglecting warnings, Pallavi’s actions lead to unintended consequences.

videos.title: Dizzying Heights
videos.overview: Pallavi challenges tradition on a podcast, recounting past online struggles, failed collaborations and inorganic tactics to gain visibility. In the present, her moral stance against a brand backfires while the news of her father's illness makes her anxious.

videos.title: The Real Job
videos.overview: Pallavi's flashback reveals family tension over her career choices and a decline in online followers including her and Ritu's failure to impress a brand manager and her past overnight fame sparked by a horrifying incident. While at present she grapples with the mixed reactions to her latest post.

videos.title: The Inflection Point
videos.overview: Past reveals how Pallavi's family disapproves, leading to deletion of her viral video. Viraj urges her to host an online session with influencers, boosting older videos and earning her the coveted Blue Tick. Presently, she exposes the brand, facing legal consequences.

videos.title: The Lost Cause
videos.overview: Pallavi’s attempt to resolve the crisis goes awry. The past reveals a reel to real romance with Viraj. Left feeling desolate, Pallavi tries to rectify the situation, just as Ritu reaches out again since the argument. They’re both left in utter shock at what happens next.

videos.title: The Final Upload
videos.overview: In the hospital, Pallavi faces her mother amid distress. Malvika's smear campaign ends with exposed intentions. Betrayed by influencers, Pallavi schemes to reclaim her online presence, re-evaluating priorities with a revealing truth.

tt32832648.name: Tribhuvan Mishra CA Topper
tt32832648.description: Middle-class man seeks secret escort services during financial woes. Entangled in lies, murder and gang, he becomes what he once despised - corrupt.

tt32729607.name: Pill
tt32729607.description: Pill unravels the deep-set rot in the Indian pharmaceutical industry. Dr. Prakash along with three whistle-blowers face a powerful pharma giant Forever Cure to expose the corrupt nexus of pharma, middlemen, and doctors through which a pill reaches the common man. Will the good be able to overcome the evil?

videos.title: The Transfer
videos.overview: Dr. Prakash uncovers dysfunction within the Medicine Authority of India while Forever Cure Pharma eyes expansion, sparking a clash of interests and ethical dilemmas.

videos.title: The File
videos.overview: Noor, the journalist finds a dossier on a discontinued antibiotic by Forever Cure Pharma. Dr. Prakash learns of a failed inspection at their Gurgaon facility. Suspicion grows, leading to a compelling investigation.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: Noor shares scant details of the discontinued antibiotic on social media, catching Gursimrat's attention, who informs Dr. Prakash. Despite Neelima's dismissal, Dr. Prakash persists, determined to join forces with Noor in their quest for truth.

videos.title: The Drug Test
videos.overview: Forever Cure Pharma's CEO, Bramha Gill, stunned by outcry over trial deaths, seeks CM's help. Dr. Prakash orders Gurgaon plant re-inspection; no evidence found. An insider who discovers the truth is being forced to shut down.

videos.title: The Bribe
videos.overview: Amidst damaging articles, Bramha Gill rushes to the US for FMA approval of their cancer drug. Dr. Prakash faces a setback when he finds his mentor has joined hands with the enemy. Determined, Prakash opts to meet MCGI's Mr. Raman.

videos.title: The Despair
videos.overview: Denied by superiors, Prakash takes Forever Cure Pharma to court for plant inspection. Court orders an inspection only to uncover the rot in the practices of Forever cure pharma.

videos.title: The Conspiracy
videos.overview: Dr. Prakash decides to test drugs by his own means but faces a setback. Yet he approaches the supreme court, what is up his sleeve?

videos.title: The Catharsis
videos.overview: It is race against time for Dr, Prakash and team in court. Their only hope, Ashish struggles for his life in a hit and run attack. Will the common man win?

tt27618627.name: 36 Days
tt27618627.description: An enigmatic woman's arrival in a seemingly idyllic housing estate in Goa threatens to expose the residents' darkest secrets. As they clamour to unravel her mysteries, all their lies and hidden identities begin destroying them, culminating in absolute horror. Neha Sharma, Amruta Khanvilkar, Sharib Hashmi, Chandan Roy Sanyal, Shruti Seth, Sushant Divgikar and Purab Kohli star in the crime-thriller of a 36-day journey to the fateful moment that upends the lives of Goa’s Casa De Magnolia residents.

tt28075268.name: Showtime
tt28075268.description: An epic saga of legacy and ambition, get a glimpse behind the multi million-dollar industry of Bollywood, nepotism and power struggles at the top.

tt27302334.name: Crimes Aaj Kal
tt27302334.description: Crimes Aaj Kal is a thrilling web show hosted by Vikrant Massey that showcases the stories of modern-day crimes committed by modern-day criminals, based on true events happening all around the country.

videos.title: Reel Vs Real
videos.overview: Has Aditya really been kidnapped or is he faking it? It’s a reel that reveals the kidnapping. Cops believe Aditya is doing this on purpose it’s fake. Aditya’s girlfriend Monica reveals that he was planning a reel like this. Is it really a Reel or a real kidnapping?

videos.title: The Broken Heart
videos.overview: Francis is threatened to stay away from Sophia. Cops find out he was threatened by Sanjay. 24 year old Sanjay when reached is found murdered. A girl’s photos are found in his room. Is this Sophia? What is the game here? Who killed Sanjay?

videos.title: Kill The Enemy
videos.overview: Abhay is accused of killing his mother and younger brother in cold blood. His father Rakesh doesn’t believe that his Abhay could have done this. Cops have no doubt that it is Abhay. A psychologist comes in to make Abhay speak. Did Abhay committed this crime? If yes, why?

videos.title: The Last Party
videos.overview: Naina, Ronak, Basant, Sandeep, Ashima have come to Goa, for the New Year eve. A party amongst the friends. The Party ends up in the death of Naina. A fall from the balcony. Is it an accidental fall, after getting drunk too much? Or something else?

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Anuj Rawat, commits suicide. His fiance Natasha suspects foul play though cops don’t find any foul play in the suicide. But Natasha’s doubts prove true. Investigation into Anuj’s recent past reveals shocking details. Was it really a suicide? Why?

videos.title: No Way Out
videos.overview: Namrata Wadkar decides to take her own life one afternoon, when her parents are not at home. She would have hung herself by the fan, she has already written the suicide note. But then it’s only her suicide note that has been found. What happened to Namrata?

videos.title: War Of Words
videos.overview: Avantika Gera, 2nd year Computer Engineering student is shot dead in broad daylight in Pune. Her one sided lover and a local politician’s son Vikas Naik and her boy-friend Sunil are in dock. Who killed Avantika and why?

videos.title: The Scapegoat
videos.overview: 7 year old Prithvi is dropped by his cousin Navin for Prithvi’s maths tuition outside the house of the teacher, Shankar Nagar. But Shankar claims Prithvi didn’t come for tuitions at all that day. Where would a 7 year old child disappear?

videos.title: The Missing Links
videos.overview: 18 year old Geeta Singh, in Jodhpur, leaves home, leaving behind a note that she is going with someone she loves and wants to start a new life. Could she fulfil her wish? What happened to her? Similar to Inspector rishi

videos.title: Pursuit Of Desire
videos.overview: Sumit, a class 8 student, fights with his parents everyday wanting a mobile phone. His parents have made it clear to him that he will get it only after 10th standard. One day Sumit goes out and doesn’t return back home. Where is Sumit? What happened to him? Like Mirzapur

videos.title: The Vicious Circle
videos.overview: Prajakta Tiwari, a missing saleswoman, entangled in a mysterious love story with Vaibhav Prasad. Surveillance reveals Vaibhav's connection to Rashmi Kushwaha, whose tragic suicide sparks questions. Was it a love triangle, jealousy, or a sinister plot? Uncover the secrets in this gripping tale of passion and deceit.

videos.title: Dangerous Pursuits
videos.overview: In a tale of love, betrayal, and a mysterious murder, a past incident resurfaces. A web of secrets connects Nazneen, Anwar, and a businessman's demise. As the plot unfolds, motives blur, leaving questions about innocence and revenge. Uncover the truth in this gripping narrative.

videos.title: Murder Most Foul
videos.overview: In the Mumbai corporate office's sinister depths, techie Sneha, 26, meets a chilling end. Amidst workplace rivalries, the murder weapon's mysterious entry stirs intrigue. Raghav, Vinita, and Ashutosh emerge as suspects, each harboring secrets. The plot thickens with a love triangle, a one-sided obsession, and a shocking revelation about Sneha's friend, Maira. What was the motive?

videos.title: Suppressed Anger
videos.overview: Prakash Munjal, a transport company owner in Bhopal, and his wife Savita meet a grim fate. Daughters point fingers at cousins and a tech prodigy from Pune. Dark family secrets surface, but the true orchestrator remains concealed. Who's the puppet master behind this labyrinth of betrayals? Like Mirzapur

videos.title: Gone Too Far
videos.overview: 24 year old Shilpa Goradia, finds a newborn baby girl, murdered and abandoned near her house. Cops Feel that Shilpa is not telling the entire truth. What is the truth?

videos.title: Gone Girl
videos.overview: Sanjana Doshi, a 23-year-old student attending college in London, has ceased communication with her uncle, Rajesh Doshi, and aunt, Bhavna Doshi, residing in Anand, Gujarat. Has an unforeseen event occurred to her?

videos.title: Whispers of Fate
videos.overview: Swati Kanwar, a 21-year-old, has gone missing, yet her family hesitates to file a formal missing person report. Concerned friends of Swati turn to the police, urging them to uncover the truth behind her disappearance. Where has Swati vanished to?

videos.title: The Vanishing
videos.overview: 21 year old Suyash Kolhe, a 2nd year engineering student, in Pune, goes missing. Suyash stays with his sister, Mansi (19) years old, also a student. They both stay on rent in a small flat. The strongest suspicion is on Mansi, who is having an affair with a guy Anand and Suyash was opposed to it. But if it's a forced disappearance, then where are the signs of it?

tt32614039.name: Industry
tt32614039.description: Aspiring screenwriter Aayush Verma navigates the bylanes of the Mumbai film industry and etches a bittersweet migrant fairy tale through his personal friendships and professional fall-outs, to make it into the world of ‘Industry’.

videos.title: Narration
videos.overview: Aayush narrates his 26th script - Dhoom Dhadaka - with the hope of getting it produced with his name in the credit, but he stumbles upon unprecedented troubles from producer Rakesh Raman and actor Kunal Kumar.

videos.title: Salim-Javed
videos.overview: Aayush gets Producer Juggy Wadhwani’s actor son Rocky excited for his script Dhoom Dhadaka but his co-writer, Gayatri has another story idea - Swaadanusar which Aayush ends up pitching in his desperation to get his career started. TV star Sanya and Ayush become friends.

videos.title: Greenlight
videos.overview: Aayush and Rocky try to get Dhoom Dhadaka greenlit but they are both treated as newbies in the Industry. Meanwhile, Gayatri befriends TV actor, Arjun who is looking for someone to write his film idea.

videos.title: Agent of Change
videos.overview: There are new problems on Aayush’s greenlit film. Rocky’s family gets a new film for him to star in but he is asked to audition by the director. Meanwhile, Aayush fights with Gayatri because of his closeness with Sanya and pitches her story Swaadanusaar as his own.

videos.title: The Announcement
videos.overview: Aayush’s two films as screenwriter are announced but he feels that he is slowly losing control over Dhoom Dhadaka. Meanwhile, Aayush gets jealous of Gayatri and Arjun's romantic relationship and she learns from a third person about Aayush’s foul play in selling her script as his.

tt32563122.name: Sisterhood
tt32563122.description: Four radically different 9th-grade girls forge a bond within the walls of an all-girls convent school, embarking on a journey of friendship, self-discovery, and shared adventures that define their transformative school years.

videos.title: The First Day
videos.overview: Nikita must pay a fine but doesn't have the money for it and plans to steal from the might box by crossing Gargi, the new entrant. Zoya must help Ann, the repeater to improve her grades this year.

videos.title: Where Art Thy Periods, Juliet?
videos.overview: A sharp pain shoots up Nikita's abdomen who has desperately been waiting to get her first period. Ann and Gargi sign up for auditioning for Romeo and Juliet, while competing to play Juliet.

videos.title: Joy, The Boy
videos.overview: Zoya and Joy, the topper from boys' school compete to decide who is better. A nervous Nikita is unable to speak to her crush Joy and is helped by Gargi to approach him, as Ann distracts their teacher.

videos.title: Women of Science
videos.overview: The girls need to work on their science group project before their term end exams and Zoya is determined to make the best project, but Nikita's little mistake costs them.

videos.title: Birthday Bombs
videos.overview: The term end exams are on, and Nikita is planning a firecracker blast on the last day. Her plan is on it's way to be sabotaged by Kiara and Diane, but her friends come to her rescue.

tt28102654.name: Gaanth Chapter 1: Jamnaa Paar
tt28102654.description: The mystery triggers with the death of six members of the Chandel family, along with their dog, in a house near the banks of the river Yamuna: jamna-paar.

videos.name: The Crime Scene From Hell
videos.overview: Gadar Singh is reinstated from suspension to investigate the mysterious homicide of Jatin Chandel and his family, delving into a case shrouded in unnatural circumstances and hidden secrets. Watch the episode for more.
videos.description: Gadar Singh is reinstated from suspension to investigate the mysterious homicide of Jatin Chandel and his family, delving into a case shrouded in unnatural circumstances and hidden secrets. Watch the episode for more.

videos.name: Nosy Neighbours, Noisy Neighbours
videos.overview: Sakshi Murmu is drawn into the homicide case while treating the sole survivor. Meanwhile, Gadar Singh questions the neighbours, hoping to uncover leads in the mysterious case. Will he succeed?
videos.description: Sakshi Murmu is drawn into the homicide case while treating the sole survivor. Meanwhile, Gadar Singh questions the neighbours, hoping to uncover leads in the mysterious case. Will he succeed?

videos.name: Pyres and Puzzles
videos.overview: During their investigation, Sakshi Murmu and Gadar Singh uncover a crucial clue. Together, they pursue this lead to unravel the mystery behind the murders of Jatin Chandel and his family. Watch the episode for more.
videos.description: During their investigation, Sakshi Murmu and Gadar Singh uncover a crucial clue. Together, they pursue this lead to unravel the mystery behind the murders of Jatin Chandel and his family. Watch the episode for more.

videos.name: The Hunt Begins
videos.overview: Gadar Singh and the team apprehend prime suspect Jabbar for interrogation. Meanwhile, Sakshi Murmu delves into the victim's school records and workbooks for leads. Watch the episode for more.
videos.description: Gadar Singh and the team apprehend prime suspect Jabbar for interrogation. Meanwhile, Sakshi Murmu delves into the victim's school records and workbooks for leads. Watch the episode for more.

videos.name: Confessions of a Cockroach
videos.overview: Yashwant becomes shocked when Jabbar commits suicide. On the other hand, Gadar Singh interrogates Haseena, determined to crack the case through her confession. Will he ultimately unravel the mystery?
videos.description: Yashwant becomes shocked when Jabbar commits suicide. On the other hand, Gadar Singh interrogates Haseena, determined to crack the case through her confession. Will he ultimately unravel the mystery?

videos.name: Locks in the Present, Keys in the Past
videos.overview: Reporter Surendranath reaches out to Gadar Singh, offering assistance in solving the case. Meanwhile, Sakshi grows worried as a killer tries to attack Kushagra in the hospital. Can she rescue him?
videos.description: Reporter Surendranath reaches out to Gadar Singh, offering assistance in solving the case. Meanwhile, Sakshi grows worried as a killer tries to attack Kushagra in the hospital. Can she rescue him?

videos.name: A Convenient Truth
videos.overview: After collecting ample evidence, the CBI officers declare Jatin and his family's deaths as a mass suicide. However, Gadar and Sakshi remain dissatisfied with this conclusion, resolving to find the real truth behind the incident. Will they succeed?
videos.description: After collecting ample evidence, the CBI officers declare Jatin and his family's deaths as a mass suicide. However, Gadar and Sakshi remain dissatisfied with this conclusion, resolving to find the real truth behind the incident. Will they succeed?

videos.name: Underground Resurrection
videos.overview: The police decide to arrest Gadar Singh for Sunny's death. In the meantime, Yashwant contacts Sakshi and informs her of the incident, urging her to intervene and save Gadar Singh from trouble. Will she be successful in her efforts to rescue him?
videos.description: The police decide to arrest Gadar Singh for Sunny's death. In the meantime, Yashwant contacts Sakshi and informs her of the incident, urging her to intervene and save Gadar Singh from trouble. Will she be successful in her efforts to rescue him?

tt30224310.name: Aangan Aapno Kaa
tt30224310.description: This is story of a daughter who is determined to fulfil her duties towards her father indefinitely. A contemporary family drama, the show also promises to be a heartwarming journey of a daughter with ...

videos.title: Jaidev's Retirement Function
videos.overview: Jaidev Sharma, a dedicated single father, and his unbreakable bond with his three daughters.

tt32230926.name: Namacool
tt32230926.description: Mayank and Piyush, inseparable best friends, embark on their journey to uncover the true essence of manhood. However, yearning for popularity and romance, a chain of hilarious misfortunes thrusts them into the midst of a murder accusation.

videos.title: Katta Aur Katto
videos.overview: Mayank and Piyush embark on a string of misadventures aiming to impress their idol, Chakku Pandey, to rank higher in his gang. Chakku has everything they aspire to have - The Qahar of the City - Minty, and dominance. Chaos erupts when Dean Syed Ahmed refuses to hold college elections at KCR College.

videos.title: Naye Badshah
videos.overview: Released from lockup, Mayank, along with Piyush become college celebrities. Amidst this newfound fame, a poignant encounter between Piyush and Rubiya ignites the beginning of a meaningful connection. Meanwhile, Meghnad's mysterious actions add layers to the unfolding mystery, complicating the situation even further.

videos.title: Biryani Ishq Ki
videos.overview: Amidst financial woes, Piyush charms Rubiya, offering help for her dinner event. Meanwhile, Chakku faces a tough decision. Tensions rise as Mayank's clash with Samarth strains his relationship with Chakku. At Rubiya's dinner, Piyush grapples with jealousy, while Mayank receives a mysterious message from Chakku.

videos.title: Rubiya Ki Khoobiyaan
videos.overview: Mayank faces a pivotal decision when Chakku offers him a major task. As tensions rise between them, Piyush grapples with conflicting emotions, while Minty's clandestine meeting with Mayank hints at deeper plots. Meanwhile, Niharika's jealousy grows as she observes Piyush's growing closeness with Rubiya. Amidst it all, Meghnad's mysterious phone call hints at darker machinations at play.

videos.title: Iski Topi Uske Sar
videos.overview: As preparations for a college dance competition heat up, Piyush and Mayank find themselves entangled in a web of secrets and alliances. While Piyush navigates the complexities of his relationships with Niharika and Rubiya, Mayank delves into murky dealings to undercut Chakku's power. With tensions rising and guns at the ready, the stage is set for a dramatic confrontation for all involved.

videos.title: Jhoom Barabar Jhoom
videos.overview: Piyush struggles with loyalty as Mayank's troubles deepen. Their desperate plan to eliminate Dean Ahmed fails, pushing them to seek redemption through the competition. Yet, a sudden gunshot disrupts the event, leaving everyone in shock.

videos.title: Mai Anari Tu Khiladi
videos.overview: Mayank and Piyush confront each other under Rumi Darwaza. Amid chaos, Misunderstandings ensue, culminating in a tense standoff with police, caught on a live stream!

tt32258354.name: Murder in Mahim
tt32258354.description: Set against the backdrop of a horrible murder at Mahim station, follows Peter's involvement in this diabolical inquiry. The stakes rise when his own son, Sunil, becomes a suspect in the case.

tt22015480.name: Lootere
tt22015480.description: When pirates hijack a ship off the coast of Somalia, a high-stakes game is played with innocent lives and a precious piece of cargo aboard.

videos.title: Welcome to Somalia
videos.overview: Mogadishu's port presidency elections are coming up, and Vikrant Gandhi wants to be re-elected at any cost. But bad news hits him when the UK-Kyival enters Somalian waters.

videos.title: Besieged
videos.overview: Vikrant is shocked that Bilal Ali used pirates to help him. Captain A.K. Singh and his crew concoct a plan to take back control of the ship.

videos.title: Home Sweet Home
videos.overview: Vikrant meets the pirates and checks his cargo, but an accident upsets his plans until Bilal offers a solution. Tired of her husband's indifference, Avika resolves to find Ismael.

videos.title: Middlemen
videos.overview: The going gets tough for the crew aboard. Vikrant learns about Mudit's death and realises his impossible situation. Gupta finds out who backed his boss into a corner.

videos.title: Dog Eat Dog
videos.overview: Al-Muharib's boss issues an ultimatum to Faisal over the delayed guns' shipment. Discontent grows among the pirates, leading to an ugly spat. Vikrant gets to know who betrayed him.

videos.title: Zero Hundred
videos.overview: Vikrant finds Avika. Ghulam Waris of Kenya's Indian High Commission asks Vikrant to help with the hostage crisis. On the ship, Koombe reveals to Faisal where his cargo really is.

videos.title: Betrayal
videos.overview: Tawfiq tightens the noose around Vikrant. A deadly warning forces the Kotwals to accept the pirates' ransom demand. Gabul realises Koombe and Salaah are missing.

videos.title: Welcome Back to Somalia
videos.overview: Waris and Vikrant reach the Harardhere port. Gabul decides to make an example of the ship's crew. A fight for survival ensues aboard UK-Kyival, at Vikrant's house and in Somalia.

tt15204292.name: Heeramandi: The Diamond Bazaar
tt15204292.description: Sanjay Leela Bhansali brings his majestic signature flair to stories of love and betrayal in the lives of courtesans in pre-independence India.

tt28681409.name: Ranneeti: Balakot & Beyond
tt28681409.description: Post the deadly Pulwama attacks, Kashyap and his team strike back with a fitting reply. In the age of hybrid warfare, they must race against time to bring back their captured pilot while also battling Pakistan's lies in global media.

videos.name: Drishtikon - War of Perspective
videos.overview: Suspended RAW agent Kashyap uncovers vital intel on a cross-border terrorist organisation's latest developments posing a grave threat to India. Unfortunately, a massive explosion hits Pulwama before he can get through NSB head Dutta.
videos.description: Suspended RAW agent Kashyap uncovers vital intel on a cross-border terrorist organisation's latest developments posing a grave threat to India. Unfortunately, a massive explosion hits Pulwama before he can get through NSB head Dutta.

videos.name: Yuktikon - War of Strategy
videos.overview: Kashyap assembles an elite counter terrorism unit which also has Manisha, a spin doctor with a past connection to Kashyap. Their plan is to carry out a radical operation against the terrorists who caused the Pulwama attacks.
videos.description: Kashyap assembles an elite counter terrorism unit which also has Manisha, a spin doctor with a past connection to Kashyap. Their plan is to carry out a radical operation against the terrorists who caused the Pulwama attacks.

videos.name: Anubhootikon - War of Perception
videos.overview: With aid from the IAF, Kashyap's team begins strategizing the execution of a deadly air strike, aided by a deep-cover Indian spy within the terrorist camp who is risking his life to supply critical intelligence.
videos.description: With aid from the IAF, Kashyap's team begins strategizing the execution of a deadly air strike, aided by a deep-cover Indian spy within the terrorist camp who is risking his life to supply critical intelligence.

videos.name: Pratishodhikon - War of Retaliation
videos.overview: A humiliated Pakistan launches a counter-airstrike in Kashmir. While Indian jets chase away the intruder, Wing Commander Abhimanyu is taken P.O.W in the skirmish escalating tensions between India-Pakistan.
videos.description: A humiliated Pakistan launches a counter-airstrike in Kashmir. While Indian jets chase away the intruder, Wing Commander Abhimanyu is taken P.O.W in the skirmish escalating tensions between India-Pakistan.

videos.name: Shaktikon - War of Power
videos.overview: Post the airstrikes, India and Pakistan engage in a media war of narrative control. While Kashyap and Manisha are on opposite ends regarding their approach; Chief Dutta ponders on how to avoid an all-out war.
videos.description: Post the airstrikes, India and Pakistan engage in a media war of narrative control. While Kashyap and Manisha are on opposite ends regarding their approach; Chief Dutta ponders on how to avoid an all-out war.

videos.name: Kathakon - War of Narrative
videos.overview: Dutta and Kashyap's plan creates international pressure on Pakistan compelling them to release the captured Indian Pilot. Once back, Abhimanyu reveals critical intel that prompts India to challenge Pakistan.
videos.description: Dutta and Kashyap's plan creates international pressure on Pakistan compelling them to release the captured Indian Pilot. Once back, Abhimanyu reveals critical intel that prompts India to challenge Pakistan.

videos.name: Jhoothkon - War of Lies
videos.overview: Abhimanyu helps Kashyap figure a counter strategy to firmly challenge Pakistan at FATC. Meanwhile, Netra and Kabir are back at the enemy camp gathering concrete proof of Pakistan's support to terrorism to support Kashyap's case.
videos.description: Abhimanyu helps Kashyap figure a counter strategy to firmly challenge Pakistan at FATC. Meanwhile, Netra and Kabir are back at the enemy camp gathering concrete proof of Pakistan's support to terrorism to support Kashyap's case.

videos.name: Rahasyakon - War of Secrets
videos.overview: Netra and Kabir are caught in a deadly chase from the terrorist camp with sensitive intel which could incriminate Pakistan at FATC. Kashyap is racing against time to get them both to safety but will he be successful?
videos.description: Netra and Kabir are caught in a deadly chase from the terrorist camp with sensitive intel which could incriminate Pakistan at FATC. Kashyap is racing against time to get them both to safety but will he be successful?

videos.name: Vaastavikatakon - War of Reality
videos.overview: At the FATC amongst global leaders, Kashyap tries to pin down Pakistan's every move. Will he be able to expose their ties to terrorism and be a step ahead in this grey war.
videos.description: At the FATC amongst global leaders, Kashyap tries to pin down Pakistan's every move. Will he be able to expose their ties to terrorism and be a step ahead in this grey war.

tt31913505.name: Dil Dosti Dilemma
tt31913505.description: Asmara’s summer takes an unexpected turn when she is sent to her grandparents’ neighborhood as a form of punishment. To maintain appearances with her friends, she pretends to be in Canada. Amidst the struggles of a traditional setting, she learns new life lessons.

tt31014169.name: Aankh Micholi
tt31014169.description: Undercover cop Rukmini gets married into a traditional family as the 'Aadarsh Bahu. Oscillating dual lives, how long will she be able to maintain her cover?

videos.title: Rukmini's Rigorous Training
videos.overview: Rukmini undergoes rigid training by her father, sculpting her into a future IPS officer. Malhar's taunts about being an orphan affects Sumedh.

videos.title: A Shock for Rukmini
videos.overview: Rukmini collapses on seeing Vandana getting shot. Kesar is devastated by Vijay's death. Later, she rejects Sumedh upon discovering Vijay's deceit.

videos.title: Malhar Brings Sumedh Back
videos.overview: Sumedh motivates Rukmini to bring Vandana's killer to justice. Later, Malhar refuses to take his medicine and convinces Kesar to allow Sumedh into the house.

videos.title: Kesar Receives a Threat
videos.overview: Sumedh quits his education to take care of Vijay's tea stall. While Rukmini aspires to become an IPS officer, Kesar gets threatened by Dollar Seth.

videos.title: Malhar, Rukmini's Determination
videos.overview: Malhar and Rukmini get into a head-to-head competition to bag the best IPS Officer title. Kesar receives criticism for accepting Sumedh as her son.

videos.title: Malhar Expresses His Love to Rukmini
videos.overview: Malhar takes Sumedh's help to confess his feelings to Rukmini, but the latter says she needs more time. Elsewhere, Sumedh seeks Kesar's affection.

videos.title: Kesar Questions Preesha
videos.overview: Sumedh aids Rukmini's father in reclaiming stolen luggage from a thief. Kesar furiously confronts Preesha for cutting hair without her consent.

videos.title: Rukmini Spins Up a Story
videos.overview: Rukmini gets Sumedh's photo from her father and tells Malhar that the man in the photo is her boyfriend. Elsewhere, Kesar punishes Preesha for cutting her hair.

videos.title: Kesar Takes Up the Challenge
videos.overview: Kesar intends to win the local competition to keep her promise to Malhar but faces a challenge from her neighbour. Further, she panics after seeing a gun.

videos.title: Sumedh Helps Kesar
videos.overview: Kesar refuses to take Sumedh's help to win the contest, but he is determined to help keep her promise. Elsewhere, Rukmini faces some trouble in the race.

videos.title: Kesar Accepts Defeat
videos.overview: Kesar surprises everyone by forfeiting the trophy she won with Sumedh's help. Later, Rukmini, uncovering sabotage, successfully gets the saboteur terminated.

videos.title: Preesha Gets Caught
videos.overview: Sumedh finds Preesha in Western clothes with her friends and tries to sneak her into the house. However, Kesar catches Preesha red-handed and scolds her.

videos.title: Rukmini Makes a Mistake
videos.overview: Rukmini mistakenly places her heartfelt letter in Sumedh's pocket instead of Malihar's. Kesar and her family are excitedly ready for Malihar's arrival.

videos.title: Malhar Returns Home
videos.overview: Malhar confides in Sumedh about his feelings for Rukmini. Kesar celebrates Malhar's arrival and eagerly anticipates his return.

videos.title: Malhar Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Kesar blames Malhar for lying to her for Sumedh, but Malhar takes a stand and blames Kesar for always insulting Sumedh. Later, Sumedh fights with Malhar.

videos.title: Malhar Apologises to Kesar
videos.overview: Sumedh cooks a dessert for Malhar so that he can use it to apologise to Kesar. Elsewhere, Rukmini tries to impress Sonal by cooking her mother's recipe.

videos.title: Rukmini Is Ecstatic
videos.overview: Malhar gets thrilled by Rukmini's unique declaration of love towards him. When Sumedh helps Rukmini, they remember a shared memory from their childhood.

videos.title: Malhar Faces Kesar's Questions
videos.overview: Malhar nervously discloses Sumedh and Neeti's budding relationship to Kesar. Elsewhere, Rukmini admits her feelings for Malhar in front of her father.

videos.title: Sumedh Grows Happy
videos.overview: When Malhar invites Neeti to his home, Sumedh becomes overjoyed and gets lost in her thoughts. Rukmini sets out on her journey to achieve her dream.

videos.title: Rukmini in an Unforeseen Situation
videos.overview: Kesar makes preparations to welcome Neeti but refuses to accept Sumedh as her son. Rukmini faces a shocker as her senior officials suspend her from the post.

videos.title: Neeti Humiliates Sumedh
videos.overview: Neeti humiliates Sumedh and declares interest in Malhar. Meanwhile, Rukmini vows to reclaim her position after being disregarded by her senior.

videos.title: Kesar Makes a Promise
videos.overview: Kesar gets furious when Neeti insults Sumedh and promises to find the best wife for him in the next 15 days. Elsewhere, Rukmini gets terminated from her job.

videos.title: Rukmini's Dream Is Shattered
videos.overview: Rukmini has an emotional breakdown as her dream of becoming an IPS officer is shattered. Elsewhere, Sumedh takes an oath to reunite Malhar with his beloved.

videos.title: Rukmini's Request to Her Father
videos.overview: Kesar tells the matchmaker that she needs the perfect bride for Sumedh within 15 days. Later, Rukmini tries to convince her father that she is getting framed.

videos.title: Kesar Questions Sumedh
videos.overview: Kesar asks Sumedh to confess to her if Malhar is in a relationship, while Sumedh is unable to lie to her. Elsewhere, Rukmini's aunt makes a shocking suggestion.

videos.title: Rukmini's Father Falls Sick
videos.overview: Rukimini's aunt tells her about Sumedh and suggests she marry him. Humiliated at work, Rukmini's father collapses and gets hospitalised.

videos.title: Rukmini's Emotional Breakdown
videos.overview: Sumedh rushes to the hospital as Arvind suffers a heart attack. Later, Rukmini breaks down emotionally upon seeing Arvind's condition in the hospital.

videos.title: Rukmini Agrees to Get Married
videos.overview: When Arvind's health worsens, Rukmini anxiously gives her consent for marriage. On the other hand, Kesar is mesmerised seeing Rukmini's photo.

videos.title: Kesar to Meet Rukmini!
videos.overview: After seeing Rukmini's photo and her responsibility towards her family, Kesar decides to meet her. Meanwhile, Rukmini feels heartbroken at Malhar's conduct towards her.

videos.title: A Shocker for Rukmini
videos.overview: Sumedh calls Rukmini and asks her to meet him to discuss the future of her relationship with Malhar. However, Rukmini is shocked to see Sumedh at her house.

videos.title: Kesar's Test for Rukmini
videos.overview: Kesar decides to evaluate Rukmini's skill in concealing her family's flaws by giving her a test. Later, Sumedh shares details about himself with Rukmini.

videos.title: Rukmini Faces a Dilemma
videos.overview: Malhar approves Sumedh and Rukmini's marriage. Later, Rukmini faces a dilemma when Kesar asks for her consent to the marriage.

videos.title: Rukmini, Sumedh's Engagement
videos.overview: Amid family pressure, Rukmini reluctantly exchanges rings with Sumedh. Later, he attempts to meet her to clear misunderstandings, but she refuses to see him.

videos.title: Rukmini's Haldi Ceremony
videos.overview: Piyush comforts Rukmini when she weeps as her dream to catch Vandana's killer gets shattered. Later, Rukmini feels disheartened during her Haldi ceremony.

videos.title: Kesar Sympathises with Rukmini
videos.overview: Rukmini gets frightened by the red colour in the saree from Kesar and discards it. Upon understanding Rukmini's trauma, Kesar opposes all to offer her sympathy.

videos.title: Sumedh, Rukmini's Wedding
videos.overview: Despite her anxiety about the future, Rukmini gets ready to tie the knot with Sumedh. Later, Sumedh assists Piyush by making tea at his wedding.

videos.title: A Shocker for Piyush
videos.overview: Rukmini is overjoyed by her father's visit before the wedding. Later, Piyush uncovers Sumedh's true occupation and confronts Sonal for hiding it.

videos.title: Rukmini, Sumedh's Wedding
videos.overview: Rukmini and Sumedh proceed to the wedding with their participation in different rituals. Malhar meets with an accident when he arrives at the wedding venue.

videos.title: Rukmini's Unusual Grihapravesh
videos.overview: Rukmini is overwhelmed by Kesar's behaviour with the women of the family. Later, a water crisis makes Rukmini mistakenly enter the house without a Grihapravesh.

videos.title: Sumedh's Request to Kesar
videos.overview: As everyone gets locked out of their rooms, Sumedh requests Kesar to sleep in his room. While Rukmini agrees, Kesar hesitates to ruin their wedding night.

videos.title: Kesar Criticises Rukmini
videos.overview: Sumedh enters the bathroom to help Rukmini, and they get scared when Kesar knocks on the door. Later, Kesar gets furious at Rukmini for being late.

videos.title: Rukmini's Trophies are Discarded
videos.overview: Kesar assists Rukmini in preparing for the ceremony, spotting her injury in the process. Further, she finds Rukmini's trophies and asks her to get over her past.

videos.title: Will Sumedh Help Rukmini?
videos.overview: Rukmini decides to seek Sumedh's help to fulfil her dream. Later, Kesar gets angry when Rukmini advises her about obeying traffic rules.

videos.title: Rukmini Faces Kesar's Wrath
videos.overview: Rukmini's daring chase after a thief leaves everyone stunned. But Kesar fumes in anger and lashes out at Rukmini for the same.

videos.title: Rukmini Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Sumedh aids Rukmini in making morning tea for the family. Later, Rukmini confronts Kesar for littering on her way to the temple.

videos.title: Rukmini Faces Humiliation
videos.overview: Kesar asks Rukmini to help her recover some lost money, but she gets blamed for stealing. Later, Rukmini decides to buy some thoughtful gifts for Sumedh.

videos.title: A Shocker for Rukmini
videos.overview: Rukmini is surprised when she sees that no one is wearing any uniform at Sumedh's felicitation ceremony. Later, Rukmini learns about Sumedh's occupation.

videos.title: Rukmini's Ambitious Goal
videos.overview: Rukmini rejects the idea of marrying Sumedh. Later, she discloses her aspiration to become an IPS officer, while Kesar exposes her family's betrayal.

videos.title: Rukmini Questions Fai's Deception
videos.overview: Shivani devices a plan to hide their mistake to evade Kesar's anger. Elsewhere, Rukmini emotionally breaks down and confronts Fai about the deception against her.

videos.title: Rukmini Uncovers the Truth
videos.overview: Rukmini is devastated when her educational certificates disappear from her Almirah. Her investigation unexpectedly unveils Shivani's scheme in front of everyone.

videos.title: Rukmini Accepts Her False Reality
videos.overview: Kesar demands Bhaven and Shivani's departure due to their deceit. Elsewhere, Rukmini decides to bury her dreams, embracing the falsehood of her current life.

videos.title: Rukmini's Rebellious Move
videos.overview: Kesar gets furious at Preesha for misbehaving at the dinner table and attempts to hit her However, Rukmini stops Kesar which makes the latter lose her calm.

videos.title: Sumedh Learns Rukmini's Truth
videos.overview: Rukmini confronts Sonal and her aunt, furious at their deception regarding Sumedh and his family. Later, Sumedh stumbles upon a photo of Rukmini in an IPS uniform.

videos.title: Kesar's Startling Ultimatum
videos.overview: Rukmini's anxiety mounts as the police come to hand over her certificates to Kesar. Later, Rukmini gets dumbfounded as Kesar delivers a startling ultimatum.

videos.title: Sumedh's Night of Despair
videos.overview: Sumedh feels shattered by Rukmini's unexpected reaction on their special night. Later, Kesar gets furious as Rukmini wakes up late the next morning.

videos.title: Rukmini Defends Her Father
videos.overview: Rukmini gives a stern reply when Kesar questions her upbringing and insults Arvind. Later, Sumedh burns his hands to avoid applying colour to Rukmini against her will.

videos.title: Shivani's Plan to Humiliate Rukmini
videos.overview: Shivani serves Rukmini a glass of special Thandai to intoxicate her. Later, Sumedh stands up for Rukmini when the neighbours insult her for being drunk.

videos.title: Rukmini's Fear of Exposure
videos.overview: Rukmini panics about her secret getting exposed as Kesar asks Preesha to contact Arvind. Later, the Thakkars get overjoyed to learn the news of Malhar's return.

videos.title: Malhar Returns Home
videos.overview: Sumedh reminisces about a childhood encounter as Rukmini tries to comfort him. Later, Rukmini and Malhar are surprised to find each other in their house.

videos.title: Rukmini Decides to Confess
videos.overview: Kesar is pleased by Rukmini's cooking skills and gifts her a bangle. As the situation turns uneasy with Malhar, Rukmini decides to tell the truth to Sumedh.

videos.title: Malhar Becomes Doubtful
videos.overview: Malhar shares his heartbreak with Sumedh, who conveys marital woes with Rukmini. Malhar doubts Rukmini's relationship with Sumedh when he notices an extra bed.

videos.title: Malhar Ambushes Rukmini
videos.overview: Malhar finds Rukmini alone at the market and confronts her about her feelings for him. Later, he urges Sumedh to take a trip to Mumbai with a hidden motive.

videos.title: Sumedh Faces Heartbreak
videos.overview: Malhar advises Rukmini to divorce Sumedh and hands her the papers. Later, Sumedh experiences heartbreak upon discovering the documents in his room.

videos.title: Sumedh Confronts Rukmini
videos.overview: Sumedh informs the family about his decision to move to Mumbai for business. Subsequently, he seeks an explanation from Rukmini for her wish to divorce him.

videos.title: Sumedh Decides to Stay
videos.overview: In her attempt to stop Sumedh from leaving, Rukmini sustains an injury. Despite Sumedh's decision to stay, Malhar blames Rukmini for influencing Sumedh.

videos.title: Malhar's Wicked Intent
videos.overview: Rukmini confesses the truth about the divorce papers to Sumedh. Meanwhile, Malhar, intent on stirring trouble, plans a party celebrating Rukmini and Sumedh's wedding.

videos.title: Kesar Confronts Rukmini
videos.overview: Kesar gets furious at Rukmini for lying to her and decides to break off the marriage. However, Sumedh stops Kesar and claims that Rukmini told him everything.

videos.title: Rukmini's New Choice
videos.overview: Rukmini gets cornered by some officers who offer her a job as an undercover agent for the country. However, Rukmini rejects the offer and accepts Kesar's terms.

videos.title: Rukmini Fasts for Sumedh
