videos.overview: After Kesar gives Rukmini a month to prove herself, she vows to reunite Sumedh and the former. Rukmini keeps fast for Sumedh for his healthy life.

videos.title: Kesar Learns Rukmini's Past
videos.overview: Rukmini stops Malhar from committing suicide, and Kesar appreciates Rukmini's actions. Later, Kesar learns about Rukmini's affair in the IPS academy.

videos.title: Sumedh, Malhar's Heated Clash
videos.overview: Sumedh explodes in anger when Kesar unveils Rukmini's past. Later, on learning about Rukmini and Malhar's past, a conflict ensues between Sumedh and Malhar.

videos.title: Sumedh's Firm Stand for Rukmini
videos.overview: Sumedh defends Rukmini against Kesar's accusations and gives an apt reply to her. Later, Rukmini vows to ensure Sumedh's rightful place in Kesar's life.

videos.title: Kesar Reveals Her Will
videos.overview: Rukmini helps Sumedh in selecting a meaningful birthday present for Kesar. When Kesar discloses the distribution of her assets, Sumedh declines his portion.

videos.title: Sumedh to Leave the House?
videos.overview: Sumedh promises Kesar to leave the house for good so that she doesn't have to see his face anymore. Later, Rukmini asks Kesar to disown Sumedh legally.

videos.title: Kesar Confesses her Love for Sumedh
videos.overview: Kesar refuses to disown Sumedh as she confesses that she loves him like a son. Later, Sumedh informs Kesar that Malhar got kidnapped by a group of criminals.

videos.title: Rukmini Saves Malhar
videos.overview: Rukmini bravely fights the criminals holding Malhar hostage and successfully rescues him. Later, Sumedh and Malhar plead with Kesar to let Rukmini fulfill her dream.

videos.title: Dream Comes True for Rukmini
videos.overview: Kesar gives her blessings to Rukmini as the latter gets ready for her first day as an IPS officer. Later, Rukmini's father comes to meet Rukmini and salutes her.

videos.title: Rukmini’s Romantic Surprise for Sumedh
videos.overview: Rukmini decorates the house to surprise Sumedh and tells him she wants to marry him again. Later, she is shocked to see a tattoo on Kesar’s arm.

videos.title: Are Rukmini’s Suspicions True?
videos.overview: Rukmini questions Kesar about Vijay’s death and tries to connect the dots. Later, Sumedh learns about Rukmini suspecting Kesar of her mother's murder.

videos.title: Sumedh Rejects the Evidence
videos.overview: Rukmini shows Sumedh the evidence which proves that Kesar killed Rukmini's mother. Later, Rukmini accuses Kesar of murder when Sumedh refuses to believe the evidence.

videos.title: Rukmini's Emotional Decision
videos.overview: Sumedh buries the evidence against Kesar to prevent Rukmini from arresting her. However, Rukmini reveals that she has already changed her mind about arresting Kesar.

tt30146775.name: The Mars
tt30146775.description: "The Mars" is a documentary series that delves into various aspects of the planet Mars, from its past to present and future.

videos.title: Exploring Mars
videos.overview: In this episode, viewers explore Mars' cultural roots, allure, and challenges, while considering future colonization endeavors, offering a captivating glimpse into the Red Planet's mysteries.

videos.title: Mission to Mars
videos.overview: In this episode, viewers embark on a riveting journey through the history of Mars exploration, delving into each mission launched to the Red Planet and uncovering their remarkable achievements.

videos.title: Mars Reality Check
videos.overview: This episode delves into Mars' potential for life, tracing history, examining climate, water signs, methane, extremophiles, and strange phenomena, sparking questions about life beyond Earth.

videos.title: Mars Water Hunt
videos.overview: In Episode 4, join the Mars water hunt as viewers explore the planet's aqueous history and present, revealing tantalizing clues and latest probe findings, igniting curiosity about Martian habitability and life.

videos.title: Martian Rovers Exploration
videos.overview: In Episode 5, join the Martian rovers exploration journey, uncovering Mars' secrets, from scientific instruments to groundbreaking discoveries, shaping future exploration and expanding human understanding of the Red Planet.

videos.title: Elon Musk's Vision
videos.overview: In this episode, Elon Musk's bold vision of colonizing Mars unfolds, revealing the pivotal role of the Starship in advancing humanity's interplanetary ambitions.

videos.title: Mars in Media
videos.overview: In the finale, explore Mars in media, from science to fiction, uncovering its cultural allure and influence on human imagination and exploration.

tt31711499.name: Family Aaj Kal

videos.overview: While Meher's parents' research into her boyfriend's profession doesn't go well, Meher's grandfather, with ulterior motives if his own, convinces her to surprise her unprepared parents and bring her boyfriend home for dinner.

videos.title: Diversion
videos.overview: The family somehow manages to avoid meeting Meher's boyfriend. Convinced that she is making the wrong choice by dating him, they hatch a bizarre plan to break them up.

videos.title: Speed Breaker
videos.overview: All is not well; hearts are broken and everyone in the family, including Meher, are finding it hard to cope.

videos.overview: The family members repent their mistake and triy to reconnect with Meher but she doesn't trust them so easily just yet. Meanwhile, Gaurav gets a dinner invite from Meher's family.

tt28614045.description: A saga based on real-life events of the patriots who dedicated their lives to protect India. It is a testimony to the courage, commitment, and the spirit of every Rakshak towards their country and its citizens.

videos.title: EP01
videos.overview: Inspired by true events, Rakshak - India's Braves is the story of Triveni Singh, an Indian Army Lieutenant who is devoted to his family, but his passion to save people around him from threats is far more noble and greater. What starts off as a threat of a militant attack soon turns into something far threatening.

videos.title: Yuddh Ki Goonj
videos.overview: After the devastation cause by the Pulwama attack, Doctor, a radicalized terrorist, plans an attack on the Defense Minister & Army Chief of India as Naib Subedaar Sombir Singh & DySP Aman Thakur swing into action and are shocked to find Snipers in the valley which is extremely rare. Subedaar Sombir Singh receives intel of Haider Qasim being the terrorist in question who is a bomb expert.

videos.title: Veer Yodhha
videos.overview: The deadly terrorists sent by Doctor enter a safe house taking an entire family hostage. Subedaar Sombir Singh has to make harsh decisions as they are hard pressed for time as reinforcements make their way to him. While the Army & Police gear up for the arrival for the Defense Minister & Army chief, the situation in the safe house seems to be getting out of hand.

videos.title: Aakhri Ladai
videos.overview: A race against time as set in as the defense minister & army chief arrive in Kashmir, when the terrorists have taken refuge in a school. Children in the school are taken in as human shields as first on site DySP Aman Thakur battles for his life single handedly with the mob lynching and the terrorists opening fire. As Sombir Singh is minutes away from neutralizing the terrorists.

tt30460964.description: What goes around, comes around? Let Karma come calling, she will handle it.

videos.title: Karm
videos.overview: Karma Talwar's entry into the elite Alibaug circle disturbs high-society queen Indrani Kothari. It soon becomes clear that Karma has a dark past. She is on a mission and has her first target in sight.

videos.title: Bharosa
videos.overview: Karma begins wooing Ahaan Kothari, so Indrani puts her security head Sameer after her. As Karma plots the downfall of her second target, she meets Vedant, her childhood friend.

videos.title: Annyaay

videos.title: Andhere Raaz

tt30974154.name: Hustlers
tt30974154.description: Hustlers chronicles the journey of Sanjay Sharma as he chases his ultimate dream of 'Naam Kamana Hai' so that he can prove his worth to his family, specifically his father. When the real world throws its harsh realities at Sanjay, he finds quirky ways to fight them and twist the situation in his favor. But how far is he willing to go to make his dreams come true?

videos.overview: Vinay and Priya uncover leads at a massage parlor, track online transactions, and expose the blackmailers. Meanwhile, Sonu, Tittu, Sweety set sights on a new target, their unsuspecting landlord.

videos.title: F*#k You Jaanu !
videos.overview: Vinay and Priya unravel the blackmailers' location, raiding their hideout. Sonu is arrested, evidence seized, and all seems well. Yet, an enigmatic figure emerges, setting the stage for a twist.

tt29959616.name: Dehati Ladke
tt29959616.description: An engrossing tale of Rajat's (Shine Pandey) journey of self-discovery as he moves from a village to a big city to pursue his dream of clearing the UPSC exams. The story follows Rajat as he explores his new-found freedom, builds new friendships, and experiences first love-all while navigating family pressures and staying true to his goal.

videos.title: Teesri Kasam
videos.overview: Rajat leaves his village for Lucknow. His father expects him to bring honor to their village. His mother makes him swear three oaths to help him pass the civil service exam.

videos.title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
videos.overview: Rajat is attracted to Prerna, the most popular girl in college. At a party, he meets her friend Ritesh and realizes Prerna already has a love interest.

videos.title: Shatranj Ke Khiladi
videos.overview: Rajat decides to suppress his loveria for prerna, and focus on studies, remembering prashant's teaching that life is like chess, black and white, failure or success. But the more he tries to distance her, more she tries to befriend him, and Rajat ends up verbally sparring with Ritesh as a consequence. But then a chance meeting with a mystery woman reignites ishqfluenza in his heart.

videos.title: Diljale
videos.overview: When Rajat finds himself obsessing over the mystery woman, he likens himself to a 'Mausam ka mendhak' who is 'tartara-oaing' for a princess who will kiss him and make him a prince. He is torn between his feelings for Prerna and this fascinating mystery woman. This same mystery woman is also the one to give him the vital eye opening gyan that, in order to win a girls heart.

videos.title: Dil, Dosti, Etc
videos.overview: Confident Rajat, reapproaches Prerna and impulsively touches her face. She seems offended , he is crestfallen and then to top it all, he discovers that the mystery woman -" Chaya " is no one but Prashant Bhaiya's long standing girlfriend. He is crushed with the double whammy till he comes to know that Prerna was opposite of offended.

videos.title: Aashiq Aawara
videos.overview: Rajat is stressing over an assignment when he gets entangled in a web of distraction by Yuvan, who wants to slap back the girl who slapped him, to avenge his insult. Rajat disapproves of his action but gets dragged along by Shashank. At the last moment Yuvan bails, and they are caught by police.

videos.title: Bade Ghar Ki Beti
videos.overview: Rajat is invited to Prerna's birthday and his friends insist he dress up in a 3 piece suit, buy a gift for Prerna as well as her dad. They also push him to tell her he likes her during party, and ask for a kiss as return gift. Rajat realizes his friends pranked him when he becomes laughing stock of party.

videos.title: Doodh Ka Karz
videos.overview: Rajat comes back from Prerna's party, and finds his father waiting for him. DSC dresses him down, doubting if he will ever be able to repay doodh ka karz. Rajat is shaken by the experience and pulls back from falling in love, but his friends get him back on track, and push him to kiss Prerna to seal their love.

videos.title: Mohabbatein
videos.overview: Months have passed and Rajat is still only friends with prerna. As valentine's day nears, his friends push him to finally get the first kiss and put his love into second gear. Rajat plans to propose to Prerna but she goes to mussoorie as her nani is sick. Rajat gets invited to Chaya's party, where he witnesses chaya and prashant fight over him not clearing UPSC.

videos.title: Sanam Bewafa
videos.overview: Rajat skips classes, reads sad love stories, and throws library books after feeling hurt by Prerna's lie and guilty about almost kissing Chaya. Concerned friends extract a promise from suicidal Rajat to not end his life.

videos.title: Mohabbat Ki Jung
videos.overview: Rajat writes 'prerna gupta bewafa hai' on some currency notes and distributes them craftily in the campus. This leads to confrontation between Prerna and Rajat. Prashant intervenes and makes Rajat realize that he has to trust Prerna if he loves her. Rajat apologises and confesses his love and they end up kissing for the first time. Rajat decides to teach Ritesh a lesson for lying.

videos.title: Baap Numberi, Beta Dus Numberi
videos.overview: Rajat and friends are unrepentant in the lock-up, thinking they will get bailed out like last time, and that they were right in teaching that snake Ritesh a lesson. DSC is shocked to see Rajat defending his actions. DSC blames Shashank and treats his father SK with contempt. Yuvan's brother tries to bribe the police and get the boys out but Ritesh's father is a big lawyer.

videos.title: Yaar Gaddar
videos.overview: Shashank is angry with Rajat because DSC discriminated agaisnt SK & Shashank. Even though shashank dislikes his own father but he hates discrimination even more. Shashank is punishing Rajat by going close to Prerna. He takes her to a restaurant and feeds her with his hand. Rajat finds out Shashank has a secret.

videos.title: Dil
videos.overview: Rajat is dating Prerna but feels that she gives more time to friends than to him, although he does everything she asks him to, like participating in science fest, for which, he is making an original invention; a love galvanomter or a love testing machine. Rajat tells his friends that they misjudged Ritesh. He can't be all that bad if he took back the case.

videos.title: Murder
videos.overview: Rajat goes drunk to Chaya's house and tries to kiss her, in a fit of brokenness. Chaya puts him down gently. He fights with her when he finds out that she's leaving Lucknow and Prashant, as she is done with that relationship. Rajat then visits Prashant, discovers that he is depressed, and leaving his hostel room to move somewhere else. Rajat is convinced that Prerna doesn’t love him.

videos.title: Murder 2
videos.overview: Rajat is heartbroken and plans to expose Prerna in front of everybody. He feels detached even from his friends and stays alone most of the time. Right before the exams, Rajat prepares chits and during the exam, puts them in Prerna’s bag. The letter gets caught for cheating in the exam and Shashank suspects Rajat for framing Prerna. He goes after Rajat and questions him.

videos.title: Aag Hi Aag
videos.overview: Yuvan and Shashank call Rajat to talk face to face with Prerna, where Rajat talks extremely ill about Prerna, thus breaking her heart. Shashank feels bad for Prerna and goes after her to talk to her. Yuvan brings Rajat and Shashank to discuss out their differences, but Rajat speaks ill of Shashank too and the duo get into a fight. Similar to Paglet

videos.title: Dulara
videos.overview: A disturbed Rajat goes to his hometown.He feels guilty for securing low results and disappointing his parents.His cousin,back in the village, informs him about how his father has stopped meeting everybody fearing that somebody might ask him about Rajat’s marks and comment about his decision of sending Rajat to the big city.While his father is asleep,Rajat leaves for Lucknow.Similar to Ittu si baat

videos.title: Chamatkaar
videos.overview: On reaching Lucknow, Rajat learns that Shashank is leaving the Haveli and shifting to some other place. Rajat decides to go to Delhi for two months to join a crash course. Before leaving, he goes to meet Prashant, who looks shattered. The next day, as Rajat is about to leave for Delhi, he receives a phone call from his father, who informs him that Prashant has committed suicide in his room.

videos.title: Phir Milenge
videos.overview: Rajat is shattered by Prashant’s sudden demise. Rajat’s father explains to Rajat that he shouldn’t get so stressed about studies and he can always join him in his dairy and farm. But Rajat assures his father that he will work very hard and never think of committing suicide. After completing his crash course in Delhi, Rajat successfully clears his UPSC written examination. videos.overview: SSC, vo exam jo lakhon students ki umeed hai aur kuch logon ke liye profitable business.Ye kahani hai SSC yani Shiv Shankar chaudhary aur uski life ke 2 important phases ki. Ek hai graduation ke samay Shiv jise SSC crack karne se jyada tension rehti hai apne papa ke gusse ki. Dosara Shiv Delhi NCR ka upcoming SSC training institute chalata hai aur apne rival Khanna ke plans ka shikar hota rehta hai. Aieye dekhte hai kya hai in dono ka struggle?

videos.title: Mukherjee Nagar
videos.overview:
Kisi bhi ladai mein insaan ki aadhi jeet tabhi ho jati hai jab vo ladne ki himmat juta le. Student Shiv ko uske papa ne ghar se nikaal diya hai aur ab vo aa gaya hai Mukherjee Nagar ke warzone mein, jahan sapne bante bhi hai aur bigadte bhi. Dosari taraf SSC sir ke best teacher ko Khanna hijack kar leta hai aur us par ilzaam bhi lagata hai. Nayi nayi problems sar utha rahi hain lekin hope ki ungali thame Shiv aur SSC badh rahe hain kadam dar kadam.

In any fight, man's only victory is achieved when he musters the courage to attack. Student Shiv has been thrown out of the house by his father and now he has come to the warzone of Mukherjee Nagar, where dreams are both shared and spoiled. On Dosari's side Khanna has kidnapped SSC sir's best teacher and also blames him. New problems are still remaining but with the finger of hope Shiv and SSC are being resolved step by step.

videos.title: Rank, Rann and Restart
videos.overview:
Here is the Hindi overview - Jab insaan ke paas khone ke liye kuch nahi hota to paane ke liye poori duniya hoti hai. Shiv ab ye samajh chuka hai ki usse kamar kas kar mehnat karni hi hogi kyunki uska ghar kafi peeche chhot gaya hai. SSC sir ke star student number one rank to le aata hai lekin usse Khanna ko bech deta hai. Idhar iss dhokhe ke baad SSC apni life ki sabse badi ladayi ke liye tayyar ho raha hai to udhar Shiv depression ke kale badal se ghir chuka hai. Kya nayi hope ka suraj phir niklega?

Translated from Google - When a man does not have enough money to gain, he has the whole world to gain. Shiv has now realized that he will have to work hard because his house has fallen into disrepair. SSC sir's star student has come to number one rank but has sold it to Khanna. After this betrayal, SSC is getting ready for the biggest fight of its life and Shiv is under the dark cloud of depression. Did I hope that the sun would come out again?

videos.title: Kar Jaayenge Ya Ghar Jaayenge
videos.overview:
Hindi Overview - Life mein hamesha aapki jeet hi ye possible nahi lekin aap har baar jee jaan se koshish karen ye possible hai. Shiv life ki aankhon mein aankhen daal ke challange accept karta hai aur ek baar phir SSC naam ke pahad par chadne ke liye poori jaan laga deta hai. SSC sir akele hi Khanna ko galat aur apne teaching method ko sahi sabit karne ke struggle mein lage hain. Sari duniya ki nazar in dono par hi tiki hai. Kya iss baar himmat ki jeet hogi?

Translated to English - In life you always win, it is not possible but every time you try your best, it is possible. Shiv accepts the challenge of putting his eyes in the eyes of life and once again gives his whole life to climb the mountain named SSC. SSC sir is alone in the struggle to correct Khanna and correct his teaching method. The eyes of the whole world are fixed on these two. Will courage triumph this time?

Between his desire to apprehend Phenyl, his candid mother seeking purpose, his first love, and his quirky relationship with his Sub Inspector boss, Girpade finds himself dealing with bizarre rich people problems - one hilarious case at a time.

videos.title: Kutte Ka Patta
videos.overview: Constable Girpade, also known as Mandaar Ghorpade, has a bizarre dream involving Phenyl disguised as a reporter. At work, he's assigned to build a toilet. Their day takes an unexpected turn when rich girls report their missing designer dog leash. Girpade and D'Mello investigate by attending a dog's birthday party. Using face-reading skills and social media clues, Girpade cracks the case.

videos.title: Imran Ka Saamaan
videos.overview: Eccentric tech entrepreneur and millionaire Imran Mast files a complaint about his frozen sperm going missing from the sperm bank. Will Girpade be able to find out who wants Imran Mast’s private stuff? Girpade and D'Mello run through a list of suspects while simultaneously investigating one of Phenyl Mohan's past accomplices.

videos.title: Hatya Hustle
videos.overview: After a popular rapper's manager cum girlfriend is found unconscious due to a drug overdose, Girpade and his team must wade through the fog of Indian hip-hop culture to uncover the reasons behind her drastic actions.

videos.title: Halkat Halloween
videos.overview: Archer Road Station receives a complaint about a missing expensive collectible, lodged by an estranged father who purchased it for his son for Halloween. Girpade and D'Mello visit an upscale building society and must contend not only with the man's doting ex-wife and her yoga instructor boyfriend but also with the festival of Halloween itself.

videos.title: Shudh Hindi Confessions
videos.overview: Someone is exposing the secrets of a young schoolboy, pushing him to the brink as he locks himself on the school's sports complex terrace. Girpade must calm the boy and unmask the culprit before the confession goes public.

videos.title: Mission Judwaa
videos.overview: Girpade and D’Mello wake up next to a goat with no memory after a party they had attended to uncover the location of missing twins. With a fog looming over their memories, they must retrace their steps quickly and learn what happened to them.

videos.title: Recipe Kisne Churayi?
videos.overview: Two heritage brands, one in the paan business and the other in the ice-cream business, clash over their rival products, ice-cream-flavored paan and paan-flavored ice-cream. Girpade investigates their claims of recipes being stolen from each other.

videos.title: Nang-Dhadang
videos.overview: A naked man arrives at the police station, silently protesting without disclosing his complaint. With rumors of the naked man reaching a frenzied media outside the station, the officers must keep the media at bay and play his game to decipher his message, one agonizing guess at a time.

videos.title: Poly-Aamras
videos.overview: In a clash between traditional norms and modern relationships, Girpade strives to protect a polyamorous group from having their private lives exposed by a voyeuristic blackmailer, aiming to apprehend the culprit.

videos.title: Phenyl Mohan: Hands Up
videos.overview: When a doppelganger of Girpade kidnaps a prominent man's wife and two children, the police suspect Girpade and arrest him. Meanwhile, D’Mello aids Girpade in proving his innocence and uncovering the true culprit, Phenyl Mohan.

tt28622072.name: Lakhan Leela Bhargava
tt28622072.description: The story of an empathetic advocate in his fight for justice. We follow Lakhan on his journey to become a respected lawyer while facing prejudice for being the illegitimate child of the biggest lawyer in the city.

videos.title: Thoda sa Criminal Thoda sa Lawyer
videos.overview: Lakhan Leela Bhargava, an extremely honest lawyer who can go up to any level to ensure that justice is delivered, gets his first case. Will this be the chance Lakhan has been waiting for?

videos.title: Waqeel Top toh Life Lallan Top
videos.overview: Contemplating about his loss at the court, Lakhan assures his mother that he would turn things around. Will Lakhan be able to turn things around?

videos.title: Sachaai Ki Waqalat
videos.overview: Lakhan learns some crucial details about the case during his investigation with the help of his Lakhan Mandali. Will Lakhan be able to win his first case?

videos.title: Pyaar Ya Takraar?
videos.overview: Lakhan saves a man who was trying to commit suicide and finds out his wife has filed an alimony case against him. Will Lakhan be able to find out the truth?

videos.title: Pati, Patni Aur Woh
videos.overview: Nikita produces some photos in court to prove that Bharat cheated on her. A new twist in the case puts Lakhan in a fix. Will Lakhan be able to turn it around?

videos.title: Lakhan Ka Endgame
videos.overview: Lakhan learns a startling fact from someone from Bharat's past. What will be Lakhan's endgame?

videos.title: Naam Nahi Toh Kuch Nahi
videos.overview: An old friend of Lakhan seeks his advice after receiving a notice from his brother claiming ownership of a trademark that actually belongs to him. Will Lakhan be able to get justice for his client?

videos.title: Wasiyat Ki Asliyat
videos.overview: The court considers the evidence produced by Razzak. An unexpected ally provides Lakhan with important information. Will Lakhan be able to find the missing thread?

videos.title: Cheez azeez, dil ke kareeb
videos.overview: An argument with Leela gives Lakhan a brilliant idea regarding the case. Will Lakhan be able to prove the truth?

videos.title: Challenge Accepted
videos.overview: Neeraj challenges Sakshi to win an impossible case as Sakshi seeks Lakhan's help. Will Sakshi and Lakhan be able to win this challenge?

videos.title: Mushkil Mein Mandali
videos.overview: Lakhan and Sakshi stumble upon shocking revelations while trying to gather evidence in the case. Will Lakhan get in trouble for helping Sakshi?

videos.title: Ek teer se do nishaane
videos.overview: Lakhan gets in deep trouble while trying to help Sakshi. Will Lakhan be able to come back with a plan?

videos.title: Pyaar Aur Jung Mein Sab Jaayaz Hai
videos.overview: After a personal heartbreak, Lakhan gets a new case where the opponent is a prominent and experienced lawyer. This fact makes him nervous. Will he be able to fight him in court?

videos.title: Parvarrish ki Keemat
videos.overview: Dr. Sahab provokes Lakhan by defaming his mother and Lakhan loses him calm in court. Will Lakhan be able to come back from this fall?

videos.title: It's Her Choice
videos.overview: Lakhan presents an emotional argument in court. Will Lakhan be able to mend the rift between Jaydeep and his parents?

videos.title: Face The Danger
videos.overview: A famous influencer approaches Lakhan to fight his case about attempt to murder. But it's not what it seems. Will Lakhan be able to crack this complicated case?

videos.title: Jhoot Ka Pardafaash
videos.overview: Deeper investigation by Lakhan reveals some shocking realities about Gima's past. Will Lakhan be able to expose Gima?

videos.title: Social Media Ka Khel
videos.overview: Lakhan and Mandali learn that there is a bigger player in this game besides C-Raj and RealGima. Will Lakhan expose the real culprit?

videos.title: Maut Ka Muavza
videos.overview: For a couple who lost their daughter in a restaurant fire, Lakhan decides to seek justice. He is unaware of the danger this case poses. Will Lakhan get in trouble for taking this dangerous case?

videos.title: Sach Ke Dushman
videos.overview: Lakhan decides to quit the case after Leela narrowly escapes a fatal attack. But Leela and Mandali stand by him. Will he continue his fight for justice?

videos.title: The LLB Club
videos.overview: Lakhan and Leela take an emotional decision for the sake of the case. Lakhan gets help from unexpected supporters. Will Lakhan be able to get justice for all the victims?

tt27988910.name: Pyaar Ka Pehla Adhyaya - Shiv Shakti
tt27988910.description: Shiv has a rewarding career as a doctor, but his personal life is in tatters. Shakti, an orphan, is a nurturer by nature. Will Shakti heal a broken Shiv?

videos.title: Radha Meets Shakti
videos.overview: Radha warns her indifferent mother Mandira that someday a person will teach her a lesson. Soon, Radha and Mohan run into a medical student, Shakti. Mandira decides to get her nephew Shiv married.

tt27930291.name: Titlie
tt27930291.description: Obsessed by the notion of fairy tale love , Titlie marries her beau Garv . Soon , the picture - perfect romance turns abusive , forcing her to wrestle with reality .

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Obsessed by the notion of fairy tale love , Titlie marries her beau Garv . Soon , the picture - perfect romance turns abusive , forcing her to wrestle with reality .

tt28336217.name: Choona
tt28336217.description: When an unlikely group of misfits discovers a common enemy in the same ruthless yet superstitious politician, they plot a heist to exact revenge.

tt26914830.name: Charlie Chopra & the Mystery of Solang Valley
tt26914830.description: Amateur detective Charlie Chopra investigates a murder at her fiancé's family home in the mountains of Himachal Pradesh, uncovering secrets and facing danger.

videos.title: Keh Do Ki Ye Jhooth Hai

tt28638031.name: Aakhri Sach
tt28638031.description: A bone-chilling tale that unravels the most twisted ties of fate, the trapped secrets of a family and the terrifying horrors an investigator has ever seen.

tt29258828.name: Builders
tt29258828.description: A gang of five selfishly motivated and destructive friends spend their time in a gym and go through various adventures.

tt28744346.name: Kaala
tt28744346.description: A father-son tale set against the backdrop of a complex financial crime and a little-known time in the history of India and Bangladesh. Watch their dark journey.

tt19868466.name: Bambai Meri Jaan
tt19868466.description: A sneak into the post-independence Bombay and streets riddled with crime. An honest cop's journey as he tries to protect his family.

videos.title: In the Name of the Father

tt28857177.name: Lucky Guy
tt28857177.description: The series dives into the strange life of Lucky, a college student who appears to have it all since birth, but now his luck has become a bane as he is faced with some of the most difficult situations of his life.

tt27662745.name: Leaked!
tt27662745.description: The life of Mumbai's elite attending the prestigious "Oakwood High School". Rebellious teenagers, bursting with emotions as they navigate their complex lives filled with secrets, we all would want to know. The 'seemingly perfect' lives of privileged teenagers go for a toss when the 'IT Girl' of the school is found dead.

videos.title: I Saw What You Did To Her
The Cat Is Out Of The Bag

tt17524566.name: Guns & Gulaabs
tt17524566.description: In a sleepy town, a mechanic struggles to emerge from his dead gangster father's shadow in a mission to win over the love of his life. An honest officer ends up being a chaos agent; whilst a reluctant cartel heir has an identity c...

videos.title: Chapter 1: Har Insaan Mein Hai Shaitaan
Chapter 2: Everything I Do ... I Do It For You
Chapter 5: Do Dil Mil Rahe Hain

tt22531848.name: Taali
tt22531848.description: A web series based on the life of transgender activist, Gauri Sawant, throws light on her daring transformation, the journey towards motherhood, and the battle that led to the inclusion of the 3rd gender in every document in India.

tt28443585.name: The Kashmir Files: Unreported
tt28443585.description: The series captures the story of Kashmir, highlighting the events leading up to the mass exodus of Kashmiri Pandits in the 90s, the abrogation of Article 370, and its impact on the former state.

videos.title: Paradise Plundered
videos.overview: Vivek and Pallavi set out to explore the history of Kashmir that led to the genocide of Kashmiri Pandits. They dig into the geographical features of the state, its accession with India and the ideologies that have wanted to separate Kashmir from the country.

videos.title: The Genesis of Terrorism
videos.overview: Post-partition, Kashmir suffers from covert attacks, wars, infiltrations and terrorism. The seeds of terrorism are sown in the late 70s. Political leaders of Kashmir and the 1987 elections become catalysts to the sinister plan of terrorism.

videos.title: The Demand for Azaadi
videos.overview: Pakistan's then President Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq’s Operation Tupac manifests itself in Kashmir. As radicalisation sweeps across the state, the demand for an ‘Azaad’ Kashmir picks up.

videos.title: The Night That Changed Lives
videos.overview: The fateful night of 19th January 1990 changes the lives of Kashmiri Pandits forever, some of whom witness the brutal killings of their loved ones. A majority of the Kashmiri Pandits are forced to escape their homes.

videos.title: The Cover Up
videos.overview: The exodus of Kashmiri Pandits was denied, ignored and even covered up. What were the repurcussions of the exodus on the rest of the country?

videos.title: Erased History, Erased Community
videos.overview: The hosts trace the history of Kashmir and try to find out whether Hindus were original inhabitants of the state or whether they settled there much later.

videos.title: Kashmir Today
videos.overview: How has the uncovering of the genocide impacted Kashmir? Has it made any difference to the world? Is the reality of Kashmir any dfferent today?

tt28494878.name: Commando
tt28494878.description: When a covert mission in Pakistan goes wrong and his close friend Kshitij is captured, Commando Virat embarks on a perilous journey to rescue him.

videos.title: The Dance of Death
videos.overview: ISI Col. Jaffer Hassan and his terrorist partners plan a biological war against India. Risking his life, Indian spy Kshitij alerts Commando Virat of the imminent threat.

videos.title: Bring It On
videos.overview: Jaffer gets livid when he loses access to the virus system. Virat gets the go-ahead from a reluctant Bakshi to rescue Kshitij, but runs into trouble at the border. Enter Bhavna.

videos.title: The Death Trap
videos.overview: As Kshitij's torture continues, Virat and his team surveil the heavily-guarded Sahiwal Jail and plan a rescue. Meanwhile, Jaffer gets wind of their mission.

videos.title: The Great Escape
videos.overview: The rescue mission goes smoothly, until Jaffer enters the picture. Once the dust settles, the colonel calls up his mole in India and a shocking truth is revealed.

tt27327718.name: The Jengaburu Curse
tt27327718.description: A London-based analyst returns to Odisha in search of her missing father. Her quest leads to a conspiracy involving bauxite mining, secretly backed by an international nexus, leading to unexplained deaths and a displaced community.

tt28106779.name: Kaalkoot
tt28106779.description: Follows the life of Ravishankar Tripathi, a tenacious and dedicated police officer who finds himself at the forefront of a challenging acid attack case.

tt28451164.name: Do Gubbare
tt28451164.description: Discover a heartwarming tale of an unexpected friendship that will leave you smiling!

videos.title: Ajooba
videos.overview: Anxious about his arrival in Pune, Rohit's perspective takes a delightful turn when he encounters his charismatic and witty landlord.

videos.title: Kaam ki cheez
videos.overview: As Rohit starts to settle into his new home and new job, his sense of belonging takes an unexpected hit.

videos.title: Ghar se duur
videos.overview: Rohit and Manu discuss Aajoba's secret as Manu tries to uncover one herself. Aajoba's reminiscence about his past makes Rohit cherish his own connections.

videos.title: Muskurahat
videos.overview: Aajoba, Rohit and others celebrate Diwali together. Rohit finds out Aajoba's secret leaving him with a feeling of guilt.

videos.title: Tirbhinnat
videos.overview: Rohit starts taking up additional responsibilities at home like a family member but the arrival of Aajoba's own family makes Rohit wonder about his place in their home.

videos.title: Gubbare
videos.overview: A rather sweet surprise pops up directly linking Aajoba's past with Rohit's present changing their lives forever and for the better. The circle is complete.

tt28477916.name: Honey Trap Squad
tt28477916.description: A secret squad of female RAW agents uses charm, deception, and covert operations to bring down an international counterfeit-money empire while evading a deadly assassin sent to stop them.

tt28227737.name: Sandeep Bhaiya
tt28227737.description: A tiffin service provider finds a mentor in a failed UPSC aspirant who inspires her to become an IFS.

tt28259300.name: Ishq Next Door
tt28259300.description: A simple young guy leads a responsible, boring, and colorless life until he bumps into the 'girl next door'. Now his life is colorful but complicated.

videos.title: Responsibility
videos.overview: A cute love story of a boy and a girl-next-door with an ex-ceptional twist!

videos.title: Becharapan
videos.overview: Meher and her uncle decide to take on the local goon, Sattu ji, in the upcoming society elections. Dev is stressed by a situation at work. Ashwin comes back from Jordan.

videos.title: Kabaddi Kabaddi
videos.overview: Dev and Meher start becoming good friends. Ashwin tries to reconcile with Meher and challenges Dev to a Kabaddi match in an attempt to humiliate him.

videos.title: Badle Badle Rang
videos.overview: Dev is visibly happy with recent developments in his personal life. Ashwin and Meher come to Dev for help regarding a loan for Ashwin's NGO.

videos.title: Hide & Seek
videos.overview: In light of new information, Dev is avoiding Meher. Meher is dealing with tensions at her house. Meanwhile, Ashwin is planning something special for Meher.

videos.title: Chhoti Si Philosophy
videos.overview: Dev is abiding by a philosophy he received as a kid. Meher and Ashwin are trying to move on. Meanwhile, there is a wedding in Rajat Vihar where a conflict arises.

videos.title: Taalmatoli
videos.overview: As some confusion gets cleared, Dev deliberates over his intention to share his feelings with Meher. Ashwin confronts Dev.

videos.title: Chhipkali Ki Dum
videos.overview: Dev and Meher try to strike a rhythm in their relationship. Ashwin is relentless in his pursuit and escalates his attempts to sabotage.

videos.title: Love & War
videos.overview: Dev decides to buy Amma a new TV, but his plans get derailed. Meher gets news which puts her in a dilemma. Dev and Ashwin have a face-off.

videos.title: Regret Ka Demo
videos.overview: Dev faces consequences for his actions. Meher makes an important choice but is afraid of history repeating itself.

tt19868286.name: Adhura
tt19868286.description: Strange events take place in the Nilgiri Valley School that seem to be connected to Vedant, a 10-year-old new student. When the batch of 2007 returns for its reunion, Adhiraj Jaisingh, an ex-student must face what he did fifteen years ago. But things take a horrifying turn when Vedant and Adhiraj's paths collide. A dark secret begins to reveal itself threatening the lives of everyone on campus.

videos.title: If You Make Trouble You Will Be Punished
The Boy Who Lives Inside Vedant

tt27161705.name: Baalveer
tt27161705.description: Returning for Season 3, Baalveer, a young superhero who fights evil forces with his magical powers and protects children from harm, is unaware of his scheming superiors' plan to betray him. Stripped of his powers and identity, he leads a mundane life until an unexpected event reignites his abilities. With help from Kaashvi, a girl he partners up with, he embarks on a journey to reclaim his powers and identity while battling his enemies. Will Baalveer become the ultimate hero he once was?

videos.title: Baalveer Ki Entry
videos.overview: Everyone is looking for Baalveer in Udaka Lok. Baalveer's grand entry amazes his friends.

videos.title: Baalveer Kasam Kaal
videos.overview: Baalveer passes the test given to him by Maha Mahi Mutaan. Baalveer is confident that he will be able to face and defeat the evil Aageel. Will Baalveer's confidence prove to be his downfall?

videos.title: Kaashvi's Life In Danger
videos.overview: Aageel abducts Kaashvi to retrieve the Maha Jadoo. Baalveer tries to save a cable car from falling off a cliff. Meanwhile, Maha Mahi Uttan talks to Adishi about Baalveer's antics.

videos.title: Baalveer Ki Kasam
videos.overview: Aageel abducts Kaashvi to retrieve the Maha Jadoo. Baalveer tries to save a cable car from falling off a cliff. Meanwhile, Maha Mahi Uttan talks to Adishi about Baalveer's antics.

videos.title: Baalveer The Protector
videos.overview: Baalveer reads out the rules of Shashvan Lok and pledges to protect the Earth, humanity and the Universe. Kaashvi’s parents decide to go to Imbaash Lok together to save Kaashvi. Will they make it out alive?

videos.title: Baalveer Ka Suraksha Kavach
videos.overview: Aageel sends her henchmen to find Kaashvi and bring her back alive. Maha Mahi Uttan gives magical armour to Baalveer to protect him from Aageel's Maha Jadoo. Meanwhile, Kaashvi's mother sacrifices all of her magical powers in order to protect her daughter. What will happen now?

videos.title: Baalveer Ka Faisla
videos.overview: Shashmaagh urges Uttan to arrest Baalveer and punish him for harming innocent people. Meanwhile, Aageel comes up with a vicious plan to lure Baalveer into her trap.

videos.title: Baalveer Faces A Trial
videos.overview: Shashmaagh presses charges against Baalveer for the loss of innocent lives. Aageel realises she won't be able to extract what she needs from Dharti Lok without making a few sacrifices.

videos.title: Accha Jadoo Aur Bura Jadoo
videos.overview: Aageel wants to prevent Baalveer from meeting Kaashvi. Baalveer goes to Dharti Lok to find the reason behind Tuer’s death. Meanwhile, Aageel finds a way to destroy Baalveer through Kaashvi. Will Aageel succeed in her mission?

videos.title: Aageel In Udaka Lok
videos.overview:
10. Aageel In Udaka Lok
