Uttan wants to take Baalveer’s power without killing him. Aageel goes to Udaka Lok to take her Maha Jadoo from Kaashvi. Later, Uttan and Shashmaagh attack Baalveer and capture him.

videos.title: Udaka Lok Ki Deewar
videos.overview: Baalveer decides to leave Udaka Lok and continue his duties of protecting the world from somewhere else. However, Shashmaagh takes Adishi hostage, which compels Baalveer to return.

videos.title: Baalveer Zinda Hai
videos.overview: Bardol tries to commit suicide because he thinks he has been discovered by one of his enemies, but Bhaskar stops him. Later, Tetra and Andher inform Aageel that Baalveer is alive and stop her from attacking Shashvan Lok.

videos.title: Baalveer On Dharti Lok
videos.overview: Andher suggests that Aageel shouldn’t go to Dharti Lok. Later, Maha Mahim asks Bardol to find a place for Baalveer on Dharti Lok which only he would know about.

videos.title: Baalveer's Family Time
videos.overview: Awaiting his trial, Baalveer spends quality time with his family. Meanwhile, Aageel sends a beacon to locate her Maha Jadoo.

videos.title: Baalveer's Real Identity
videos.overview: Maha Mahim gives magical pills to Bardol to control Baalveer's anger. Eva and Navya throw a party to thank Baalveer for saving their lives, while Bardol and Bhaskar try to prevent Baalveer from remembering his real identity.

videos.title: Baalveer Shaant Ho Gaya Hai
videos.overview: Baalveer is attacked and becomes unconscious before his memory returns. While Kaashvi reunites with her mother, Aageel waits for her plan to bear fruit. Will Kaashvi be a victim of Aageel's magic?

videos.title: Kaashvi Ka Naya Roop
videos.overview: Kaashvi attacks a few goons who tease her. Bardol tells Bhaskar that extremely new powerful magic has been activated on Dharti Lok, and Baalveer is not safe anymore. Meanwhile, Baalveer gets attacked. What will happen now?

videos.title: The Plan To Poison Baalveer
videos.overview: While the plan to poison Baalveer is set into motion, his mother gets worried about Baalveer's safety. Later, Baalveer is handed over the spiked drink. Will Baalveer be poisoned to death?

videos.title: Aageel On Dharti Lok
videos.overview: Bardol informs Maha Mahim that Aageel has come to Dharti Lok. Shashmaag plays a trick on Aageel. Later, someone steals Tetra and Andher’s magic while Maha Mahim punishes Shashmaag for stealing the poison that can kill Baalveer.

videos.title: Shashmaag Ka Sauda
videos.overview: Aageel is conflicted and decides to talk to Shashmaag, who has an enticing offer for her. Meanwhile, Kaashvi is in danger of being assassinated. Later, Aageel reaches Chambal Lok to meet with Shashmaag. What happens next?

videos.title: Aageel Meets Veer
videos.overview: Aageel runs away from Shashmaag and Uttan. Andher and Tetra inform Aageel that they have found Baalveer on Dharti Lok. Later, Aageel disguises himself as a human and meets Baalveer.

videos.title: Dhokebaaz Shashmaag
videos.overview: Aageel reaches Veer's residence and wonders why he did not recognise her. Meanwhile, Shashmaag gets blackmailed. Later, on Aageel's orders, Veer's family is attacked. Will Aageel's plan to resurface Baalveer succeed?

videos.title: Black Box Ka Footage
videos.overview: Shashmaag opens the black box and reviews the footage that clearly shows him at fault. Meanwhile, Baalveer's mother tip-toes behind Shashmaag and realises that he had framed Baalveer. How will this latest revelation affect the situation?

videos.title: Baalveer's Mother In Danger
videos.overview: Aageel takes Bardol to Imbaash Lok. Baalveer puts on a magic show for his family members. Later, Shashmaag tortures Baalveer’s mother. Will Baalveer come to save his mother?

videos.title: Jadui Swagat
videos.overview: Kaashvi misses her mother. Meanwhile, Baalveer welcomes the boss of the event company, Kiara in a magical way. Later, Baalveer sings a song to impress Kiara. Will Baalveer's efforts bear any fruit?

videos.title: Aageel Arrives To Kill Veer
videos.overview: Shashmaag tortures Baalveer's mother. While Veer is in the middle of showing a magic trick, Aageel arrives to kill him. On seeing Kaashvi there, Aageel decides to kill her as well. Will Aageel succeed?

videos.title: Baalveer's Memory
videos.overview: Maha Jadoo starts giving Baalveer power and he takes his original form. Aageel and Baalveer fight each other. Later, Baalveer finds his poster and tries to remember his identity.

videos.title: Baalveer Ke Liye Sandesh
videos.overview: Aageel plan to use Bardol to take out Maha Jadoo from Kaashvi. Later, Shashmaag shows Maha Mahim the proof that he had tampered with to make Maha Mahim believe that Baalveer deserves punishment. Later, Aageel calls Khirjoj to help her with Maha Jadoo.

videos.title: Baalveer Ke Mann Ke Sawal
videos.overview: Navya starts speaking and Baalveer realises he has powers. Shashvan Lok's army enters Imbaash Lok. Later, Aageel asks Bardol to send a safe signal to Shashvan Lok.

videos.title: Baalveer In His Original Form
videos.overview: Baalveer saves a kid’s life and finds out he has magical powers. Later, Aageel tells Kaashvi the truth about her mother.

videos.title: Powerful Kaashvi
videos.overview: Benaam tells her story to Baalveer and asks him for his help. Kaashvi beats Khirjoj. Later, Aageel decides to turn Kaashvi into a stone.

videos.title: Baalveer Ka Magic Touch
videos.overview: Baalveer tries to stop his parents from finding out about his truth. Bardol decides to help Aageel in order to save his own life. Meanwhile, Maha Mahim sends his agents to Earth to bring Baalveer back.

videos.title: Bardol Is Missing
videos.overview: Bardol begs for forgiveness from Aageel as Aageel decides to turn him to stone. Baalveer wonders where his real mother is. Later, two people from Shashvan Lok come to Dharti Lok to look for Bardol.

videos.title: Baalveer Ki Yadash
videos.overview: Baalveer remembers everything. Benaam asks Baalveeer to save her and her people. Later, Aageel decides to use ‘Lal Darwaza’ to destroy Baalveer.

videos.title: Control Kaashvi
videos.overview: Baalveer decides to leave his house on Dharti Lok. Aageel enters the ‘Lal Darwaza’ and finds a way to destroy Baalveer. Later, Baalveer’s family thinks he got into an accident.

videos.title: Dosti Ho Toh Aisi
videos.overview: Kinkori and Dilak put Baalveer in handcuffs. Later, Kinkori and Dilak hide Baaleer from Shaashmagh. Meanwhile, Aageel plans to control Kaashvi through Maha Jadoo inside her.

videos.title: Kaashvi Ka Pehla Jurm
videos.overview: Shashmaag finds out that Baalveer is looking for his mother. Kaashvi steals an expensive goddess statue from Baalveer’s house. Later, Shashmaag captures Baalveer.

videos.title: Kaashvi's Jealousy
videos.overview: Kinkori tries to protect Baalveer. Maha Mahin asks Shashmaag about Adishi’s whereabouts. Later, Kaashvi commits another sin.

videos.title: Kaashvi Ke Andar Ka Maha Jadoo
videos.overview: Kaashvi saves a girl from getting involved in an accident. However, it becomes increasingly challenging for Kaashvi to control the immense power of the Maha Jadoo within her. Meanwhile, Shashmaag traps Baalveer in a cage. How will Baalveer manage to escape?

videos.title: Maha Mahim And Shashmaag's Trap
videos.overview: Despite Baalveer's attempts to establish communication with his mother, he encounters difficulties. Maha Mahim and Shashmaag conspire to deceive Baalveer as part of their plan to capture him. Will Baalveer succumb to their trap?

videos.title: Baalveer Fights Maha Mahim
videos.overview: Baalveer choses to fight Maha Mahim as an intense battle ensues. Meanwhile, Aageel follows up on her evil plans and hypnotises Kaashvi.

videos.title: Maha Jaadu Ki Aag
videos.overview: Baalveer's family is worried about him performing his new fire act as they are worried about his safety. Meanwhile, Aageel continues to hypnotise Kaashvi and plans on ruining Baalveer's show by replacing the fire with her magical fire.

videos.title: Aageel Controls Kaashvi
videos.overview: Aageel uses her magic to control Kaashvi as Baalveer prepares for his fire show. Meanwhile, Shashmaagh tries to steal from Uttan.

videos.title: Baalveer Ka Jadui Show
videos.overview: Shashmaag takes Kurja’s help while Aageel asks Kaashvi to kill Baalveer. Later, Benaam asks Baalveer not to use his magical powers in the magic show. What will he do now?

videos.title: The Fire Show
videos.overview: Dilak and Konkori find Baalveer’s mother in a cave. Shashmaag decides to put Kurja’s soul in Baalveer’s mother’s body. Later, Baalveer lights himself on fire.

tt27908694.name: UP65
tt27908694.description: Based on a popular Hindi novel, this is a comimg of age youth comedy set around the lives of engineering students in Varanasi.

videos.title: Almost is a Lot
videos.overview: Nishant enters institute and has a perfect plan to dominate. Get a library card made, hide first-year books in the sociology section and avoid seniors at all costs. Only two of his three wishes come true.

videos.title: Ee Banaras Hai Maharaj!
videos.overview: Pandey is 'Bhasmasur' now and a private tour guide to Nishant. The Banaras Darshan is chaotic until Nishant experiences Ganga Aarti and finds someone special.

videos.title: High On Life
videos.overview: Nishant tries his best but finally succumbs to academic pressure. Curious about how Akhil got an A plus, Nishant enters Room no 116, but then a drunk text ruins everything.

videos.title: Banarasi Avengers Assemble!
videos.overview: When hangover washes out, half the campus wants to beat the shit out of Nishant. Boys have unknowingly messed with the most dangerous species on the campus.

videos.title: Yours Lovingly Shubhra
videos.overview: A nervous Nishant bunks lectures and goes on a pizza date with Shubhra. Meanwhile, Prasad strikes a golden opportunity but ends up hospitalizing himself.

videos.title: Pen Down Movement
videos.overview: Exams are around the corner, and our boys are scared. Kabadi Baba has an idea, but is it worth fighting for against the administration and Pawan Mishra?

videos.title: When Langoors met Angoors
videos.overview: After swiping right on every girl in a 450-kilometer radius, boys finally find love. Little did they know that maintaining a relationship would be 100 times more difficult.

videos.title: BHANGover
videos.overview: Every problem in Banaras has one solution: "Bhaang". To unlock their true potential in exams, our boys drink bhaang. Intoxication turns out to be an adventure.

videos.title: Aukaat Se Bahar Wala Pyaar
videos.overview: Pandey does everything to prove that he is the perfect boyfriend for Antari. Is it too late when he realizes that he has stretched his legs out of his blanket?

videos.title: Masti Ki Internshala
videos.overview: Everyone has a summer internship except for three freshers, Mohit, Prasad and Pandey. In pursuit of excellence, these three idiots learn that the only way to make their CVs impressive is, 'To Lie!'.

videos.title: Startup Karte Hain Bro!
videos.overview: Boys come to know of a college unicorn who got a million-dollar funding. They decide to join hands and participate in a start-up pitching fest. Easy peasy, right? They have no idea.

videos.title: Teen Tigaada Crypto Bigaada
videos.overview: Harassed and abused by loan sharks of the campus - dhobi, canteen wallah and chai wallah; boys decide to gamble. Under Akhil's leadership, they go all in Crypto, hoping for a humble 350x profit.

videos.title: Shaam-e-Banaras
videos.overview: After giving academic exams, it's time to address the elephant in the room. Pandey's future with Antari. The gang device a meticulous plan to turn the tables around.

videos.title: Ek Chutki Certificate Ki Keemat
videos.overview: Nishant and his friends have a hard time securing a certificate from their institute and fail miserably at their internship. However, they turn a blind eye to their problems when they get together at the institute.

videos.title: Naya Maal
videos.overview: Without Kabadi's induction, another batch of freshers has been served on a platter to Pawan Baklol. Can the gang save the batch and impart some culture to the young ones?

videos.title: Bell Curve ka Ghanta
videos.overview: The ECE department is full of toppers. The class average is reaching sky-high levels. At this point, can the boys welcome two more toppers into their branch?

videos.title: Mess ka Khaana
videos.overview: Pandey and the boys decide to protest against quality of food in the mess. Who will win this game of hunger? Mess Maharaj or The Boys.

videos.title: Tu Hai Kaun Bey!
videos.overview: After ignoring academics for almost three semesters, once again boys start dreaming. From cracking CAT and UPSC to a perfect 10 grade; everything is on the cards.

videos.title: Sutta hi na mila!
videos.overview: Antari and the boys go on a journey of fire and ashes from living happily with cigarettes to endless trials of leaving it. In the process they learn amazing things about themselves.

videos.title: Karwachauth ka Chaand
videos.overview: As outrageous as it may sound, committed people in the campus are observing the traditional festival of Karwachauth. Some will succeed to solidify their bond and some will fail.

videos.title: Parent Teacher Meeting
videos.overview: As if sending grade reports to home was not enough, Pawan Mishra has scheduled a Parents Teacher Meet. From Mess Maharaj to students everyone struggles to make things right before the parents arrive.

videos.title: Banarasiyaa
videos.overview: After successfully losing the startup competition in the first year, boys decide to give entrepreneurship another go. This time for a more personal cause.

videos.title: RAC Ticket
videos.overview: Valentine's day is around the corner. Couples are struggling to meet each other's expectations. While single males wish they can opt for temporary blindness till these festivities are over.

videos.title: Fest ka Bhokaal!
videos.overview: Mohit and Prasad join the organizing team of the college fest ULLAAS. But a careless mistake jeopardizes the whole fest. With institute reputations at stake can the gang salvage ULLAAS?

videos.title: French Kiss
videos.overview: Shubhra and Antari crack the esteemed Le Sage Scholarship and are shortlisted for a foreign internship in France. Will Nishant and Pandey support their partners and celebrate this victory or become insecure due to the much-hyped libido of French men?

videos.title: Lauh-purush
videos.overview: After the plan to buy a kickass electrical model from Kabaadi backfires, boys run around to find a way to score 40 out of 60 in the finals. Without the help of Shubhra and Antari can they do it?

tt27618691.name: Kafas
tt27618691.description: A middle-class family sees a brighter tomorrow when their son meets with a life-changing career opportunity. But this transition only unravels a web of trauma, raising poignant questions about wealth, power, and morality.

videos.title: Welcome Home Superstar
videos.overview: Seema and Raghav Vashisht, a middle-class couple, find their world shattered as their son, Sunny, who has just returned from the shoot of his debut film confides in them a terrible secret about the producer of the movie. As the inequality of power and stature between the predator and the family weighs heavily on them, will the Vashishts fight back?

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: The distraught parents are contacted by the producer's legal team offering them money in return for their silence on the subject. The couple is faced with the impossible choice between doing the right thing and accepting money that could turn their life around.

videos.title: Trailer Trouble
videos.overview: The family takes a giant financial leap as their fortunes turn after accepting the money. Sunny starts to act increasingly erratic even as he tries to get used to this whole new world and put his trauma behind. All seems well financially, but is it?

videos.title: Free Fall
videos.overview: Sunny’s erratic behavior shocks his parents, and their own guilt starts to rip the family apart from within. Unbeknownst to the parents, Sunny’s sister, Shreya, decides to take matters into her own hands to ensure that her brother’s abuser does not go unpunished.

videos.title: Laugh Out Loud
videos.overview: Amidst the promotional activities for the upcoming film, Sunny finds himself cornered by the producer. Meanwhile, Sunny’s sister enlists the help of a journalist, unaware of the dire consequences of her actions. The family is in for a rude shock, as things take an ugly turn and Sunny does the unthinkable.

videos.title: Next Steps
videos.overview: As the family hits rock bottom, they decide to defy all odds and fight back. But there is a huge price to pay in return for this defiance. Will the family reign victorious or will they lose to the far more influential powers?

tt14173900.name: Social Currency
tt14173900.description: Eight social media stars forgo their fame and followers as they vie for the title of ultimate influencer in this unpredictable reality show.

videos.title: Sunny with a chance of Drama!

tt27862209.name: Rafuchakkar
tt27862209.description: A twisted story that follows a con artist who must prove his innocence in the court of law.

videos.title: The game begins
videos.overview: Pawan Kumar Bawaria aka Prince, a con artist from Nainital, is caught by the Crime Branch officer, Shaurya Chautala, for duping eminent citizen Sarvesh Pathania. He is taken to court, where his friend Jaidev defends him against the public prosecutor.

videos.title: Cat and mouse
videos.overview: In a back-and-forth between the courtroom in the present and Shaurya's investigation in the past. Just when it seems that the case is swinging in Prince's favour, a new twist arises in the form of three new witnesses from Ahmedabad.

videos.title: Magic biscuits
videos.overview: A new con comes to light when the 3 witnesses allege that they have been conned by Kirtan Gada, an alibi of Pawan, posing as a fitness trainer. The noose tightens further around Prince as Ritu demands something that will nail him: a polygraph test.

videos.title: True or false
videos.overview: The Polygraph test begins. At first, Prince is able to dodge the questions but stumbles when he sees Harpreet Singh who alleges that he was conned by Manjeet Walia. The polygraph test turns the tables in favour of Ritu and Shaurya.

videos.title: Con the conman
videos.overview: The trial continues with Pawan yet to be proven guilty. This leads to a desperate situation and Pathania, Ritu, and Shaurya plan to trap Pawan. But their plans are laid bare when the Judge sides with Pawan and gives him bail.

videos.title: Double agent
videos.overview: Prince plans new cons and one of his victims includes who works as a property dealer in Gurgaon. He tries to persuade Ritu to join his side. But things don't go as smoothly as Shaurya begins to see through Prince's machinations.

videos.title: Blast from the past
videos.overview: Shaurya and Ritu plan to track Prince's past. Soon Prince is back in court. But Jaidev is absent, having dropped the case. With Shaurya, Pathania and Ritu, Prince finds himself surrounded. Ritu reveals a secret about Pawan's past.

videos.title: Motivation
videos.overview: Ritu reveals the real motive for every con that Prince has done and seeks punishment for him. Just then when hope seems lost, Prince has a saviour who helps turn the tables in his favour leaving Shaurya and Ritu frustrated.

videos.title: Birds of a feather
videos.overview: Prince presents proof of illegality against Pathania. He reveals the reason for Pathania's interest to see him apprehended. He accepts the charges, in return for Pathania's arrest. Is his new attitude towards Ritu and Shaurya another trick?

tt19868678.name: Jee Karda
tt19868678.description: Seven school friends -who thought that by the time they are 30 their life will be sorted- turn 30 to find that it’s a grand hot mess instead. They live, love, laugh, make mistakes, get their hearts broken, grow up a little but through it all discover that the best of friendships are imperfect and life is a luminous shade of grey.

tt27910159.name: Sarvam Shakthi Mayam
tt27910159.description: The personal journey of an atheist writer and a dysfunctional family as they embark on a pilgrimage to visit all 18 Maha Shakti Peethas.

videos.title: The Beginning of A Journey
videos.overview: Madhav is a failed businessman. His friend, Deepak, suggests he visit the 18 Maha Shakthipeeths with his family. Meanwhile, Ranjith, an atheist and an author, chooses the same places as the backdrop for his next book.

videos.title: More Trouble for Madhav
videos.overview: Madhav's family arrives in Alampuram, where Ranjith asks for his help. Kanaga invites the group for dinner and a stay. Priya's irritation with Madhav's financial troubles increases.

videos.title: Ranjith Discovers the Divine
videos.overview: Madhav's family and Ranjith travel to Pithapuram. Ranjith discovers the divine within while Madhav's fate becomes uncertain. Priya contemplates divorce if Madhav asks her father for help.

videos.title: Tribal Beliefs
videos.overview: Madhav collects sacred soil from the Girija Devi temple. Ranjith learns about tribal beliefs, and Madhav apologises to Pranav. The group spends the night in Kolkata. Priya is shocked by a revelation.

videos.title: Fiery Confrontations
videos.overview: In Guwahati, a fiery confrontation erupts between Priya and Madhav. The pressure starts mounting on Madhav. Ranjith's conversations and experiences prompt him to write about his journey.

videos.title: Going Separate Ways
videos.overview: In Prayagraj, Priya decides to end the trip, but Madhav pleads with her to wait until they reach Kashi. Ranjith receives some disappointing news about his health. Madhav's family splits as the members begin their individual journeys.

videos.title: Priya and Revathi's Epiphany
videos.overview: Ranjith's mother urges him to complete his book. Priya's conversation with Revathi leads her to embrace the uncertainty of their journey. Madhav and Pranav go to Kashmir, and Madhav receives sacred soil.

videos.title: Unexpected Encounters
videos.overview: Ranjith's encounter with a scientist sparks his interest in astrophysics and ancient wisdom. Madhav and Pranav meet an aghora. Priya searches for answers in Mahur as Madhav tries to reach her.

videos.title: Back Together
videos.overview: Revathi and Pranav have questions for their parents. Priya and Madhav cross paths and get back together when they learn about Ranjith's health. Ranjith encourages Madhav to visit Kanchi.

videos.title: The Final Transformation
videos.overview: In Kanchi, Ranjith's selfless act leaves Priya and Madhav in awe. The family reconciles and travels to Sri Lanka, where Madhav immerses the sacred soil from all the 18 peeths in the ocean.

tt15561862.name: Badtameez Dil
tt15561862.description: A woman who believes in the old-school magic of romance and a practical man who believes in modern-day dating fall in love despite their opposing ideas of romance

videos.title: Love Like A Poem
videos.overview: Liz, a timidly weird but lovable soul, loves to do what she’s doing. Enamored by her filmmaker friend Ari, she rushes to watch his premiere. Believing he loves her back, some dreams come down crushing after she realizes that he’s with someone else.

videos.title: I Hate Love
videos.overview: Karan meets a girl for marriage but later denies the proposal. Liz is busy eating, weeping, as she passes time to get over her heartbreak. She’s in for a shock after her sister reveals something about her relationship status.

videos.title: The Day It All Changed
videos.overview: Liz unintentionally lands up in Karan’s house to mend her broken heart. It’s time for the wedding fiesta as Krish and Anish are set to tie the knot! Amid the chaos, Liz’s mom introduces her to Sameer.

videos.title: Matchmaker
videos.overview: Liz feels bad after Ari comes to live in their house. Upon Karan’s advice, she goes on a date with Sameer. Keeping his problems aside, Karan helps Liz live her life to the fullest.

videos.title: Broken Threads
videos.overview: Liz catches a glimpse of Sameer with another woman and gets upset. Karan takes Liz with him on his mother’s anniversary. It all comes back to him after he recalls his downhearted past.

videos.title: Messy Emotions
videos.overview: Liz goes in-depth and learns about Karan’s past. She calls Aditi to mend things between him and her. Will the duo reconcile, or will things turn upside down all over again?

videos.title: Fumbling Words
videos.overview: Ari gets kicked out of Hailey’s life and he soon realizes that he loves Liz. He confesses his feelings to her, but will she accept him after all the mess that has been happening in her life? Karan and Aditi mend ways and they bump into Liz during Hailey’s delivery.

videos.title: Not Again, Please?
videos.overview: It’s an occasion of jubilation and high spirits as everyone gathers for Aditi’s child’s birthday. While Karan realizes that Liz is back with Sameer, she sees that he’s moved on with Anjali.

videos.title: Stuck Like Magna Tiles
videos.overview: Tasneem’s call brings Karan-Liz together again. However, their baggage of emotions meddles with their thoughts. Will the two finally realize what’s cooking in their hearts?

videos.title: Cheers To A New Mess!
videos.overview: Karan is overwhelmed as all goes well within his family. He goes down on his knees and proposes to Liz for marriage. Will the duo live happily ever after or does destiny have some other plans for them?

tt26345056.name: Chashni
tt26345056.description: An untoward incident mars the loving relationship between two sisters- Chandni and Roshni. Years later, fate brings them face to face only to find out that they are daughter-in-law and mother-in-law for each other. Thus, begins a typical saas-bahu saga.

videos.title: Chandni, Roshni's Tale Begins
videos.overview: Chandni and Roshni's lives are full of hardships due to Sanjay's work rivalry. While Chandni chooses to make him proud, Roshni is the polar opposite.

tt27759189.name: School of Lies
tt27759189.description: A young 12-year-old boy, who goes missing from a private boarding school, RISE, and how the subsequent domino effect it causes as the truth is only as complex as simple.

tt22297178.name: Scoop
tt22297178.description: A journalist's life takes a 180 because of the very system that made her who she is. Will she fight or will she concede?

tt15752618.name: Taj: Divided by Blood
tt15752618.description: In his quest to find a worthy successor for his grand legacy, Emperor Akbar sparks a war among his sons. What follows is a terrifying battle for power, filled with politics, betrayals, and bloodshed.

tt19868314.name: Dahaad
tt19868314.description: Sub-inspector Anjali Bhaati investigates a series of deaths where women are found in public bathrooms. The deaths first appear as suicides but as the investigation progresses, Bhaati realizes that there's a serial killer on the lo...

tt27548825.name: Fireflies: Parth aur Jugnu
tt27548825.description: A 14-year-old boy named Parth, who meets Jugnu, a mystical kid from the haunted forest of Bheem Mukteshwar.

videos.title: Bhakti, Shakti, Yukti
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose when Parth, a class 9 student who struggles with exam phobia, fails his exams. Everyone around him is concerned about how his academic failure has dented his father’s reputation.

videos.title: Shatru Ya Mitra
videos.overview: Jugnu, a boy with super-human powers, creates havoc in Parth’s school. Parth increasingly starts fearing Jugnu's presence but decides to return to the jungle and face his fears.

videos.title: Shortcut
videos.overview: Parth's friend, Johnson, decides to steal money from his dad to pay the re-evaluation fee for his papers and encourages Parth to do the same. As Parth struggles to make a decision, nani senses his dilemma.

videos.title: Jaan Lega Woh
videos.overview: Strange events occur at the CRC as several recovered patients have a relapse. Arjun is convinced that Vinita hiding something from him. At night, Parth sneaks into the woods to find Jugnu.

videos.title: Shaapit Tan
videos.overview: Parth confronts Jugnu, who is forced to reveal his story and how his destiny is tied to the Sanjeevani tree. Parth realises that Jugnu is not the monster everyone makes him out to be.

videos.title: Raakshas
videos.overview: Parth introduces Jugnu to his friends, all of whom agree to take Jugnu to school. The kids seem to have a good time until Hooda enters the classroom.

videos.title: Magic Does Not Exist
videos.overview: Nani believes it is no longer safe for her to keep Ohri's book with her. Sleeman decides to change his strategy after another failed experiment. Arjun focuses on conducting the tests outside the CRC.

videos.title: Ringmaster
videos.overview: Sleeman ultimately decides to track down Jugnu as he is the key to accessing Sanjeevani. Laffu unintentionally talks about nani's copy of Ohri's book to Nyasa.

videos.title: Vishwas Aur Andhvishwas
videos.overview: Sleeman blackmails the mayor into ordering a lockdown at the CRC and in the jungle. An anxious Anamika asks the kids to stay indoors. When Parth and the group learn about the lockdown, they decide to sneak into the jungle.

videos.title: Amrit Poornima
videos.overview: The fateful night of Amrit Poornima is here, and it is Sleeman's only chance to get his hands on Sanjeevani and become immortal. His is a race against time, but so is Jugnu's. Who will win?

tt27442834.name: Saas, Bahu Aur Flamingo
tt27442834.description: Savitri, the matriarch of a massive cartel in the lawless Borderlands, opens up a battle for succession to find her heir in a murky world of drugs and violence.

tt27548904.name: The Haunting
tt27548904.description: Moushmi is accused of killing her best friend and roommate, but claims that it is a demon who made her do this, she is innocent.

tt27369003.name: Garmi
tt27369003.description: Arvind Shukla is on the path to fulfil his dreams. Will he, however, lose his way in the world of politics, crime, and deceit?

videos.title: Hello I Am Arvind…Arvind Shukla
videos.overview: A not-so-willing Arvind Shukla gains admission into Trivenipur University and is favoured by the president of the college for hostel accommodation. Little does he know that he has entered a college known for the political rivalry between two leaders, Bindu Singh and Govind Maurya.

videos.title: Feels Like Hell
videos.overview: Welcomed by the seniors in the traditional manner, Arvind turns the tables and gives them a piece of his mind. From making new friends to understanding the dynamics of college politics, Arvind’s journey has just begun.

videos.title: Say Hello To The Devil
videos.overview: As love begins to bloom for Arvind, he warms up to the place he wasn't keen to set foot on. A man of values, Arvind slowly starts to become a part of the college's political web.

videos.title: End Of Innocence
videos.overview: In a fraction of a second, Arvind's life takes a turn when he sees his first love committing suicide because of the humiliation she faces. Her actions were instigated by none other than the college president, Bindu Singh.

videos.title: Everything Is Fair In Love And War
videos.overview: Govind Maurya schemes an alliance with Arvind due to pressure from the higher-ups in the political game. Projected as the reason for his girlfriend’s death, Arvind decides to take revenge on Bindu Singh with the help of Govind and his best friend, Ajay.

videos.title: Welcome To Politics
videos.overview: After Arvind shoots Bindu in his hostel room, Mrityunjay, a police officer, deduces that Bindu's murder was a personal vendetta and decides to destroy Arvind. Arvind’s revenge throws him into the dirty game of college politics, which is inescapable. Meanwhile, Govind Maurya, who has not taken the moves of the political higher-ups kindly, finds the initial seeds of jealousy towards Arvind sown in his mind.

videos.title: Blood Vs Books
videos.overview: Govind capitalises on Bindu's comatose state and threatens the road contractor to give him Bindu's share. Meanwhile, all the forces come together to get Arvind out from jail. Arvind, focusing on studying in jail for his upcoming exams, gets coaxed into meeting a dangerous criminal from Meerut, who becomes his new sworn enemy.

videos.title: What's Brewing?
videos.overview: Arvind’s rising popularity in the university has started to concern Govind, who fears he will end up losing control. Govind decides to take matters into his own hands and destroys the college road but is caught by Mrityunjay. Govind’s impulsive act costs him the power to contest the election as President to none other than Arvind Shukla.

videos.title: Hello I Am Arvind Shukla..REBOOTED
videos.overview: As Bindu recovers, Arvind, now a completely different person, finds himself part of a dirty game not liked by many. The threats in Arvind's life are bigger and greater than before.

tt21908726.name: Dancing on the Grave
tt21908726.description: The disappearance of a wealthy heiress sparks a search for answers by family members and police alike. She had abandoned the trappings of aristocratic heritage and formed a union with a mysterious godman – What happened to Shakereh, and more urgently, where did she go?

tt27191658.name: Tooth Pari: When Love Bites
tt27191658.description: A rebellious vampire with a broken tooth falls for a shy dentist on the streets of Kolkata but will human and mystical forces keep them apart?

tt19868804.name: Jubilee
tt19868804.description: In a newly independent India, a studio boss, his movie-star wife, a trusted aide, a nautch girl and a refugee will have their paths cross in their pursuit of stardom and riches.

tt27252197.name: Angrezi Mat Jhaad
tt27252197.description:
Mana English na aane ki wajah se mili hai tumko haar, kabhi nahi kar paaye pyaar ka izhaar aur kabhi gawar keh kar chale gaye dost yaar lekin abh ho jaao taiyyar aur keh do "Angrezi Mat Jhaad"

Featuring Mayur More (also known for his role as Vaibhav in Kota Factory), Deepak Kumar Mishra (well known director of our famous show Panchayat) and Pratish Mehta (popular for for Pandya Vlog)

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hindi section ka star performer Sandeep (Mayur More, who has also worked in Kota Factory) khaa jaata hai Angrezi ke aage maat, lekin sawal yeh hai ki kya uska yeh darr de jaayega usko uske zindagi ki har cheezo mein maat?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: It's time for an office party, Sandeep has come out to break the English wall between himself and Krish! Do you think you will be able to express your feelings?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In the frustration of not knowing English, Sandeep misbehaved in front of Namita because of which he was fined.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Sandeep's patience is over, now he is going to start the journey of learning English, but will this path be easy for him!

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Chadha hai Sandeep pe English department mein jaane ka bukhaar lekin uski yeh ichha laa rahi hai office dosti mein daraar. Abh kya Sandeep chhod dega Dost Yaar ya phir Angrezi ka ki thought?

tt15055202.name: IRL: In Real Love
tt15055202.description: Four singles looking for love face the ups and downs of connecting in real life and online. Will they choose virtual romance or go offline?

videos.title: Crushing on You, You and You
Quit Playing Games With My Heart

tt27055809.name: United Kacche
tt27055809.description: Tango's biggest dream in life is to shift abroad from his pind in Punjab. He finally manages, but as a kachcha, an illegal immigrant. Is life in the UK as rosy as Tango thought it would be?

videos.title: London Aaye?
videos.overview: Tejinder Gill, a.k.a. Tango, lands in the UK, leaving behind his family. He has given away his ancestral land to fulfil his father’s dream of shifting to the UK. But will things go as planned?

videos.title: Jet Lag
videos.overview: Tango learns about the do’s and don’ts of living in the UK from his housemates. He is shocked when a ghost from his past appears while he is looking for a job.

videos.title: Pehli Job, Dusra Pyaar
videos.overview: Tango’s struggles come to an end as he lands his first job. Sajjad’s mysterious meeting goes well. Tango has a crush on Daisy, but it’s only a matter of time before his past catches up.

videos.title: Bus-king
videos.overview: Sajjad and Zareen need to pay their rent and inform Tango about it. Tango asks his shady roommate, Shampy for help and he has a plan. They get into trouble for busking at the Piccadilly circus.

videos.title: Halloween Mubarak
videos.overview: It’s Halloween! Tango and his housemates plan a party. Daisy brings her friend Christina, who gets smitten by Tango. However he has other plans for the night.

videos.title: Shaadi at the Strip
videos.overview: Tango’s visa expires and now he is officially a Kaccha. When Daisy refuses to forgive him, he agrees to Shampy’s scheme – Fake Marriage. Will this scheme help or land him in a bigger mess?

videos.title: Love Bite
videos.overview: A new revelation has Tango angry and happy at the same time. He decides to focus on being happy and visits the bar. A drunk Tango returns home only to be bitten by a venomous spider.

videos.title: The Kaccha Heist
videos.overview: Patel kicks the ‘kacchas’ out of the house and Tango tries to cheer them up. Shampy needs money for his mother’s operation, so the kacchas come together and plan a heist.

tt20118220.name: Happy Family, Conditions Apply
tt20118220.description: Meet the Dholakias, a family of four generations living under one roof, as they navigate the ups and downs of their lives. While they appear to be picture perfect, they are endearingly, heartbreakingly human, each with their unique quirks and quibbles. Follow their journey as they try their best to navigate through all the things life throws at them.

videos.title: To Go Or Not To Go

tt27050076.name: Hunter - Tootega Nahi, Todega
tt27050076.description: Hunter is an action thriller web series that follows Suniel Shetty as ACP Vikram in his journey to the dark alleys of Mumbai's crime world. A mission to find a missing woman leads him juggling between his past and future.

tt7401524.name: Tenali Rama
tt7401524.description: The story of the legendary poet in Emperor Krishnadevaraya's court who uses his timely wit and intelligence to solve even the trickiest problems and becomes very popular in the King's court.
